# Cedar Design Web

> Vue 3 component library. Package: @cedar-design/ui. Component prefix: C / c-.

Read the quick start and the relevant component page before generating code. Follow the documented props, events, slots, imports and styles. Do not substitute APIs from another component library.

Documentation language: en-US.

# Affix

The same scenarios, parameters and interactions as Cedar. Only component prefixes differ; themes and site shells remain independent.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/affix/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const containerRef = ref<HTMLElement>()
</script>

<template>
  <p>Scroll inside the bordered area.</p>
  <div ref="containerRef" class="scroller">
    <div class="scroll-content">
      <c-affix :target="containerRef"><c-button status="primary">Basic usage</c-button></c-affix>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.scroller {
  height: 200px;
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
}
.scroll-content {
  min-height: 600px;
  padding: 16px;
}
</style>
```

## Layout and arrangement

### Affix direction, offset and container

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | Scroller or selector; finds nearest scrolling ancestor when omitted, falling back to window | Affix direction, offset and container |
| `offset-top` | Distance from the scroll container top; accepts CSS lengths | Affix direction, offset and container |
| `offset-bottom` | Distance from the bottom; takes precedence over offset-top, including 0 | Affix direction, offset and container |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

## Interaction and control

### Change event

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | Scroller or selector; finds nearest scrolling ancestor when omitted, falling back to window | Change event, Disabled, CSS mode and manual update |
| `offset-top` | Distance from the scroll container top; accepts CSS lengths | Change event, Disabled, CSS mode and manual update |
| `disabled` | Disable affixing | Disabled, CSS mode and manual update |
| `css-mode` | Use native position: sticky, subject to ancestor overflow and container boundaries | Disabled, CSS mode and manual update |
| `z-index` | Stacking level | Disabled, CSS mode and manual update |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/affix/__demos__/fix-change.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const containerRef = ref<HTMLElement>()
const fixed = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <p>Scroll inside the bordered area.</p>
  <div ref="containerRef" class="scroller">
    <div class="scroll-content">
      <div style="height: 40px"></div>
      <c-affix :target="containerRef" :offset-top="20" @change="fixed = $event"
        ><c-button status="primary">Change event</c-button></c-affix
      >
    </div>
  </div>
  <p role="status">Fixed: {{ fixed }}</p>
</template>

<style scoped>
.scroller {
  height: 200px;
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
}
.scroll-content {
  min-height: 600px;
  padding: 16px;
}
</style>
```

### Disabled, CSS mode and manual update

Example source: src/affix/__demos__/controls.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { nextTick, ref } from "vue";
const containerRef = ref<HTMLElement>();
const affixRef = ref<{ updatePosition: () => Promise<void> }>();
const disabled = ref(false);
const cssMode = ref(false);
const spacerHeight = ref(40);
const updates = ref(0);
async function updateLayout() {
  spacerHeight.value = spacerHeight.value === 40 ? 100 : 40;
  await nextTick();
  await affixRef.value?.updatePosition();
  updates.value++;
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-space wrap size="12px" style="margin-bottom: 12px">
    <c-checkbox v-model="disabled"> Disabled</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="cssMode"> CSS sticky</c-checkbox>
    <c-button @click="updateLayout">Change layout and update position</c-button>
  </c-space>
  <p aria-live="polite">Position updates: {{ updates }}</p>
  <div ref="containerRef" class="scroller">
    <div class="scroll-content">
      <div :style="{ height: `${spacerHeight}px` }"></div>
      <c-affix
        ref="affixRef"
        :target="containerRef"
        :disabled="disabled"
        :css-mode="cssMode"
        :offset-top="12"
        :z-index="2"
      >
        <c-button status="primary">Scroll to pin</c-button>
      </c-affix>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.scroller {
  height: 200px;
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
}
.scroll-content {
  min-height: 600px;
  padding: 16px;
}
</style>
```

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->
### Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| offset-top | Distance from the scroll container top; accepts CSS lengths | `number / string` | `0` |
| offset-bottom | Distance from the bottom; takes precedence over offset-top, including 0 | `number / string` | `undefined` |
| target | Scroller or selector; finds nearest scrolling ancestor when omitted, falling back to window | `string / HTMLElement / Window` | `undefined` |
| target-container | Extra outer scroller to listen to; omitted means no extra listener, and it is not a clipping boundary | `string / HTMLElement / Window` | `undefined` |
| z-index | Stacking level | `number / string` | `10` |
| disabled | Disable affixing | `boolean` | `false` |
| css-mode | Use native position: sticky, subject to ancestor overflow and container boundaries | `boolean` | `false` |

### Events

| Event | Arguments and timing |
| --- | --- |
| change | `(fixed: boolean, offset: number)`, emitted when the fixed state changes. While fixed, offset is the affix threshold; otherwise it is the distance to the corresponding container edge. Disabling affixing reports 0. |

### Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | Content to affix | — |

### Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| updatePosition | Rebind scrollers and recalculate on the next animation frame | — | `Promise<void>` |

### Platform notes

Props, event arguments, slots and public methods match across platforms. CSS mode follows browser sticky rules; examples use independent scroll containers.
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { AffixInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

## Appearance and states

### Appearance configuration comparison

Choose an axis to compare its available values with the same content and model. Other settings remain unchanged while comparing.

Example source: src/alert/__demos__/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive as __demoReactive } from "vue";

const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({
  variant: "tonal",
  status: "default",
});

import { computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from 'vue'
const demoCompareFields = [{"name":"variant","values":["tonal","outline","standard"]},{"name":"status","values":["info","success","warning","danger","default"]}]
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef("variant")
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(() => demoCompareFields.find(field => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)?.values ?? [])
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          aria-label="variant"
          :options="[
            { label: 'tonal', value: 'tonal' },
            { label: 'outline', value: 'outline' },
            { label: 'standard', value: 'standard' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="status">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['status']"
          aria-label="status"
          :options="[
            { label: 'info', value: 'info' },
            { label: 'success', value: 'success' },
            { label: 'warning', value: 'warning' },
            { label: 'danger', value: 'danger' },
            { label: 'default', value: 'default' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint"><span lang="zh-CN">选择一个对比维度；其他配置和内容保持一致。输入类示例共享同一个值，便于比较外观。</span><span lang="en-US">Compare one dimension while keeping the other settings and content identical. Input specimens share the same value.</span></p>
<c-radio-group v-model="demoCompareAxis" aria-label="Compare configuration" :options="demoCompareFields.map(field => ({ label: field.name, value: field.name }))" />
<div class="demo-config-comparison">
<section v-for="sample in demoComparedOptions" :key="String(sample)">
<p><code>{{ demoCompareAxis }}={{ sample }}</code></p>
<c-alert v-bind="{ ...__demoAppearance, [demoCompareAxis]: sample }">This is an info alert.</c-alert>
</section>
</div>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.demo-config-comparison { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr)); gap: 20px; min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; }
.demo-config-comparison > section { min-width: 0; }
.demo-config-comparison p { margin: 0 0 8px; }
html:not([lang='en-US']) .demo-config-comparison-hint > [lang='en-US'],
html[lang='en-US'] .demo-config-comparison-hint > [lang='zh-CN'] { display: none; }
</style>
```

## API

### `<Alert>` Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| status | Alert status | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger' \| 'default'` | `'info'` |
| variant | Visual variant | `'standard' \| 'tonal' \| 'outline'` | `'standard'` |
| color | Custom background color; overrides the background derived from type | `string` | - |
| title | Alert title | `string` | - |
| message | Content text; the default slot can also supply it | `string` | - |
| show-icon | Whether to show an icon | `boolean` | `true` |
| closable | Whether to show the close button | `boolean` | `false` |
| banner | Whether to display a top banner without borders or rounded corners | `boolean` | `false` |
| center | Whether to center the content | `boolean` | `false` |
| elevation | Elevation: `true`, `false`, or a level from `0-24` | `boolean \| number` | `false` |

### `<Alert>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ----------------------------- |
| close | Triggered when the Close button is clicked and can only be used when the Close button is displayed | `(event: MouseEvent) => void` |
| closed | Emitted after close transition | - |

### `<Alert>` Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| ---------- | -------- | ---- |
| default | Content | - |
| icon | Icon | - |
| title | Title | - |
| action | Actions | - |
| close-icon | The close icon of alert | - |

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types:

```ts
import type {
  AlertInstance,
  AlertProps,
  AlertStatus,
  AlertVariant,
} from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

### Style variables

See `style/token.less`; all variables use the `--c-alert-` prefix. Example override:

```css
:root {
  --c-alert-padding-vertical: 12px;
  --c-alert-padding-horizontal: 20px;
}
```

## Migration notes (breaking changes)

| Previous API | Current API |
| -- | -- |
| `type="error"` | `type="danger"` |
| `type="normal"` | `type="default"` |
| `closeable` | `closable` |
| `#close-element` slot | `#close-icon` slot |

Added capabilities: `variant` / `color` / `elevation` / `default` status / `closed` event.

`type="default"` renders no built-in icon. Use `#icon` when an icon is needed.

## Shared implementation and platform boundaries

Each platform maintains a complete local implementation. They do not import a common core or share component instances or reactive state. Changes must update both implementations. Component bodies, props, key styles and paired tests have read-only source consistency checks; theme tokens and installation entries remain local to each library.

The close button supports keyboard activation. close fires once, and closed fires after the leave transition. Maple renamed its internal __close-icon class to __close-btn. Default icons are adapted locally in each library.

### Complete variable defaults

Colored titles, content, icons and outline borders use readable system content colors. standard and tonal share the same level-1 background; standard adds a subtle decorative border. Default titles use content-primary; body text and icons use content-secondary. The content variable also sets the root inherited color, used by close icons and actions without an explicit color. Maple dark mode inherits these colors while retaining its geometry overrides: 16px padding, 22px icons, 12px icon/close gaps and 1.5 body line height. color changes only the background; callers must also verify foreground contrast. The table lists :root defaults, not theme overrides.

| Variable | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-alert-padding-vertical` | `var(--c-sys-space-4)` |
| `--c-alert-padding-horizontal` | `var(--c-sys-space-6)` |
| `--c-alert-padding-vertical-with-title` | `var(--c-sys-space-6)` |
| `--c-alert-padding-horizontal-with-title` | `var(--c-sys-space-6)` |

### Scroll Lifecycle

Example source: src/anchor/__demos__/scroll-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import Anchor, { AnchorLink } from "../index";

const active = ref(true);
const mounted = ref(true);
const container = ref<HTMLElement>();
const changes = ref(0);
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <c-button html-type="button" @click="active = !active"
      >切换 KeepAlive</c-button
    >
    <c-button html-type="button" @click="mounted = !mounted"
      >卸载／挂载</c-button
    >
    <p>
      切换链接后立即停用或卸载；激活后再次点击，检查旧滚动不会恢复。change
      通知：{{ changes }}
    </p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <Anchor
        v-if="active"
        :scroll-container="container"
        :change-hash="false"
        @change="changes++"
      >
        <AnchorLink href="#anchor-lifecycle-first" title="第一段" />
        <AnchorLink href="#anchor-lifecycle-second" title="第二段" />
      </Anchor>
    </KeepAlive>
    <div ref="container" style="height: 180px; overflow: auto">
      <section id="anchor-lifecycle-first" style="min-height: 240px">
        第一段内容
      </section>
      <section id="anchor-lifecycle-second" style="min-height: 240px">
        第二段内容
      </section>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

The axis, highlight and indentation follow reading start. Vertical scrolling and anchor targets remain unchanged.

## API

### `<anchor>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | :-------: |
| boundary | Scrolling `boundary` value. After setting the value to a number, it will stop scrolling when the distance is `boundary` from the scrolling container. | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'center' \| 'nearest' \| number` | `'start'` |
| show-line | Whether to show the left axis | `boolean` | `true` |
| show-background | Whether to show the background | `boolean` | `true` |
| scroll-container | Scroll container | `string \| HTMLElement \| Window` | `-` |
| change-hash | Whether to change the hash. When set to `false`, clicking on the anchor will not change the hash of the page | `boolean` | `true` |

### `<anchor>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------ | ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ |
| select | Emitted when the user clicks a link | hash: `string \| undefined`<br>preHash: `string` |
| change | Emitted when the active link changes | hash: `string` |

### `<anchor-link>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------ | ------------------ | -------- | :----: |
| title | Anchor link text | `string` | `-` |
| href | Anchor link URL | `string` | `-` |

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { AnchorInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

<!-- Source: src/auto-complete/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/auto-complete/ -->

# AutoComplete

Text input with suggested completions. Suggestions are arrays; application code owns remote loading.

## Reading direction

The editor and suggestion popup inherit source dir, including in custom containers. Horizontal caret keys keep native editing behavior; vertical keys navigate candidates, Enter selects and Escape closes. Candidate updates preserve the native composition buffer until composition ends instead of repainting the previous model value.

## Search and visibility

case-sensitive replaces the removed strict prop. Default matching searches label and ignores case; use search-fields to include value. Custom filter-option callbacks own their case policy; filter-option=false bypasses local filtering for remote results. AutoComplete has no public open/defaultOpen/update:open API: focusing and typing determine suggestion visibility. trigger-props can customize placement but cannot force internal open state. A public v-model:open would require a separate API change.

## Basic examples

### Basic

Example source: src/auto-complete/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-auto-complete
    v-model="value"
    :options="options"
    placeholder="输入或选择城市"
    clearable
    style="width: 100%; max-width: 320px"
  />
  <p>当前值：{{ value || '-' }}</p>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('')
const options = [
  'Beijing',
  { value: 310000, label: 'Shanghai' },
  { value: 'chengdu', label: 'Chengdu' },
  { value: 'wuhan', label: 'Wuhan', disabled: true },
]
</script>
```

### Interaction state comparison

Toggle disabled, read-only and error states, then interact with the same instance. Recovery controls remain outside the target; error appearance alone does not validate data.

#### State Lab

## Appearance and states

### Appearance configuration comparison

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose                                                                  | Related examples                    |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------- |
| `options`     | Suggestions, including groups; unique values become strings on selection | Appearance configuration comparison |
| `clearable`   | Allow clearing a nonempty editable value                                 | Appearance configuration comparison |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

Choose a dimension to compare all its values side by side while keeping other settings and content identical. Change the other settings to inspect combinations; input specimens share one model.

Example source: src/auto-complete/__demos__/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive as __demoReactive } from "vue";
import { ref } from "vue";
const value = ref("研发");
const options = [{ value: "研发" }, { value: "研发平台" }, { value: "设计" }];
const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: "filled", size: "md" });

import { computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from 'vue'
const demoCompareFields = [{"name":"variant","values":["filled","outline","standard"]},{"name":"size","values":["xs","sm","md","lg","xl"]}]
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef("variant")
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(() => demoCompareFields.find(field => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)?.values ?? [])
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          aria-label="variant"
          :options="[
            { label: 'filled', value: 'filled' },
            { label: 'outline', value: 'outline' },
            { label: 'standard', value: 'standard' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="size">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['size']"
          aria-label="size"
          :options="[
            { label: 'xs', value: 'xs' },
            { label: 'sm', value: 'sm' },
            { label: 'md', value: 'md' },
            { label: 'lg', value: 'lg' },
            { label: 'xl', value: 'xl' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint"><span lang="zh-CN">选择一个对比维度；其他配置和内容保持一致。输入类示例共享同一个值，便于比较外观。</span><span lang="en-US">Compare one dimension while keeping the other settings and content identical. Input specimens share the same value.</span></p>
<c-radio-group v-model="demoCompareAxis" aria-label="Compare configuration" :options="demoCompareFields.map(field => ({ label: field.name, value: field.name }))" />
<div class="demo-config-comparison">
<section v-for="sample in demoComparedOptions" :key="String(sample)">
<p><code>{{ demoCompareAxis }}={{ sample }}</code></p>
<c-auto-complete
      v-model="value"
      :options="options"
      clearable
      v-bind="{ ...__demoAppearance, [demoCompareAxis]: sample }"
    ></c-auto-complete>
</section>
</div>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.demo-config-comparison { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr)); gap: 20px; min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; }
.demo-config-comparison > section { min-width: 0; }
.demo-config-comparison p { margin: 0 0 8px; }
html:not([lang='en-US']) .demo-config-comparison-hint > [lang='en-US'],
html[lang='en-US'] .demo-config-comparison-hint > [lang='zh-CN'] { display: none; }
</style>
```

## Matching and suggestions

### Opening Policy

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration    | Purpose                                                                  | Related examples                              |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------- |
| `options`        | Suggestions, including groups; unique values become strings on selection | Opening Policy, Case Sensitive, Group Spacing |
| `placeholder`    | Placeholder or floating hint text                                        | Opening Policy, Case Sensitive, Group Spacing |
| `should-open`    | Opening policy; does not filter candidates                               | Opening Policy, Group Spacing, Virtual List   |
| `filter-option`  | Filter by label; false for remote filtering                              | Opening Policy                                |
| `case-sensitive` | Case-sensitive built-in matching                                         | Case Sensitive                                |
| `trigger-props`  | Trigger configuration; cannot override owned opening and disabled state  | Group Spacing                                 |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

Example source: src/auto-complete/__demos__/opening-policy.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const value = ref("");
const allowEmpty = ref(false);
const filter = ref(true);
const shouldOpen = (text: string) => allowEmpty.value || text.length >= 2;
const options = ["Cedar", "Maple", "Vue"];
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="md">
    <c-checkbox v-model="allowEmpty"> 允许空输入展开</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="filter"> 按输入过滤候选</c-checkbox>
    <c-auto-complete
      v-model="value"
      :options="options"
      :filter-option="filter"
      :should-open="shouldOpen"
      placeholder="默认输入两个字符后展开"
    />
    <p>展开条件不负责过滤；即使允许展开，没有匹配候选也不显示菜单。</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Async data and configuration

### Remote

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration   | Purpose                                                                  | Related examples            |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------- |
| `options`       | Suggestions, including groups; unique values become strings on selection | Remote, Passthrough Options |
| `filter-option` | Filter by label; false for remote filtering                              | Remote                      |
| `placeholder`   | Placeholder or floating hint text                                        | Remote                      |
| `disabled`      | Disabled; inherited when unset, explicit false overrides                 | Passthrough Options         |
| `should-open`   | Opening policy; does not filter candidates                               | Passthrough Options         |
| `trigger-props` | Trigger configuration; cannot override owned opening and disabled state  | Passthrough Options         |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

Example source: src/auto-complete/__demos__/remote.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-auto-complete
    v-model="value"
    :options="options"
    :filter-option="false"
    placeholder="输入关键字获取远程建议"
    style="width: 100%; max-width: 320px"
    @search="handleSearch"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('')
const options = ref<string[]>([])

let requestId = 0
onBeforeUnmount(() => requestId++)
const handleSearch = async (keyword: string) => {
  const current = ++requestId
  const result = await Promise.resolve(keyword ? Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, index) => `${keyword}-${index + 1}`) : [])
  if (current === requestId) options.value = result
}
</script>
```

### Passthrough Options

Example source: src/auto-complete/__demos__/passthrough-options.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { AutoCompleteTriggerOptions } from "@cedar-design/ui";
const disabled = ref(false);
const triggerOptions: AutoCompleteTriggerOptions = {
  placement: "top-start",
  popupOffset: 8,
  popupContainer: false,
};
const options = [
  { value: "USER_A", label: "Apple" },
  { value: "USER_B", label: "Banana" },
];
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" fill>
    <c-button @click="disabled = !disabled">{{
      disabled ? "启用输入" : "禁用输入"
    }}</c-button>
    <c-auto-complete
      edit-mode="direct"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :should-open="() => true"
      :options="options"
      :trigger-props="triggerOptions"
      aria-label="透传配置示例"
    />
    <p role="status">
      顶层 disabled：{{ disabled }}；聚焦输入框查看向上展开的候选。
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Events

| Event                                     | Arguments                                                     |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `update:model-value`                      | `value: string`                                               |
| `input / search / change`                 | `value: string, event: Event`                                 |
| `select`                                  | `value: string, option: AutoCompleteOptionInfo, event: Event` |
| `clear`                                   | `event: Event`                                                |
| `focus / blur`                            | `event: FocusEvent`                                           |
| `dropdown-scroll / dropdown-reach-bottom` | `event: Event`                                                |

Typing: `input → update:modelValue → search`; selection: `update:modelValue → select → change`; clear: `clear → input → update:modelValue → change`. Selecting the same value emits only select. change is a commit on blur, Enter or selection. Input owns typing/focus/clear Form notifications; AutoComplete notifies Form once for suggestion commits. Selection applies maxLength; select.value is the committed string, while option.value retains the original suggestion. clear receives an event, not a string.

### Slots

| Slot              | Description                        |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `option`          | `{ data: AutoCompleteOptionInfo }` |
| `footer`          | Menu footer                        |
| `prefix / suffix` | Input prefix / suffix              |
| `clear-icon`      | `{ clear }`                        |

### Methods

`focus()` / `blur()`

label is text. Use the option slot or an option render function for complex candidates; function/VNode labels are not supported. Arrow keys browse, Enter selects, Escape closes, and Tab retains native focus navigation. Vue useId keeps SSR identifiers stable.

Clearing does not emit search or reopen candidates, including when focus returns from a keyboard-focused clear button to the input. The parent controls the value: each rejected clear or selection still emits a change proposal; an accepted candidate selection notifies Form once.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

Suggestions share Select’s list, group, selected and disabled styles. AutoComplete style variables follow the corresponding Select variables by default. In `inline` mode, the list opens below the input and follows scrolling; use `trigger-props` to explicitly change placement or enable automatic flipping. In `popup` mode, candidates use the same full editor surface as Select.

### Public type exports

Root and component entries export `AutoCompleteEmits`、`AutoCompleteSlots`、`AutoCompleteExpose` alongside Props and Instance. Emits are event argument tuples derived from the runtime validators; Expose contains focus/blur.

`case-sensitive` only makes built-in local filtering `case-sensitive`: `ap` matches `Apple` when false, but not when true. It does not require choosing an option or validate the value. A custom `filterOption` takes priority; `filterOption=false` disables local filtering and makes `case-sensitive` irrelevant.

### Migrating strict / Migration

The old `strict` prop is removed. Use `case-sensitive` (`caseSensitive` in TypeScript) instead; boolean meanings and the default false remain unchanged. This removal is marked for the next major release, without a compatibility alias.

### Built-in search fields

`searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` configures the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type, null, or a zero-argument factory. Omitting it preserves the existing default. Use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on each clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine empty values, change Form reset defaults, or treat 0/false as universally empty.
Text and person-ID models remain strings; use an empty string or a business-defined string sentinel.

## Loading options through a function prop

Pass options(query, { signal }) directly; useAsyncData is unnecessary. options still accepts arrays, and an explicit array, including [], takes precedence. The component manages loading, stale-result isolation and cancellation. load-error reports failures, and the instance refresh() method retries. A business loader may accept only query and ignore the second argument.

filterable enables entering a search query. filterOption controls only local matching and never sends requests. With an options loader, remote results are not filtered again by default; with only an array, local matching is enabled by default. Most callers do not need filter-option.

```vue
<c-auto-complete v-model="text" :options="loadSuggestions" />
```

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

# Avatar

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

- `color`: Overrides the color.

Example source: src/avatar/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space align="center" :size="16" wrap>
    <c-avatar>C</c-avatar>
    <c-avatar>CD</c-avatar>
    <c-avatar shape="square">Cedar</c-avatar>
    <c-avatar color="#00bebe">U</c-avatar>

  </c-space>
</template>
```

```vue
<template>
  <c-space align="flex-end" :size="32" wrap>
    <c-space direction="column" align="center" :size="8">
      <c-avatar image-url="/cat.jpg" alt="编辑头像" :size="56" @click="onClick('button')">
        <template #trigger-icon>+</template>
      </c-avatar>
      <span class="label">{{ last === 'button' ? 'click · button' : 'trigger-type="button"' }}</span>
    </c-space>

    <c-space direction="column" align="center" :size="8">
      <c-avatar
        image-url="/cat2.jpg"
        alt="更换头像"
        :size="56"
        trigger-type="overlay"
        @click="onClick('overlay')"
      >
        <template #trigger-icon>+</template>
      </c-avatar>
      <span class="label">{{ last === 'overlay' ? 'click · overlay' : 'trigger-type="overlay"' }}</span>
    </c-space>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const last = ref('')

function onClick(type: string) {
  last.value = type
}
</script>

  color: var(--c-color-text-3);
  font-size: var(--c-font-size-sm);
```

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->
### Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| shape | Avatar shape | `circle / square` | `circle` |
| image-url | Image URL | `string` | `-` |
| alt | Image alternative text | `string` | `''` |
| size | Avatar width and height; numbers are px, strings are CSS lengths | `number / string` | `-` |
| auto-fix-font-size | Whether to shrink long text automatically | `boolean` | `true` |
| trigger-type | How the action icon is shown | `button / overlay` | `button` |
| trigger-icon-style | Custom style for the action icon | `CSSProperties` | `-` |
| object-fit | Image fitting mode | `fill / contain / cover / none / scale-down` | `cover` |
| color | Background color | `string` | `-` |
| bordered | Whether to show a border | `boolean` | `false` |
| border-color | Border color | `string` | `-` |
| loading | Placeholder image while loading | `string` | `-` |
| error | Fallback image URL when image loading fails | `string` | `-` |
| lazy | Whether to lazy-load the image | `boolean` | `false` |
| hoverable | Whether to scale on hover | `boolean` | `false` |

### Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| click | Emitted when the avatar is clicked | `(event: MouseEvent) => void` |
| load | Emitted when the image loads | `() => void` |
| error | Emitted when image loading fails | `() => void` |

### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Text, icon, or loading content for an image |
| error | Fallback content when image loading fails |
| trigger-icon | Action icon on the avatar |

### Methods

No custom public methods.
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

### AvatarGroup Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| shape | Child avatar shape | `circle / square` | `circle` |
| size | Child avatar width and height; numbers are px, strings are CSS lengths | `number / string` | `-` |
| auto-fix-font-size | Whether to shrink child avatar text automatically | `boolean` | `true` |
| max-count | Maximum visible avatars; `0` means unlimited | `number` | `0` |
| z-index-ascend | Use ascending stacking order | `boolean` | `false` |
| max-style | Custom summary avatar style | `CSSProperties` | `-` |
| max-popover-props | Summary Popover props | `PopoverProps` | `-` |
| offset | Overlap offset | `number / string` | `-` |
| vertical | Stack avatars vertically | `boolean` | `false` |

### AvatarGroup Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Avatar list |

### Type definitions

```ts
import type {
  AvatarGroupInstance,
  AvatarGroupProps,
  AvatarInstance,
  AvatarProps,
  AvatarObjectFit,
  AvatarShape,
  AvatarTriggerType,
} from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

| `--c-avatar-z-index-trigger` | `1` |
| `--c-avatar-z-index-overlay` | `0` |
| `--c-avatar-z-index-overlay-hover` | `2` |

Text, summary counts and button trigger icons use the primary content `color` by default. Borders follow the container surface; only icons on dark interaction overlays use `content-on-dark`. The avatar `fill-4` background, button background/hover levels and translucent black overlay remain component visual values. When overriding the avatar background with `color`, also check text contrast and override `text-color` if needed.

### Reduced motion

Built-in CSS transitions follow `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Removing transitions does not change final visibility, selected/expanded state or event semantics. Applications control custom animations inside slots.

Document: llms/en-US/components/back-top.md

<!-- Source: src/back-top/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/back-top/ -->

# BackTop

Visibility RAF and JS duration/easing interpolation have separate ownership. Old listeners/canceled or consumed frames cannot replay after target replacement/deactivation/disposal. Recheck after custom easing before writing; RAF/cancel/time origin use the target owner window. Retained inactive/disposed commands are inert, activation does not resume old animation. Scoped14/full30 per copy pass using controlled queues/iframe, not native browser/OS proof. Default200ms/API remain; no CSS token added.

A native button that scrolls the page or an explicit container to the top.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/back-top/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'

const scroller = ref<HTMLElement>()
onMounted(() => {
  if (scroller.value) {
    scroller.value.scrollTop = 240
    scroller.value.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll'))
  }
})
</script>

<template>
  <div class="back-top-demo">
    <p>在面板内滚动，超过 120px 时显示按钮。</p>
    <div class="back-top-demo__frame">
      <div ref="scroller" class="back-top-demo__scroll">
        <p v-for="row in 30" :key="row">A · 滚动内容 {{ row }}</p>
      </div>
      <c-back-top
        :target-container="() => scroller"
        :popup-container="false"
        :visible-height="120"
        :right="16"
        :bottom="16"
        aria-label="回到顶部"
      />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

The examples use isolated local containers. Omit `target-container` to listen to the page, not the nearest scrollable ancestor. A selector that is invalid or missing hides the button; use a reactive getter for a container mounted asynchronously. `popup-container` controls where the button renders, not what scrolls.

## Lifecycle and edge cases

### Scheduling Lifecycle

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target-container` | Scroll target; omitted means page | Scheduling Lifecycle |
| `popup-container` | Render target; false renders locally | Scheduling Lifecycle |
| `duration` | Animation duration in ms; 0 is immediate | Scheduling Lifecycle |
| `easing` | Built-in curve or normalized progress function | Scheduling Lifecycle |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/back-top/__demos__/scheduler-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { BackTopInstance } from "@cedar-design/ui";
const first = ref<HTMLElement>();
const second = ref<HTMLElement>();
const active = ref(true);
const alternate = ref(false);
let retained: BackTopInstance | undefined;
const capture = (instance: BackTopInstance | null) => {
  if (instance) retained = instance;
};
const lower = () => {
  if (first.value) first.value.scrollTop = 300;
  if (second.value) second.value.scrollTop = 300;
};
</script>
<template>
  <div style="position: relative">
    <c-button @click="lower">Scroll down / 滚动到底部</c-button>
    <c-button @click="alternate = !alternate"
      >Switch target / 切换目标</c-button
    >
    <c-button @click="active = !active">Activate / 停用与激活</c-button>
    <c-button @click="retained?.scrollToTop()"
      >Retained command / 保留命令</c-button
    >
    <p>
      Start an animation, switch or deactivate before completion. Old work must
      not resume.
    </p>
    <div ref="first" style="height: 100px; overflow: auto">
      <div style="height: 500px">Target A</div>
    </div>
    <div ref="second" style="height: 100px; overflow: auto">
      <div style="height: 500px">Target B</div>
    </div>
    <KeepAlive>
      <c-back-top
        v-if="active"
        :ref="capture"
        :target-container="() => (alternate ? second : first)"
        :popup-container="false"
        :duration="1000"
        easing="linear"
      />
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

## API

### Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target-container` | Scroll target; omitted means page | `string \| HTMLElement \| (() => HTMLElement \| null \| undefined)` | `—` |
| `popup-container` | Render target; false renders locally | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `body` |
| `visible-height` | Inclusive scroll threshold in px, numeric strings accepted | `number \| string` | `200` |
| `duration` | Animation duration in ms; 0 is immediate | `number` | `200` |
| `easing` | Built-in curve or normalized progress function | `'linear' \| 'quartOut' \| 'easeInOutCubic' \| ((progress: number) => number)` | `'quartOut'` |
| `right` | Right offset; number in px, string accepts CSS units | `number \| string` | `—` |
| `bottom` | Bottom offset; number in px, string accepts CSS units | `number \| string` | `—` |
| `elevation` | Shadow level; true uses level 2 | `boolean \| number` | `true` |
| `aria-label` | Accessible name | `string` | `'Back to top'` |

When `popup-container=false`, the button is positioned absolutely; give its containing block `position: relative`. Repeated clicks replace the previous animation; changing target, deactivation and unmount cancel queued work. Reduced-motion preference skips animation. Horizontal scroll position is preserved.

### Events / slots / methods

- `click(event: MouseEvent)`: emitted once per activation.
- Default slot: noninteractive text or icons. The root is already a native button; do not nest another Button or link.
- `scrollToTop()`: scrolls the current target without emitting an additional click.
- Keyboard: Tab focuses the visible button; Enter / Space activates it. Hidden buttons are not focusable.

### Types

```ts
import type { BackTopProps, BackTopInstance, BackTopTarget, BackTopEasing } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

### Style variables

| Token | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-back-top-right` | `40px` |
| `--c-back-top-bottom` | `40px` |
| `--c-back-top-button-size` | `var(--c-sys-control-touch-target)` |
| `--c-back-top-button-border-radius` | `50%` |
| `--c-back-top-font-size` | `var(--c-sys-font-size-md)` |
| `--c-back-top-icon-size` | `20px` |
| `--c-back-top-background` | `var(--c-sys-color-surface-raised)` |
| `--c-back-top-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-brand)` |
| `--c-back-top-hover-background` | `var(--c-sys-color-state-hover)` |
| `--c-back-top-focus-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-brand)` |
| `--c-back-top-focus-width` | `2px` |
| `--c-back-top-focus-offset` | `2px` |
| `--c-back-top-z-index` | `var(--c-z-index-local-sticky)` |

Pre-release migration: Cedar `margin-right/bottom` → `right/bottom`, `button-size-width` → `button-size`, `button-size-font/icon` → `font-size/icon-size`, `button-bg/bg-hover/text-color` → `background/hover-background/text-color` (all with the component prefix). Maple duration is now 200ms; default target is the page. Legacy arbitrary BTween curve names are replaced with the documented presets or a function. No aliases remain.

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->
### Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------: |
| description | Fallback description text | `string` | `-` |
| content | Badge content | `number \| string` | `-` |
| max | Maximum displayed numeric badge value. Numeric content above this value is shown as `${max}+`. | `number` | `99` |
| dot | Display a dot | `boolean` | `false` |
| offset-x | Horizontal offset; ignored in inline mode | `number` | `0` |
| offset-y | Vertical offset | `number` | `0` |
| color | Custom color; outline uses it for border and text | `string` | `-` |
| text-color | Content text color | `string` | `-` |
| mode | Layout mode | `'floating' \| 'inline'` | `floating` |
| position | Physical corner or left/right midpoint inside the host box, default top-right. Only used in floating mode; RTL does not mirror it | `'top-right' \| 'top-left' \| 'bottom-right' \| 'bottom-left' \| 'left' \| 'right'` | `top-right` |
| inline-position | Inline badge at the logical start or end of the host content, default end. Only used in inline mode | `'start' \| 'end'` | `end` |
| size | Size | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `md` |
| status | Semantic status | `SemanticStatus` | `danger` |
| show | Show the badge | `boolean` | `true` |
| show-zero | Show numeric zero | `boolean` | `false` |
| variant | Appearance | `'outline' \| 'default'` | `default` |

### Events

No component-specific events.

### Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| ------- | ---------------- | ---- |
| default | Fallback description text | - |
| content | Content displayed inside the badge | - |

### Methods

No public methods.

### Platform notes

Props and slots match across platforms. Without a default slot and with an empty description, the badge renders independently inline. Omitting content displays a dot. Each library reads text direction from its own configuration and supplies its own theme colors and CSS prefix.
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

| `--c-badge-offset` | `2px` |
| `--c-badge-ring-width` | `2px` |

Filled badge text follows Button: primary, info, success, warning, danger and secondary use `content-on-dark`; tertiary uses `content-on-dark` in light mode and `content-on-bright` in dark mode. Default notification badges use red backgrounds and white text; the neutral background remains `#e0e0e0`.

Colored outline text and borders follow Button, using the matching `content-brand`, `content-info`, `content-success`, `content-warning` and `content-danger` semantic roles; secondary and tertiary outlines use `content-secondary` for readability. `variant-outline-bg-color` works for every status and defaults to transparent. The `color` prop overrides outline text and border; `text-color` overrides text further. Both preserve control through the background variable. Recheck contrast after customizing foreground or background.

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { BadgeInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

### Color override boundaries

The bg-color fallback and danger fill use red backgrounds with white text: danger level 7 in light mode and level 4 in dark mode. Fixed neutral light gray and secondary/tertiary gray levels are intentional component colors. Override the border-color isolation ring to match the host surface. Callers must ensure contrast for custom color/text-color values.

## Content and presentation

### Routes

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `routes` | Route list | Routes, Droplist, Max Count |
| `max-count` | Maximum ordinary breadcrumb items, excluding the overflow item; 0 means unlimited | Max Count |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Preview configuration: `:routes="routes"`, `:href="paths.join('/')"`.

Example source: src/breadcrumb/__demos__/routes.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-breadcrumb :routes="routes" @click.prevent />
    <c-breadcrumb :routes="routes">
      <template #item-render="{ route, routes, paths }">
        <span v-if="route === routes[routes.length - 1]">{{ route.label }}</span>
        <c-link v-else :href="paths.join('/')" @click.prevent>
          {{ route.label }}
        </c-link>
      </template>
    </c-breadcrumb>
    <c-breadcrumb :routes="routes">
      <template #item-render="{ route, routes }">
        <span v-if="route === routes[routes.length - 1]">{{ route.label }}</span>
        <RouterLink v-else :to="route.to">
          {{ route.label }}
        </RouterLink>
      </template>
    </c-breadcrumb>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { RouterLink } from 'vue-router'

export default {
  components: { RouterLink },
  setup() {
    const routes = [
      {
        path: '/',
        to: { query: { breadcrumb: 'home' } },
        label: 'Home',
      },
      {
        path: '/channel',
        to: { query: { breadcrumb: 'channel' } },
        label: 'Channel',
      },
      {
        path: '/news',
        to: { query: { breadcrumb: 'news' } },
        label: 'News',
      },
    ]
    return { routes }
  },
}
</script>
```

## API

### Breadcrumb Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------ |
| max-count | Maximum ordinary breadcrumb items, excluding the overflow item; 0 means unlimited | `number` | `0` |
| routes | Route list | `BreadcrumbRoute[]` | `-` |
| separator | Separator text | `string \| number` | `/` |

### Breadcrumb Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| more-icon | Custom overflow icon | `omittedItems` `count` `start` `end` |
| item-render | Custom breadcrumb rendering when routes is provided | `route:BreadcrumbRoute`<br/>`routes:BreadcrumbRoute[]`<br/>`paths:string[]` |
| separator | Custom separator | `-` |

### BreadcrumbItem Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------- | ------------ | ----------------------------- | ------ |
| separator | Separator text | `string \| number` | `-` |
| href | Link URL | `string` | `-` |
| droplist | Dropdown menu content | `BreadcrumbRoute['children']` | `-` |
| dropdown-props | Props passed to Menu | `MenuProps` | `-` |

### BreadcrumbItem Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------ | -------- | -------------- |
| click | Click event; omitted items do not emit it | `event: MouseEvent` |
| select | Fired when a built-in dropdown item is selected | `route: BreadcrumbRoute, event?: Event` |

### BreadcrumbItem Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| --------- | -------------- | ---- |
| droplist | Custom dropdown menu | `-` |
| separator | Custom separator | `-` |

### BreadcrumbRoute

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| -------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------ |
| label | Breadcrumb label | `string` | `-` |
| path | Navigation path (`href` on the `a` element) | `string` |
| children | Dropdown menu items | `{label:string,path:string}[]` | `-` |

## Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { BreadcrumbProps, BreadcrumbItemProps, BreadcrumbRoute } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

## Shared implementation and platform boundaries

Breadcrumb and BreadcrumbItem are maintained as local copies in Cedar / Maple. Component bodies, props, context, types, key styles and paired tests are checked by `design-ui/bin/copied-components-check.mjs`. Each library supplies its own icons, installation entry, menu implementation and theme tokens.

- A nonempty `routes` array takes precedence over the default slot; an empty array falls back to the slot. Default route rendering links all items except the last, which has `aria-current="page"`. `item-render` controls links itself.
- Separator precedence: child slot → child prop → parent slot → parent prop. `0` and an empty string are supported.
- `max-count` preserves the existing boundary: collapsing occurs only when the total exceeds `max-count + 1`. It keeps the first and trailing items. The overflow position does not trigger omitted items’ clicks, links or dropdowns.
- Built-in dropdown selection emits `select(route, event)`. Indices and separators update with dynamic insertion, removal, reordering and SSR.
- Cedar adds a `__content` wrapper for item content; attributes fall through to it. Maple retains its existing theme variables through token mappings.

## Appearance and states

### Four variants

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | Appearance; inherits group, otherwise default | Four variants, Colors, ripple and elevation |
| `size` | Size; inherits group, otherwise md | Four variants, Five sizes |
| `status` | Semantic color; inherits group, otherwise default | Four variants |
| `disabled` | Disabled; inherits group, explicit false overrides | Disabled buttons and links |
| `component` | Root tag; link attributes fall through | Disabled buttons and links |
| `loading` | Loading; blocks activation and navigation | Disabled buttons and links |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


The `default` variant uses white text for primary, info, success, warning, danger and secondary solid fills.

Example source: src/button/__demos__/variants.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";

const variant = ref("default");
const size = ref("md");
const background = ref("navy");
const variants = ["default", "text", "outline", "tonal"];
const sizes = ["xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl"];
const statuses = [
  "default",
  "primary",
  "secondary",
  "tertiary",
  "info",
  "success",
  "warning",
  "danger",
];
const backgrounds = [
  { label: "Navy / 深蓝", value: "navy", color: "#17224B" },
  { label: "White / 白色", value: "light", color: "#FFFFFF" },
  { label: "Light gray / 浅灰", value: "muted", color: "#F5F5F5" },
  { label: "Dark gray / 深灰", value: "dark", color: "#252525" },
];
const cardBackground = computed(
  () => backgrounds.find((item) => item.value === background.value)?.color,
);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block align="stretch" :size="16">
    <c-form layout="vertical" size="sm">
      <c-form-item label="Variant" field="variant">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="variant"
          :options="variants"
          aria-label="Button variant"
          variant="button"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="Size" field="size">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="size"
          :options="sizes"
          aria-label="Button size"
          variant="button"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="Background" field="background">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="background"
          :options="backgrounds"
          aria-label="Button background"
          variant="button"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-card
      class="button-variant-card"
      :data-background="background"
      :elevation="false"
      :style="{ '--c-card-background': cardBackground }"
    >
      <c-space wrap>
        <c-button
          v-for="status in statuses"
          :key="status"
          :status="status"
          :variant="variant"
          :size="size"
          >{{ status }}</c-button
        >
      </c-space>
    </c-card>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Five sizes

Horizontal buttons and inputs of the same size share the default height and font size within each platform. Cedar heights are 24/28/32/36/44px; Maple heights are 32/40/48/56/64px. Horizontal button padding is 8/12/16/20/24px per side, with a 6px icon-label gap. Stacked buttons keep their separate content-based height. Component-level overrides remain independent.

Example source: src/button/__demos__/size.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const sizes = ["xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl"] as const;
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-space v-for="size in sizes" :key="size" align="center" wrap :size="12">
      <span>{{ size }}</span>
      <c-input
        :size="size"
        :aria-label="`Input ${size}`"
        placeholder="Input"
        style="width: 140px"
      />
      <c-button :size="size">Button</c-button>
      <c-button :size="size"
        ><template #icon><c-icon-search /></template>Search</c-button
      >
    </c-space>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Icons and layout

### Icons and label layouts

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | Semantic color; inherits group, otherwise default | Icons and label layouts |
| `variant` | Appearance; inherits group, otherwise default | Icons and label layouts |
| `size` | Size; inherits group, otherwise md | Icons and label layouts |
| `stacked` | Stack icon and text; inherits group when omitted | Icons and label layouts |
| `round` | Round button | Icons and label layouts |
| `block` | Full available width | Block buttons |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Use built-in icons to compare icon-only, inline and stacked labels across four variants and five sizes. Stacked buttons grow with content and keep at least 8px of top and bottom padding. Omit the default slot for icon-only buttons; round controls shape and stacked controls label layout.

Example source: src/button/__demos__/icons.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";

const sizes = ["xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl"] as const;
const variants = ["default", "text", "outline", "tonal"] as const;
const layouts = ["icon", "inline", "stacked"] as const;
const size = ref<(typeof sizes)[number]>("md");
const variant = ref<(typeof variants)[number]>("tonal");
const items = [
  { status: "default", icon: "plus", label: "Add" },
  { status: "primary", icon: "reply", label: "Reply" },
  { status: "info", icon: "info-circle", label: "Info" },
  { status: "success", icon: "check", label: "Confirm" },
  { status: "warning", icon: "delete", label: "Delete" },
  { status: "danger", icon: "close", label: "Close" },
] as const;
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-form layout="vertical" size="sm">
      <c-form-item label="Variant" field="variant">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="variant"
          :options="variants"
          aria-label="Icon button variant"
          variant="button"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="Size" field="size">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="size"
          :options="sizes"
          aria-label="Icon button size"
          variant="button"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-space
      v-for="layout in layouts"
      :key="layout"
      direction="column"
      :size="8"
    >
      <span>{{
        layout === "icon"
          ? "Icon only / 纯图标"
          : layout === "inline"
            ? "Icon and text / 横排图文"
            : "Stacked / 上下堆叠"
      }}</span>
      <c-space wrap>
        <c-button
          v-for="item in items"
          :key="item.label"
          :status="item.status"
          :variant="variant"
          :size="size"
          :stacked="layout === 'stacked'"
          :round="layout === 'icon'"
          :aria-label="item.label"
        >
          <template #icon>
            <c-icon-plus v-if="item.icon === 'plus'" />
            <c-icon-reply v-else-if="item.icon === 'reply'" />
            <c-icon-info-circle v-else-if="item.icon === 'info-circle'" />
            <c-icon-check v-else-if="item.icon === 'check'" />
            <c-icon-delete v-else-if="item.icon === 'delete'" />
            <c-icon-close v-else-if="item.icon === 'close'" />
          </template>
          <template v-if="layout !== 'icon'" #default>{{
            item.label
          }}</template>
        </c-button>
      </c-space>
    </c-space>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Loading and action feedback

### Loading layouts and animations

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

### Sync, async and rejection recovery

Example source: src/button/__demos__/controlled-loading.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const saving = ref(false)
const failing = ref(false)
const message = ref('点击保存，观察业务控制的 loading / Click Save to start')
const delay = () => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 800))
async function save() {
  if (saving.value) return
  saving.value = true
  try { await delay(); message.value = '保存完成 / Saved' }
  finally { saving.value = false }
}
async function recover() {
  if (failing.value) return
  failing.value = true
  try { await delay(); throw new Error('模拟请求失败 / Simulated failure') }
  catch (error) { message.value = (error as Error).message }
  finally { failing.value = false }
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="12">
    <p>click 支持 async 回调；业务通过 loading 展示等待，在 finally 中恢复。Async click handlers own their loading state.</p>
    <c-space wrap :size="12">
      <c-button :loading="saving" @click="save">保存 / Save</c-button>
      <c-button :loading="failing" @click="recover">失败与恢复 / Failure recovery</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p aria-live="polite">{{ message }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Icons and content follow reading order; stacked content stays top to bottom and slot graphics are not mirrored. ButtonGroup owns horizontal joining edges and outer corners even when a child has a different text direction. A single child keeps all corners; vertical groups preserve top-to-bottom order. Native Tab, Enter and Space remain available; ordinary groups do not intercept horizontal arrows. Disabled and loading behavior stays unchanged.

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->

### Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------- | -------------- |
| status | Semantic color; inherits group, otherwise default | `SemanticStatus` | `undefined` |
| variant | Appearance; inherits group, otherwise default | `default / text / outline / tonal` | `undefined` |
| size | Size; inherits group, otherwise md | `xs / sm / md / lg / xl` | `undefined` |
| html-type | Native button type | `button / submit / reset` | `button` |
| component | Root tag; link attributes fall through | `button / a` | `button` |
| round | Round button | `boolean` | `false` |
| block | Full available width | `boolean` | `false` |
| loading | Loading; blocks activation and navigation | `boolean` | `false` |
| loading-type | Spinner animation; same as Loading.type; not used in line mode | `circle / wave / cube / rect / disappear` | `circle` |
| loading-mode | Inline, covering, or bottom progress line; line only uses loading-color | `default / fill / line` | `default` |
| loading-size | Indicator size; xs/sm/md/lg/xl map to 12/14/16/18/20px; numbers are px; follows button size when omitted; not used in line mode | `ComponentSize / number` | `undefined` |
| loading-color | Loading indicator color | `string` | `currentColor` |
| disabled | Disabled; inherits group, explicit false overrides | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| ripple | Click ripple | `boolean` | `true` |
| focusable | Allow sequential Tab focus; does not prevent programmatic focus | `boolean` | `true` |
| autofocus | Native autofocus | `boolean` | `false` |
| text-color | Custom text color | `string` | `undefined` |
| color | Custom background or variant base color | `string` | `undefined` |
| elevation | Default variant shadow; true=2, false=off, rounded/clamped 0–24; group owns grouped elevation | `boolean / number` | `true` |
| stacked | Stack icon and text; inherits group when omitted | `boolean` | `undefined` |

### Events

| Event | Arguments and behavior |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| click | `(event: MouseEvent) => void` |
| touchstart | `(event: TouchEvent) => void` |

click is a normal emitted event and supports async handlers. Business state controls loading; restore it in finally. Listener Promises do not automatically drive loading. Disabled/loading links have no effective href.

### Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| ------- | -------------------------------- | ---- |
| default | Button label; retained while loading | — |
| icon | Leading icon; above label when stacked | — |

### Methods

No custom public methods.
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

## ButtonGroup

Props: size=md, status=default, variant=default, color/text-color=undefined, disabled/stacked/vertical=false, elevation=true. Uses the default slot and exposes buttonGroupProvider for reactive group configuration; it has no custom events. Child buttons override individual group fields, while the group controls elevation as a whole.

## Types

ButtonProps、ButtonVariant、ButtonLoadingMode、ButtonInstance、ButtonGroupProps、ButtonGroupInstance。

## CSS variable responsibilities and complete defaults

Button exposes 58 appearance tokens. `{status}-color` controls the solid background, `{status}-foreground-color` controls text/outline/tonal foreground, and `{status}-tonal-color` controls soft backgrounds. `solid-text-color` and `solid-state-layer-color` are shared by semantic statuses; default/tertiary foregrounds and primary/tertiary state layers retain theme-specific roles.

Sizes use xs/sm/md/lg/xl. Font sizes, transition duration, focus width/offset and stacked-height increments reuse system variables. Button groups and stacked buttons share border-radius. Four state opacity variables preserve hover/active differences. loading-duration controls only the bottom progress line; Loading controls other loading animations. Internal variables and fixed animation geometry are not public customization points.

## Interaction and customization

### Controlled

Example source: src/calendar/__demos__/controlled.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space wrap>
    <c-button @click="selectToday">选择今天</c-button>
    <c-button @click="selectTomorrow">选择明天</c-button>
  </c-space>
  <c-calendar
    v-model="value"
    class="calendar-demo"
    @change="lastAction = `选择了 ${format($event)}`"
    @panel-change="lastAction = `面板切换到 ${formatMonth($event)}`"
  />
  <c-alert status="info">{{ lastAction }}</c-alert>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from "vue";

const value = ref(new Date());
const lastAction = ref("可点击日期或切换月份");
const format = (date: Date) => date.toLocaleDateString("zh-CN");
const formatMonth = (date: Date) =>
  date.toLocaleDateString("zh-CN", { year: "numeric", month: "long" });
function selectToday() {
  value.value = new Date();
  lastAction.value = `外部设置为 ${format(value.value)}`;
}
function selectTomorrow() {
  const tomorrow = new Date();
  tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1);
  value.value = tomorrow;
  lastAction.value = `外部设置为 ${format(value.value)}`;
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.calendar-demo {
  margin: 12px 0;
}
</style>
```

### Custom Cell

Example source: src/calendar/__demos__/custom-cell.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-calendar v-model="value">
    <template #default="{ year, month, date }">
      <div v-if="items[key(year, month, date)]" class="cell-items">
        <span
          v-for="item in items[key(year, month, date)]"
          :key="item.label"
          class="cell-item"
          :style="{ '--item-color': item.color }"
          >{{ item.label }}</span
        >
      </div>
    </template>
  </c-calendar>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from "vue";

const value = ref(new Date());
const today = new Date();
const key = (year: number, month: number, date: number) =>
  `${year}-${month}-${date}`;
const relativeKey = (offset: number) => {
  const date = new Date(today);
  date.setDate(date.getDate() + offset);
  return key(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth() + 1, date.getDate());
};
const items: Record<string, Array<{ label: string; color: string }>> = {
  [relativeKey(0)]: [
    { label: "产品评审", color: "rgb(var(--c-primary-6))" },
    { label: "版本发布", color: "rgb(var(--c-success-6))" },
  ],
  [relativeKey(2)]: [{ label: "客户回访", color: "rgb(var(--c-warning-6))" }],
  [relativeKey(5)]: [{ label: "团队周会", color: "rgb(var(--c-purple-6))" }],
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.cell-items {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.cell-item {
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--c-color-text-2);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.cell-item::before {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  margin-right: 6px;
  background: var(--item-color);
  border-radius: 50%;
  content: "";
}
</style>
```

<!-- Source: src/card/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/card/ -->

# Card

Source changes synchronously invalidate render generations. Close, row direction, newer work, deactivation or disposal prevent old nextTick/timer/double-frame continuations from changing newer phases. Render/timer deliveries consume once. Recheck lifecycle/request/node after geometry hooks to reject reentrant disposal. Suspension cancels both timers and retained close/click input is inert; activation starts a fresh phase from current props without replay, and initial KeepAlive activation does not duplicate the wait.

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive as __demoReactive } from "vue";

const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: "default", size: "md" });

import { computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from 'vue'
const demoCompareFields = [{"name":"variant","values":["default","outline","tonal"]},{"name":"size","values":["sm","md"]}]
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef("variant")
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(() => demoCompareFields.find(field => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)?.values ?? [])

__demoAppearance['elevation'] = 2
demoCompareFields.push({ name: 'elevation', values: [0, 2, 6] })
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-form layout="vertical">

    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint"><span lang="zh-CN">选择一个对比维度；其他配置和内容保持一致。输入类示例共享同一个值，便于比较外观。</span><span lang="en-US">Compare one dimension while keeping the other settings and content identical. Input specimens share the same value.</span></p>

  </c-space>
```

## Lifecycle and edge cases

### Floating scheduler lifecycle

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `floating` | Fullscreen state; supports v-model:floating | Floating scheduler lifecycle |
| `ripple` | Click ripple | Floating scheduler lifecycle |
| `floating-duration` | Fullscreen transition duration in ms | Floating scheduler lifecycle |
| `title` | Title | Floating scheduler lifecycle |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


500ms ripple wait is interaction policy; floating-duration defaults to250ms for collapse and transition. DoubleRaf settles layout; cancellation rejects stale continuation writes, not underlying frames. Public API and CSS variables are unchanged. Full Card Cedar21/Maple44 and scoped15 each are controlled tests, not native browser/OS certification.

Example source: src/card/__demos__/scheduler-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const active = ref(true)
const mounted = ref(true)
const floating = ref(false)
const ripple = ref(true)
const duration = ref(250)
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="floating = !floating">Float / 浮起与回落</c-button>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">Activate / 停用与激活</c-button>
    <c-button @click="mounted = !mounted">Mount / 卸载与挂载</c-button>
    <c-button @click="ripple = !ripple">Ripple wait / 涟漪等待</c-button>
    <c-button @click="duration = duration ? 0 : 250">Duration / 零与默认时长</c-button>
    <p>Toggle floating rapidly, suspend during500ms ripple wait or layout settlement, then activate. Old tasks must not reset a newer phase. Underlying doubleRaf frames are not physically canceled.</p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <c-card v-if="active" v-model:floating="floating" :ripple="ripple" :floating-duration="duration" title="Floating lifecycle / 浮起生命周期">
        Card content / 卡片内容
        <template #floating-content>
          <c-button @click.stop="floating = false">Collapse / 回落</c-button>
          <c-button @click.stop="active = false">Deactivate / 停用</c-button>
          <c-button @click.stop="mounted = false">Unmount / 卸载</c-button>
        </template>
      </c-card>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

The same scenarios, parameters and interactions as Cedar. Only component prefixes differ; themes and site shells remain independent.

## Reading direction

Headings, content and actions follow reading order. Default floating actions sit at reading end without mirroring images or custom slots.

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->
### Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | Appearance | `default / outline / tonal` | `default` |
| size | Density; omitted value follows platform rules below | `sm / md` | `undefined` |
| direction | Order of cover and body, default column; supports row, column and row-reverse. Does not position the card itself | `row / column / row-reverse` | `column` |
| hoverable | Hover styling | `boolean` | `false` |
| title-style | Title row styles | `CSSProperties` | `undefined` |
| title | Title | `string` | `undefined` |
| subtitle | Subtitle | `string` | `undefined` |
| description | Description | `string` | `undefined` |
| top-divider | Top divider | `boolean` | `false` |
| bottom-divider | Bottom divider | `boolean` | `false` |
| src | Cover image URL; cover slot takes precedence | `string` | `undefined` |
| fit | Cover image fit | `fill / contain / cover / none / scale-down` | `cover` |
| image-height | Image height; numbers use px | `string / number` | `undefined` |
| image-width | Image width; numbers use px | `string / number` | `undefined` |
| alt | Image alternative text | `string` | `undefined` |
| elevation | Shadow for default variant; true means level 1, false disables it, numeric levels 0–24 | `boolean / number` | `true` |
| ripple | Click ripple | `boolean` | `false` |
| floating | Fullscreen state; supports v-model:floating | `boolean` | `false` |
| floating-duration | Fullscreen transition duration in ms | `number` | `250` |

### Events

| Event | Arguments and timing |
| --- | --- |
| click | `(event: Event)`, emitted when the card is clicked |
| update:floating | `(value: boolean)`, emits false when the built-in close button requests closing; expansion is controlled by the parent |

### Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | Body | — |
| cover | Cover; overrides src | — |
| header | Entire header; overrides title, title-action and subtitle | — |
| title | Title | `{ slotClass: string }` |
| title-action | Title action | — |
| subtitle | Subtitle | `{ slotClass: string }` |
| description | Description | `{ slotClass: string }` |
| footer | Footer actions | — |
| floating-content | Expanded content; column layout only | — |
| close-button | Custom close button; update floating yourself | — |

### Methods

No public methods.

### Platform notes

Props, event arguments and slots match. Cedar inherits the global size when size is omitted: xs/sm map to sm, all others to md. Maple falls back to md. Pass size explicitly for identical density. Themes and CSS prefixes remain platform-specific.
Card no longer has a loading prop. Compose a loading overlay with the Loading directive.
<!-- same-source-api:end -->
