| `--c-card-close-button-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-on-dark)` |
| `--c-card-close-button-border-radius` | `50%` |

Card colors follow system semantics: regular/filled backgrounds and borders use `surface-default`, `surface-muted` and `border-default`. Titles, body text and secondary text use `content-primary`, `content-tertiary` and `content-secondary`. Expanded floating-button containers sit on the card surface and use `content-primary`; text/icons on dark close buttons use `content-on-dark`. The `#212121` close-button background is Card-specific, not the global primary-action color. See the Design Token specification for old variable mappings.

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { CardProps } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

See `API-MIGRATION.md` at the repository root for size and cross-platform migration rules. Only the documented sizes are supported, not every ComponentSize.

### Variable consumption rules

Row content consumes `--c-card-content-row-margin`, independently from the title margin. Card intentionally exposes only sm/md density, not all five control sizes. Motion uses `--c-card-animation-duration` (`var(--c-sys-motion-duration-slow)`) and `--c-card-animation-easing` (`var(--c-sys-motion-easing-standard)`). Reduced motion disables transitions on every animated Card section.

## Direction and layout

### Multi Slides

Preview configuration: `:slides-per-view="2.5"`, `:space-between="10"`, `:model-value="current"`, `:loop="loop"`.

Example source: src/carousel/__demos__/multi-slides.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
const current = ref(1);
const proposal = ref(1);
const changes = ref(0);
const accept = ref(true);
const loop = ref(true);
function update(value) {
  proposal.value = value;
  if (accept.value) current.value = value;
}
</script>

<template>
  <section class="multi-slides-demo">
    <c-checkbox v-model="accept"> Accept changes / 接受切换</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="loop"> Loop / 循环</c-checkbox>
    <p role="status">
      Current: {{ current }} · Proposal: {{ proposal }} · Changes: {{ changes }}
    </p>
    <c-carousel
      :slides-per-view="2.5"
      :space-between="10"
      :style="{ width: '600px', height: '200px' }"
      :model-value="current"
      :loop="loop"
      draggable
      keyboard
      @update:modelValue="update"
      @change="changes++"
    >
      <c-carousel-item v-for="i in 6" :key="i">
        <div
          style="
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: #4a90d9;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: bold;
          "
        >
          {{ i }}
        </div>
      </c-carousel-item>
    </c-carousel>
  </section>
</template>
```

### Auto Sized

- `height`: Constrains the component height.

Example source: src/carousel/__demos__/auto-sized.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
const current = ref(1);
const changes = ref(0);
const wider = ref(false);
const compact = ref(false);
const extra = ref(false);
const empty = ref(false);
const reversed = ref(false);
const widths = computed(() => {
  const items = empty.value
    ? []
    : [140, 220, 180, 260, ...(extra.value ? [200] : [])];
  return (reversed.value ? items.reverse() : items).map(
    (width) => width + (wider.value ? 80 : 0),
  );
});
</script>

<template>
  <section class="auto-sized-demo">
    <c-checkbox v-model="wider"> Wider cards / 加宽卡片</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="compact"> 300px viewport / 窄容器</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="extra"> Extra card / 增加末项</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="empty"> Empty / 清空项目</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="reversed"> Reverse cards / 反转顺序</c-checkbox>
    <p role="status">Current: {{ current }} · Changes: {{ changes }}</p>
    <c-carousel
      v-model="current"
      slides-per-view="auto"
      :space-between="12"
      :style="{ width: compact ? '300px' : '100%' }"
      height="180px"
      centered-slides
      draggable
      @change="changes++"
    >
      <c-carousel-item
        v-for="width in widths"
        :key="width"
        :style="{ width: width + 'px' }"
      >
        <div class="carousel-demo-panel">{{ width }}px</div>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
const current = ref(1);
const accept = ref(true);
const proposal = ref(1);
function update(value) {
  proposal.value = value;
  if (accept.value) current.value = value;
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-checkbox v-model="accept"> Accept changes / 接受切换</c-checkbox>

    :model-value="current"
    height="180px"
    keyboard
    draggable
    @update:modelValue="update"
  >
    <c-carousel-item v-for="item in 4" :key="item"
      ><div class="carousel-demo-panel">Slide {{ item }}</div></c-carousel-item
    >
  </c-carousel>
```

## Lifecycle

### Scheduler Lifecycle

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auto-play` | Autoplay configuration | Scheduler Lifecycle |
| `move-speed` | Explicit duration in milliseconds | Scheduler Lifecycle |
| `height` | Container height; numbers are px | Scheduler Lifecycle |
| `keyboard` | Scoped arrow/Home/End navigation | Scheduler Lifecycle |
| `mousewheel` | Wheel navigation | Scheduler Lifecycle |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `height`: Constrains the component height.

Example source: src/carousel/__demos__/scheduler-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const active = ref(true)
const mounted = ref(true)
const current = ref(1)
const playing = ref(false)
const moves = ref(0)
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="playing = !playing">Autoplay / 自动播放</c-button>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">Activate / 停用与激活</c-button>
    <c-button @click="mounted = !mounted">Mount / 卸载与挂载</c-button>
    <p>Current / 当前: {{ current }}; changes / 通知: {{ moves }}. Suspend during autoplay or loop settlement, then activate. Old work must not replay.</p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <c-carousel v-if="active" v-model="current" :auto-play="playing ? { interval: 1000 } : false" :move-speed="600" :height="180" keyboard mousewheel @change="moves++">
        <c-carousel-item v-for="item in 3" :key="item">Slide / 幻灯片 {{ item }}</c-carousel-item>
      </c-carousel>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

## API

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the current slide number, starting at 1. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state only on creation; later changes do not reset it. An explicit bound value takes precedence. Initialization does not emit `update:modelValue`.

### Carousel Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model-value` | Controlled one-based slide number | `number` | `undefined` |
| `default-value` | Uncontrolled initial index | `number` | `1` |
| `loop` | Loop without duplicating instances | `boolean` | `true` |
| `auto-play` | Autoplay configuration | `boolean \| number \| CarouselAutoPlayConfig` | `false` |
| `move-speed` | Explicit duration in milliseconds | `number` | `undefined (token)` |
| `trigger` | Indicator trigger | `click \| hover` | `click` |
| `orientation` | Horizontal/vertical axis of carousel sliding, default horizontal; does not determine indicator position | `horizontal \| vertical` | `horizontal` |
| `show-arrow` | Arrow visibility | `always \| hover \| never` | `always` |
| `arrow-class` | Additional arrow class | `string` | `undefined` |
| `indicator` | Show indicators | `boolean` | `true` |
| `indicator-type` | Indicator appearance | `dot \| line \| slider` | `dot` |
| `indicator-position` | Indicator edge or outer region of the carousel container, default bottom. Not a trigger-relative popup placement | `bottom \| top \| left \| right \| outer` | `bottom` |
| `indicator-class` | Additional indicator class | `string` | `undefined` |
| `indicator-color` | Custom indicator background | `string` | `undefined` |
| `height` | Container height; numbers are px | `number \| string` | `undefined` |
| `transition-timing-function` | Explicit timing function | `string` | `undefined (token)` |
| `touchable` | Touch dragging | `boolean` | `true` |
| `draggable` | Mouse dragging, independent of touch | `boolean` | `false` |
| `mousewheel` | Wheel navigation | `boolean` | `false` |
| `keyboard` | Scoped arrow/Home/End navigation | `boolean` | `false` |
| `slides-per-view` | Visible count; auto uses item size | `number \| auto` | `1` |
| `space-between` | Item gap; numbers/numeric strings are px | `number \| string` | `0` |
| `effect` | Effect; all supported by both libraries | `slide \| fade \| card` | `slide` |
| `centered-slides` | Center active slide | `boolean` | `false` |
| `aria-label` | Carousel accessible name | `string` | Locale |
| `previous-button-aria-label` | Previous button accessible name | `string` | Locale |
| `next-button-aria-label` | Next button accessible name | `string` | Locale |

### Model and interaction
Public slide numbers start at 1. Controlled actions emit update:model-value, then change(slideNumber, previousSlideNumber, isManual), and do not move until the parent accepts current. External assignments do not emit change. Method option event:false suppresses only change, not the model proposal. isManual is true for user actions and false for autoplay.

loop moves existing children across boundaries without cloning component instances. Without looping or centering, the final viewport is clamped to avoid empty space; selection can move within the final visible group without moving the track. Partly visible slides remain accessible; fully offscreen slides are inert. fade displays one slide. auto uses explicit CarouselItem width horizontally or height vertically; vertical mode requires a container height. Only CarouselItem children, including those inside Vue Fragments, count as slides; comments and ordinary elements do not.

auto-play=true uses 3000ms and pauses on hover; a number sets milliseconds without hover pausing; an object configures interval/hoverToPause. Focus within, dragging, hidden documents/ancestors and KeepAlive deactivation always pause playback. Reduced-motion preferences are respected. Interactive children such as inputs/buttons keep native behavior; mark custom interactive areas with data-carousel-no-drag. show-arrow=hover also shows arrows on keyboard focus.

### Events
| Event | Arguments |
| --- | --- |
| update:model-value | slideNumber: number |
| change | slideNumber: number, previousSlideNumber: number, isManual: boolean |

### Slots
| Slot | Arguments |
| --- | --- |
| default | CarouselItem |
| prev / next / indicator | { slideNumber, length, hovering, prev, next, to, resize } |

### Methods
| Method | Signature |
| --- | --- |
| prev / next | (options?: CarouselToOptions) => void |
| to | (slideNumber: number, options?: CarouselToOptions) => void |
| resize | () => void |

CarouselItem has no own props, events or methods. Its default slot supplies slide content.

### Types
CarouselProps, CarouselItemProps, CarouselInstance, CarouselItemInstance, CarouselEmits, CarouselSlots, CarouselItemSlots, CarouselExpose, CarouselSlotScope, CarouselToOptions, CarouselChangeData, CarouselOrientation, CarouselEffect, CarouselAutoPlayConfig, CarouselArrowType, CarouselIndicatorType, CarouselIndicatorPosition, CarouselTriggerEvent.

| `--c-carousel-focus-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-brand)` |

### Loop transition boundaries

Each slide always has one component instance. Ordinary previous/next navigation recycles positions after the departing slide exits. Multi-slide or centered jumps that would require one slide in two positions settle immediately without animation, cloning interactive content or queuing unlimited transitions. Fewer items than visible slides are not cloned to fill space. Accessible names follow global Locale; explicit label props take precedence.

# Cascader

Hierarchical option selection with single, multiple and path models.

```ts
import type { CascaderProps, CascaderInstance } from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes null unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render null as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to null. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

The candidate `options` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. Components own loading, cancellation and stale results, and emit load-error on failure. Choice groups initialize with an empty query; searchable fields load when queries change. Root tree loaders remain independent of existing load-more child loading.

## Reading direction

Inherits source dir. Child columns, expansion icons and separators follow reading direction. Horizontal keys enter loaded children or return to the parent in the visible direction, skipping disabled children; vertical keys retain logical order. Search preserves native horizontal caret editing. Path and multiple-value arrays are not reversed. Clearing the last value while closed resets navigation before reopening.

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <c-cascader :options="options" :style="{ width: '320px' }" placeholder="Please select ..." :format-label="format" />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const options = [
      {
        value: 'beijing',
        label: 'Beijing',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'chaoyang',
            label: 'ChaoYang',
            children: [
              {
                value: 'datunli',
                label: 'Datunli',
              },
            ],
          },
          {
            value: 'haidian',
            label: 'Haidian',
          },
          {
            value: 'dongcheng',
            label: 'Dongcheng',
          },
          {
            value: 'xicheng',
            label: 'Xicheng',
            children: [
              {
                value: 'jinrongjie',
                label: 'Jinrongjie',
              },
              {
                value: 'tianqiao',
                label: 'Tianqiao',
              },
            ],
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        value: 'shanghai',
        label: 'Shanghai',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'huangpu',
            label: 'Huangpu',
          },
        ],
      },
    ]
    interface Option {
      value: string
      label: string
    }

    const format = (options: Option[]) => {
      const labels = options.map((option) => option.label)
      return labels.join('-')
    }
    return {
      options,
      format,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

### Load More

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <c-cascader :options="options" :style="{ width: '320px' }" placeholder="Please select ..." :load-more="loadMore" />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const options = [
      {
        value: 'beijing',
        label: 'Beijing',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'chaoyang',
            label: 'ChaoYang',
          },
          {
            value: 'haidian',
            label: 'Haidian',
            isLeaf: true,
          },
          {
            value: 'dongcheng',
            label: 'Dongcheng',
            isLeaf: true,
          },
          {
            value: 'xicheng',
            label: 'Xicheng',
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        value: 'shanghai',
        label: 'Shanghai',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'huangpu',
            label: 'Huangpu',
            isLeaf: true,
          },
        ],
      },
    ]
    const loadMore = (option: any, done: any) => {
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        const nodes = [
          {
            value: `${option.value}-option1`,
            label: `${option.label}-Option1`,
            isLeaf: true,
          },
          {
            value: `${option.value}-option2`,
            label: `${option.label}-Option2`,
            isLeaf: true,
          },
        ]
        done(nodes)
      }, 2000)
    }

    return {
      options,
      loadMore,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

### Async Devices

- `options`: Options for cascader
- `loading`: Whether it is loading state
- `path-mode`: Whether the value is a path
- `filterable`: Whether to allow searching

Example source: src/cascader/__demos__/async-devices.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const value = ref(['factory', 'device-2'])
const options = ref<Record<string, unknown>[]>([])
const loading = ref(false)
async function load() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    options.value = await Promise.resolve([
      { id: 'factory', name: '工厂', nodes: [
        { id: 'device-1', name: '设备一' },
        { id: 'device-2', name: '设备二' },
        { id: 'device-3', name: '检修设备', disabled: true },
      ] },
    ])
  } finally { loading.value = false }
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-button @click="load">加载设备树</c-button>
    <c-cascader v-model="value" :options="options" :loading="loading" path-mode filterable clearable
      :field-names="{ label: 'name', value: 'id', children: 'nodes' }" placeholder="选择设备路径" />
    <p>已提交路径：{{ value }}。标签与 ID 分离，异步加载后自动回显。</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Cascader props

Use `v-model`, `v-model:open` and `v-model:input-value` for controlled state. Clear values are `''` for single selection and `[]` for multiple selection. Select uses `undefined` when an actual empty-string option exists.

| Prop                                    | Description                                                                                                                                      | Type                                                          | Default                         |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `open-trigger-target`                   | Pointer opening target: the whole field or only the suffix icon. Explicit keyboard opening and controlled open remain available.                 | `'field' \| 'icon'`                                           | `'field'`                       |
| `model-value / default-value`           | Controlled value / uncontrolled initial value                                                                                                    | `Value`                                                       | `Single: ''; multiple: []`      |
| `open / default-open`                   | Controlled / initial open state                                                                                                                  | `boolean`                                                     | `undefined / false`             |
| `input-value / default-input-value`     | Search text, independent of selected values                                                                                                      | `string`                                                      | `undefined / ''`                |
| `multiple`                              | Multiple selection; enables search by default                                                                                                    | `boolean`                                                     | `false`                         |
| `size`                                  | Supports all five sizes; inherits group/form settings                                                                                            | `ComponentSize`                                               | `md`                            |
| `variant`                               | filled, outline, standard; inherits InputGroup                                                                                                   | `FormControlVariant`                                          | `filled`                        |
| `disabled / readonly / error`           | Inherits form state unless explicitly overridden                                                                                                 | `boolean`                                                     | `undefined`                     |
| `placeholder`                           | Placeholder                                                                                                                                      | `string`                                                      | `—`                             |
| `hint / line`                           | Floating hint / standard variant underline                                                                                                       | `boolean`                                                     | `true`                          |
| `text-color / focus-color / blur-color` | Field colors                                                                                                                                     | `string`                                                      | `—`                             |
| `loading`                               | Loading state; blocks selection and confirmation                                                                                                 | `boolean`                                                     | `false`                         |
| `show-tags`                             | Show tags; false displays separated text                                                                                                         | `boolean`                                                     | `true`                          |
| `separator`                             | Separator when show-tags=false                                                                                                                   | `string`                                                      | `,`                             |
| `text-align`                            | Text alignment: left / center / right. Inherits FormItem content-align when unset; standalone fields default to inline start                             | `'left' \| 'center' \| 'right'`                               | `-`                             |
| `max-tag-count`                         | Maximum visible tags; 0 means unlimited                                                                                                          | `number`                                                      | `0`                             |
| `tag-nowrap`                            | Keep tags on one line with ellipsis and preserved removal icons; overflow scrolls horizontally; hover, focus or tap truncated text to preview it | `boolean`                                                     | `false`                         |
| `popup-container`                       | Selector, element, element resolver, or false for inline rendering                                                                               | `PopupContainer`                                              | `—`                             |
| `trigger-props`                         | Menu Trigger props; field owns open state                                                                                                        | `TriggerProps`                                                | `—`                             |
| `virtual-list-props`                    | Pass the virtual list attribute, pass in this parameter to turn on virtual scrolling [VirtualListProps](#VirtualListProps)                       | `VirtualListProps`                                            | `—`                             |
| `search-delay`                          | Search debounce delay in ms                                                                                                                      | `number`                                                      | `500`                           |
| `format-label`                          | Format selected labels; use label slot for VNodes                                                                                                | `function`                                                    | `—`                             |
| `clearable`                             | Allow clearing; preserve disabled selections                                                                                                     | `boolean`                                                     | `false`                         |
| `options`                               | Tree options; leaf values must be unique in scalar mode; paths distinguish branches                                                              | `CascaderOption[]` / `(query, { signal }) => Array / Promise` | `undefined`                     |
| `field-names`                           | Map value, label, disabled, children, isLeaf, tagProps, render                                                                                   | `CascaderFieldNames`                                          | `—`                             |
| `path-mode`                             | Return a complete path instead of a node value                                                                                                   | `boolean`                                                     | `false`                         |
| `check-strictly`                        | Allow parent selection; unlink parent/child checks                                                                                               | `boolean`                                                     | `false`                         |
| `filterable`                            | Enable search                                                                                                                                    | `boolean`                                                     | `Single: false; multiple: true` |
| case-sensitive                          | Case-sensitive built-in filtering; custom filters take priority                                                                                  | boolean                                                       | false                           |
| `filter-option`                         | Receives query and raw node                                                                                                                      | `(input, option) => boolean`                                  | `—`                             |
| `expand-trigger`                        | Menu / List expansion: click or hover                                                                                                            | `string`                                                      | `click`                         |
| `expand-child`                          | Expand to first child                                                                                                                            | `boolean`                                                     | `false`                         |
| `load-more`                             | Load children asynchronously; call done(children), or done() to allow retry                                                                      | `(option, done) => void`                                      | `—`                             |
| `fallback-option`                       | Display unresolved values                                                                                                                        | `boolean or (value) => string`                                | `true`                          |
| `search-option-only-label`              | Show node label only in search results                                                                                                           | `boolean`                                                     | `false`                         |
| `auto-fit-popup-width`                  | Match Menu width to field                                                                                                                        | `boolean`                                                     | `false`                         |
| `edit-mode`                             | Presentation                                                                                                                                     | `menu`                                                        | `menu`                          |

### Events and methods

- `update:modelValue`, `change(value)`: emitted on commit, not while editing a draft.
- `update:open`, `open-change(open)`: request an expanded-state change.
- `update:inputValue`, `input-value-change(text)`, `search(text)`: search state.
- `focus(event)`, `blur(event)`, `clear(event)`: native field events; only the field owner notifies Form.
- Methods: `focus()`, `blur()`.

### Slots and option data

Use `label({ data })` for custom `selected` labels; `selected` replaces the whole selection area. Also supports `prefix`, `suffix`, `clear-icon({ clear })`, `arrow-icon`, `loading-icon`, `search-icon`, `empty`, and `option({ data })`.

Option `label` is searchable plain text. Use `render` or the `option` slot for custom `option` content, and `format-label` or `label` slot for selected content. Values identify selections; labels never do. `disabled` blocks selection/removal, and `tagProps` customizes selected tags.

### `<CascaderPanel>` Props

| Parameter                 | Description                                                                                                      | Type                                                                                                                                                               |         Default         |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :---------------------: |
| path-mode                 | Return a complete path instead of a node value                                                                   | `boolean`                                                                                                                                                          |         `false`         |
| multiple                  | Multiple selection; enables search by default                                                                    | `boolean`                                                                                                                                                          |         `false`         |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Bound value                                                                                                      | `string\| number\| Record<string, any>\| (    \| string    \| number    \| Record<string, any>    \| (string \| number \| Record<string, any>)[]  )[]\| undefined` |           `-`           |
| default-value             | Default value (uncontrolled state)                                                                               | `string\| number\| Record<string, any>\| (    \| string    \| number    \| Record<string, any>    \| (string \| number \| Record<string, any>)[]  )[]\| undefined` | `'' \| undefined \| []` |
| options                   | Tree options; leaf values must be unique in scalar mode; paths distinguish branches                              | `CascaderOption[]` / `(query, { signal }) => Array / Promise`                                                                                                      |       `undefined`       |
| expand-trigger            | Menu / List expansion: click or hover                                                                            | `string`                                                                                                                                                           |        `'click'`        |
| check-strictly            | Allow parent selection; unlink parent/child checks                                                               | `boolean`                                                                                                                                                          |         `false`         |
| load-more                 | Load children asynchronously; call done(children), or done() to allow retry                                      | `(  option: CascaderOption,  done: (children?: CascaderOption[]) => void) => void`                                                                                 |           `-`           |
| field-names               | Customize fields in `CascaderOption`; when option `value` is an object, `value` is also used as the key property | `CascaderFieldNames`                                                                                                                                               |           `-`           |
| expand-child              | Expand to first child                                                                                            | `boolean`                                                                                                                                                          |         `false`         |

### `<CascaderPanel>` Events

| Event  | Description                             | Arguments                                                                              |
| ------ | --------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| change | Emitted when the selected value changes | value: `string \| number \| (string \| number \| (string \| number)[])[] \| undefined` |

| ----- | :---------------------------------------------: | --------- |
| empty | Content displayed when no options are available | -         |

| --------- | ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | :-----: |

| label     | Option text                           | `string`                                  |   `-`   |
| render    | Custom render function                | `RenderFunction`                          |   `-`   |
| disabled  | Whether disabled                      | `boolean`                                 | `false` |
| tagProps  | Property used for the displayed label | `TagProps`                                |   `-`   |
| children  | Child options                         | `CascaderOption[]`                        |   `-`   |
| isLeaf    | Whether this is a leaf node           | `boolean`                                 | `false` |

## Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { CascaderProps } from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

Field editing uses edit-mode: Cedar supports direct/click/dblclick, and Maple supports direct/popup. The old menu/list/picker editing values are not retained. Popup editors reuse the existing option index, search, asynchronous loading and virtual-list algorithms.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

### Single-selection checkmark variables

| Variable                        | Default                             |
| ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `--c-cascader-item-check-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-action-primary)` |
| `--c-cascader-item-check-size`  | `var(--c-sys-font-size-md)`         |

### Built-in search fields

`searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

The `options` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. The component manages loading, cancellation and stale-result isolation; failures emit load-error. Single/multiple groups initialize with an empty-string query, searchable fields reload when the query changes, and root loading for tree fields remains independent of existing load-more child loading.

# Checkbox

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Reading direction

Checkbox labels and groups follow source dir without reversing value arrays. Space keeps its toggle meaning; disabled and readonly behavior remains effective. Changing direction does not select or clear options.

### Checked All Indeterminate

Preview configuration: `:model-value="checkedAll"`, `:indeterminate="indeterminate"`, `value="1"`, `value="2"`.

Example source: src/checkbox/__demos__/checked-all-indeterminate.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-checkbox :model-value="checkedAll" :indeterminate="indeterminate" @change="handleChangeAll">Check All </c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox-group v-model="data" @change="handleChange">
      <c-checkbox value="1">Option 1</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox value="2">Option 2</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox value="3">Option 3</c-checkbox>
    </c-checkbox-group>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent, ref } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const indeterminate = ref(false)
    const checkedAll = ref(false)
    const data = ref<string[]>([])

    const handleChangeAll = (value) => {
      indeterminate.value = false
      if (value) {
        checkedAll.value = true
        data.value = ['1', '2', '3']
      } else {
        checkedAll.value = false
        data.value = []
      }
    }

    const handleChange = (values) => {
      if (values.length === 3) {
        checkedAll.value = true
        indeterminate.value = false
      } else if (values.length === 0) {
        checkedAll.value = false
        indeterminate.value = false
      } else {
        checkedAll.value = false
        indeterminate.value = true
      }
    }

    return {
      indeterminate,
      checkedAll,
      data,
      handleChangeAll,
      handleChange,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

## Async options

### Async Options

Preview configuration: `edit-mode="direct"`, `:options="options"`, `:max="2"`.

Example source: src/checkbox/__demos__/async-options.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onDeactivated, onUnmounted, ref, shallowRef } from "vue";

const value = ref(["remote"]);
const options = ref([]);
const loading = ref(false);
let pendingTimer;
const manual = ref(false);
const waiting = shallowRef([]);
const applied = ref(0);
const ignored = ref(0);
const changeCount = ref(0);
let version = 0;
let sequence = 0;

function cancelPending() {
  version++;
  if (pendingTimer !== undefined) {
    clearTimeout(pendingTimer);
  }
  pendingTimer = undefined;
  loading.value = false;
}

function load() {
  cancelPending();
  loading.value = true;
  const ticket = version;
  const id = ++sequence;
  const complete = () => {
    if (ticket !== version) {
      ignored.value++;
      return;
    }
    applied.value = id;
    options.value = [
      { label: "异步设备", value: "remote" },
      { label: "设备 A", value: "a" },
      { label: "设备 B", value: "b" },
      { label: "停用设备", value: "locked", disabled: true },
    ];
    pendingTimer = undefined;
    loading.value = false;
  };
  if (manual.value) {
    new Promise((resolve) => {
      waiting.value = [...waiting.value, { id, resolve }];
    }).then(complete);
  } else {
    pendingTimer = setTimeout(complete, 800);
  }
}

function settle(latest) {
  const jobs = [...waiting.value];
  const job = latest ? jobs.pop() : jobs.shift();
  waiting.value = jobs;
  job?.resolve();
}

function cleanup() {
  cancelPending();
  const jobs = waiting.value;
  waiting.value = [];
  jobs.forEach((job) => job.resolve());
}

function remove() {
  cancelPending();
  options.value = [];
}

onDeactivated(cleanup);
onUnmounted(cleanup);
</script>

<template>
  <c-space class="checkbox-async-demo" direction="column">
    <p>业务值独立于当前选项，加载或移除选项不会清空已选值：{{ value }}</p>
    <c-checkbox v-model="manual" edit-mode="direct" @change="remove"
      >Manual responses / 手动返回</c-checkbox
    >
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button size="sm" @click="load">加载选项</c-button>
      <c-button size="sm" @click="remove">移除选项</c-button>
      <c-button
        size="sm"
        :disabled="waiting.length === 0"
        @click="settle(false)"
        >返回最早加载</c-button
      >
      <c-button size="sm" :disabled="waiting.length === 0" @click="settle(true)"
        >返回最新加载</c-button
      >
    </c-space>
    <p aria-live="polite">
      {{
        loading
          ? "加载中，可在完成前移除选项以取消本次加载。"
          : "加载完成后保留当前选值和键盘焦点。"
      }}
    </p>
    <c-checkbox-group
      v-model="value"
      edit-mode="direct"
      :options="options"
      :max="2"
      @change="changeCount++"
    />
    <p>用户变更次数：{{ changeCount }}</p>
    <p role="status">
      Applied: {{ applied }} · Ignored: {{ ignored }} · Pending:
      {{ waiting.length }}
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

`ChoiceValue = string | number | boolean`；`CheckboxModel = boolean | ChoiceValue[]`；`RadioModel = ChoiceValue | null`。

### Reduced motion

Built-in CSS transitions follow `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Removing transitions does not change final visibility, selected/expanded state or event semantics. Applications control custom animations inside slots.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

The `options` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. The component manages loading, cancellation and stale-result isolation; failures emit load-error. Single/multiple groups initialize with an empty-string query, searchable fields reload when the query changes, and root loading for tree fields remains independent of existing load-more child loading.

<!-- Source: src/col/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/col/ -->

# Col

24-column Flex layout. Row manages gutters and alignment; Col manages spans, offsets, ordering and breakpoints. Use Grid for CSS Grid collapse and suffix items.

> **Choosing a layout**
>
> - Grid + GridItem: Use for form columns and card grids with consistent column widths, spans, responsive column counts, or collapsed rows and suffix items.
> - Row + Col: Use for 24-column Flex layouts that need horizontal/vertical alignment, wrapping control, fixed and flexible widths together, or responsive ordering. Row controls the row; Col controls width, offset and order.
> - Space: Use for simple groups of buttons, tags or text that only need spacing, direction and alignment. Use native Flex for more flexible width allocation.

## Basic examples

### Span and offset

Example source: src/col/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

  <div class="controls">Offset<c-radio-group v-model="offset"><c-radio v-for="value in [0, 4, 8]" :key="value" :value="value">{{ value }}</c-radio></c-radio-group></div>
  <c-row :gutter="12"><c-col :span="span" :offset="offset"><div class="cell">{{ span }} / +{{ offset }}</div></c-col><c-col :span="4"><div class="cell soft">4</div></c-col></c-row>
```

## Responsiveness and accessibility

Breakpoints use the browser viewport: xs is the base; sm ≥576, md ≥768, lg ≥992, xl ≥1200 and xxl ≥1600px. Configured values resolve downward from the largest matching breakpoint. SSR starts with xs and responds to the viewport after mounting. Grid collapsing and dynamic ordering are calculated after mounting. These layout containers add no keyboard shortcuts; callers supply content semantics and focusable elements. There are no public methods or dedicated theme tokens.

## Imports

Grid contains only Grid.Item. Row and Col are independent components with their own source, styles, navigation, documentation and demos. Grid.Row/Grid.Col, Row/Col re-exports from Grid and GridRowInstance/GridColInstance are removed. Import them from the library root or separate row/col entries. Installing Grid no longer registers Row/Col automatically.

## Interaction and control

### Toggle All

Preview configuration: `title="Panel 1"`, `name="1"`, `title="Panel 2"`, `name="2"`.

Example source: src/collapse/__demos__/toggle-all.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :style="{ width: '100%' }">
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="toggleAll({ expand: 'inverse' })">Toggle all</c-button>
      <c-button @click="toggleAll({ expand: 'inverse', skipDisabled: true })">Toggle all (skip disabled)</c-button>
      <c-button @click="toggleAll({ expand: true })">Expand all</c-button>
      <c-button @click="toggleAll({ expand: true, skipDisabled: true })">Expand all (skip disabled)</c-button>
      <c-button @click="toggleAll({ expand: false })">Collapse all</c-button>
      <c-button @click="toggleAll({ expand: false, skipDisabled: true })">Collapse all (skip disabled)</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-collapse ref="collapseRef" v-model="activeNames">
      <c-collapse-item title="Panel 1" name="1">
        <div>Content 1</div>
      </c-collapse-item>
      <c-collapse-item title="Panel 2" name="2">
        <div>Content 2</div>
      </c-collapse-item>
      <c-collapse-item title="Panel 3" name="3" disabled>
        <div>Content 3</div>
      </c-collapse-item>
      <c-collapse-item title="Panel 4" name="4" disabled>
        <div>Content 4</div>
      </c-collapse-item>
    </c-collapse>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const collapseRef = ref<{
  toggleAll: (options: { expand: boolean | 'inverse'; skipDisabled?: boolean }) => void
}>()
const activeNames = ref<(string | number)[]>(['2', '4'])

const toggleAll = (options: { expand: boolean | 'inverse'; skipDisabled?: boolean }) => {
  collapseRef.value?.toggleAll(options)
}
</script>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"` and supports runtime and nested overrides. Titles and expanded content inherit reading direction without changing expansion state. The left/right values of expand-icon-position remain physical sides. Custom expansion graphics are not additionally mirrored.

## API

The main value uses ordinary `v-model`: `modelValue` is an array of expanded panel names, including in accordion mode. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state only on creation; later changes do not reset it. Initialization does not emit `update:modelValue`. When `modelValue` is provided, the parent controls the state and its value is authoritative.

<!-- same-source-api:start -->
### Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value | Expanded names; v-model | `(string \| number)[]` | `—` |
| default-value | Uncontrolled initial expanded names | `(string \| number)[]` | `[]` |
| accordion | Accordion mode; at most one open panel | `boolean` | `false` |
| show-expand-icon | Whether to show expansion icons; child items decide when omitted | `boolean` | `—` |
| expand-icon-position | Expand-icon position within the header: left or right, default left. Does not control content expansion direction | `'left' \| 'right'` | `'left'` |
| bordered | Whether to show border | `boolean` | `true` |
| divider | Show dividers | `boolean` | `true` |
| offset | Gap between expanded panels | `boolean` | `false` |
| destroy-on-hide | Destroy content when hidden | `boolean` | `false` |

### Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | Request an expanded-name update | `(string \| number)[]` |
| change | Emitted when expanded panels change | `(string \| number)[]`, `Event` |

### Slots

| Slot | Description | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | Panel list | `—` |

### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| toggleAll | Expand or collapse all panels (no-op in accordion) |

<!-- same-source-api:end -->

The parent `expand-icon` slot is forwarded to items that do not provide their own icon. Scope: `expanded`, `disabled`, `position`. It is not rendered on the root node.

#### CollapseToggleAllOptions

| Arguments | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| expand | `'inverse'` toggles all; `boolean` expands or collapses all | `'inverse' \| boolean` | `—` |
| skipDisabled | Skip disabled panels | `boolean` | `false` |

### `<collapse-item>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name **(required)** | Unique panel identifier corresponding to a value in `modelValue` | `string \| number` | `—` |
| title | Panel title | `string` | `—` |
| disabled | Whether disabled | `boolean` | `false` |
| show-expand-icon | Whether to show an expansion icon | `boolean` | `true` |
| destroy-on-hide | Destroy content when hidden | `boolean` | `false` |

### `<collapse-item>` Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| title | Panel title | `—` |
| extra | Extra content | `—` |
| expand-icon | Expand icon | expanded: `boolean`<br>disabled: `boolean`<br>position: `'left' \| 'right'` |
| default | Panel content | `—` |

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types. `Collapse.Item` and `CollapseItem` refer to the same component.

```ts
import type { CollapseInstance, CollapseToggleAllOptions, ExpandIconPosition } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

Collapse public color variables default to system semantics consistently in Cedar and Maple:

| Variable | Default semantic value |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-collapse-border-color` | `--c-sys-color-border-default` |
| `--c-collapse-title-bg` | `--c-sys-color-surface-default` |
| `--c-collapse-title-bg-active` | `--c-sys-color-surface-default` |
| `--c-collapse-title-bg-disabled` | `--c-sys-color-surface-default` |
| `--c-collapse-title-text-color` | `--c-sys-color-content-primary` |
| `--c-collapse-title-text-color-disabled` | `--c-sys-color-content-disabled` |
| `--c-collapse-content-text-color` | `--c-sys-color-content-primary` |
| `--c-collapse-content-text-color-disabled` | `--c-sys-color-content-disabled` |
| `--c-collapse-content-bg` | `--c-sys-color-surface-muted` |
| `--c-collapse-expand-icon` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-secondary)` |
| `--c-collapse-item-border-color` | `--c-sys-color-border-default` |

### Reduced motion

Built-in CSS transitions follow `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Removing transitions does not change final visibility, selected/expanded state or event semantics. Applications control custom animations inside slots.

## Content and presentation

### Colors

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default-value` | Default | Colors |
| `history-colors` | History colors | Colors |
| `show-history` | Show history colors | Colors |
| `show-preset` | Show preset colors | Colors |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `default-value`: Default value (uncontrolled state)
- `history-colors`: Color array of historical colors
- `show-history`: Show history colors
- `show-preset`: Show preset colors

Example source: src/color-picker/__demos__/colors.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-color-picker
    defaultValue="#00BEBE"
    :historyColors="history"
    showHistory
    showPreset
    @open-change="addHistory" />
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const history = ref(['#00BEBE'])
const addHistory = (visible, color) => {
  if (!visible) {
    const index = history.value.indexOf(color)
    if (index !== -1) {
      history.value.splice(index, 1)
    }
    history.value.unshift(color)
  }
}
</script>
```

```vue
    <c-radio-group type="button" v-model="format">
      <c-radio v-for="item in formatList" :value="item">{{ item }}</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
    <c-color-picker defaultValue="#00BEBE" :format="format" showText :hide-trigger="false" />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const format = ref('hex')
const formatList = ['hex', 'rgb']
</script>
```

## API

### `<ColorPicker>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Bound value | `string` | `-` |
| default-value | Default | `string` | `-` |
| format | Color value format | `'hex' \| 'rgb'` | `-` |
| size | Size | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` |
| show-text | Show color value | `boolean` | `false` |
| show-history | Show history colors | `boolean` | `false` |
| show-preset | Show preset colors | `boolean` | `false` |
| disabled | Disable interaction | `boolean` | `false` |
| disabled-alpha | Disable alpha | `boolean` | `false` |
| hide-trigger | Panel only, without a trigger | `boolean` | `true` |
| history-colors | History colors | `string[]` | `-` |
| preset-colors | Preset colors | `string[]` | `-` |


### Existing precedence of forwarded configuration (F07)

Existing triggerProps are spread after some internal Trigger settings, so nested fields such as disabled can currently override internal values. F07 preserves this order and type for compatibility; it does not apply AutoComplete managed-field rules, promise a new safe subset or automatically prohibit these existing capabilities.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Props

| Arguments            | Description              | Type                         | Default |
| -------------------- | ------------------------ | ---------------------------- | ------- |
| `model-value`        | Bound value              | `string`                     | `-`     |
| `format`             | Color format             | `hex \| rgb`                 | `-`     |
| `size`               | Size                     | `xs \| sm \| md \| lg \| xl` | `md`    |
| `show-text`          | Show color value         | `boolean`                    | `false` |
| `show-history`       | Show history colors      | `boolean`                    | `false` |
| `show-preset`        | Show preset colors       | `boolean`                    | `false` |
| `disabled`           | Disable interaction      | `boolean`                    | `false` |
| `disabled-alpha`     | Disable alpha            | `boolean`                    | `false` |
| `color-picker-props` | Forwarded to ColorPicker | `object`                     | `{}`    |

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { ConfigProviderProps } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```


## Reading direction

Use `<c-config-provider dir="rtl">` to scope right-to-left layout. Omit `dir` to inherit, or nest `dir="ltr"` for a local override. Native DOM `dir` containers work too. The provider renders a `display: contents` div to carry direction to ordinary descendants without adding a layout box; place it in an HTML context that permits a div. It does not change the document direction. The former boolean `rtl` option is replaced by `dir` before release. Physical left/right placements retain their meaning.

Each platform maintains a complete local implementation. They do not import a common core or share component instances or reactive state. Changes must update both implementations. ### Responsive Panels

- `show-time`: Whether to increase time selection
- `shortcuts`: Quick selection of preset time range
- `shortcuts-position`: The position of the preset range on the panel, which is placed at the bottom by default, and the side is generally used for scenes with a large number of preset times

Example source: src/date/picker/__demos__/responsive-panels.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const selected = ref("2026-10-20 09:30:00");
const selectedRange = ref(["2026-10-20 09:30:00", "2026-10-22 18:00:00"]);
const position = ref<"left" | "right" | "bottom">("left");
const positions = ["left", "right", "bottom"].map((value) => ({
  label: value,
  value,
}));
const types = ["date", "month", "year"] as const;
const shortcuts = [{ label: "本月工作日范围", value: "2026-10-20 09:30:00" }];

  {
    label: "本月工作日范围",

</script>
<template>
```

### Disabled Parts

- `disabled-date`: Unselectable date
- `show-time`: Whether to increase time selection
- `disabled-time`: Unselectable time

Example source: src/date/picker/__demos__/disabled-parts.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-date-picker style="margin: 0 24px 24px 0"
    :disabled-date="(current: any) => dayjs(current).isBefore(dayjs())"
  />
  <c-date-picker style="margin-right: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px"
    show-time
    :disabled-date="(current: any) => dayjs(current).isBefore(dayjs())"
    :disabled-time="getDisabledTime"
  />
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent } from 'vue'
import dayjs from 'dayjs'

export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    function range(start: any, end: any) {
      const result = []
      for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
        result.push(i)
      }
      return result
    }

    function getDisabledTime(date: any) {
      return {
        disabledHours: () => range(6, 24),
        disabledMinutes: () => range(30, 60),
        disabledSeconds: () => range(30, 60),
      }
    }
    return {
      dayjs,
      getDisabledTime,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

### Current Range

If not specified, it will be formatted as a string, in the same format as `format`.
- `default-picker-value`: Date displayed on the panel
- `show-now-button`: Whether to display the now button when showTime

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Calendar dates, months and years follow reading order; navigation icons mirror, while date values keep their meaning. In paged grids, Left/Right moves focus visually, Up/Down moves one row, and Home/End moves to the row boundary, skipping disabled items. Focus navigation does not select; Enter/Space keeps the existing selection behavior. Navigation is bounded by the displayed grid. Explicit `shortcuts-position="left|right"` remains physical; `bottom` stays below. Field popovers inherit their source direction.

## API

### Props

Pure panels do not accept field/popup props such as open/default-open, popup-container, placement, trigger-props, placeholder, variant or clearable. Configure popups through Date/DateRange popup-props, and typing through input-editable. disable-confirm alone controls confirmation tools; show-confirm-btn is removed.

| Arguments | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `model-value` | Bound value | `Date \| string \| number` | `-` |
| `type` | Panel type | `date \| week \| month \| year \| quarter` | `date` |
| `format` | Display format | `string \| Function` | `-` |
| `day-start-of-week` | First weekday, calendar only; integer 0–6 | `DateWeekStart` | `0` |
| `readonly` | Readonly; does not change selection | `boolean` | `false` |
| `time-picker-props` | Local time-panel display options | `Partial<TimePickerProps>` | `-` |
| `show-time` | Include time selection | `boolean` | `false` |
| `disabled` | Disable interaction | `boolean` | `false` |
| `disabled-date` | Return true to disable a date | `Function` | `-` |

Desktop calendar capabilities, including shortcuts, footer and cell slots, remain in a separate presentation implementation.

### Shared date-family contract

| Arguments | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `default-value` | Uncontrolled initial value, read once | DateValue / DateValue[] | — |
| `value-format` | Model and event value format: a date format string, Date, or timestamp | string | Follows type |
| `min` / `max` | Inclusive bounds; string bounds use value-format | DateValue | — |
| `disabled-time` | Disabled times for the current date and endpoint | (date: Date, side: DateSide) => DateDisabledTime | — |
| `disable-confirm` | Commit immediately | boolean | true |

`DateValue = Date | string | number`. Clearing a single value produces undefined; clearing a range produces [].
The date argument of `disabledDate(date, side)` and `disabledTime(date, side)` is always a Date; side is start/end.
Time callbacks return numeric lists from `disabledHours()`, `disabledMinutes(hour)` and `disabledSeconds(hour, minute)`.
Invalid dates and incomplete/reversed ranges cannot be committed. Confirmation revalidates dynamic disabling rules. Locked range endpoints cannot be cleared or changed.
Nested panel props configure presentation only; they must not override top-level model-value, format, bounds, disabling rules or control events.

### Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| -------------------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `update:model-value` | Request a model update | value |
| `select` | Select a draft; does not imply submission | value, date(s), formatted text(s) |
| `change` | Committed value changes | value, date(s), formatted text(s) |
| `confirm` | Confirm valid selection; does not use ok | value, date(s), formatted text(s) |

Set `:disable-confirm="false"` to show confirmation tools. The `actions` slot provides `{ confirm, disabled }`; custom `actions` must still call confirm to validate.

Document: llms/en-US/components/date-range.md

<!-- Source: src/date-range/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/date-range/ -->

# DateRange

A date range field. The bound model is an array; use DateRangePicker for a standalone panel.

## String range models

Set format="MM-DD" and value-format="MM-DD" to get ['09-10', '10-10'] directly. These values have no year; parsing uses the current year and cannot preserve cross-year ordering. For real bookings store YYYY-MM-DD and map the payload in application code. format only changes display, while value-format changes the model and events.

Without time-zone the browser-local time zone remains in effect. An explicit IANA time zone changes the civil-time interpretation of strings; Date/timestamp values preserve their instant. Editing one endpoint does not change an untouched endpoint's repeated-hour occurrence or milliseconds.

### Field Panel Tools

Example source: src/date-range/__demos__/field-panel-tools.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { DateShortcut } from "@cedar-design/ui";

const selected = ref(["2025-01-15", "2025-01-20"]);
const viewport = ref(["2025-01-01", "2025-02-01"]);
const acceptNavigation = ref(true);
const notice = ref("");
const shortcutNotice = ref("");
const shortcuts: DateShortcut[] = [
  { label: "下个月", value: ["2025-02-15", "2025-02-20"] },
  { label: "不可选", value: ["2025-03-01", "2025-03-05"], disabled: true },
];
function navigate(value: unknown) {
  if (
    acceptNavigation.value &&
    Array.isArray(value) &&
    value.length === 2 &&
    value.every((part) => typeof part === "string")
  )
    viewport.value = value;
}
function observe(_value: unknown, _dates: unknown, texts: unknown) {
  notice.value = String(texts);
}
function choose(shortcut: DateShortcut) {
  shortcutNotice.value = String(shortcut.label);
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-checkbox v-model="acceptNavigation"> 接受视口请求</c-checkbox>
  <c-date-range
    v-model="selected"
    :input-editable="false"
    format="DD/MM/YYYY"
    :date-range-picker-props="{ pickerValue: viewport, shortcuts }"
    @update:picker-value="navigate"
    @picker-value-change="observe"
    @select-shortcut="choose"
  />
  <p>选择模型：{{ selected }}；受控视口：{{ viewport }}</p>
  <p>视口通知：{{ notice }}；快捷项通知：{{ shortcutNotice }}</p>
  <p>
    导航不改变选择模型；拒绝视口请求后，日历仍显示原月份。快捷项先选择草稿，确认后提交。
  </p>
</template>
```
