### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## Reading direction

Range values remain `[start, end]` across direction changes; switching direction neither swaps endpoints nor commits drafts. Range ribbons and boundary corners follow reading order. Paged calendar grids use visual Left/Right focus movement and chronological rows. Maple endpoint editing and continuous range highlighting are separate presentations. Explicit shortcut positions `left/right` remain physical, and popovers inherit their source direction.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Props

| Arguments                 | Description                                                                                                                      | Type                                       | Default   |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | --------- |
| `open-trigger-target`     | Pointer opening target: the whole field or only the suffix icon. Explicit keyboard opening and controlled open remain available. | `'field' \| 'icon'`                        | `'field'` |
| `model-value`             | Bound value                                                                                                                      | `(Date \| string \| number)[]`             | `-`       |
| `type`                    | Date precision                                                                                                                   | `date \| week \| month \| year \| quarter` | `date`    |
| `open`                    | Controlled popup visibility                                                                                                      | `boolean`                                  | `-`       |
| `clearable`               | Show the clear action                                                                                                            | `boolean`                                  | `true`    |
| `disabled`                | Disable interaction                                                                                                              | `boolean \| boolean[]`                     | `-`       |
| `readonly`                | Read-only interaction                                                                                                            | `boolean`                                  | `false`   |
| `size`                    | Size                                                                                                                             | `xs \| sm \| md \| lg \| xl`               | `-`       |
| `variant`                 | Field appearance                                                                                                                 | `filled \| outline \| standard`            | `filled`  |
| `separator`               | Range separator                                                                                                                  | `string`                                   | `-`       |
| `placeholder`             | Placeholder                                                                                                                      | `string[]`                                 | `-`       |
| `disabled-date`           | Return true to disable a date                                                                                                    | `Function`                                 | `-`       |
| `format`                  | Display format                                                                                                                   | `string`                                   | `-`       |
| `show-time`               | Include time selection                                                                                                           | `boolean`                                  | `false`   |
| `date-range-picker-props` | Panel presentation options                                                                                                       | `DateRangePickerOptions`                   | `{}`      |

### Shared date-family contract

| Arguments         | Description                                                                   | Type                                               | Default      |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| `default-value`   | Uncontrolled initial value, read once                                         | DateValue / DateValue[]                            | —            |
| `value-format`    | Model and event value format: a date format string, Date, or timestamp        | string                                             | Follows type |
| `min` / `max`     | Inclusive bounds; string bounds use value-format                              | DateValue                                          | —            |
| `disabled-time`   | Disabled times for the current date and endpoint                              | (date: Date, side: DateSide) => DateDisabledTime   | —            |
| `disable-confirm` | Commit immediately                                                            | boolean                                            | false        |
| `default-open`    | Uncontrolled initial open state                                               | boolean                                            | false        |
| `popup-props`     | Trigger presentation options; cannot override owned visibility or date rules  | object                                             | {}           |
| `popup-container` | Portal target; the top-level value wins, including false for inline rendering | string / HTMLElement / (() => HTMLElement) / false | —            |

`DateValue = Date | string | number`. Clearing a single value produces undefined; clearing a range produces [].
The date argument of `disabledDate(date, side)` and `disabledTime(date, side)` is always a Date; side is start/end.

`disabled-date` restricts range endpoints. A range may cross disabled interior values; it is not scanned item by item or truncated automatically. This applies to dates, months and years. Interior disabled values remain gray. Changing pages preserves the selected start and clears hover preview; reverse selection is sorted chronologically.
Time callbacks return numeric lists from `disabledHours()`, `disabledMinutes(hour)` and `disabledSeconds(hour, minute)`.
Invalid dates and incomplete/reversed ranges cannot be committed. Confirmation revalidates dynamic disabling rules. Locked range endpoints cannot be cleared or changed.
Nested panel props configure presentation only; they must not override top-level model-value, format, bounds, disabling rules or control events.

### Events

| Event                         | Description                               | Arguments                         |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `update:model-value`          | Request a model update                    | value                             |
| `select`                      | Select a draft; does not imply submission | value, date(s), formatted text(s) |
| `change`                      | Committed value changes                   | value, date(s), formatted text(s) |
| `update:open` / `open-change` | Popup visibility changes                  | open: boolean                     |
| `clear`                       | Clear the selection                       | None                              |
| `focus` / `blur`              | Focus enters or leaves the whole field    | None                              |
| `click`                       | Click the field                           | event                             |

Desktop supports keyboard editing. The default panel edits a draft before confirmation; disable-confirm commits directly. Escape or closing discards the draft. focus(index = 0) focuses a start/end input, and blur() closes the popup.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Document: llms/en-US/components/date.md

<!-- Source: src/date/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/date/ -->

# Date

Floating date panels use the visual viewport height so the full calendar is visible when space permits. Short windows scroll content while keeping actions visible. Override `--c-date-picker-popover-max-height` to adjust the limit (default `100dvh - 32px`).

A date field with a trigger. Use DatePicker for a standalone panel.

## String models and time zones

format controls display; value-format controls the model and events. Use YYYY-MM-DD for a date string or YYYY-MM for a month string. MM-DD has no year and parsing uses the current year, so retain a full date for cross-year ordering or explicit leap-year rules.

Omitting time-zone preserves browser-local behavior. With an IANA time zone, Date and timestamps represent instants while strings represent local civil times in that zone. Invalid DST times are rejected; newly entered repeated times resolve to the first occurrence. Untouched Date/timestamp range endpoints preserve their exact instant and hidden precision. Maple-only scroll/line views do not change Cedar panel defaults.

### Rejected Close

Example source: src/date/__demos__/rejected-close.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";

const value = ref("2026-09-22");
const open = ref(false);
const closeRequests = ref(0);
const commits = ref(0);

function requestOpen(next) {
  if (next) open.value = true;
  else closeRequests.value++;
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="12px">
    <p>关闭请求会被父级拒绝；选择新日期后可再次确认，重复确认不应重复提交。</p>
    <c-date
      v-model="value"
      :open="open"
      @update:open="requestOpen"
      @change="commits++"
    >
      <template #actions="{ confirm, disabled }">
        <c-button :disabled="disabled" @click="confirm()">确认</c-button>
        <c-button @click="open = false">允许关闭</c-button>
      </template>
    </c-date>
    <span data-test="date-transaction-state"
      >值：{{ value }}；提交：{{ commits }}；拒绝关闭：{{ closeRequests }}</span
    >
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Field Panel Tools

Example source: src/date/picker/__demos__/field-panel-tools.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { DateShortcut } from "@cedar-design/ui";

const selected = ref("2025-01-15");
const viewport = ref("2025-01-01");
const acceptNavigation = ref(true);
const notice = ref("");
const shortcutNotice = ref("");
const shortcuts: DateShortcut[] = [
  { label: "下个月", value: "2025-02-15" },
  { label: "不可选", value: "2025-03-01", disabled: true },
];
function navigate(value: unknown) {
  if (acceptNavigation.value && typeof value === "string")
    viewport.value = value;
}
function observe(_value: unknown, _dates: unknown, texts: unknown) {
  notice.value = String(texts);
}
function choose(shortcut: DateShortcut) {
  shortcutNotice.value = String(shortcut.label);
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-checkbox v-model="acceptNavigation"> 接受视口请求</c-checkbox>
  <c-date
    v-model="selected"
    :input-editable="false"
    format="DD/MM/YYYY"
    :date-picker-props="{ pickerValue: viewport, shortcuts }"
    @update:picker-value="navigate"
    @picker-value-change="observe"
    @select-shortcut="choose"
  />
  <p>选择模型：{{ selected }}；受控视口：{{ viewport }}</p>
  <p>视口通知：{{ notice }}；快捷项通知：{{ shortcutNotice }}</p>
  <p>
    导航不改变选择模型；拒绝视口请求后，日历仍显示原月份。快捷项先选择草稿，确认后提交。
  </p>
</template>
```

```vue
        :day-start-of-week="week"
        :disable-confirm="false"
```

| Arguments             | Description                                                                                                                      | Type                                       | Default         |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | --------------- |
| `open-trigger-target` | Pointer opening target: the whole field or only the suffix icon. Explicit keyboard opening and controlled open remain available. | `'field' \| 'icon'`                        | `'field'`       |
| `model-value`         | Bound value                                                                                                                      | `Date \| string \| number`                 | `-`             |
| `type`                | Date precision                                                                                                                   | `date \| week \| month \| year \| quarter` | `date`          |
| `open`                | Controlled popup visibility                                                                                                      | `boolean`                                  | `-`             |
| `clearable`           | Show the clear action                                                                                                            | `boolean`                                  | `true`          |
| `disabled`            | Disable interaction                                                                                                              | `boolean`                                  | `false`         |
| `readonly`            | Read-only interaction                                                                                                            | `boolean`                                  | `false`         |
| `size`                | Component size                                                                                                                   | `xs \| sm \| md \| lg \| xl`               | `-`             |
| `variant`             | Field appearance                                                                                                                 | `filled \| outline \| standard`            | `filled`        |
| `placeholder`         | Placeholder                                                                                                                      | `string`                                   | `-`             |
| `disabled-date`       | Return true to disable a date                                                                                                    | `Function`                                 | `-`             |
| `format`              | Display format                                                                                                                   | `string \| Function`                       | Depends on type |
| `show-time`           | Include time selection                                                                                                           | `boolean`                                  | `false`         |
| `date-picker-props`   | Panel presentation options                                                                                                       | `DatePickerOptions`                        | `{}`            |

#### Copying and editing

With open-trigger-target="icon", use the input area to edit or copy and the suffix button to open. Existing text remains copyable when editing or search is disabled.

Example source: src/date/__demos__/open-trigger-target.en-US.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-radio-group
      v-model="target"
      :options="[
        { label: 'Whole field', value: 'field' },
        { label: 'Suffix icon only', value: 'icon' },
      ]"
    />
    <label><c-switch v-model="editable" /> Allow editing / search</label>
    <c-date
      v-model="value"
      edit-mode="direct"
      :open-trigger-target="target"
      :input-editable="editable"
    />
    <p>
      Disable editing to copy existing text. In icon mode, editing does not open
      the panel.
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const target = ref<"field" | "icon">("icon");
const editable = ref(true);
const value = ref("2026-10-27");
</script>
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Calendar dates, months and years follow reading order; navigation icons mirror, while date values keep their meaning. In paged grids, Left/Right moves focus visually, Up/Down moves one row, and Home/End moves to the row boundary, skipping disabled items. Focus navigation does not select; Enter/Space keeps the existing selection behavior. Navigation is bounded by the displayed grid. Explicit `shortcuts-position="left|right"` remains physical; `bottom` stays below. Field popovers inherit their source direction.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Props

| Arguments             | Description                                                                                                                      | Type                                       | Default        |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | -------------- |
| `open-trigger-target` | Pointer opening target: the whole field or only the suffix icon. Explicit keyboard opening and controlled open remain available. | `'field' \| 'icon'`                        | `'field'`      |
| `model-value`         | Bound value                                                                                                                      | `Date \| string \| number`                 | `-`            |
| `type`                | Date precision                                                                                                                   | `date \| week \| month \| year \| quarter` | `date`         |
| `open`                | Controlled popup visibility                                                                                                      | `boolean`                                  | `-`            |
| `clearable`           | Show the clear action                                                                                                            | `boolean`                                  | `true`         |
| `disabled`            | Disable interaction                                                                                                              | `boolean`                                  | `false`        |
| `readonly`            | Read-only interaction                                                                                                            | `boolean`                                  | `false`        |
| `size`                | Size                                                                                                                             | `xs \| sm \| md \| lg \| xl`               | `-`            |
| `variant`             | Field appearance                                                                                                                 | `filled \| outline \| standard`            | `filled`       |
| `placeholder`         | Placeholder                                                                                                                      | `string`                                   | `-`            |
| `disabled-date`       | Return true to disable a date                                                                                                    | `Function`                                 | `-`            |
| `format`              | Display format                                                                                                                   | `string \| Function`                       | Follows `type` |
| `show-time`           | Include time selection                                                                                                           | `boolean`                                  | `false`        |
| `date-picker-props`   | Panel presentation options                                                                                                       | `DatePickerOptions`                        | `{}`           |

### Shared date-family contract

| Arguments         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Type                                               | Default      |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| `default-value`   | Uncontrolled initial value, read once                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | DateValue / DateValue[]                            | —            |
| `value-format`    | Model and event value format: a date format string, Date, or timestamp                                                                                                                                                                                  | string                                             | Follows type |
| `min` / `max`     | Inclusive bounds; string bounds use value-format                                                                                                                                                                                                        | DateValue                                          | —            |
| `disabled-time`   | Disabled times for the current date and endpoint                                                                                                                                                                                                        | (date: Date, side: DateSide) => DateDisabledTime   | —            |
| `disable-confirm` | Commit immediately                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | boolean                                            | false        |
| `default-open`    | Uncontrolled initial open state                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | boolean                                            | false        |
| `popup-props`     | Optional field-popup presentation settings. Placement defaults to bottom-start and is positioned automatically by the underlying Trigger; the preferred side can be overridden. No top-level placement prop; field state and rules cannot be overridden | object                                             | {}           |
| `popup-container` | Portal target; the top-level value wins, including false for inline rendering                                                                                                                                                                           | string / HTMLElement / (() => HTMLElement) / false | —            |

`DateValue = Date | string | number`. Clearing a single value produces undefined; clearing a range produces [].
The date argument of `disabledDate(date, side)` and `disabledTime(date, side)` is always a Date; side is start/end.
Time callbacks return numeric lists from `disabledHours()`, `disabledMinutes(hour)` and `disabledSeconds(hour, minute)`.
Invalid dates and incomplete/reversed ranges cannot be committed. Confirmation revalidates dynamic disabling rules. Locked range endpoints cannot be cleared or changed.
Nested panel props configure presentation only; they must not override top-level model-value, format, bounds, disabling rules or control events.

### Events

| Event                         | Description                               | Arguments                         |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `update:model-value`          | Request a model update                    | value                             |
| `select`                      | Select a draft; does not imply submission | value, date(s), formatted text(s) |
| `change`                      | Committed value changes                   | value, date(s), formatted text(s) |
| `update:open` / `open-change` | Popup visibility changes                  | open: boolean                     |
| `clear`                       | Clear the selection                       | None                              |
| `focus` / `blur`              | Focus enters or leaves the whole field    | None                              |
| `click`                       | Click the field                           | event                             |

Desktop supports keyboard editing. The default panel edits a draft before confirmation; disable-confirm commits directly. Escape or closing discards the draft. focus(index = 0) focuses a start/end input, and blur() closes the popup.

## Explicit time zones

`timeZone` accepts IANA names such as `Asia/Shanghai`. Date objects and millisecond timestamps represent instants; strings represent local time in the target zone. Display, typed input, min/max, shortcuts and disabling rules use the same protocol; event Date objects retain the actual instant. Omitting `timeZone` preserves local-zone behavior. Nonexistent daylight-saving times and invalid zones cannot be committed; repeated times use the first occurrence. Maple scroll / line are mobile calendar presentations; desktop retains its existing panel.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

### Placement semantics and configuration

The Date field prefers bottom-start below its input. Override the preferred side through popupProps.placement only when needed; the underlying Trigger positions it, not Popup or Popover. DatePicker is a standalone date panel with no input anchor; placement in the legacy date/picker directory is not a current public DatePicker prop.

# Dialog

A modal dialog with matching declarative and programmatic APIs.

## Basic examples

### Basic

Example source: src/dialog/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-button @click="open = true">Open Dialog</c-button>

  <c-dialog
    v-model:open="open"
    title="Dialog Title"
    message="This is a basic component dialog."
    @confirm="Message.success('Confirmed')"
    @cancel="Message.info('Cancelled')"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Message } from "@cedar-design/ui";
import { ref } from "vue";

const open = ref(false);
</script>
```

## Invocation and content

### Global

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | Title | Confirm, Form, Simple |
| `type` | Status icon: `info`, `success`, `warning` or `error` | Confirm, Simple |
| `message` | Message content; the default slot is also supported | Confirm, Simple |
| `before-close` | Return a boolean/Promise or call done; the first completion wins | Form |
| `simple` | Compact layout with a centered footer | Simple |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/dialog/__demos__/global.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space>
    <c-button @click="openBasic">Basic</c-button>
    <c-button @click="openDialog">Open</c-button>
    <c-button @click="openAndUpdate">Open and Update</c-button>
    <c-button @click="awaitAction">Await Action</c-button>
    <c-button @click="hideButtons">Hide Footer Buttons</c-button>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Dialog, Message } from "@cedar-design/ui";

function openBasic() {
  Dialog.open("This dialog was opened from a string message.");
}

function openDialog() {
  Dialog.open({
    title: "Global Method",
    message: "This dialog was opened programmatically.",
  });
}

function openAndUpdate() {
  const instance = Dialog.open({
    title: "Submitting",
    message: "Processing the request…",
  });
  window.setTimeout(
    () =>
      instance.update({
        title: "Completed",
        message: "The request succeeded.",
      }),
    800,
  );
}

async function awaitAction() {
  const action = await Dialog.open("Choose an action to close this dialog.");
  if (action) Message.info(`Dialog action: ${action}`);
}

function hideButtons() {
  Dialog.open({
    title: "No Footer Buttons",
    message: "Click the overlay or press Esc to dismiss this dialog.",
    confirmButton: false,
    cancelButton: false,
  });
}
</script>
```

### Alert

Example source: src/dialog/__demos__/alert.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-button @click="handleClick">Alert</c-button>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { Dialog } from '@cedar-design/ui'

export default {
  setup() {
    const handleClick = () => {
      Dialog.alert({
        title: 'Alert',
        message: 'This is an alert description.',
        type: 'info',

</script>
```

### Confirm

Example source: src/dialog/__demos__/confirm.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space>
    <c-button @click="openConfirm">Confirm</c-button>
    <c-button status="danger" @click="openDangerConfirm">Delete</c-button>
    <c-button @click="componentOpen = true">Component Confirm</c-button>
  </c-space>

  <c-dialog
    v-model:open="componentOpen"
    type="warning"
    title="Confirm Action"
    message="Are you sure you want to continue?"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { Dialog, Message } from "@cedar-design/ui";

const componentOpen = ref(false);

async function openConfirm() {
  const action = await Dialog.confirm({
    title: "Confirm Action",
    message: "Are you sure you want to continue?",
  });
  if (action) Message.info(`Dialog action: ${action}`);
}

async function openDangerConfirm() {
  const action = await Dialog.confirm({
    title: "Dangerous Action",
    message: "This action cannot be undone. Continue?",
    confirmButtonText: "Delete",
    confirmButtonProps: { variant: "default", status: "danger" },
  });
  if (action) Message.info(`Dialog action: ${action}`);
}
</script>
```

### Message

Example source: src/dialog/__demos__/message.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space>
    <c-button @click="handleClickInfo">Info</c-button>
    <c-button status="success" @click="handleClickSuccess">Success</c-button>
    <c-button status="warning" @click="handleClickWarning">Warning</c-button>
    <c-button status="danger" @click="handleClickError">Error</c-button>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { Dialog } from '@cedar-design/ui'

export default {
  setup() {
    const handleClickInfo = () => {
      Dialog.info({
        title: 'Info Notification',
        message: 'This is an info description which directly indicates a neutral informative change or action.',
      })
    }
    const handleClickSuccess = () => {
      Dialog.success({
        title: 'Success Notification',
        message: 'This is a success notification',
      })
    }
    const handleClickWarning = () => {
      Dialog.warning({
        title: 'Warning Notification',
        message: 'This is a warning description which directly indicates a warning that might need attention.',
      })
    }
    const handleClickError = () => {
      Dialog.error({
        title: 'Error Notification',
        message: 'This is an error description which directly indicates a dangerous or potentially negative action.',
      })
    }

    return {
      handleClickInfo,
      handleClickSuccess,
      handleClickWarning,
      handleClickError,
    }
  },
}
</script>
```

```vue
      <c-form-item field="post" label="Post">
        <c-select v-model="form.post">
          <c-option value="post1">Post1</c-option>
          <c-option value="post2">Post2</c-option>
          <c-option value="post3">Post3</c-option>
          <c-option value="post4">Post4</c-option>
        </c-select>
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
  </c-dialog>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent, reactive, ref } from 'vue'

export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const visible = ref(false)
    const form = reactive({
      name: '',
      post: '',
    })

    const handleClick = () => {
      visible.value = true
    }

    const handleBeforeClose = ({ action }, done) => {
      if (action !== 'confirm') {
        done()
        return
      }

      window.setTimeout(() => {
        done()
      }, 2000)
    }

    const handleCancel = () => {
      visible.value = false
    }

    return {
      visible,
      form,
      handleClick,
      handleBeforeClose,
      handleCancel,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

## Async actions and closing

### Async

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `before-close` | Return a boolean/Promise or call done; the first completion wins | Async, Guard Protocol |
| `title` | Title | Async |
| `message` | Message content; the default slot is also supported | Async |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/dialog/__demos__/async.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space>
    <c-button @click="asyncOpen = true">Async Close</c-button>
    <c-button @click="loadingOpen = true">Button Loading</c-button>
  </c-space>

  <c-dialog
    v-model:open="asyncOpen"
    title="Async Close"
    message="Every action waits for the asynchronous task to finish."
    :before-close="beforeClose"
  />
  <c-dialog
    v-model:open="loadingOpen"
    title="Button Loading"
    message="The confirm button displays loading while the task is running."
    :before-close="buttonLoadingClose"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { DialogAction } from "../types";

const asyncOpen = ref(false);
const loadingOpen = ref(false);

function beforeClose({ action: _action }: { action: DialogAction }, done: () => void) {
  window.setTimeout(done, 1000);
}

function buttonLoadingClose(
  { action }: { action: DialogAction },
  done: () => void,

) {
  if (action !== "confirm") {
    done();
    return;
  }

  window.setTimeout(() => {
    done();
  }, 1000);
}
</script>
```

### Api Review

### Guard Protocol

Example source: src/dialog/__demos__/en-US/guard-protocol.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { DialogBeforeClose } from "@cedar-design/ui";
const open = ref(false);
const mode = ref("promise");
const allowed = ref(false);
const status = ref("");
const check: DialogBeforeClose = (payload, done, { signal }) => {
  status.value = `Waiting: ${payload.action}`;
  if (mode.value === "done") {
    setTimeout(() => {
      status.value = allowed.value ? "Allowed" : "Rejected";
      done(!signal.aborted && allowed.value);
    }, 500);
    return;
  }
  return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) =>
    setTimeout(() => {
      status.value = allowed.value ? "Allowed" : "Rejected";
      resolve(!signal.aborted && allowed.value);
    }, 500),
  );
};
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch">
    <c-switch v-model="allowed" />
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="mode">
      <c-radio-group
        aria-label="mode"
        v-model="mode"
        :options="[
          { value: 'promise', label: 'Promise' },
          { value: 'done', label: 'done callback' },
        ]"
        variant="button"
        size="sm"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-button @click="open = true">Open</c-button>
    <c-dialog
      v-model:open="open"
      :before-close="check"
      @guard-error="status = 'Error'"
    >
      <template #default
        ><c-button v-if="false" @click="open = true">Confirm action</c-button
        ><span v-else>Close with beforeClose</span></template
      >
    </c-dialog>
    <p role="status">{{ status }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### `<Dialog>` Props

| Name | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------ |
| dir | Reading direction; inherits the source scope when omitted. Physical left/right placements keep their meaning. | `ReadingDirection` (`ltr` / `rtl`) | — |
| `open` **(v-model)** | Visible state | `boolean` | `-` |
| `default-open` | Initial uncontrolled state | `boolean` | `false` |
| `title` | Title | `string` | `-` |
| `message` | Message content; the default slot is also supported | `string` | `-` |
| `message-align` | Message alignment | `'left' \| 'center' \| 'right'` | `'left'` |
| `type` | Status icon: info, success, warning or error | `string` | `-` |
| `simple` | Compact layout with a centered footer | `boolean` | `false` |
| `width` | Width | `number \| string` | `-` |
| `top` | Top offset; ignored when align-center is enabled | `number \| string` | `-` |
| `title-align` | Title alignment | `'start' \| 'center'` | `'center'` |
| `align-center` | Center vertically and horizontally | `boolean` | `true` |
| `overlay` | Show overlay | `boolean` | `true` |
| `overlay-class` | Overlay class | `string` | `-` |
| `overlay-style` | Overlay style | `CSSProperties` | `-` |
| `overlay-closable` | Request closure on an overlay click | `boolean` | `true` |
| `esc-to-close` | Request closure on Escape | `boolean` | `true` |
| `lock-scroll` | Lock background scrolling while open | `boolean` | `true` |
| `close-on-route-change` | Close on browser history or hash changes | `boolean` | `false` |
| `popup-container` | Teleport target; `false` disables teleport | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `'body'` |
| `confirm-button` | Show the confirm button | `boolean` | `true` |
| `cancel-button` | Show the cancel button | `boolean` | `true` |
| `closable` | Show close button | `boolean` | `true` |
| `confirm-button-text` | Confirm button text | `string` | `-` |
| `cancel-button-text` | Cancel button text | `string` | `-` |
| `confirm-button-loading` | Confirm button loading state | `boolean` | `false` |
| `cancel-button-loading` | Cancel button loading state | `boolean` | `false` |
| `confirm-button-disabled` | Disable the confirm button | `boolean` | `false` |
| `cancel-button-disabled` | Disable the cancel button | `boolean` | `false` |
| `confirm-button-props` | Confirm button props | `ButtonProps` | `-` |
| `cancel-button-props` | Cancel button props | `ButtonProps` | `-` |
| `footer` | Show the footer | `boolean` | `true` |
| `dialog-class` | Dialog class | `string \| any[]` | `-` |
| `dialog-style` | Dialog style | `CSSProperties` | `-` |
| `body-class` | Body class | `string \| any[]` | `-` |
| `body-style` | Body style | `StyleValue` | `-` |
| `hide-title` | Hide the title | `boolean` | `false` |
| `unmount-on-close` | Unmount after closing | `boolean` | `false` |
| `draggable` | Allow dragging | `boolean` | `false` |
| `fullscreen` | Fullscreen layout | `boolean` | `false` |
| `overlay-animation-name` | Overlay animation name | `string` | `fade-modal` |
| `dialog-animation-name` | Dialog animation name | `string` | `zoom-modal` |
| `z-index` | Stack level | `number` | `-` |
| `before-close` | Return a boolean/Promise or call done; the first completion wins | `DialogBeforeClose` | — |

### `<Dialog>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------ | ------------- | --------------- |
| `open` | Opening begins | `-` |
| `opened` | Opening transition completes | `-` |
| `close` | Closing begins | `-` |
| `closed` | Closing transition completes | `-` |
| `confirm` | Accepted confirm action | `Event` |
| `cancel` | Accepted cancel or close action | `Event` |
| `click-overlay` | `MouseEvent` | `MouseEvent` |
| `key-escape` | ESC | `KeyboardEvent` |

### `<Dialog>` Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| --------- | ---- | ---------------------------- |
| `default` | Content | `-` |
| `title` | Title | `-` |
| `footer` | Footer | `cancel`, `confirm`, `close` |

### DialogConfig

| Name | Description | Type |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `content` | Renderable content; takes priority over message | `RenderContent` |
| `footer` | Footer visibility or custom footer content | `boolean \| RenderContent` |
| `onConfirm` | Confirm callback | `(e?: Event) => void` |
| `onCancel` | Cancel callback | `(e?: Event) => void` |
| `onClickOverlay` | Overlay click callback | `() => void` |
| `onKeyEscape` | Escape callback | `() => void` |

### DialogMethod

| Method | Description | Return value |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------- |
| `Dialog.open(config)` | Open a dialog | `Promise<DialogAction> & DialogReturn` |
| `Dialog.confirm(config)` | Confirmation dialog; defaults to warning | Same as above |
| `Dialog.alert(config)` | Alert dialog without a cancel button | Same as above |
| `Dialog.info(config)` | Information dialog | Same as above |
| `Dialog.success(config)` | Success dialog | Same as above |
| `Dialog.warning(config)` | Warning dialog | Same as above |
| `Dialog.error(config)` | Error dialog | Same as above |
| `Dialog.close()` | Close the latest functional dialog | `void` |
| `Dialog.setDefaultOptions(config)` | Set default programmatic options | `void` |
| `Dialog.resetDefaultOptions()` | Reset default programmatic options | `void` |

### DialogReturn

| Prop | Description |
| ---------------- | -------- |
| `close()` | Close |
| `update(config)` | Update options |

### Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"` and supports runtime and nested overrides. Content, headings and action gaps use logical edges. Portals inherit their source direction. Direction changes preserve close, confirm, cancel and pending-state semantics.

| `--c-dialog-animation-duration` | `var(--c-sys-motion-duration-slow)` |
| `--c-dialog-animation-easing` | `var(--c-sys-motion-easing-standard)` |


Promise and done share a single completion state: false/done(false) rejects; true/done() allows; a resolved Promise&lt;void&gt; allows. The first completion wins. Errors emit guard-error; cancellation/unmount invalidates late completion. Synchronous void retains the callback protocol and waits for done on these close/confirm guards.


Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise&lt;void&gt; allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

### `<Dialog>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------ | ------------- | --------------- |
| `open` | When opened | `-` |
| `opened` | Opening transition completes | `-` |
| `close` | Closing begins | `-` |
| `closed` | Closing transition completes | `-` |
| `confirm` | Accepted confirm action | `Event` |
| `cancel` | Accepted cancel or close action | `Event` |
| `click-overlay` | `MouseEvent` | `MouseEvent` |
| `key-escape` | ESC | `KeyboardEvent` |

The `close` button, overlay, ESC and `close()` use `close` semantics without an additional `cancel` event.

### `<Dialog>` Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| --------- | ---- | ---------------------------- |
| `default` | Content | `-` |
| `title` | Title | `-` |
| `footer` | Footer | `cancel`, `confirm`, `close` |

Confirm and cancel buttons use Button's `default` status and `text` variant unless `confirmButtonProps` or `cancelButtonProps` overrides them.

### Global methods

Function-based Dialog calls default to simple layout (`simple: true`) with the top-right close button hidden (`closable: false`). Explicit options or global defaults can override both.

#### DialogConfig

Accepts the component props in camelCase, plus:

| Parameter | Description | Type |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `content` | Renderable content; takes priority over `message` | `RenderContent` |
| `footer` | Whether to show a footer, or custom footer content | `boolean \| RenderContent` |
| `onConfirm` | Confirm callback | `(e?: Event) => void` |
| `onCancel` | Cancel callback | `(e?: Event) => void` |
| `onClickOverlay` | Overlay click callback | `() => void` |
| `onKeyEscape` | Escape callback | `() => void` |

#### DialogMethod

| Method | Description | Returns |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------- |
| `Dialog.open(config)` | Open a dialog | `Promise<DialogAction> & DialogReturn` |
| `Dialog.confirm(config)` | Confirmation dialog; defaults to `type: warning` | As above |
| `Dialog.alert(config)` | Alert dialog without a cancel button | As above |
| `Dialog.info(config)` | Information dialog | As above |
| `Dialog.success(config)` | Success dialog | As above |
| `Dialog.warning(config)` | Warning dialog | As above |
| `Dialog.error(config)` | Error dialog | As above |
| `Dialog.close()` | Close the latest functional dialog | `void` |
| `Dialog.setDefaultOptions(config)` | Set default programmatic options | `void` |
| `Dialog.resetDefaultOptions()` | Reset default programmatic options | `void` |

#### DialogReturn

| Prop | Description |
| ---------------- | -------- |
| `close()` | Close |
| `update(config)` | Update options |

After installation, call through `app.config.globalProperties.$dialog`.

### Style variables

Dialog public color variables have the same meanings as Maple: `--c-dialog-background` is the raised panel background (`surface-raised`); `--c-dialog-overlay-background` is the scrim; `--c-dialog-title-text-color` and `--c-dialog-content-text-color` are primary content; `--c-dialog-close-button-color` is the secondary action. `--c-dialog-status-{info|success|warning|danger}-color` uses readable content-info/success/warning/danger, not status fills. Business themes should override these component variables; shared themes should override the corresponding system variables. Borders, widths, spacing and layout retain desktop specifications.

#### Complete variable defaults

The backdrop consumes `sys-color-scrim` through the Dialog component variable. Maple no longer uses Popup colors for Dialog. Set a per-instance backdrop variable via `overlay-style`; a variable on the panel (`dialog-style`) does not inherit to its sibling backdrop. Explicit `overlay-style.backgroundColor` wins. Teleported content needs variables on its actual DOM ancestors. Dark themes inherit the same semantic colors; geometry remains platform-specific. Status icons use readable content colors.

Variables are grouped by purpose: background/overlay-background for panel/scrim; border-* for panel/divider borders; title-* for title typography; content-* for body typography; actions-* for actions; close-button-* for the close button; status-* for semantic icons; simple-*/fullscreen-* for mode dimensions; animation-* for enter/leave motion. width/margin-top control ordinary panel layout. Internal drag/position variables are not public customization points.

### Before-hook waiting feedback

Before-hook waits show visible feedback and aria-busy. Rejected or failed operations recover; duplicate submissions do not start another copy. Notification event Promises never drive loading.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`. Horizontal text start/end follows reading order; vertical start/end remains top/bottom. Inset controls along-line indentation and spacing controls perpendicular margins. Paired horizontal inset and vertical spacing uses logical start/end. Vertical borders use inline start; hairline, border type and aria-orientation retain their meaning. Direction changes preserve content nodes.

## API

### Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | Horizontal/vertical orientation of the divider itself, default horizontal; does not control text alignment | `horizontal` \| `vertical` | `horizontal` |
| `type` | Line style | `solid` \| `dashed` \| `dotted` \| `double` | `solid` |
| `text-align` | Text position along the line; start/end follow logical direction | `start` \| `center` \| `end` | `center` |
| `description` | Description text; the default slot takes priority | `string` | — |
| `inset` | Inset along the line: left/right horizontally, top/bottom vertically | `DividerSize` | — |
| `spacing` | Outer spacing across the line: top/bottom horizontally, left/right vertically | `DividerSize` | `md` |
| `thickness` | Line width in px; theme defaults to 1px; hairline takes priority | `number` | — |
| `hairline` | Scale the theme line width by half; 0.5px with the default theme | `boolean` | `false` |
| `color` | Line color; defaults to the theme border color | `string` | — |
| `opacity` | Opacity of the entire divider, including text, from 0 to 1; zero preserves layout | `number` | — |

### Spacing values

`DividerSize = number | string | Array<number | string>`

`inset` controls the ends of the line; `spacing` controls the outer gap between the line and adjacent content. Both accept presets `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, a number in px, a CSS length, or an array. A scalar or single-item array applies to both ends; `[start, end]` sets each end separately. Array entries are lengths, not preset names.

| Direction | inset array order | spacing array order |
| --- | --- | --- |
| horizontal | Inline start/end inset; right/left in RTL | Top/bottom margin |
| vertical | Top/bottom inset | Inline start/end margin; right/left in RTL |

`inset` has no `inset` by default; `spacing` defaults to the platform’s `md` `spacing`. Presets use platform theme tokens, so pixel values may differ.

### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | Custom divider content; overrides description |


# Drawer

A side panel with declarative and programmatic APIs and cancellable before-close operations.

## Basic examples

### Basic

Example source: src/drawer/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-button status="primary" @click="handleClick">Open Drawer</c-button>
  <c-drawer v-model:open="visible" :width="340" @confirm="handleConfirm" @cancel="handleCancel" unmount-on-close>
    <template #title>Title</template>
    <div>
      You can customize modal body text by the current situation. This modal will be closed immediately once you press
      the OK button.
    </div>
  </c-drawer>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
const visible = ref(false)

const handleClick = () => {
  visible.value = true
}
const handleConfirm = () => {
  visible.value = false
}
const handleCancel = () => {
  visible.value = false
}
</script>
```

### Api Review

## Closing and async control

### Guard Protocol

Example source: src/drawer/__demos__/en-US/guard-protocol.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { DrawerBeforeClose } from "@cedar-design/ui";
const open = ref(false);
const mode = ref("promise");
const allowed = ref(true);
const status = ref("");
const check: DrawerBeforeClose = (payload, done, { signal }) => {
  status.value = `Waiting: ${payload.action}`;
  if (mode.value === "done") {
    setTimeout(() => {
      status.value = allowed.value ? "Allowed" : "Rejected";
      done(!signal.aborted && allowed.value);
    }, 500);
    return;
  }
  return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) =>
    setTimeout(() => {
      status.value = allowed.value ? "Allowed" : "Rejected";
      resolve(!signal.aborted && allowed.value);
    }, 500),
  );
};
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch">
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" label="Allow closing"><c-switch v-model="allowed" aria-label="Allow closing" /></c-form-item>
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="mode">
      <c-radio-group
        aria-label="mode"
        v-model="mode"
        :options="[
          { value: 'promise', label: 'Promise' },
          { value: 'done', label: 'done callback' },
        ]"
        variant="button"
        size="sm"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-button @click="open = true">Open</c-button>
    <c-drawer
      v-model:open="open"
      :before-close="check"
      @guard-error="status = 'Error'"
    >
      <p>The guard waits briefly before closing. Turn off the switch to reject once, then enable it here and retry.</p>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" label="Allow closing"><c-switch v-model="allowed" aria-label="Allow closing inside drawer" /></c-form-item>
      <c-button @click="allowed = true; open = false">Allow and close</c-button>
      <p role="status">{{ status }}</p>
    </c-drawer>
    <p role="status">{{ status }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| dir | Reading direction; inherits the source scope when omitted. Physical left/right placements keep their meaning. | `ReadingDirection` (`ltr` / `rtl`) | — |
| open **(v-model)** | Controlled visibility | `boolean` | - |
| default-open | Initial uncontrolled visibility | `boolean` | `false` |
| placement | Side of the containing area where the drawer appears, default right. It is not anchored to a button and does not perform popup collision flipping | `'top' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'left'` | `'right'` |
| title | Title | `string` | - |
| overlay | Show the overlay | `boolean` | `true` |
| overlay-class / overlay-style | Overlay class and style | `string / CSSProperties` | - |
| overlay-closable | Request closure on overlay click | `boolean` | `true` |
| closable | Show the close button | `boolean` | `true` |
| confirm-button-text / cancel-button-text | Action button text | `string` | - |
| confirm-button-loading / cancel-button-loading | Action button loading state | `boolean` | `false` |
| confirm-button-disabled / cancel-button-disabled | Action button disabled state | `boolean` | `false` |
| confirm-button-props / cancel-button-props | Action button props | `ButtonProps` | - |
| unmount-on-close | Unmount content after the closing transition | `boolean` | `false` |
| width / height | Width for left/right placement; height for top/bottom placement | `number \| string` | `250` |
| popup-container | Portal container | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `'body'` |
| drawer-class / drawer-style | Panel class and style | `string \| any[] / CSSProperties` | - |
| body-class / body-style | Body class and style | `string \| any[] / StyleValue` | - |
| `before-close` | Return a boolean/Promise or call done; the first completion wins | `DrawerBeforeClose` | — |
| esc-to-close | Request closure on Escape | `boolean` | `true` |
| lock-scroll | Lock scrolling on the host | `boolean` | `true` |
| close-on-route-change | Request closure on route changes | `boolean` | `false` |
| z-index | Custom z-index | `number` | Automatically allocated |
| header / footer / cancel-button | Show the corresponding region | `boolean` | `true` |

### Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:open | Request a visibility update | `boolean` |
| confirm / cancel | Accepted confirm or cancel action | `Event` |
| open / close | Opening or closing begins | - |
| opened / closed | Opening or closing transition completes | - |
| click-overlay | Click the topmost overlay | `MouseEvent` |
| key-escape | Escape reaches the topmost drawer | `KeyboardEvent` |

| `--c-drawer-transition-timing-function` | `var(--c-transition-timing-function-standard)` |


Promise and done share a single completion state: false/done(false) rejects; true/done() allows; a resolved Promise&lt;void&gt; allows. The first completion wins. Errors emit guard-error; cancellation/unmount invalidates late completion. Synchronous void retains the callback protocol and waits for done on these close/confirm guards.


Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise&lt;void&gt; allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"` and supports runtime and nested overrides. Drawer placement=left/right remains physical, including entry and exit motion. Headings, content and footer actions inherit reading direction. Direction changes do not submit or clear content.

### Slots

`default`, `header`, `title`, `footer`. The `footer` slot receives `confirm`, `cancel` and `close` methods.

### Imperative calls

`Drawer.open(config)` uses camelCase options such as `cancelButtonText`, `beforeClose` and `closeOnRouteChange`. Notifications use `onConfirm`, `onCancel`, `onOpen`, `onOpened`, `onClose`, `onClosed`, `onClickOverlay` and `onKeyEscape`.

```ts
import type { DrawerAction, DrawerConfig, DrawerProps } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

## CSS variables and color semantics

Built-in fade and four-direction slide disable transitions and initial displacement under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Component styles handle this without global fallbacks. Default durations remain unchanged; business-defined animations require separate handling. Compiled-CSS checks do not substitute for testing live OS preference changes.

Panel bg uses surface-raised; overlay-bg uses sys-color-scrim; header-text-color/content-text-color use content-primary, with the close button inheriting header-text-color; border-color uses border-default. Drawer keeps its existing geometry, motion and stacking defaults. Drawer is a Cedar component; Maple does not define empty same-name variables.

overlay-style sets instance scrim variables; drawer-style sets panel variables. These sibling nodes do not inherit variables from one another. Set global system theme variables on a real common ancestor. Explicit background props take precedence over variable consumption. The unused close-icon-right variable is removed; title layout and close-btn-margin-left position the close button, without an ineffective compatibility alias.

| Variable | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-drawer-header-height` | `var(--c-size-12)` |
| `--c-drawer-footer-button-margin-left` | `var(--c-spacing-6)` |
| `--c-drawer-header-font-size` | `var(--c-font-size-title-1)` |
| `--c-drawer-padding-horizontal` | `var(--c-spacing-7)` |
| `--c-drawer-footer-padding-vertical` | `var(--c-spacing-7)` |
| `--c-drawer-content-padding-vertical` | `var(--c-spacing-6)` |
| `--c-drawer-header-font-weight` | `var(--c-font-weight-500)` |

### Before-hook waiting feedback

Before-hook waits show visible feedback and aria-busy. Rejected or failed operations recover; duplicate submissions do not start another copy. Notification event Promises never drive loading.

## API

### Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expand` | Controlled expansion | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| `default-expand` | Initial uncontrolled expansion | `boolean` | `false` |
| `expand-trigger` | Enable click / Enter / Space toggling | `'click'` | `—` |
| `line-clamp` | Positive line count; omitted or invalid means single line | `number \| string` | `—` |
| `tooltip` | Tooltip configuration; false disables it | `boolean \| TooltipProps` | `true` |

Providing `expand` makes the component request updates from its parent rather than changing controlled state. When omitted, internal state is used, initialized once by `default-expand`. Tooltip follows its own width and trigger defaults; display does not depend on measured overflow. Touch callers can include `click` in `tooltip.trigger` explicitly. External class/style/width apply directly to the text node.

### Events and slots

- `update:expand(expand: boolean)`: the new state requested by user interaction; external updates do not emit it.
- `default`: body text.
- `tooltip-content`: tooltip content. Without it, tooltip.content takes precedence, then body text; content is not concatenated twice.
- Keyboard: expandable text supports Enter / Space; tooltip-enabled text is focusable with Tab. No public instance methods.

### Types

```ts
import type { EllipsisProps, EllipsisInstance, EllipsisExpandTrigger } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

### Style variables

| Token | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-ellipsis-focus-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-brand)` |
| `--c-ellipsis-focus-width` | `2px` |
| `--c-ellipsis-focus-offset` | `2px` |

### Style variables

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--c-empty-description-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-tertiary)` | Low-emphasis empty-state description |
| `--c-empty-icon-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-decorative)` | Decorative nontext icon; not for text users need to read |

| `--c-empty-size-xs/sm/md/lg/xl` | `var(--c-size-15/20/25/35/45)` | Default icon/image size presets |

Descriptions are text and must meet text contrast requirements; decorative icons may be weaker. Custom images/slots may have their own colors and are not forcibly recolored by `icon-color`. Desktop/mobile maintain their own dimensions and spacing while keeping variable responsibilities consistent.

# Field Decorator

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

Focused inputs do not draw an additional outer outline. Existing variant borders, underlines or backgrounds provide focus feedback. This applies to consumers including Input, Textarea, Date and Time.

Input, textarea and numeric-input carets use `currentColor`, matching the current input text. Error state does not override caret color separately.

`--c-field-caret-color` defaults to `currentColor` and controls Input, InputNumber and Textarea carets without changing text color.

```vue
  selectValue.value = "beijing";
```

## Loading and waiting

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

 Example source: src/field-decorator/__demos__/loading.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const busy = ref(true)
const mode = ref<'default' | 'line'>('line')
const text = ref('加载时仍可编辑')
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-space><c-switch v-model="busy" />加载状态</c-space>
    <c-radio-group v-model="mode" :options="['default', 'line']" variant="button" aria-label="字段加载布局" />
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item label="文本"><c-input v-model="text" :loading="busy" :loading-mode="mode" /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="多行文本"><c-textarea v-model="text" :loading="busy" :loading-mode="mode" /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="选择"><c-select edit-mode="direct" :options="[{ label: '选项', value: 'a' }]" :loading="busy" :loading-mode="mode" /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="日期"><c-date edit-mode="direct" :loading="busy" :loading-mode="mode" /></c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p>加载展示由同一个 FieldDecorator 实现，不隐式禁用输入；需要禁止操作时单独设置 disabled 或 readonly。</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Loading tokens

| Token | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-field-loading-line-size` | `2px` |
| `--c-field-loading-duration` | `1s` |
| `--c-field-loading-color` | `var(--c-field-focus-color)` |

## Props

The outline notch uses `fieldset / legend`, not a background mask. It starts aligned with the content column and reserves `hint-space` on both sides. CSS `max()/calc()` in `padding-inline-start` must be emitted verbatim by Less, preventing different Less versions from prematurely evaluating it as `0px`. `check:input` checks source parity and both libraries’ Less output.

| Prop | Type | Default / meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tag` | `'div' \| 'span'` | `div`; wrapper element |
| `value` | `unknown` | Checks only whether content is empty |
| `id` | `string` | Native control id associated with the floating label |
| `title` | `string` | Native title tooltip |
| `size` | `ComponentSize` | `md`; implements all five sizes |
| `variant` | `'outline' \| 'filled' \| 'standard'` | `outline` |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Floating label text |
| `hint` | `boolean` | Cedar false / Maple true |
| `hint-center` | `boolean` | `true`; use false for multiline controls |
| `line` | `boolean` | `true`; whether to show a border or underline |
| `focused` | `boolean` | Consumer-supplied focus state |
| `composing` | `boolean` | Keep the label floated during IME composition |
| `disabled` / `readonly` / `error` | `boolean` | Provided by the consumer after merging Form / Group state |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `false`; whether clearing is allowed |
| `text-color` / `focus-color` / `blur-color` | `string` | Custom text, focused and unfocused colors |
| `cursor` | `string` | Custom caret |

## Slots and events

`default` contains a native input, tags or display content. `prefix` / `suffix` contain adornments. `clear-icon` receives `clear(event?)`; a custom button should call it. Clearing does not bubble to open the selection panel.

`clear(event)` asks the consumer to update the value; `mousedown(event)` lets the consumer manage focus. The wrapper does not mutate the model itself.

Style semantics use `--c-field-*` / `--mp-field-*`, declared in each library's `style/token.less`. Implementations are not shared across libraries. Consumers must not draw a second border.

## Error and disabled border variables

Prefix these suffixes with `--c-field-` / `--mp-field-`: `variant-outline-border-color-error` controls outline error borders; `variant-standard-line-color-error` controls standard error underlines; `variant-standard-line-color-disabled` controls standard disabled underlines and defaults to system border-subtle. Disabled overrides error, hover and focus. All three support local overrides. `field-error-color` still controls error text. Internal variables are not business API; unused legacy declarations are removed without aliases.

# Filter Form

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Preview configuration: `v-model:collapsed="collapsed"`, `:fields="fields"`, `:rules="rules"`.

Example source: src/filter-form/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-filter-form
    v-model="filter"
    v-model:collapsed="collapsed"
    :fields="fields"
    :rules="rules"
  >
    <template #actions>
      <c-button variant="outline" :elevation="false" @click="reset">重置</c-button>
      <c-button status="primary" :elevation="false" @click="search">搜索</c-button>
    </template>
  </c-filter-form>
  <pre class="demo-filter-json">{{ filter }}</pre>
  <p role="status">{{ result }}</p>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

  Cascader,
  DateRange,
  Input,
  Select,
  type FilterFormField,

const collapsed = ref(true)

const filter = ref<Record<string, unknown>>({
  region: undefined,
  status: undefined,
  keyword: '',
  timeRange: undefined,
})

const options = {
  status: [
    { label: '待处理', value: 'pending' },
    { label: '进行中', value: 'doing' },
    { label: '已完成', value: 'done' },
  ],
  owner: [
    { label: '张三', value: 'zhang' },
    { label: '李四', value: 'li' },
  ],
}

const rules = {
  keyword: [{ maxLength: 50, message: '最多 50 个字符' }],
}

const fields: FilterFormField[] = [
  {
    component: Cascader,
    field: 'region',
    label: '地区',
    props: {
      clearable: true,
      placeholder: '请选择地区',
      pathMode: true,
      variant: 'outline',
      options: [

          value: 'beijing',
          label: '北京',
          children: [
            { value: 'chaoyang', label: '朝阳' },
            { value: 'haidian', label: '海淀' },
          ],
        },
        {
          value: 'shanghai',
          label: '上海',
          children: [{ value: 'huangpu', label: '黄浦' }],
        },
      ],
    },
  },
  {
    component: Select,
    field: 'status',
    label: '状态',
    props: { variant: 'outline', clearable: true, placeholder: '全部', options: options.status },
  },
  {
    component: Select,
    field: 'owner',
    label: '负责人',
    props: { variant: 'outline', clearable: true, placeholder: '全部', options: options.owner },
  },
  {
    component: Input,
    field: 'keyword',
    label: '关键词',
    autoEmitChange: false,
    props: { variant: 'outline', clearable: true, placeholder: '回车或失焦触发' },
  },
  {

  result.value = `搜索条件：${JSON.stringify(filter.value)}`

  filter.value = {
    region: undefined,
    status: undefined,
    keyword: '',
    timeRange: undefined,
  }
```

Example source: src/filter-form/__demos__/async-options.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" style="width: 100%">
    <c-alert>
      异步加载选项后，通过 computed 更新字段的 props.options。
    </c-alert>
    <c-filter-form
      v-model="filter"
      :fields="fields"
      :collapsed="false"
      :collapsible="false"
    >

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, onMounted, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue'
import {
  Input,
  Select,
  type FilterFormField,
} from '@cedar-design/ui'

const filter = ref<Record<string, unknown>>({
  category: undefined,
  tag: undefined,
  name: '',
})

const options = ref<Record<string, unknown>>({
  category: [],
  tag: [],
})

const fields = computed<FilterFormField[]>(() => [
  {
    component: Select,
    field: 'category',
    label: '分类',
    props: { clearable: true, placeholder: '请选择', options: options.value.category },
  },
  {
    component: Select,
    field: 'tag',
    label: '标签',
    props: { clearable: true, multiple: true, placeholder: '请选择', options: options.value.tag },
  },
  {
    component: Input,
    field: 'name',
    label: '名称',
    props: { clearable: true },
  },
])

let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>
onUnmounted(() => clearTimeout(timer))

onMounted(() => {
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    options.value = {
      category: [
        { label: '组件', value: 'component' },
        { label: '工具', value: 'tool' },
      ],
      tag: [
        { label: '推荐', value: 'hot' },
        { label: '新品', value: 'new' },
      ],
    }
  }, 800)
})

const result = ref('尚未搜索')
function search() {
  result.value = `搜索条件：${JSON.stringify(filter.value)}`
}

function reset() {
  filter.value = {
    category: undefined,
    tag: undefined,
    name: '',
  }
}
</script>
```

## API

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the filter-fields object. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once; later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence, and initialization emits no `update:modelValue`.

### FilterForm Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Form value | `Record<string, unknown>` | `{}` |
| fields | Filter-item schema | `FilterFormField[]` | `[]` |
| field-map | Optional field-component registry | `FilterFormFieldMap` | `{}` |
| rules | Forwarded Form validation rules | object | - |
| collapsed **(v-model)** | Whether to collapse extra items | boolean | `true` |
| collapsible | Whether expanding/collapsing is enabled | boolean | `true` |
| cols | Responsive column count | number \| object | `{ xs:1, sm:2, md:3, lg:3, xl:4, xxl:5 }` |
| grid-props | Other Grid props | object | - |
| change-debounce | Change debounce interval in milliseconds | number | `500` |

### FilterFormField

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| component | Vue component or a key in `fieldMap` | `string \| Component` | - |
| field | Form field path | string | - |
| label | Label | string | - |
| visible | Whether to render | boolean | `true` |
| autoEmitChange | Whether input emits change while editing | boolean | `true` |
| props | Props forwarded to the field component | object | - |
| gridItemProps | GridItem props | object | - |
| formItemProps | FormItem props | object | - |

### FilterFormFieldRegistration

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| component | Field component | Component | - |
| defaultProps | Default props | object | - |

### Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | v-model | `(value) => void` |
| update:collapsed | Collapsed state changes | `(collapsed) => void` |
| change | Debounced field-value changes | `(value, field) => void` |

### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| actions | Action area for search/reset, on the same row as the expand/collapse control |

### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| formRef | Internal Form instance |

## Style variables

| Variable | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-filter-form-border-radius` | `var(--c-border-radius-md)` |
| `--c-filter-form-background-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-surface-default)` |
| `--c-filter-form-padding` | `var(--c-sys-space-7)`（20px） |
| `--c-filter-form-border-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-border-subtle)` |
| `--c-filter-form-border-width` | `1px` |
| `--c-filter-form-action-offset` | `calc(1em * var(--c-form-line-height) + var(--c-form-vertical-label-margin-bottom))` |
| `--c-filter-form-item-margin-bottom` | `0px`; Grid controls row spacing |
| `--c-filter-form-actions-gap` | `var(--c-sys-space-5)`（12px） |
| `--c-filter-form-collapse-gap` | `4px` |
| `--c-filter-form-collapse-color` | `var(--c-color-text-2)` |
| `--c-filter-form-collapse-hover-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-brand)` |
| `--c-filter-form-focus-width` | `2px` |
| `--c-filter-form-focus-offset` | `3px` |

Consumption verified on 2026-10-16: real Less compilation and mounted DOM confirm these 13 variables feed the container, FormItem, action-area and collapse-button rules. The static style entry also imports Form styles. Multi-column action `padding-top` consumes action-offset; stacked single-column mode overrides it to `0`. Root derived aliases do not necessarily recompute after locally overriding Form dependencies; adjust alignment by overriding `--c-filter-form-action-offset` on the actual FilterForm root.

## Types

```ts
import type {
  FilterFormProps,
  FilterFormField,
  FilterFormFieldMap,
  FilterFormFieldRegistration,
} from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

Grid column spacing is controlled by `grid-props.colGap` in numeric px. There is no same-name CSS override, ensuring numerical Grid measurements match actual spacing.
