# Form

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Reading direction

Form and FormItem accept start/end/left/center/right for content-align and start/end/left/right for label-align. Content defaults to start and labels to end: default LTR placement stays the same while RTL follows reading order. Explicit left/right remain physical. Item overrides and explicit label-column styles retain precedence. Direction changes preserve values, validation and disabled/readonly state.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

- `model`: Form data object

Example source: src/form/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-form ref="refForm" :model="form" @submit="handleSubmit">
    <c-form-item field="name" label="Username" required>
      <c-select v-model="form.name">
        <c-optgroup label="Group-1">
          <c-option>Beijing</c-option>
          <c-option>Shanghai</c-option>
        </c-optgroup>
        <c-option>Guangzhou</c-option>
        <c-option disabled>Disabled</c-option>
      </c-select>
    </c-form-item>
    <c-form-item>
      <c-button html-type="submit">Submit</c-button>
    </c-form-item>
  </c-form>
  {{ form.name }}
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
import type { FormInstance } from "../index";

const refForm = ref<FormInstance>();
const form = reactive({ name: "", post: "", isRead: false });
const handleSubmit = (data: any) => refForm.value?.resetFields(data);
</script>
```

### Layout

`edit-mode` describes editing behavior: `direct` always shows the control; `click` and `dblclick` activate the existing editor overlay near the field. `readPretty` is an independent boolean. FormItem and fields inherit the mode when omitted. The legacy field `presentation` prop has been removed; use `edit-mode` to configure editing behavior. Replace `presentation="inline"` with `edit-mode="direct"`; `layout="inline"` is unchanged.

Combine `layout`, `content-align` with `direct / click / dblclick` editing and the independent `readPretty` boolean to compare label, value and wrapped-text alignment. Notes can override the form layout, and values survive every switch. Click or double-click a value to edit in a popover; readPretty displays saved text.

Example source: src/form/__demos__/en-US/layout.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

</script>

<template><Comparison english /></template>
```

### Cross Field

- `model`: Form data object

Example source: src/form/__demos__/cross-field.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";

import {
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onDeactivated,
  reactive,
  ref,
  shallowRef,
  useId,
} from "vue";

const formRef = ref();
const id = useId();
const model = reactive({ source: "", confirmation: "" });
const result = ref("尚未提交");
const submissions = ref(0);
const snapshot = ref("");
const message = "两次代码须相同且不能为空";
const sourceRules = [{ required: true, message: "请输入源代码" }];
const paused = ref(false);
const pending = shallowRef([]);
let epoch = 0;
function complete() {
  const [resolve, ...rest] = pending.value;
  pending.value = rest;
  resolve?.();
}
function cleanup() {
  epoch++;
  const tasks = pending.value;
  pending.value = [];
  tasks.forEach((resolve) => resolve());
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup);
onDeactivated(cleanup);
const confirmationRules = [
  {
    validator: async (value, callback) => {
      if (paused.value)
        await new Promise((resolve) => {
          pending.value = [...pending.value, resolve];
        });
      if (!value || value !== model.source) callback(message);
    },
  },
];
function submitted({ errors, values }) {
  submissions.value++;
  result.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
  snapshot.value = JSON.stringify(values);
}
async function validateConfirmation() {
  const current = ++epoch;
  const errors = await formRef.value?.validateField("confirmation");
  if (current === epoch) result.value = errors ? "确认值未通过" : "确认值通过";
}
function reset() {
  cleanup();
  result.value = "已重置";
  snapshot.value = "";
}
</script>

<template>
  <section class="cross-field-form-demo">
    <p>
      仅使用本地合成代码。校验时确认值比较当前源代码；修改源代码不自动复验依赖字段。
    </p>
    <c-form ref="formRef" :model="model" @submit="submitted" @reset="reset">
      <c-form-item
        field="source"
        label="源代码"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id + '-source' }"
        :rules="sourceRules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id + '-source'" v-model="model.source" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="confirmation"
        label="确认代码"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id + '-confirmation' }"
        :rules="confirmationRules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id + '-confirmation'" v-model="model.confirmation" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-space wrap>
        <c-button html-type="submit">提交代码</c-button>
        <c-button @click="validateConfirmation">只校验确认值</c-button>
        <c-button html-type="reset">重置代码</c-button>
      </c-space>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">结果：{{ result }}；提交次数：{{ submissions }}</p>
    <c-button
      html-type="button"
      :aria-pressed="paused"
      @click="paused = !paused"
      >暂停跨字段校验</c-button
    >
    <c-button html-type="button" :disabled="!pending.length" @click="complete"
      >返回跨字段结果</c-button
    >
    <p class="cross-field-pending">等待：{{ pending.length }}</p>
    <ModelOutput>模型：{{ model }}</ModelOutput>
    <ModelOutput>上次提交值：{{ snapshot || "-" }}</ModelOutput>
  </section>
</template>
```

### Empty markers and required validation

The API uses -1 for no selection. Validate the initial value to see a required error, choose a department and validate successfully, then clear to -1 and validate again. Form provides recognition settings; the field defines clear output. Custom validators still receive the original value.

Example source: src/form/__demos__/en-US/empty-values-validation.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const model = reactive({ department: -1 as number | null | undefined });
const form = ref();
const result = ref("Not validated");
const options = [
  { value: 1, label: "Engineering" },
  { value: 2, label: "Product" },
];
async function validate() {
  const errors = await form.value.validate();
  result.value = errors ? "Required error" : "Valid";
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>
      Validate the initial -1, then select a department and validate again.
      Clearing restores -1.
    </p>
    <c-form
      ref="form"
      :model="model"
      layout="vertical"
      :empty-values="[null, undefined, -1]"
    >
      <c-form-item field="department" label="Department" required>
        <c-select
          v-model="model.department"
          :options="options"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-value="-1"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-button @click="validate">Validate</c-button>
    <p role="status">{{ result }}</p>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ String(model.department) }}</output>
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Reading placeholders and inheritance

Initially in reading mode, Name inherits Form’s default “-”, Code uses the FormItem override, Nickname uses the field override, and Quantity remains 0. Changing Form text only affects inheriting fields. Toggling reading/editing does not rewrite the model. Precedence is Field > FormItem > Form; custom read slots win.

Example source: src/form/__demos__/en-US/empty-text.vue

```vue
});
</script>

      Nickname, and the valid number 0 for Quantity.
    </p>

      <c-button @click="reading = !reading">Toggle reading/editing</c-button>

      <c-button @click="emptyText = '-'">Use default “-”</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-form
      :model="model"
      layout="vertical"
      :read-pretty="reading"
      :empty-text="emptyText"

      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
```

```vue
<template>
  <c-space>
    <c-button @click="formRef && formRef.validate()">Submit</c-button>
    <c-button @click="formRef && formRef.resetFields()">Reset</c-button>

    <template v-for="(fieldName, index) in fieldNames" :key="index">

import { reactive, ref, defineComponent } from 'vue'

    const fieldCount = 20
    const fieldNames = Array.from({ length: fieldCount }, (_, index) => `name${index}`)

      Object.fromEntries(fieldNames.map((fieldName, index) => [fieldName, index === 7 ? '' : index.toString()])),
    )
```

Example source: src/form/__demos__/dynamic-form.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-form :model="form" :style="{ width: '600px' }">
    <c-form-item field="name" label="Username">
      <c-input v-model="form.name" placeholder="please enter your username..." />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-form-item
      v-for="(post, index) of form.posts"
      :field="`posts[${index}].value`"
      :label="`Post-${index}`"
      :key="index"
    >
      <c-input v-model="post.value" placeholder="please enter your post..." />
      <c-button @click="handleDelete(index)" :style="{ marginLeft: '10px' }">Delete</c-button>
    </c-form-item>
  </c-form>

import { reactive, defineComponent } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const form = reactive({
      name: '',
      posts: [{ value: '' }],
    })
    const handleAdd = () => {
      form.posts.push({
        value: '',
      })
    }

      form.posts.splice(index, 1)
    }

      form,
      handleAdd,
      handleDelete,
    }
```

### Async Validate Form

- `model`: Form data object

Example source: src/form/__demos__/async-validate-form.vue

```vue
<template>
  <section class="async-form-demo" @submit.capture="beginSubmit">
    <p>本地模拟异步校验：用户名只能是 admin，延迟 600ms，不访问外部接口。</p>
    <c-form
      ref="formRef"
      :model="form"
      @submit="handleSubmit"
      @reset="handleReset"
    >
      <c-form-item
        field="name"
        label="用户名"
        :label-attrs="{ for: `${demoId}-name` }"
        :rules="rules"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input
          :id="`${demoId}-name`"
          v-model="form.name"
          placeholder="请输入 admin"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="post"
        label="岗位"
        :label-attrs="{ for: `${demoId}-post` }"
      >
        <c-input
          :id="`${demoId}-post`"
          v-model="form.post"
          placeholder="请输入岗位"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="isRead">
        <c-checkbox v-model="form.isRead">已阅读说明</c-checkbox>
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item>
        <c-space>
          <c-button html-type="submit" status="primary" :loading="submitting"
            >提交</c-button
          >
          <c-button html-type="reset">重置</c-button>
          <c-button @click="setStatus">模拟服务端错误</c-button>
        </c-space>
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p role="status">提交结果：{{ result }}；活动校验：{{ pendingCount }}</p>
    <ModelOutput>{{ form }}</ModelOutput>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import ModelOutput from '../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue'

import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, reactive, ref, useId } from "vue";
import type { FormInstance, FieldRule } from "@cedar-design/ui";

const formRef = ref<FormInstance>();
const demoId = useId();
const form = reactive({ name: "", post: "", isRead: false });
const result = ref("尚未提交");
const submitting = ref(false);
const pendingCount = ref(0);
const pending = new Map<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>, () => void>();
let generation = 0;
let submittedGeneration = -1;
const rules: FieldRule[] = [
  {
    validator: (value, callback) =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        const current = generation;
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          pending.delete(timer);
          pendingCount.value = pending.size;
          if (current === generation && value !== "admin")
            callback("用户名必须是 admin");
          resolve();
        }, 600);
        pending.set(timer, resolve);
        pendingCount.value = pending.size;
      }),
  },
];

function beginSubmit() {
  submittedGeneration = generation;
  submitting.value = true;
  result.value = "校验中";
}
function cancelPending() {
  generation++;
  pending.forEach((resolve, timer) => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    resolve();
  });
  pending.clear();
  pendingCount.value = 0;
  submitting.value = false;
}
function handleSubmit({ errors }: { errors?: unknown }) {
  if (submittedGeneration !== generation) return;
  submitting.value = false;
  result.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
}
function handleReset() {
  cancelPending();
  result.value = "已重置";
}
function setStatus() {
  formRef.value?.setFields({
    name: { status: "error", message: "模拟服务端用户名错误" },
    post: { status: "error", message: "模拟服务端岗位错误" },
  });
  result.value = "服务端错误已展示";
}
onBeforeUnmount(cancelPending);
onDeactivated(cancelPending);
</script>
```

### Async Fields

- `model`: Form data object

Example source: src/form/__demos__/async-fields.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";

import {
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onDeactivated,
  reactive,
  ref,
  shallowRef,
  useId,
} from "vue";
const formRef = ref();
const id = useId();
const model = reactive({ name: "", code: "" });
const pending = shallowRef([]);
const submissions = ref(0);
const submittedResult = ref("-");
function submitted({ errors }) {
  submissions.value++;
  submittedResult.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
}
const result = ref("尚未校验");
let run = 0;
function request(field, value) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    pending.value = [...pending.value, { field, value, resolve }];
  });
}
function rules(field) {
  return [
    {
      validator: async (value, callback) => {
        const answer = await request(field, value);
        if (answer !== true) callback(answer);
      },
    },
  ];
}
const nameRules = rules("name");
const codeRules = rules("code");
async function validate() {
  const current = ++run;
  result.value = "校验中";
  const errors = await formRef.value?.validate();
  if (current === run) result.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
}
function complete(field, latest = false) {
  const tasks = pending.value.filter((item) => item.field === field);
  const task = latest ? tasks.at(-1) : tasks[0];
  if (!task) return;
  pending.value = pending.value.filter((item) => item !== task);
  task.resolve(
    task.value === (field === "name" ? "admin" : "1234")
      ? true
      : field === "name"
        ? "用户名必须是 admin"
        : "代码必须是 1234",
  );
}
function reset() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.resetFields();
  result.value = "已重置";
}
function clear() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.clearValidate();
  result.value = "已清空";
}
function serverError() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.setFields({
    name: { status: "error", message: "模拟服务端拒绝" },
  });
  result.value = "服务端错误";
}
function cleanup() {
  run++;
  const tasks = pending.value;
  pending.value = [];
  tasks.forEach((task) => task.resolve(true));
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup);
onDeactivated(cleanup);
</script>
<template>
  <section class="async-fields-form-demo">
    <p>
      两个独立本地 Promise 规则分别接受 admin 和
      1234；手动返回各字段，不访问网络。
    </p>
    <c-form ref="formRef" :model="model" @submit="submitted">
      <c-form-item
        field="name"
        label="用户名"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id + '-name' }"
        :rules="nameRules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id + '-name'" v-model="model.name" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="code"
        label="代码"
        :label-attrs="{ for: id + '-code' }"
        :rules="codeRules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="id + '-code'" v-model="model.code" />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-button html-type="submit">原生异步提交</c-button>
    </c-form>
    <c-button html-type="button" @click="clear">清空校验</c-button>
    <c-button html-type="button" @click="serverError">写入服务端错误</c-button>
    <p class="async-submit-status">
      原生提交：{{ submissions }}；结果：{{ submittedResult }}
    </p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="validate">校验两个字段</c-button>
      <c-button
        :disabled="!pending.some((item) => item.field === 'name')"
        @click="complete('name')"
        >返回用户名结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button
        :disabled="!pending.some((item) => item.field === 'code')"
        @click="complete('code')"
        >返回代码结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button
        :disabled="!pending.some((item) => item.field === 'name')"
        @click="complete('name', true)"
        >返回最新用户名结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button
        :disabled="!pending.some((item) => item.field === 'code')"
        @click="complete('code', true)"
        >返回最新代码结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button @click="reset">重置两个字段</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status">
      结果：{{ result }}；用户名等待：{{
        pending.filter((item) => item.field === "name").length
      }}；代码等待：{{ pending.filter((item) => item.field === "code").length }}
    </p>
    <ModelOutput>{{ model }}</ModelOutput>
  </section>
</template>
```

### Presentation State

- `model`: Form data object
- `disabled`: Whether to disable the form
- `readonly`: Whether form controls are readonly
- `rules`: Form item validation rules

Example source: src/form/__demos__/presentation-state.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from "vue";

const form = ref();
const editMode = ref("dblclick");
const disabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const model = ref({ title: "原名称", note: "原备注", department: "dev" });

const choices = [
  { value: "dev", label: "研发" },
  { value: "design", label: "设计" },
];

const check = (predicate) => [
  {
    validator: (value, callback) => {
      const result = predicate(value);
      callback(result === true ? undefined : result);
    },
  },
];
const rules = { title: check((value) => Boolean(value) || "名称必填") };

const scenario = ref("success");
const scenarios = [
  { value: "success", label: "保存成功" },
  { value: "failure", label: "保存失败，保留草稿" },
  { value: "reset", label: "等待期间重置表单" },
  { value: "disabled", label: "等待期间设为禁用" },
  { value: "readonly", label: "等待期间设为只读" },
];
const pending = shallowRef();
const result = ref("尚未保存");
const current = computed(() => JSON.stringify(model.value));
function save(value, { signal }) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = { id: undefined };
    let settled = false;
    const task = {
      value,
      finish(error, aborted = false) {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        clearTimeout(timer.id);
        signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
        if (pending.value === task) pending.value = undefined;
        result.value = aborted
          ? "保存已取消，旧结果不会提交"
          : error
            ? "保存失败，保留草稿"
            : "保存成功";
        if (error) reject(new Error("模拟保存失败，请重试"));
        else resolve(aborted ? false : undefined);
      },
    };
    const abort = () => task.finish(false, true);
    if (signal.aborted) {
      abort();
      return;
    }
    signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
    pending.value = task;
    result.value = "模拟保存中（1.2 秒）";
    timer.id = setTimeout(() => {
      if (scenario.value === "reset") form.value.resetFields();
      else if (scenario.value === "disabled") disabled.value = true;
      else if (scenario.value === "readonly") readonly.value = true;
      else task.finish(scenario.value === "failure");
    }, 1200);
  });
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => pending.value?.finish(false, true));
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch" :size="16">
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="异步保存场景">
      <c-radio-group
        v-model="scenario"
        aria-label="异步保存场景"
        :options="scenarios"
        variant="button"
        size="sm"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-checkbox v-model="disabled">禁用状态示例</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="readonly">只读状态示例</c-checkbox>
    <p>
      编辑名称、备注或部门并保存，模拟等待 1.2
      秒。选择保存结果，或在等待时禁用、只读、重置，观察草稿是否提交。
    </p>
    <c-form
      ref="form"
      :model="model"
      :edit-mode="editMode"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :readonly="readonly"
      :rules="rules"
    >
      <c-form-item field="title" label="事务名称"
        ><c-input v-model="model.title" :before-commit="save"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="note" label="事务备注"
        ><c-textarea v-model="model.note" :before-commit="save"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="department" label="事务部门"
        ><c-select
          v-model="model.department"
          :options="choices"
          filterable
          :before-commit="save"
      /></c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-space>
      <c-button @click="form.resetFields()">重置状态示例</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status" aria-label="事务保存状态">{{ result }}</p>
    <ModelOutput aria-label="事务当前模型">{{ current }}</ModelOutput>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Async Race

- `model`: Form data object
- `disabled`: Whether to disable the form
- `readonly`: Whether form controls are readonly

Example source: src/form/__demos__/async-race.vue

```vue
<template>
  <section class="async-race-form-demo">
    <p>本地异步规则只接受 admin；手动返回最早或最新结果，不访问网络。</p>
    <c-form
      ref="formRef"
      :model="model"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :readonly="readonly"
    >
      <c-form-item
        v-if="mounted"
        field="name"
        label="用户名"
        :label-attrs="{ for: demoId }"
        :rules="rules"
        :validate-trigger="[]"
        feedback
      >
        <c-input :id="demoId" v-model="model.name" placeholder="请输入 admin" />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <div class="async-race-controls">
      <c-checkbox v-model="disabled"> Disable async form</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="readonly"> Readonly async form</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="mounted"> Mount async field</c-checkbox>
    </div>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button :disabled="!mounted" @click="validate">校验字段</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!mounted" @click="validateAll">校验整表</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!pending.length" @click="complete(false)"
        >返回最早结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button :disabled="!pending.length" @click="complete(true)"
        >返回最新结果</c-button
      >
      <c-button :disabled="!mounted" @click="serverError"
        >写入服务端错误</c-button
      >
      <c-button @click="clear">清空校验</c-button>
      <c-button @click="reset">重置</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status">校验结果：{{ result }}；等待结果：{{ pending.length }}</p>
    <p>本次校验值：{{ checkedValue || "空" }}</p>
    <ModelOutput>{{ model }}</ModelOutput>
  </section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import ModelOutput from "../__demo-utils__/ModelOutput.vue";

import {
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onDeactivated,
  reactive,
  ref,
  shallowRef,
  useId,
} from "vue";
import type { FormInstance, FieldRule } from "@cedar-design/ui";

interface Pending {
  value: unknown;
  resolve: (result: true | string) => void;
}
const demoId = useId();
const disabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const mounted = ref(true);
const formRef = ref<FormInstance>();
const model = reactive({ name: "" });
const pending = shallowRef<Pending[]>([]);
const result = ref("尚未校验");
const checkedValue = ref("");
let run = 0;

function request(value: unknown) {
  return new Promise<true | string>((resolve) => {
    pending.value = [...pending.value, { value, resolve }];
  });
}
const rules: FieldRule[] = [
  {
    validator: async (value, callback) => {
      const answer = await request(value);
      if (answer !== true) callback(answer);
    },
  },
];

function validate() {
  return validateScope(false);
}
function validateAll() {
  return validateScope(true);
}
async function validateScope(all: boolean) {
  const current = ++run;
  checkedValue.value = model.name;
  result.value = "校验中";
  const errors = await (all
    ? formRef.value?.validate()
    : formRef.value?.validateField("name"));
  if (current === run) result.value = errors ? "未通过" : "通过";
}
function complete(latest: boolean) {
  const task = latest ? pending.value.at(-1) : pending.value[0];
  if (!task) return;
  pending.value = pending.value.filter((item) => item !== task);
  task.resolve(task.value === "admin" ? true : "用户名必须是 admin");
}
function clear() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.clearValidate();
  result.value = "已清空";
}
function serverError() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.setFields({
    name: { status: "error", message: "模拟服务端拒绝" },
  });
  result.value = "服务端错误";
}
function reset() {
  run++;
  formRef.value?.resetFields();
  checkedValue.value = "";
  result.value = "已重置";
}
function cleanup() {
  run++;
  result.value = "已取消";
  const tasks = pending.value;
  pending.value = [];
  tasks.forEach((task) => task.resolve(true));
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup);
onDeactivated(cleanup);
</script>

<style scoped>
.async-race-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
}
.async-race-controls label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}
</style>
```

## Business workflows

### Task Workflow

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose                                                                  | Related examples |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------- |
| `model`       | Form data object                                                         | Task Workflow    |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

- `model`: Form data object
- `layout`: The layout of the form, including horizontal, vertical, and multi-column

Example source: src/form/__demos__/task-workflow.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from "vue";
const fresh = () => ({ title: "", department: "ops", priority: "normal" });
const draft = ref(fresh());
const saved = ref(null);
const stage = ref("edit");
const message = ref("填写任务后进入确认；也可以直接提交空表单查看校验。");
const busy = ref(false);
const failNext = ref(false);
const formRef = ref();
const rules = [{ required: true, whitespace: true, message: "请输入任务名称" }];
const departments = [
  { value: "ops", label: "运营部" },
  { value: "dev", label: "研发部" },
  { value: "design", label: "设计部" },
];
const priorities = [
  { value: "normal", label: "普通" },
  { value: "urgent", label: "紧急" },
];
const departmentLabel = computed(
  () =>
    departments.find((item) => item.value === draft.value.department)?.label,
);
let timer;
let epoch = 0;
function cancelPending() {
  epoch++;
  clearTimeout(timer);
  busy.value = false;
}
onBeforeUnmount(cancelPending);
onDeactivated(cancelPending);
function review({ errors }) {
  if (errors) {
    message.value = "请补全必填项，任务尚未提交。";
    return;
  }
  stage.value = "review";
  message.value = "核对信息后确认提交；返回修改不会改变上次提交记录。";
}
function submit() {
  if (busy.value) return;
  const current = ++epoch;
  const snapshot = { ...draft.value };
  const shouldFail = failNext.value;
  failNext.value = false;
  busy.value = true;
  message.value = "正在本地模拟保存…";
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    if (current !== epoch) return;
    busy.value = false;
    if (shouldFail) {
      message.value = "保存失败：草稿已保留，请点击“重试提交”。";
      return;
    }
    saved.value = snapshot;
    stage.value = "done";
    message.value = "提交成功，已生成任务记录。";
  }, 500);
}
function reset() {
  cancelPending();
  draft.value = fresh();
  saved.value = null;
  stage.value = "edit";
  failNext.value = false;
  message.value = "已重置，可以重新演示。";
  formRef.value?.clearValidate();
}
function fill() {
  draft.value = {
    title: "展厅设备巡检",
    department: "ops",
    priority: "urgent",
  };
  formRef.value?.clearValidate();
}
</script>
<template>
  <section class="workflow-demo" aria-label="巡检任务完整流程">
    <ol class="workflow-demo__steps" aria-label="任务流程">
      <li :aria-current="stage === 'edit' ? 'step' : undefined">
        01 填写与校验
      </li>
      <li :aria-current="stage === 'review' ? 'step' : undefined">
        02 核对与提交
      </li>
      <li :aria-current="stage === 'done' ? 'step' : undefined">
        03 结果与记录
      </li>
    </ol>
    <c-form
      v-if="stage === 'edit'"
      ref="formRef"
      :model="draft"
      layout="vertical"
      @submit="review"
    >
      <c-form-item label="任务名称" field="title" :rules="rules" feedback
        ><c-input
          v-model="draft.title"
          edit-mode="direct"
          placeholder="例如：展厅设备巡检"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="执行部门" field="department"
        ><c-select
          v-model="draft.department"
          :options="departments"
          edit-mode="direct"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="任务优先级" field="priority"
        ><c-select
          v-model="draft.priority"
          :options="priorities"
          edit-mode="direct"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-space wrap
        ><c-button html-type="submit" status="primary">校验并预览</c-button
        ><c-button @click="fill">填入演示数据</c-button></c-space
      >
    </c-form>
    <div v-else-if="stage === 'review'">
      <h4>确认巡检任务</h4>
      <dl>
        <dt>任务</dt>
        <dd>{{ draft.title }}</dd>
        <dt>部门</dt>
        <dd>{{ departmentLabel }}</dd>
        <dt>优先级</dt>
        <dd>{{ draft.priority === "urgent" ? "紧急" : "普通" }}</dd>
      </dl>
      <c-checkbox v-model="failNext" :disabled="busy"
        >模拟下一次保存失败（本地）</c-checkbox
      >
      <c-space wrap
        ><c-button
          status="primary"
          :loading="busy"
          :disabled="busy"
          @click="submit"
          >{{
            message.includes("保存失败") ? "重试提交" : "确认提交"
          }}</c-button
        ><c-button :disabled="busy" @click="stage = 'edit'"
          >返回修改</c-button
        ></c-space
      >
    </div>
    <div v-else>
      <h4>任务已创建</h4>
      <p>
        {{ saved.title }} ·
        {{ saved.priority === "urgent" ? "紧急处理" : "普通处理" }}
      </p>
      <c-button @click="stage = 'edit'">继续编辑</c-button>
    </div>
    <p role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ message }}</p>
    <c-collapse>
      <c-collapse-item title="查看已提交记录" name="saved">
        <pre>{{
          saved
            ? JSON.stringify(saved, null, 2)
            : "尚无记录；校验失败、返回修改或保存失败都不会创建记录。"
        }}</pre>
      </c-collapse-item>
    </c-collapse>
    <c-button @click="reset">重新演示</c-button>
    <small
      >本例使用本地模拟保存，不访问业务服务。校验、确认、保存与失败恢复由业务流程组合。</small
    >
  </section>
</template>
<style scoped>
.workflow-demo {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.workflow-demo__steps {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
}
.workflow-demo__steps li {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;

  font-weight: 700;
}
```

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

Form / FormItem provide empty recognition through `empty-values`; each field defines clear output with its own `empty-value`. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### `<Form>` Props

| Parameter         | Description                                                                                                                                    | Type                                       |        Default        |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | :-------------------: |
| model             | Form data object                                                                                                                               | `object`                                   |         `{}`          |
| layout            | The layout of the form, including horizontal, vertical, and multi-column                                                                       | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical' \| 'inline'`   |    `'horizontal'`     |
| size              | The size of the form                                                                                                                           | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'`     |        `'md'`         |
| label-col-flex    | Label-column flex; numbers are flex ratios, unit-bearing strings are widths                                                                    | `number \| string`                         |          `-`          |
| label-col-style   | Per-instance label column style                                                                                                                | `CSSProperties`                            |          `-`          |
| wrapper-col-style | Per-instance control column style                                                                                                              | `CSSProperties`                            |          `-`          |
| label-col-props   | Label layout options; same parameters as the col component                                                                                     | `object`                                   | `span: 5, offset: 0`  |

| `read-pretty`     | Independent reading toggle. When true, displays the saved value; when false, restores the current edit-mode. FormItem inherits Form when unset | `boolean`                                  |          `-`          |
| `edit-mode`       | Shared editing mode for form fields; when unset, preserves each field default                                                                  | `'direct' \| 'click' \| 'dblclick'`        |          `-`          |

## Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { FormProps } from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

### Five density levels and item spacing

xs/sm/md/lg/xl select geometry through size classes. Item bottom spacing and reserved validation-message height both use size-*-item-margin-bottom. Inline layout uses inline-item-margin-bottom; error/help do not add item bottom spacing again.

| Variable                              | Default                     |
| ------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| `--c-form-size-xl-height`             | `var(--c-size-xl)`          |
| `--c-form-size-xl-label-font-size`    | `var(--c-sys-font-size-lg)` |
| `--c-form-size-xl-item-margin-bottom` | `var(--c-spacing-8)`        |

### edit-mode inheritance

Form supports `direct / click / dblclick`. When unset, each field retains its own default; FormItem and fields inherit explicitly configured ancestor values, and an explicit field value takes precedence. readPretty controls reading independently of readonly/disabled. Submitting the form fails while a confirmation editor remains unfinished, preserving its draft; reset cancels editing. Existing default slots and v-model are unchanged, and no editor slot is required.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

# Grid

CSS Grid columns, spans, gaps, collapse and suffix items. Use Row / Col for 24-column Flex layouts.

> **Choosing a layout**
>
> - Grid + GridItem: Use for form columns and card grids with consistent column widths, spans, responsive column counts, or collapsed rows and suffix items.
> - Row + Col: Use for 24-column Flex layouts that need horizontal/vertical alignment, wrapping control, fixed and flexible widths together, or responsive ordering. Row controls the row; Col controls width, offset and order.
> - Space: Use for simple groups of buttons, tags or text that only need spacing, direction and alignment. Use native Flex for more flexible width allocation.

## Basic examples

### Columns, spans and offsets

Example source: src/grid/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template><div>
  <c-grid :cols="4" :col-gap="12" :row-gap="12"><c-grid-item v-for="i in 8" :key="i" class="cell">{{ i }}</c-grid-item></c-grid>
  <c-grid :cols="4" :col-gap="12" :row-gap="12"><c-grid-item :span="2" class="cell">span 2</c-grid-item><c-grid-item :offset="1" class="cell soft">offset 1</c-grid-item><c-grid-item :span="4" class="cell">span 4</c-grid-item></c-grid>
</div></template>

<style scoped>
.controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.cell { box-sizing: border-box; padding: 12px; min-width: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--c-color-primary); color: var(--c-color-white); text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.soft { opacity: .7; }
</style>
```

## Responsiveness and accessibility

Breakpoints use the browser viewport: xs is the base; sm ≥576, md ≥768, lg ≥992, xl ≥1200 and xxl ≥1600px. Configured values resolve downward from the largest matching breakpoint. SSR starts with xs and responds to the viewport after mounting. Grid collapsing and dynamic ordering are calculated after mounting. These layout containers add no keyboard shortcuts; callers supply content semantics and focusable elements. There are no public methods or dedicated theme tokens.

## GridItem

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| span | Grid span | number / ResponsiveValue | 1 |
| offset | Empty tracks before the item | number / ResponsiveValue | 0 |
| suffix | Suffix at the end of the row | boolean | false |

The default slot receives `{ overflow: boolean }`, indicating whether collapsing hides content. No custom events or public methods.

## Imports

Grid contains only Grid.Item. Row and Col are independent components with their own source, styles, navigation, documentation and demos. Grid.Row/Grid.Col, Row/Col re-exports from Grid and GridRowInstance/GridColInstance are removed. Import them from the library root or separate row/col entries. Installing Grid no longer registers Row/Col automatically.

# Hover

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Preview configuration: `:hovering="hovering"`, `:focusing="focusing"`.

Example source: src/hover/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { Hover, useHoverOverlay } from '@cedar-design/ui'
import '@cedar-design/ui/hover/style'

const vHover = Hover
const { hovering, handleHovering } = useHoverOverlay()
const focusing = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-button v-hover="handleHovering" class="hover-example-target" @focus="focusing = true" @blur="focusing = false">
      将鼠标移入，或用 Tab 聚焦
      <c-hover-overlay :hovering="hovering" :focusing="focusing" />
    </c-button>
    <span role="status">悬停：{{ hovering ? '是' : '否' }}；焦点：{{ focusing ? '是' : '否' }}</span>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.hover-example-target { position: relative; }
</style>
```

## API

### Directives

| Usage | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `v-hover="callback"` | Notifies `(hovering: boolean) => void` on mouse enter and leave |
| `v-hover="styleObject"` | Applies styles on mouse enter and restores them on leave |
| `v-hover:desktop` / `v-hover:mobile` | Enabled according to the directive's platform detection; this does not imply real touchscreen hover support |

### HoverOverlay Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| hovering | boolean | false | Hover decoration state |
| focusing | boolean | false | Focus decoration state |

`useHoverOverlay()` returns `hovering` and `handleHovering` for connection to directive callbacks. The overlay is absolutely positioned, so its host must establish a positioning context. For independent use, import `@cedar-design/ui/hover/style`.

```vue
  <section class="demo-comparison-case demo-comparison-case--1" data-comparison-scene="size">
```

### Catalog

Preview configuration: `clearable`, `placeholder="搜索图标名称"`.

Example source: src/icon/__demos__/catalog.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import { iconNames } from "@cedar-design/icons-vue";
import * as CedarIcons from "@cedar-design/icons-vue";
import { Message } from "../../message";

const keyword = ref("");
const filteredIcons = computed(() =>
  keyword.value
    ? iconNames.filter((name) =>
        name.includes(keyword.value.trim().toLowerCase()),
      )
    : iconNames,
);

const groupRules = [
  [
    "方向",
    /(^|-)(arrow|caret|chevron|left|right|up|down|expand|shrink|swap|rotate|fullscreen|backward|forward)(-|$)/,
  ],
  [
    "状态与反馈",
    /(^|-)(alert|check|close|error|exclamation|info|question|success|warning|empty|stop)(-|$)/,
  ],
  [
    "编辑",
    /(^|-)(align|attachment|bold|brush|copy|delete|edit|eraser|filter|font|formula|italic|link|list|paste|quote|redo|scissor|sort|underline|undo|zoom)(-|$)/,
  ],
  ["文件", /(^|-)(archive|book|bookmark|drive|file|folder|save|storage)(-|$)/],
  [
    "媒体",
    /(^|-)(camera|image|live|music|mute|pause|play|record|skip|sound|video|voice)(-|$)/,
  ],
  [
    "通信与用户",
    /(^|-)(email|message|notification|phone|send|share|subscribe|user|robot)(-|$)/,
  ],
  [
    "品牌",
    /(alipay|bytedance|codepen|facebook|github|gitlab|google|lark|qq|tiktok|twitter|wechat|weibo|xigua)/,
  ],
  ["天气", /(^|-)weather-|(^|-)sun(-|$)|(^|-)moon(-|$)/],
  ["商业", /(^|-)(barcode|cart|gift|shopping|tag)(-|$)/],
] as const;

const iconGroups = computed(() => {
  const groups = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const name of filteredIcons.value) {
    const label = groupRules.find(([, rule]) => rule.test(name))?.[0] ?? "通用";
    if (!groups.has(label)) groups.set(label, []);
    groups.get(label)?.push(name);
  }
  return [...groupRules.map(([label]) => label), "通用"].flatMap((label) => {
    const names = groups.get(label);
    return names?.length ? [[label, names.sort()] as const] : [];
  });
});

function pascalCase(name: string) {
  return name
    .split("-")
    .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + part.slice(1))
    .join("");
}

function resolveIcon(name: string) {
  return CedarIcons[`Icon${pascalCase(name)}` as keyof typeof CedarIcons];
}

async function copyIcon(name: string) {
  const markup = `<c-icon-${name} />`;
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(markup);
    Message.success(`已复制 ${markup}`);
  } catch {
    Message.error("复制失败，请检查浏览器剪贴板权限");
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-input v-model="keyword" clearable placeholder="搜索图标名称">
    <template #prefix><c-icon-search /></template>
  </c-input>
  <section v-for="[group, names] in iconGroups" :key="group" class="icon-group">
    <h3>
      {{ group }} <small>{{ names.length }}</small>
    </h3>
    <div class="icon-catalog">
      <c-button
        v-for="name in names"
        :key="name"
        class="icon-card"
        variant="outline"
        @click="copyIcon(name)"
      >
        <span class="icon-card-content">
          <component :is="resolveIcon(name)" :size="40" />
          <span class="icon-name">{{ name }}</span>
        </span>
      </c-button>
    </div>
  </section>
</template>

<style scoped>
.icon-catalog {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 168px), 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.icon-group {
  margin-top: 24px;
}
.icon-group h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 16px;
}
.icon-group small {
  margin-left: 6px;
  color: var(--color-text-3);
  font-weight: normal;
}

.icon-card {
  min-height: 132px;
  height: auto;
  justify-content: center;
  font: inherit;
  line-height: 1.5;
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 20px 14px;
  color: var(--color-text-1);
  background: var(--color-bg-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border-2);
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.icon-card:hover {
  color: rgb(var(--c-primary-6));
  border-color: rgb(var(--c-primary-6));
}
.icon-card-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
.icon-name {
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 13px;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  white-space: normal;
}
</style>
```

### IconPark custom projects

You can use the **SVG Symbol JS** or **Web Component JS** generated by an IconPark custom project directly. Exporting individual SVG files or generating a Vue component for every icon is optional. These are SVG resource mechanisms, separate from loading text fonts with `@font-face`.

The public `@icon-park/vue-next` component package and your custom project's JS are separate resource sources. Installing the public package does not automatically include your team's uploaded or maintained icons.

| Approach | Resource source | Rendering | Loading unit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SVG Symbol JS | Custom project script | `svg` / `use` in the default slot | The icon collection in that file |
| Web Component JS | Custom project script | A custom element in the default slot | Depends on the generated implementation; do not assume individual icon loading |
| Individual SVG Vue components | Local files or a component package | Vue components in the default slot | Imported modules, subject to build configuration |

SVG Symbol is a suitable starting point: it reuses the Icon container without configuring Vue custom element recognition.

**Current API:** `CIcon` does not have a `symbol` prop and does not download, register or inject IconPark resources. The examples below use the existing default slot. `name` only resolves icon components registered in the current Vue application; it does not resolve Symbol IDs or Web Component icon names. Default slot content takes precedence over `name`.

#### SVG Symbol: load the project script

Copy the **SVG Symbol** script URL from your custom project and load it once in the application's HTML entry, such as `index.html` in a Vite application:

```html
<!-- Example path: replace with your project URL or a locally deployed copy -->
<script src="/icons/project-symbol.js" defer></script>
```

After execution, the script should inject an SVG collection containing `symbol` nodes into the page. The application owns the resource URL and decides whether to use a remote URL or a deployed static file. The component library does not embed business project URLs. Load the script type you chose; using the same collection does not require loading both script variants.

#### SVG Symbol: reference an icon

Suppose the script injects `<symbol id="project-home" viewBox="0 0 48 48">`. You can render it as follows. Paths and IDs in these examples are placeholders; use the values in your generated output.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon as CIcon } from '@cedar-design/ui'
import '@cedar-design/ui/icon/style'
</script>

<template>
  <c-icon :size="24" color="#1677ff">
    <svg width="1em" height="1em" aria-hidden="true">
      <use href="#project-home" />
    </svg>
  </c-icon>
</template>
```

`href` uses the complete Symbol ID with a leading `#`. Display names, the library's `name` prop and IconPark icon names may differ from the Symbol ID. Do not invent or strip prefixes; inspect `symbol[id]` in developer tools. This references resources injected into the current page: do not use `href="project.js#project-home"`.

`size` sets the container's font size, and the inner SVG follows it through `1em`. `rotate` and `spin` affect the entire container. Without an explicit `size`, normal Icon size inheritance applies. Preserve the generated Symbol's `viewBox` to avoid clipping or incorrect scaling.

#### An application wrapper for shorter usage

Create an application component named `ProjectIcon.vue` if you want to pass an ID as a prop. This requires neither a library API change nor a generated Vue file for each icon:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon as CIcon } from '@cedar-design/ui'
import '@cedar-design/ui/icon/style'

defineProps<{ symbol: string }>()
</script>

<template>
  <c-icon>
    <svg width="1em" height="1em" aria-hidden="true">
      <use :href="`#${symbol}`" />
    </svg>
  </c-icon>
</template>
```

Use it in the application:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import ProjectIcon from './ProjectIcon.vue'
</script>

<template>
  <ProjectIcon symbol="project-home" :size="24" color="#1677ff" />
</template>
```

Here, `symbol` belongs to the application wrapper and excludes `#`. Undeclared attributes such as `size`, `color`, `rotate` and `spin` fall through to the single `CIcon` root. Forward `$attrs` explicitly if you add multiple roots or disable `inheritAttrs`. The existing `transition` prop only animates `CIcon`'s `name` changes; it does not animate Symbol reference changes inside the slot.

#### Web Component: script and compiler configuration

Alternatively, load your project's **Web Component JS** and place its registered element in the slot. The following assumes the generated element is named `iconpark-icon` and uses a `name` attribute. Confirm element names, attributes and theme support against your project's generated usage instructions.

```html
<!-- Application HTML entry; use the Web Component variant here -->
<script src="/icons/project-web-component.js" defer></script>
```

Configure the build that compiles Vue SFCs containing this tag to recognize the custom element. For Vite:

```ts
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
import vue from '@vitejs/plugin-vue'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    vue({
      template: {
        compilerOptions: {
          isCustomElement: (tag) => tag === 'iconpark-icon',
        },
      },
    }),
  ],
})
```

Merge this into the existing Vue plugin configuration instead of adding a duplicate plugin. `isCustomElement` is a compile-time setting; setting only `app.config.compilerOptions` does not replace this configuration when using a build tool. Configure the library build when the tag is wrapped inside library source, or the application build when application source uses the tag directly.

```vue
<template>
  <c-icon :size="24" color="#1677ff">
    <iconpark-icon name="project-home" size="1em"></iconpark-icon>
  </c-icon>
</template>
```

This example uses the application's existing `c-icon` import or registration. The outer `CIcon` does not automatically forward theme, stroke width or other attributes to slot content. Set supported attributes directly on the custom element. If it uses Shadow DOM, external `.c-icon svg` rules cannot directly style its inner SVG; use the element's supported attributes, inherited styles or CSS variables.

#### Size, color and multicolor icons

| Setting | Behavior and limitations |
| --- | --- |
| `size` | Symbol examples inherit through `1em`; check the Web Component's own sizing API |
| `color` | Works only when the graphic uses `currentColor` or supports corresponding inheritance |
| Fixed `fill` / `stroke` | Colors embedded in the graphic are not automatically overridden by the container's `color` |
| Multicolor icons | Preserve their colors; avoid forcing a single `fill` or `stroke` across all paths |
| Themes and stroke width | Depend on generated output; public Vue icon package props do not automatically apply to project scripts |

#### On-demand loading and bundle size

Importing components on demand and loading icon resources are independent. Slot usage does not make `CIcon` depend on the entire IconPark package, and existing Resolver imports still work. The Resolver does not load resources based on a `use` ID.

A Symbol script that injects a collection loads that entire file. If it contains 200 icons and a page references three, all 200 are still downloaded and injected. `href="#project-home"` selects a graphic; it does not request an individual icon. A static script is outside the application's module tree-shaking analysis, and string IDs do not automatically remove unused Symbols.

| Goal | Approach |
| --- | --- |
| Small collection reused across pages | Load once at application entry and reuse the browser cache by file version |
| Large collection with distinct business modules | Split resources into shared and module collections; load each when its route or module needs it |
| Render the page before loading icons | Manage loading, failure and placeholder states in the application; show icons when resources are ready |
| Require individual icons to participate in tree shaking | Use separate SVG modules or Vue components and verify package exports and actual build output |

Remote JS is outside the library's npm package but still contributes to application download size. Updating the project requires updating generated resources and their cache versions. The component library's build size alone does not describe page cost.

#### Loading order, SSR and accessibility

- Make static resources available when icons are needed. For dynamic loading, wait for successful script execution. For Web Components, `customElements.whenDefined('iconpark-icon')` can additionally wait for registration; it neither downloads the script nor automatically settles on a resource loading failure.
- Load each resource once per application instead of inserting a script on every component mount. Keep Symbol IDs unique across collections to avoid conflicting references.
- Do not execute scripts requiring `window`, `document` or `customElements` on the server. Use HTML scripts or client lifecycle loading. When rendering conditionally, keep server and initial client placeholders consistent. Icons remain invisible until their resources exist; strict first-paint requirements need server-inlined Symbols or individual SVGs.
- Use `aria-hidden="true"` for decorative SVGs. Give standalone informative SVGs `role="img"` and an accessible name. Give icon-only buttons an `aria-label` on the button itself.

#### Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Check |
| --- | --- |
| Blank icon | Successful script execution, correct script variant, exact ID and nonzero container size |
| `Failed to resolve component: iconpark-icon` | Compile-time `isCustomElement` configuration for the source containing the tag |
| Color does not change | Fixed graphic colors or the Web Component's supported color interface |
| Size does not follow `CIcon` | Inner SVG / element sizing through `1em` and any fixed pixel dimensions |
| Old icon after a project update | Current script version and browser / CDN caching |
| Works locally but fails after deployment | Resource base paths, network requests, CSP `script-src` and script execution errors |
| Wrong icon with multiple collections | Symbol ID collisions, duplicate scripts and the unique IDs in actual output |

References: [Vue and Web Components](https://vuejs.org/guide/extras/web-components), [SVG use element](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Element/use).

### Dynamic Name

- `size`: Controls the component size.

Example source: src/icon/__demos__/dynamic-name.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { getCurrentInstance, ref } from "vue";
import {
  IconArrowLeft,
  IconArrowRight,
  IconCheckCircle,
  IconInfoCircle,
  IconRefresh,
  IconSearch,
} from "@cedar-design/icons-vue";
const iconName = ref("arrow-left");
const app = getCurrentInstance()?.appContext.app;
const icons = {
  IconArrowLeft,
  IconArrowRight,
  IconCheckCircle,
  IconInfoCircle,
  IconRefresh,
  IconSearch,
};
for (const [name, component] of Object.entries(icons)) {
  if (app && !app.component(name)) {
    app.component(name, component);
  }
}
function toggle() {
  iconName.value =
    iconName.value === "arrow-left" ? "arrow-right" : "arrow-left";
}
</script>
<template>
  <p>
    name 是已注册图标的名称。本例提供
    arrow-left、arrow-right、check-circle、info-circle、refresh、search；默认插槽存在时优先显示插槽内容。
  </p>
  <div class="icon-name-demo">
    <c-space wrap align="center" :size="24">
      <c-button @click="toggle">切换图标</c-button>
      <c-icon :name="iconName" :size="32" :transition="300" />
    </c-space>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Lifecycle and edge cases

### Lifecycle

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Explicitly registered icon name | Lifecycle |
| `transition` | Name-change animation duration in ms | Lifecycle |
| `size` | `inherit` | Lifecycle |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `size`: Controls the component size.

Example source: src/icon/__demos__/lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, getCurrentInstance, KeepAlive, ref } from "vue";
import { IconArrowLeft, IconArrowRight } from "@cedar-design/icons-vue";

const language = ref("zh-CN");
const english = computed(() => language.value === "en-US");

const active = ref(true),
  iconName = ref("arrow-left"),
  duration = ref(300);
const app = getCurrentInstance()?.appContext.app;
if (app && !app.component("IconArrowLeft")) {
  app.component("IconArrowLeft", IconArrowLeft);
}
if (app && !app.component("IconArrowRight")) {
  app.component("IconArrowRight", IconArrowRight);
}
function toggleName() {
  iconName.value =
    iconName.value === "arrow-left" ? "arrow-right" : "arrow-left";
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space wrap>
    <c-button @click="toggleName">{{
      english ? "Switch name" : "切换名称"
    }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">{{
      english ? "Toggle active" : "切换激活"
    }}</c-button>
    <c-button @click="duration = duration ? 0 : 300"
      >{{ english ? "Toggle duration" : "切换时长" }} {{ duration }}ms</c-button
    >
    <KeepAlive
      ><c-icon v-if="active" :name="iconName" :transition="duration" :size="32"
    /></KeepAlive>
  </c-space>
  <p>
    {{
      english
        ? "Inactive changes commit on activation without replay. Duration changes cancel the old phase; zero shows the latest name immediately."
        : "停用后切换名称，激活直接显示最新图标，不重放旧动画；时长变更取消旧阶段，0立即显示最新名称。"
    }}
  </p>
</template>
```

## Shared implementation and platform boundaries

Each platform maintains a complete local implementation. They do not import a common core or share component instances or reactive state. Changes must update both implementations. Component bodies, props, key styles and paired tests have read-only source consistency checks; theme tokens and installation entries remain local to each library.

Only icons registered in the current application are resolved. Repeated name changes cancel stale timers; no changes run after unmount. Each library locally adapts its registration prefix and legacy spin class; icon resources are not imported across libraries.

Icons inherit the host font size on both platforms. For a fixed 20px icon, set size="20" or icon-size explicitly. The size prop overrides the variable; color inherits from the host by default.

### Motion variables

| Token | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-icon-spin-duration` | `1s` |

Built-in motion follows prefers-reduced-motion: reduce: content and state feedback remain, while decorative spinning, shimmer and ripples stop. Icon name changes display the latest value immediately and cancel unfinished phases, keeping CSS and JS durations aligned. Callers must adapt custom animation classes. Ripple duration/cleanup follows Ripple documentation; its historical 250ms rule is not an Icon duration limit.

## Image presentation and states

### Fit Mode

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | Displayed image width | Fit Mode, Captions and additional content, Error |
| `src` | Image source URL | Fit Mode, Captions and additional content, Error |
| `height` | Displayed image height | Fit Mode, Error, Loader |
| `preview-disabled` | Whether click preview is disabled | Fit Mode, Loader, Lazy |
| `object-fit` | How the image fits its container | Fit Mode, Lazy |
| `title` | Title | Captions and additional content |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

### Imperative Preview

Example source: src/image/__demos__/imperative-preview.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const images = ['/cat.jpg', '/cat2.jpg']
let handle: { next: () => void; close: () => void } | undefined

function previewSingle() {
  imagePreview(images[0])
}

function previewMultiple() {
  handle = imagePreview({ images, modelValue: 1 })
}

function next() {
  handle?.next()
}

function close() {
  handle?.close()
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-space :size="12" wrap>
    <c-button status="primary" size="sm" @click="previewSingle">预览单图</c-button>
    <c-button status="primary" size="sm" @click="previewMultiple">预览多图</c-button>
    <c-button size="sm" @click="next">下一张</c-button>
    <c-button size="sm" @click="close">关闭</c-button>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Lifecycle

### Track Lifecycle

Preview configuration: `v-model:open="open"`, `:images="images"`, `:loop="loop"`, `name="Replace images / 换图"`.

Example source: src/image/__demos__/track-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ImagePreviewAction as CImagePreviewAction } from '../index'

import { ref } from 'vue'
const active = ref(true)
const open = ref(false)
const current = ref(1)
const loop = ref(true)
const images = ref(['/cat.jpg', '/cat2.jpg'])
function replaceImages() { images.value = [...images.value].reverse() }
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="open = true">Open / 打开</c-button>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">Activate / 停用与激活</c-button>
    <c-button @click="loop = !loop">Loop / 循环</c-button>
    <c-button @click="replaceImages">Replace images / 等长换图</c-button>
    <p>Current / 当前: {{ current }}. Navigate across the loop edge; deactivate, close or replace images. Old work must not replay.</p>
    <KeepAlive>
      <c-image-preview-group v-if="active" v-model:open="open" v-model="current" :images="images" :loop="loop">
        <template #actions>
          <c-image-preview-action name="Replace images / 换图" @click="replaceImages">换图</c-image-preview-action>
          <c-image-preview-action name="Deactivate / 停用" @click="active = false">停用</c-image-preview-action>
        </template>
      </c-image-preview-group>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Controller Lifecycle

Preview configuration: `v-model:open="open"`, `:src="source"`, `interaction="touch"`, `:keyboard="true"`.

Example source: src/image/__demos__/controller-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ImagePreviewAction as CImagePreviewAction } from '../index'

import { ref } from "vue";
const open = ref(false);
const active = ref(true);
const source = ref("/cat.jpg");
const presses = ref(0);
const switchSource = () => {
  source.value = source.value === "/cat.jpg" ? "/cat2.jpg" : "/cat.jpg";
};
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="open = true">Open / 打开预览</c-button>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">Activate / 停用与激活</c-button>
    <p>
      Long presses / 长按通知: {{ presses }}. Cancel or deactivate; old input
      must not replay.
    </p>
    <KeepAlive>
      <c-image-preview
        v-if="active"
        v-model:open="open"
        :src="source"
        interaction="touch"
        :keyboard="true"
        @long-press="presses++"
      >
        <template #actions>
          <c-image-preview-action
            name="Switch source / 换图"
            @click="switchSource"
            >换图</c-image-preview-action
          >
          <c-image-preview-action
            name="Deactivate / 停用"
            @click="active = false"
            >停用</c-image-preview-action
          >
        </template>
      </c-image-preview>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"` and supports runtime and nested overrides. Preview collection navigation, horizontal keys and swipes follow reading direction without reversing the image array. Direction changes cancel pending gestures while preserving the current image, scale and rotation. Images and zoomed pan coordinates are not mirrored. Numerical indicators remain LTR.

## API

ImagePreviewGroup binds a one-based image number through ordinary `v-model`; `defaultValue` initializes the uncontrolled index. Panel opening uses `v-model:open` and `defaultOpen` independently. Programmatic preview options also use modelValue/`defaultValue` and onUpdate:modelValue.

### `<image>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default | Version |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | :-------: | :----- |
| src | Image source URL | `string` | `-` |  |
| width | Displayed image width | `string \| number` | `-` |  |
| height | Displayed image height | `string \| number` | `-` |  |
| title | Title | `string` | `-` |  |
| description | Caption displayed at the bottom; also used as alt when alt is empty | `string` | `-` |  |
| object-fit | How the image fits its container | `'contain' \| 'cover' \| 'fill' \| 'none' \| 'scale-down'` | `-` |  |
| alt | Image text description | `string` | `-` |  |
| hide-footer | Whether to hide the footer; supports `'never'`, which retains the footer on error | `boolean \| 'never'` | `false` |  |
| footer-position | Footer region inside (inner) or outside (outer) the image, default inner; not four-side popup placement | `'inner' \| 'outer'` | `'inner'` |  |
| show-loader | Whether to show a loading effect | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| preview-disabled | Whether click preview is disabled | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| open **(v-model)** | Controlled preview open state | `boolean` | `-` |  |
| default-open | Default preview open state | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| preview-props | Preview options | `ImagePreviewProps` | `-` |  |
| footer-class | Footer-area class | `string\|array\|object` | `-` | 2.23.0 |
| popup-container | Preview mount container | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `-` |  |

### `<image>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------------- | -------------------- | --------------- |
| open-change | Preview open/close event | open: `boolean` |

### `<image>` Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| --------------- | :------------------: | ---- |
| error | Custom error-state content | - |
| error-icon | Custom error-state icon | - |
| loader | Custom loading effect | - |
| extra | Additional footer content | - |
| preview-actions | Custom preview toolbar | - |

### `<image-preview>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------: |
| src | Image source URL | `string` | `-` |
| open **(v-model)** | Whether open | `boolean` | `-` |
| default-open | Default uncontrolled open state | `boolean` | `false` |
| overlay-closable | Whether clicking the overlay outside the image requests closing; clicking the image does not close it | `boolean` | `true` |
| closable | Show the close button | `boolean` | `true` |
| actions-layout | Action layout | `string[]` | `[  'fullScreen',  'rotateRight',  'rotateLeft',  'zoomIn',  'zoomOut',  'originalSize',]` |
| popup-container | Popup mount target, matching `teleport` `to`; defaults `to` document.body | `HTMLElement \| string \| false` | `-` |
| esc-to-close | Whether ESC closes the preview | `boolean` | `true` |
| wheel-zoom | Whether mouse-wheel zoom is enabled | `boolean` | `true` |
| keyboard | Whether keyboard controls are enabled | `boolean` | `true` |
| default-scale | Default zoom scale | `number` | `1` |
| scale-step | Zoom increment per action | `number` | `0.5` |

### `<image-preview>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ----------- | ------------ | --------------- |
| close | Close event | - |
| open-change | Open-state change | open: `boolean` |

### `<image-preview-group>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------: |
| images | Image list; providing it disables collection of child Image sources | `string[]` | `-` |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Index of the current image, starting at 1 | `number` | `-` |
| default-value | Initially displayed image index, starting at 1 | `number` | `1` |
| loop | Whether to loop indefinitely | `boolean` | `false` |
| open **(v-model)** | Controlled open state | `boolean` | `-` |
| default-open | Default uncontrolled open state | `boolean` | `false` |
| overlay-closable | Whether clicking the overlay outside the image requests closing; clicking the image does not close it | `boolean` | `true` |
| closable | Show the close button | `boolean` | `true` |
| actions-layout | Toolbar layout | `string[]` | `[  'fullScreen',  'rotateRight',  'rotateLeft',  'zoomIn',  'zoomOut',  'originalSize',]` |
| popup-container | Popup mount target, matching `teleport` `to`; defaults `to` document.body | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `-` |

### `<image-preview-group>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ----------- | ---------------- | --------------- |

### `<image-preview-group>` Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments | Version |
| ------- | :----------------: | ---- | :----- |
| actions | Additional custom actions | - | 2.46.0 |

### `<image-preview-action>` Props (2.17.0)

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| -------- | -------- | --------- | :-----: |
| name | Name | `string` | `-` |
| disabled | Whether disabled | `boolean` | `false` |

### Type definitions

```ts
import type { ImageInstance } from "@cedar-design/ui";
import { imagePreview } from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

### `imagePreview` methods

Replacing an imperative preview disposes the previous instance and invokes its `onClosed` once, just like normal closure. Use this callback to release owned resources such as Object URLs. Old handles never close newer previews. If `onClosed` synchronously opens a new preview, that newer call wins and the interrupted outer call returns `undefined`.

| Method | Description | Arguments |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------- |
| `imagePreview` | Open the image preview | `url \| url[] \| ImagePreviewOptions` |
| `imagePreview.close` | Close the preview | `-` |
| `imagePreview.setDefaultOptions` | Set default configuration | `ImagePreviewOptions` |
| `imagePreview.resetDefaultOptions` | Reset default configuration | `-` |

## FAQ

### `image-preview` prop notes

1. With `keyboard` set to `true`, shortcuts are enabled according to `actions-layout`.

- `esc`: close the preview
- `left`: previous image
- `right`: next image
- `up`: zoom in
- `down`: zoom out
- `space`: restore original size

2. `defaultScale` sets the initial zoom ratio. For example, 1.5 initially displays the image at 1.5 times its original size.

3. `scaleStep` sets the zoom increment for wheel, double-click and toolbar actions.

### Variable consumption boundaries

`--c-image-preview-arrow-font-size` controls preview-group arrows. DOM for old actions-item, trigger, scale-value dimensions and simple-toolbar variables no longer exists; these ineffective entries are removed. The toolbar uses preview-color-action-* and preview-padding-action-content; the footer uses existing footer variables. Error/loading layers fill the image without an extra 100px minimum height. Zoom/track transitions use system motion and stop under reduced motion.

### Image-preview group numbering

`modelValue/defaultValue` start at `1`. `open(imageNumber = 1)` and `to(imageNumber)` use the same numbering; invalid/noninteger values are ignored. `prev()/next()` retain this numbering at loop boundaries. Model events are `update:modelValue(imageNumber)`; navigation emits `change(imageNumber, previousImageNumber)`, while external assignments do not. Long press emits `long-press(imageNumber)`; the indicator slot receives `{ imageNumber, length }`. Internal array indices remain zero-based.

# Infinite Scroll

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### List

- `status`: Selects the semantic state.

Example source: src/infinite-scroll/__demos__/list.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div ref="scroller" class="infinite-scroll-demo">
    <c-infinite-scroll
      v-model:status="status"
      :target="scroller"
      :bottom-offset="32"
      @load="fetchData"
    >
      <c-list :data="data" :scrollbar="false">
        <template #header>Infinite list</template>
        <template #item="{ item }">
          <c-list-item>{{ item }}</c-list-item>
        </template>
      </c-list>
    </c-infinite-scroll>
  </div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from "vue";
import type { InfiniteScrollStatus } from "@cedar-design/ui";

const scroller = ref<HTMLElement>();
const page = ref(0);
const data = ref<string[]>([]);
const status = ref<InfiniteScrollStatus>("idle");
let timer: ReturnType<typeof window.setTimeout> | undefined;

const fetchData = () => {
  window.clearTimeout(timer);
  timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
    timer = undefined;
    const start = data.value.length;
    data.value.push(
      ...Array.from(
        { length: 8 },
        (_, index) => `Cedar list item ${start + index + 1}`,
      ),
    );
    page.value += 1;
    status.value = page.value >= 5 ? "finished" : "idle";
  }, 600);
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => window.clearTimeout(timer));
onDeactivated(() => {
  window.clearTimeout(timer);
  timer = undefined;
  if (status.value === "loading") {
    status.value = "idle";
  }
});
</script>

<style scoped>
.infinite-scroll-demo {
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
</style>
```

## Content and presentation

### Error

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | Pagination state; supports `v-model:status` | Error |
| `target` | Scroll container; defaults to the nearest scrolling ancestor | Error |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `status`: Selects the semantic state.

Example source: src/infinite-scroll/__demos__/error.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div ref="scroller" class="infinite-scroll-demo">
    <c-infinite-scroll
      v-model:status="status"
      :target="scroller"
      @load="fetchData"
      @retry="fetchData"
    >
      <c-list :data="data" :scrollbar="false">
        <template #item="{ item }">
          <c-list-item>{{ item }}</c-list-item>
        </template>
      </c-list>

      <template #error="{ retry }">
        加载失败，<c-button
          variant="text"
          size="sm"
          status="primary"
          @click="retry"
          >点击重试</c-button
        >
      </template>
    </c-infinite-scroll>
  </div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from "vue";
import type { InfiniteScrollStatus } from "@cedar-design/ui";

const scroller = ref<HTMLElement>();
const data = ref<string[]>([]);
const status = ref<InfiniteScrollStatus>("idle");
let failedOnce = false;
let timer: ReturnType<typeof window.setTimeout> | undefined;

const fetchData = () => {
  window.clearTimeout(timer);
  timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
    timer = undefined;
    if (!failedOnce && data.value.length === 8) {
      failedOnce = true;
      status.value = "error";
      return;
    }

    const start = data.value.length;
    data.value.push(
      ...Array.from(
        { length: 8 },
        (_, index) => `Cedar list item ${start + index + 1}`,
      ),
    );
    status.value = data.value.length >= 32 ? "finished" : "idle";
  }, 600);
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => window.clearTimeout(timer));
onDeactivated(() => {
  window.clearTimeout(timer);
  timer = undefined;
  if (status.value === "loading") {
    status.value = "idle";
  }
});
</script>

<style scoped>
.infinite-scroll-demo {
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
</style>
```
