## Lifecycle and edge cases

### Scheduler Lifecycle

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | Pagination state; supports `v-model:status` | Scheduler Lifecycle |
| `target` | Scroll container; defaults to the nearest scrolling ancestor | Scheduler Lifecycle |
| `immediate` | Whether to check immediately after mounting and resolving the scroll container | Scheduler Lifecycle |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `status`: Selects the semantic state.

Example source: src/infinite-scroll/__demos__/scheduler-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { InfiniteScrollStatus } from "@cedar-design/ui";
const first = ref<HTMLElement>();
const second = ref<HTMLElement>();
const alternate = ref(false);
const active = ref(true);
const status = ref<InfiniteScrollStatus>("idle");
const loads = ref(0);
const load = () => {
  loads.value++;
  status.value = "finished";
};
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="alternate = !alternate"
      >Switch target / 切换目标</c-button
    >
    <c-button @click="active = !active">Activate / 停用与激活</c-button>
    <c-button @click="status = 'idle'">New status cycle / 新状态循环</c-button>
    <p>
      Loads / 加载次数: {{ loads }}. Old checks must not replay /
      旧检查不能重放。
    </p>
    <div ref="first" style="height: 100px; overflow: auto">
      <div style="height: 300px">Target A</div>
    </div>
    <div ref="second" style="height: 100px; overflow: auto">
      <div style="height: 300px">Target B</div>
    </div>
    <KeepAlive>
      <c-infinite-scroll
        v-if="active"
        v-model:status="status"
        :target="alternate ? second : first"
        :immediate="false"
        @load="load"
      >
        <div>Detector / 触底检测</div>
      </c-infinite-scroll>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

## API

### `<infinite-scroll>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| status | Pagination state; supports `v-model:status` | `'idle' \| 'loading' \| 'error' \| 'finished'` | `'idle'` |
| bottom-offset | Distance-to-bottom threshold; numbers are px, strings are CSS lengths | `string \| number` | `0` |
| immediate | Whether to check immediately after mounting and resolving the scroll container | `boolean` | `true` |
| disabled | Pause loading and retry | `boolean` | `false` |
| target | Scroll container; defaults to the nearest scrolling ancestor | `string \| HTMLElement` | `-` |

### `<infinite-scroll>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------- | -------------------------- | --------- |
| update:status | Requests pagination status `loading` | `loading` |
| load | Emitted when idle and the threshold is reached | - |
| retry | Emitted when retry is invoked in the error state | - |

`retry` does not also emit `load`. Both events may call the same business request function.

### `<infinite-scroll>` Methods

| Method | Description |
| ------ | ---------------------------- |
| check | Immediately check whether the loading threshold is reached |
| retry | Request a retry in the `error` state |

### `<infinite-scroll>` Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| -------- | ---------------- | ------------------- |
| default | Observed content | - |
| loading | Pagination loading state | - |
| error | Pagination error state | `retry: () => void` |
| finished | All-pages-loaded state | - |

The default error area retries on click. `finished` is terminal; detection resumes only when the parent resets `status` to `idle`.

### Type definitions

```ts
import type {
  InfiniteScrollInstance,
  InfiniteScrollMethods,
  InfiniteScrollProps,
  InfiniteScrollStatus,
} from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

### Style variables

| Variable | Default |
| ----------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| `--c-infinite-scroll-status-min-height` | `50px` |
| `--c-infinite-scroll-status-padding` | `12px 0` |
| `--c-infinite-scroll-status-color` | `var(--c-color-text-3)` |
| `--c-infinite-scroll-status-font-size` | `var(--c-font-size-md)` |
| `--c-infinite-scroll-loading-gap` | `8px` |
| `--c-infinite-scroll-error-color` | `var(--c-color-danger)` |

# InputNumber

Numeric editing with bounds and formatting.

## Reading direction

The numeric input inherits its source `dir`; step buttons follow reading order. Values, precision and vertical keys retain their meaning: ArrowUp increases and ArrowDown decreases. Neither values nor display strings are reversed.

## Basic examples

## Numeric input and formatting

### Quantity Controls

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose                                             | Related examples                                   |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `clearable`   | Allow clearing an editable field                    | Quantity Controls, Format Slots, Number Boundaries |
| `mode`        | Step-button layout                                  | Quantity Controls, Format Slots                    |
| `min`         | Minimum                                             | Quantity Controls, Number Boundaries               |
| `max`         | Maximum                                             | Quantity Controls, Number Boundaries               |
| `step`        | Positive finite step; scientific notation supported | Quantity Controls, Number Boundaries               |
| `formatter`   | Display formatting only; does not change the number | Format Slots, Number Boundaries                    |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

- `min`: Sets the lower bound.
- `max`: Sets the upper bound.
- `step`: Controls the allowed increment.
- `disabled`: Prevents user interaction.

Example source: src/input-number/__demos__/quantity-controls.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from "vue";

const props = defineProps<{ english?: boolean }>();
const value = ref<number | undefined>(2);
const disableInput = ref(true);
const disableIncrement = ref(false);
const disableDecrement = ref(false);
const incrementButton = ref(true);
const decrementButton = ref(true);
const press = ref(true);
const lastStep = ref("—");
const approved = ref<number | undefined>(2);
const blocked = ref(false);
const pending = ref(false);
const status = ref("—");
const decision = shallowRef<((allowed: boolean) => void) | undefined>();
const fail = shallowRef<(() => void) | undefined>();
function beforeCommit(
  { value: next }: { value: unknown },
  _done: (allow?: boolean) => void,
  { signal }: { signal: AbortSignal },
) {
  pending.value = true;
  status.value = props.english
    ? `Waiting to commit ${next ?? "empty"}`
    : `等待提交 ${next ?? "空值"}`;
  return new Promise<void | false>((resolve, reject) => {
    const cleanup = () => {
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", cancel);
      pending.value = false;
      decision.value = undefined;
      fail.value = undefined;
    };
    const cancel = () => {
      cleanup();
      status.value = props.english
        ? "Cancelled; old result ignored"
        : "已取消，旧结果不再生效";
      resolve(false);
    };
    signal.addEventListener("abort", cancel, { once: true });
    decision.value = (allowed) => {
      cleanup();
      status.value = allowed
        ? props.english
          ? "Approved"
          : "已允许"
        : props.english
          ? "Rejected"
          : "已拒绝";
      resolve(allowed ? undefined : false);
    };
    fail.value = () => {
      cleanup();
      status.value = props.english
        ? "Request failed; value preserved"
        : "请求失败，保留原值";
      reject(
        new Error(props.english ? "Quantity request failed" : "数量提交失败"),
      );
    };
  });
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => decision.value?.(false));
</script>

<template>
  <div class="quantity-controls-demo">
    <h4>
      {{
        english ? "Quantity controls and step direction" : "数量控制与步进方向"
      }}
    </h4>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-checkbox v-model="disableInput" edit-mode="direct">{{
        english ? "Buttons only" : "禁止手输"
      }}</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="disableIncrement" edit-mode="direct">{{
        english ? "Disable increase" : "禁用增加"
      }}</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="disableDecrement" edit-mode="direct">{{
        english ? "Disable decrease" : "禁用减少"
      }}</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="incrementButton" edit-mode="direct">{{
        english ? "Show increase" : "显示增加"
      }}</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="decrementButton" edit-mode="direct">{{
        english ? "Show decrease" : "显示减少"
      }}</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="press" edit-mode="direct">{{
        english ? "Long press" : "开启长按"
      }}</c-checkbox>
    </c-space>
    <c-input-number
      v-model="value"
      edit-mode="direct"
      mode="button"
      aria-label="数量控制示例"
      :disable-input="disableInput"
      :disable-increment="disableIncrement"
      :disable-decrement="disableDecrement"
      :increment-button="incrementButton"
      :decrement-button="decrementButton"
      :press="press"
      :min="0"
      :max="10"
      @step="(next, direction) => (lastStep = `${direction}: ${next}`)"
    />
    <p role="status">
      {{ english ? "Accepted step" : "已接受的步进" }}：{{ lastStep }}
    </p>
    <h4>
      {{
        english
          ? "Approve, reject or cancel an asynchronous commit"
          : "异步允许、拒绝与取消提交"
      }}
    </h4>
    <p>
      {{
        english
          ? "Step, type or clear the value, then choose an approval result below. Pending operations cannot overlap. External updates and disabling cancel the old request."
          : "加减、输入或清空后，在下方手动选择审批结果。等待时不能重复提交；外部回填或禁用会取消旧请求。"
      }}
    </p>
    <c-input-number
      v-model="approved"
      edit-mode="direct"
      mode="button"
      clearable
      aria-label="异步数量示例"
      :before-commit="beforeCommit"
      :disabled="blocked"
    />
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button :disabled="!pending" @click="decision?.(true)">{{
        english ? "Approve" : "允许本次变更"
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!pending" @click="decision?.(false)">{{
        english ? "Reject" : "拒绝本次变更"
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!pending" @click="fail?.()">{{
        english ? "Simulate failure" : "模拟失败"
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button @click="approved = 10">{{
        english ? "Set external value to 10" : "外部回填 10"
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button @click="blocked = !blocked">{{
        blocked
          ? english
            ? "Enable"
            : "恢复可用"
          : english
            ? "Disable"
            : "禁用控件"
      }}</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status">
      {{ status }}；{{ english ? "Committed value" : "已提交值" }}：{{
        approved ?? "—"
      }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Empty markers and valid zero

Configure empty-values and empty-value when an API uses -1 for missing data. Initially the input is blank while the model remains -1. Set it to 0 to see a valid zero; clearing returns -1. A second field clears to a valid 0, showing that clear output need not mean missing data.

Example source: src/input-number/__demos__/en-US/empty-value.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const model = reactive({ quantity: -1 as number | null | undefined });
const restored = ref<number | null | undefined>(12);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>
      -1 means missing and renders blank; 0 remains a valid number. Clearing
      produces -1.
    </p>
    <c-form :model="model" layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item field="quantity" label="Quantity">
        <c-input-number
          v-model="model.quantity"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-values="[null, undefined, -1]"
          :empty-value="-1"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="model.quantity = 0">Set to 0</c-button>
      <c-button @click="model.quantity = -1">Set to -1</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ String(model.quantity) }}</output>
    </p>
    <p>This field clears to 0 without treating 0 as missing.</p>
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item label="Clear restores valid zero">
        <c-input-number
          v-model="restored"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-value="0"
        />
        <output>{{ String(restored) }}</output>
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

```vue
import { ref } from 'vue'
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Clear output

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

### Props

| Prop          | Description                                                      | Type                            | Default                    |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| model-value   | Controlled number; undefined denotes an empty/uncontrolled value | `number`                        | —                          |
| default-value | Initial uncontrolled value                                       | `number`                        | —                          |
| mode          | Step-button layout                                               | `embed \| button \| input`      | `embed`                    |
| precision     | Decimal places (0–100), at least the step precision              | `number`                        | —                          |
| step          | Positive finite step; scientific notation supported              | `number`                        | `1`                        |
| disabled      | Disabled; inherits when omitted                                  | `boolean`                       | Inherited, otherwise false |
| error         | Error state; inherits FormItem when omitted                      | `boolean`                       | Inherited, otherwise false |
| max           | Maximum                                                          | `number`                        | `Infinity`                 |
| min           | Minimum                                                          | `number`                        | `-Infinity`                |
| formatter     | Display formatting only; does not change the number              | `(text: string) => string`      | —                          |
| parser        | Parse the original text once per edit                            | `(text: string) => string`      | —                          |
| placeholder   | Placeholder                                                      | `string`                        | —                          |
| size          | All five sizes implemented; inheritable                          | `xs \| sm \| md \| lg \| xl`    | Inherited, otherwise md    |
| variant       | Field variant; inherits InputGroup                               | `outline \| filled \| standard` | `outline`                  |
| hint          | Floating hint; inherits InputGroup / FieldDecorator              | `boolean`                       | Library default            |
| clearable     | Allow clearing an editable field                                 | `boolean`                       | `false`                    |
| model-event   | Model update timing; change only reports commits                 | `change \| input`               | `change`                   |
| readonly      | Read-only; allows focus/copy but no mutations                    | `boolean`                       | Inherited, otherwise false |
| input-attrs   | Additional native input attributes                               | `Record<string, unknown>`       | —                          |

### Events

| Event              | Arguments                                                  | Description                                                      |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| input              | `(value: number \| undefined, text: string, event: Event)` | Parsed value and display text while editing                      |
| update:model-value | `(value: number \| undefined)`                             | Proposed model update                                            |
| change             | `(value: number \| undefined, event: Event)`               | Commit, step or clear                                            |
| clear              | `(event: Event)`                                           | Explicit clear                                                   |
| focus              | `(event: FocusEvent)`                                      | Focus                                                            |
| blur               | `(event: FocusEvent)`                                      | Blur                                                             |
| keydown            | `(event: KeyboardEvent)`                                   | Native keyboard event; preventDefault intercepts default actions |

### Slots

| Slot             | Arguments                            | Description         |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------- |
| prefix / suffix  | —                                    | Inside the field    |
| prepend / append | —                                    | Outside the field   |
| plus / minus     | —                                    | Step-button icons   |
| clear-icon       | `{ clear: (event?: Event) => void }` | Custom clear button |

### Methods

| Method / property | Type                               | Description                       |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| focus             | `(options?: FocusOptions) => void` | Focus; ineffective while disabled |
| blur              | `() => void`                       | Blur                              |
| select            | `() => void`                       | Select all text                   |
| inputRef          | `HTMLInputElement \| undefined`    | Native input element              |

Old `--c-field-number-*` tokens are removed in favor of `--c-input-number-*`, without aliases. Shared field appearance still uses FieldDecorator `--c-field-*` tokens.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`--c-field-caret-color` sets the shared caret color, defaulting to `currentColor`. `--c-input-number-caret-color` overrides this component and defaults to `var(--c-field-caret-color)`.

# InputTag

Editable tag values with controlled array models.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### `<input-tag>` Props

| Parameter                 | Description                                               | Type                                              |  Default   |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | :--------: |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Bound value                                               | `(string \| number \| TagData)[]`                 |    `-`     |
| default-value             | Default value (uncontrolled state)                        | `(string \| number \| TagData)[]`                 |    `[]`    |
| input-value **(v-model)** | The value of the input                                    | `string`                                          |    `-`     |
| default-input-value       | The default value of the input (uncontrolled state)       | `string`                                          |    `''`    |
| placeholder               | Placeholder                                               | `string`                                          |    `-`     |
| disabled                  | Whether disabled                                          | `boolean`                                         |  `false`   |
| error                     | Whether it is an error state                              | `boolean`                                         |  `false`   |
| readonly                  | Whether it is read-only mode                              | `boolean`                                         |  `false`   |
| clearable                 | Enables the clear action                                  | `boolean`                                         |  `false`   |
| size                      | The size of the input                                     | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'`            |   `'md'`   |
| variant                   | The variant of the input                                  | `'filled' \| 'outline' \| 'standard'`             | `'filled'` |
| max-tag-count             | The maximum number of tags displayed, `0` means unlimited | `number`                                          |    `0`     |
| retain-input-value        | Whether to keep the content of the input box              | `boolean \| { create?: boolean; blur?: boolean }` |  `false`   |

## Removing legacy InputTag icon references

Cedar InputTag embeds Tag's actual close-btn and renders no old c-icon-hover pseudo-element. The old mixin import, default/focus pseudo-element backgrounds and duplicate custom Tag text rules are removed; Tag owns its text. Existing close-button appearance, click removal and readonly/disabled behavior remain, without a new hover background.

Both libraries remove tag-custom-icon-bg-hover; Cedar also removes input-tag-tag-remove-icon-color-bg / input-tag-tag-remove-icon-color-bg-focus. Unused variables have no replacements; remove ineffective overrides. No aliases remain. Maple has no InputTag component and only synchronizes shared Tag-variable cleanup.

The former cross-component exemptions are closed. check:token-consumers checks 414 Badge/Tag declarations without exemptions and compiles InputTag to prevent legacy icon selectors/variables returning. Integration tests cover actual DOM, close interactions and custom colors. The 553 shared defaults are unchanged because removed shared variables previously registered names only. This does not claim complete InputTag token, browser-visual or keyboard governance.

## InputTag wrapper and content responsibilities

FieldDecorator owns InputTag outline / filled / standard wrappers. Form must not redraw backgrounds, borders or focus shadows; old Form overrides for obsolete InputTag state classes are removed, while validation messages remain. filled default/hover/focus still use FieldDecorator fill-1 / fill-2 / fill-3.

input-tag-* controls content density, default tag backgrounds and disabled text. Selectors match actual c-field-decorator--size-* / --focus / --disabled classes rather than nonexistent old InputTag classes; disabled overrides focus. All xs/sm/md/lg/xl sizes are covered. xl uses 32px tags, 16px input text and 4px vertical padding.

Removed 33 unused wrapper variables: size-{xs,sm,md,lg}-height; color-text-error; color-placeholder, color-icon-clear, color-icon-clear-bg-hover; color-border-{default,error,disabled} and -hover/-focus forms; color-bg-{default,error}, their -hover/-focus forms, color-bg-disabled and its -hover form; color-shadow-{default,error}-focus; size-shadow-{default,error}-focus; border-radius, border-width, size-icon-clear and size-icon-clear-hover. All use --c-input-tag-. No compatibility aliases remain.

Migrate by responsibility: field-variant-{variant}-background for wrapper backgrounds; field-border-radius for corners; field-placeholder-text-color for placeholders; field-clear-icon-color / field-clear-icon-size for clear icons. Prefer size for geometry; do not override internal variables. Unused legacy variables have no one-to-one replacement. Tag content uses the InputTag variables below.

InputTag retains 27 content variables in unused-consumer checks. Both libraries’ Badge/Tag plus Cedar InputTag cover 441 declarations and 80 size/focus/disabled cascades. The shared-default contract remains 553 entries; Cedar-only InputTag is not a cross-platform shared component. Default text, disabled text, tag backgrounds and focused backgrounds use content-primary, content-disabled, surface-default and state-hover. Disabled restyles neutral tags only, preserving explicit color/status; business themes own custom-color contrast. Parent disabled/readonly overrides tagProps.closable/checkable. Loading or explicitly nonclosable tags cannot be removed with Backspace. Cedar spot checks cover five sizes, xl input/keyboard removal, light/dark modes and disabled custom colors, not a complete visual audit.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

# Input

Text input with controlled and uncontrolled values.

## Reading direction

The input inherits `dir` from its page or local scope. Affixes, clear actions and input groups follow reading order. Runtime changes retain the native editor, focus and selection; the browser handles caret movement, mixed text and composition without swapping editing keys. Parent rerenders preserve the native composition buffer; older selection-restoration tasks do not overwrite a newer composition.

## Basic examples

### Control Sizes

- `size`: Controls the component size.
- `variant`: Selects the visual variant.

Example source: src/field-decorator/__demos__/control-sizes.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const sizes = ["xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl"] as const;
const variants = ["outline", "filled", "standard"] as const;
const size = ref<(typeof sizes)[number]>("md");
const variant = ref<(typeof variants)[number]>("outline");
const options = [
  { value: "beijing", label: "Beijing" },
  { value: "shanghai", label: "Shanghai" },
];
const cascaderOptions = [{ value: "china", label: "China", children: options }];

const inputValue = ref("Beijing");
const selectValue = ref("beijing");
const cascaderValue = ref("beijing");
const selectMultiple = ref(["beijing", "shanghai"]);
const cascaderMultiple = ref(["beijing", "shanghai"]);
const selectOverflow = ref(["long", "beijing", "shanghai"]);
const cascaderOverflow = ref(["long", "beijing", "shanghai"]);
const selectedOptions = [
  ...options,
  {
    value: "long",
    label:
      "A very long selected option label for overflow comparison — full text preview keeps the selected value unchanged.",
  },
];
const selectedCascaderOptions = [
  { value: "china", label: "China", children: selectedOptions },
];
function resetSelections() {
  inputValue.value = "Beijing";
  selectValue.value = "beijing";
  cascaderValue.value = "beijing";
  selectMultiple.value = ["beijing", "shanghai"];
  cascaderMultiple.value = ["beijing", "shanghai"];
  selectOverflow.value = ["long", "beijing", "shanghai"];
  cascaderOverflow.value = ["long", "beijing", "shanghai"];
}
</script>
<template>
  <section
    aria-label="Form control size comparison"
    class="control-size-comparison"
  >
    <c-space wrap :size="12">
      <c-radio-group v-model="size" aria-label="Comparison size">
        <c-radio v-for="item in sizes" :key="item" :value="item">{{
          item
        }}</c-radio>
      </c-radio-group>
      <c-radio-group v-model="variant" aria-label="Comparison variant">
        <c-radio v-for="item in variants" :key="item" :value="item">{{
          item
        }}</c-radio>
      </c-radio-group>
    </c-space>
    <div class="control-size-comparison__grid">
      <div data-control="Input">
        <p>Input</p>
        <c-input :size="size" :variant="variant" placeholder="Input" />
      </div>
      <div data-control="Button">
        <p>Button</p>
        <c-button :size="size" variant="outline">Button</c-button>
      </div>
      <div data-control="Select">
        <p>Select</p>
        <c-select
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :options="options"
          placeholder="Select"
        />
      </div>
      <div data-control="Date">
        <p>Date</p>
        <c-date :size="size" :variant="variant" placeholder="Date" />
      </div>
      <div data-control="Time">
        <p>Time</p>
        <c-time :size="size" :variant="variant" placeholder="Time" />
      </div>
      <div data-control="InputNumber">
        <p>InputNumber</p>
        <c-input-number :size="size" :variant="variant" placeholder="Number" />
      </div>
      <div data-control="AutoComplete">
        <p>AutoComplete</p>
        <c-auto-complete
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :options="options"
          placeholder="AutoComplete"
        />
      </div>
      <div data-control="Cascader">
        <p>Cascader</p>
        <c-cascader
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :options="cascaderOptions"
          placeholder="Cascader"
        />
      </div>
      <div data-control="DateRange">
        <p>DateRange</p>
        <c-date-range
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :placeholder="['Start', 'End']"
        />
      </div>
      <div data-control="TimeRange">
        <p>TimeRange</p>
        <c-time-range
          :size="size"
          :variant="variant"
          :placeholder="['Start', 'End']"
        />
      </div>
    </div>

    <section
      aria-label="Selected control size comparison"
      class="control-size-comparison__states"
    >
      <c-space wrap align="center" :size="12">
        <span>Selected / Clearable / Multiple — 有值、可清空与多选不换行</span>
        <span
          >Hover or focus truncated text; tap on touch screens /
          悬停或聚焦省略正文查看全文；触屏点按查看，点外部关闭</span
        >
        <c-button size="sm" variant="outline" @click="resetSelections"
          >Reset / 恢复选中值</c-button
        >
      </c-space>
      <div class="control-size-comparison__grid">
        <div data-control="InputValue">
          <p>Input · clearable</p>
          <c-input
            v-model="inputValue"
            :size="size"
            :variant="variant"
            clearable
            placeholder="Input value"
          />
        </div>
        <div data-control="ButtonReference">
          <p>Button · reference</p>
          <c-button :size="size" variant="outline">Button</c-button>
```

### Form Feedback

Example source: src/input/__demos__/form-feedback.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-form :model="model">
    <c-form-item field="account" label="账户" feedback :validate-status="status" :help="status === 'error' ? '请输入账户后重试' : undefined">
      <c-input v-model="model.account" placeholder="外置标签会关闭内部浮动提示" hint clearable />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-button status="primary" :loading="status === 'validating'" @click="validate">模拟异步校验</c-button>
  </c-form>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from 'vue'

const model = reactive({ account: '' })
const status = ref<'validating' | 'success' | 'error'>()
let request = 0
async function validate() {
  const current = ++request
  const value = model.account
  status.value = 'validating'
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500))
  if (current === request) status.value = value.trim() ? 'success' : 'error'
}
</script>
```

Example source: src/input/__demos__/default-value.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

withDefaults(defineProps<{ english?: boolean }>(), { english: false })
const seed = ref('A: initial text')
const instanceKey = ref(0)
const lastUpdate = ref<string | null>(null)
const updateCount = ref(0)
const controlled = ref('')
function record(value: string) {
  lastUpdate.value = value
  updateCount.value += 1
}
function remount() {
  instanceKey.value += 1
  lastUpdate.value = null
  updateCount.value = 0
}
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <p>
      {{
        english
          ? '1. Uncontrolled: defaultValue supplies the initial text. Typing updates the component itself; the seed below stays unchanged.'
          : '1. 非受控：defaultValue 提供初始文字。输入后由组件自己保存新值，下方的默认值变量不会随之变化。'
      }}
    </p>
    <c-input :key="instanceKey" :default-value="seed" aria-label="Uncontrolled input" @update:model-value="record" />
    <p>
      defaultValue = <code>{{ seed }}</code>
    </p>
    <p role="status">
      update:modelValue × {{ updateCount }}; {{ english ? 'last emitted value' : '最近一次用户更新' }} =
      <code>{{ lastUpdate === null ? (english ? '(none)' : '（尚未触发）') : JSON.stringify(lastUpdate) }}</code>
    </p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="seed = seed.startsWith('A:') ? 'B: new default' : 'A: initial text'">{{
        english ? 'Change defaultValue only' : '仅修改 defaultValue'
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button @click="remount">{{ english ? 'Remount input' : '重新挂载输入框' }}</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p>
      {{
        english
          ? 'Try typing, then change defaultValue: the current text stays. Remount to read the latest defaultValue. Initialization never emits update:modelValue.'
          : '操作顺序：先输入，再修改 defaultValue，当前文字不会被覆盖；点击重新挂载后，才读取最新的默认值。初始化不会触发 update:modelValue。'
      }}
    </p>
    <p>
      {{
        english
          ? '2. Controlled: v-model is the source of truth. Its initial empty string takes precedence over defaultValue.'
          : '2. 受控：v-model 是数据来源。这里初始值为空字符串，仍优先于 defaultValue，不会自动填入默认文字。'
      }}
    </p>
    <c-input v-model="controlled" default-value="This default is ignored" aria-label="Controlled input" />
    <p role="status">
      v-model = <code>{{ JSON.stringify(controlled) }}</code>
    </p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="controlled = 'Parent supplied text'">{{
        english ? 'Update parent value' : '从父级设置值'
      }}</c-button>
      <c-button @click="controlled = ''">{{ english ? 'Clear parent value' : '清空父级值' }}</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p>
      {{
        english
          ? 'For a form, initialize the bound field in the parent. defaultValue does not write an initial value into the parent form.'
          : '表单需要初始值时，请初始化父级绑定字段。defaultValue 不会把初始值写入父级表单。'
      }}
    </p>
```

### Commit approval

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes null unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render null as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to null. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise&lt;void&gt; allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

Example source: src/input/__demos__/en-US/commit-protocol.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const value = ref<string | null>("Project A");
const message = ref("");
async function beforeCommit(
  { value: next, previousValue }: { value: unknown; previousValue: unknown },
  _done: (allow?: boolean) => void,
  { signal }: { signal: AbortSignal },
) {
  if (next === previousValue) return true;
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
  if (signal.aborted) return false;
  message.value = `Saved: ${String(next)}`;
  return true;
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-input
      v-model="value"
      edit-mode="click"
      clearable
      :empty-value="null"
      :before-commit="beforeCommit"
    />
    <p role="status">{{ message }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### `<Input>` Props

| Parameter                 | Description                                                                       | Type                                                |   Default   |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | :---------: |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Bound value                                                                       | `string \| null`                                    |     `-`     |
| `loading` | Loading presentation; keeps the input editable | `boolean` | `false` |
| `loading-mode` | Loading layout: default indicator or bottom line | `default / line` | `default` |
| model-modifiers           | `v-model` modifiers; supports `trim`                                              | `{ trim?: boolean }`                                |    `{}`     |
| default-value             | Uncontrolled initial value; read only at creation, never written into the parent  | `string`                                            |    `''`     |
| variant                   | Field appearance                                                                  | `'filled' \| 'outline' \| 'standard'`               | `'outline'` |
| size                      | Input size                                                                        | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'`              |   `'md'`    |
| clearable                 | Whether to allow the input to be cleared                                          | `boolean`                                           |   `false`   |
| empty-value               | Clear output; omission clears to an empty string and manual deletion is unchanged | `string \| null \| (() => string \| null)`          | `undefined` |
| disabled                  | Disabled state; can inherit from Form                                             | `boolean`                                           |     `-`     |
| readonly                  | Readonly state; can inherit from Form                                             | `boolean`                                           |     `-`     |
| error                     | Error state; can inherit from FormItem                                            | `boolean`                                           |     `-`     |
| placeholder               | Hint text                                                                         | `string`                                            |     `-`     |
| hint                      | Whether hint text floats                                                          | `boolean`                                           |   `false`   |
| line                      | Whether to draw a border or underline                                             | `boolean`                                           |   `true`    |
| text-color                | Input text color                                                                  | `string`                                            |     `-`     |
| focus-color               | Focused hint and supported border colors; does not control the caret              | `string`                                            |     `-`     |
| blur-color                | Unfocused hint color                                                              | `string`                                            |     `-`     |
| aria-label                | Native input accessible label                                                     | `string`                                            |     `-`     |
| autofocus                 | Focus automatically after mount                                                   | `boolean`                                           |   `false`   |
| enterkeyhint              | Mobile virtual-keyboard enter-key hint                                            | `string`                                            |     `-`     |
| max-length                | Maximum input length                                                              | `number \| { length: number; errorOnly?: boolean }` |     `0`     |
| show-word-limit           | Show the character counter                                                        | `boolean`                                           |   `false`   |
| word-length               | Length-counting function                                                          | `(value: string) => number`                         |     `-`     |
| word-slice                | Text-slicing function, used with wordLength                                       | `(value: string, maxLength: number) => string`      |     `-`     |
| input-attrs               | Attributes for the internal input element                                         | `object`                                            |     `-`     |

`disabled / readonly / size` resolve from child → InputGroup → FormItem/Form → library defaults; Cedar size also supports ConfigProvider. `clearable` applies only to nonempty editable inputs: PC shows it on hover/focus, while touch devices and Maple keep it visible. Native name/id/aria-_/data-_ reach the input; class/style stay on the wrapper. `input-attrs` cannot override controlled value, type, disabled/readonly state or length policy.

### `<Input>` Events

| Event       | Description                                   | Arguments                      |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| input       | Emitted on user input                         | value: `string`<br>ev: `Event` |
| change      | Emitted on blur, Enter submission or clearing | value: `string`<br>ev: `Event` |
| press-enter | Emitted when the user presses Enter           | ev: `KeyboardEvent`            |
| clear       | Emitted when the user clicks the clear button | ev: `MouseEvent`               |
| focus       | Emitted when the input gains focus            | ev: `FocusEvent`               |
| blur        | Emitted when the input loses focus            | ev: `FocusEvent`               |

### `<Input>` Methods

| Method | Description     | Arguments | Returns |
| ------ | --------------- | --------- | ------- |
| focus  | Focus the input | -         | -       |
| blur   | Blur the input  | -         | -       |
| select | Select all text | -         | -       |

### `<input>` Slots

| Slot       |     Description     | Arguments              |
| ---------- | :-----------------: | ---------------------- |
| suffix     |   Suffix content    | -                      |
| prefix     |   Prefix content    | -                      |
| clear-icon | Custom clear button | `clear(event?: Event)` |

### `<InputPassword>` Props

| Parameter          | Description                                                 | Type      | Default |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | :-----: |
| visibility-toggle  | Whether to show the password-visibility toggle              | `boolean` | `true`  |
| default-visibility | Default uncontrolled visibility                             | `boolean` | `false` |
| visibility         | Controlled password visibility; supports v-model:visibility | `boolean` |   `-`   |

InputPassword supports all Input props, events, slots and methods.

### `<InputGroup>` Props

| Parameter | Description                      | Type                            | Default                                     |
| --------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| size      | Default size within the group    | `ComponentSize`                 | Inherited from Form/ConfigProvider, or `md` |
| variant   | Default variant within the group | `filled \| outline \| standard` | `filled`                                    |
| disabled  | Group disabled state             | `boolean`                       | Inherited from Form, or `false`             |
| readonly  | Group readonly state             | `boolean`                       | Inherited from Form, or `false`             |
| hint      | Group floating hint              | `boolean`                       | Library default                             |

### `<InputPassword>` Events

| Parameter         | Description                     | Arguments         |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| visibility-change | Emitted when visibility changes | `visible:boolean` |

## Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { InputProps } from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

Public types: `InputEmits`, `InputSlots`, `InputExpose`, `InputGroupSlots`, `InputPasswordEmits`, `InputPasswordSlots`, `InputPasswordExpose`.

### Form presentation inheritance

Supports `edit-mode`: `direct / click / dblclick`. Inherits FormItem/Form when unset; standalone usage defaults to direct. readPretty displays plain text; popup editing updates v-model after confirmation by default. Optional before-commit can intercept saving after candidate validation. See the Form documentation for usage and comparison demos.

### Input caret theme

| CSS variable            | Default        | Description                                            |
| ----------------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--c-input-caret-color` | `currentColor` | Caret color, independently overridable from text color |

`--c-field-caret-color` sets the shared caret color, defaulting to `currentColor`. `--c-input-caret-color` overrides this component and defaults to `var(--c-field-caret-color)`.

## Layout and arrangement

### Scroll

Preview configuration: `bordered`, `scrollable`.

Example source: src/layout/__demos__/scroll.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-layout class="scroll-layout">
    <c-layout-header bordered class="bar">
      固定头部
      <c-button
        size="sm"
        @click="content?.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })"
        >回到顶部</c-button
      >
    </c-layout-header>
    <c-layout-content ref="content" scrollable @scroll="onScroll">
      <div v-for="item in 30" :key="item" class="row">
        内容 {{ item }} · 只有内容区域滚动
      </div>
    </c-layout-content>
    <c-layout-footer bordered class="bar"
      >固定底部 · 已滚动 {{ offset }}px</c-layout-footer
    >
  </c-layout>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { LayoutContentInstance } from "../index";
const content = ref<LayoutContentInstance>();
const offset = ref(0);
const onScroll = (event: Event) => {
  offset.value = Math.round((event.target as HTMLElement).scrollTop);
};
</script>
<style scoped>
.scroll-layout {
  height: 320px;
  background: var(--c-color-bg-2);
}
.bar {
  padding: 12px 16px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.row {
  padding: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-color-border-2);
}
</style>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"` and supports runtime and nested overrides. Content inherits reading direction. Sider placement=left/right and physical ResizeBox handles keep their physical-side semantics. Nested headings and content may override dir locally.

## API

### Layout Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- | :----: |
| scrollable | Enable native scrolling on this element; requires constrained height | boolean | false |
| has-sider | Indicates that there is a Sider in the sub-element, which generally does not need to be specified. Used to avoid style flicker when rendering on the server side. | boolean | false |

### Layout-Header Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| ------- | :--: | ---- |
| default | Content | - |

### Layout-content Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| ------- | :--: | ---- |
| default | Content | - |

### Layout-Footer Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| ------- | :--: | ---- |
| default | Content | - |

### Layout-Sider Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | :-----: |
| theme | Theme color | 'dark' \| 'light' | 'light' |
| collapsed | Current collapsed state | boolean | - |
| default-collapsed | Default collapsed state | boolean | false |
| collapsible | Whether collapsing is enabled | boolean | false |
| width | Width | number \| string | 200 |
| collapsed-width | Collapsed width | number | 48 |
| reverse-arrow | Reverse the collapse arrow; useful for a right-side Sider | boolean | false |
| breakpoint | Responsive breakpoint; see responsive Grid | 'xxl' \| 'xl' \| 'lg' \| 'md' \| 'sm' \| 'xs' | - |
| resize-directions | Replace the native aside with ResizeBox; this is the ResizeBox directions parameter. See ResizeBox | Array<'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom'> | - |
| hide-trigger | Hide the bottom collapse trigger | boolean | false |

### Layout-Sider Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |

| breakpoint | Responsive-breakpoint event | collapsed: boolean |

## Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { LayoutProps } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

### Additional layout capabilities

| Component | Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Content | scrollable | boolean | false | Use this element as a native scroll container |
| Header / Footer / Sider | bordered | boolean | false | Show a border adjacent to the content |
| Sider | placement | 'left' / 'right' | 'left' | Sidebar placement; handles arrows automatically, while reverse-arrow remains supported |
| Sider | collapse-mode | 'width' / 'transform' | 'width' | Resize or translate content while collapsing |

Layout, Content and Sider emit `scroll`(event: Event) and expose `scrollTo(options: ScrollToOptions)` / `scrollTo(x: number, y: number)`. Sider scrolls its internal content node by default. `width` accepts numeric px or CSS lengths. Percentage widths with transform mode are discouraged; use definite lengths such as px/rem.

The collapse control is a native button supporting Tab, Enter and Space. With `collapsed-width="0"`, the hidden region is inert and the expansion entry stays at the sidebar edge. A custom trigger slot should contain display content without nested buttons.

```vue
    </c-link>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## API

### `<Link>` Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------- | -------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | --------- |
| href | Link URL | `string` | - |
| target | Native link target | `string` | - |
| rel | Native link relationship | `string` | - |
| size | Text, icon and loading-icon size | 'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' | 'md' |
| status | Link status | `SemanticStatus` | `default` |
| underline | Underline display policy | `always \| hover \| none` | `none` |
| hoverable | Background on hover | `boolean` | `false` |
| icon | Icon | `boolean` | `false` |
| loading | Whether the link is loading | `boolean` | `false` |
| disabled | Whether the link is disabled | `boolean` | `false` |

### `<Link>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------ | -------------- | ----------------------------- |
| click | Click event | `(event: MouseEvent) => void` |

### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Link content |
| icon | Custom icon; replaced by the loading icon while loading |

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { LinkProps, LinkUnderline, LinkInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

### Style migration

Internal classes use `c-link--status-*`, `c-link--underline-*`, `c-link--disabled`, `c-link--loading` and `c-link__icon`. Migrate old single-hyphen selectors and prefer `--c-link-*` CSS variables. Focus supports `--c-link-focus-width` (2px), `--c-link-focus-offset` (2px), `--c-link-focus-color` (currentColor) and `--c-link-focus-opacity` (0.8). Reduced motion disables loading rotation and transitions.

Text colors match Button text variants: default uses content-primary; secondary/tertiary use content-secondary; colored statuses use their semantic content colors; disabled/loading use content-disabled. Both brands inherit these in light/dark modes.

Size variables: `--c-link-size-xs-font-size`, `--c-link-size-sm-font-size`, `--c-link-size-md-font-size`, `--c-link-size-lg-font-size`, `--c-link-size-xl-font-size`. Defaults are 12 / 13 / 14 / 16 / 18px. md references `--c-link-font-size`; icons/loading icons use 1em.

## Lifecycle

### Virtual Lifecycle

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | Data consumed by item slot | Virtual Lifecycle |
| `virtual-list-props` | Data virtualization; ignored when default slot exists | Virtual Lifecycle |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `data`: Supplies the example data.

Example source: src/list/__demos__/virtual-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";

const active = ref(true);
const mounted = ref(true);
const rows = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, key) => ({ key }));
let retained:
  | { scrollIntoView: (options: { key: number; align: "top" }) => void }
  | undefined;
const capture = (instance: typeof retained) => {
  if (instance) retained = instance;
};
const jump = () => retained?.scrollIntoView({ key: 50, align: "top" });
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">Activate / deactivate</c-button>
    <c-button @click="mounted = !mounted">Mount / dispose cache</c-button>
    <c-button @click="jump">Retained command: row 51</c-button>
    <p>Inactive/disposed commands do nothing. Activation never replays them.</p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <c-list
        v-if="active"
        :ref="capture"
        :data="rows"
        :virtual-list-props="{
          height: 100,
          fixedSize: true,
          estimatedSize: 20,
          buffer: 2,
          itemKey: 'key',
        }"
      >
        <template #item="{ item }"
          ><div style="height: 20px">{{ item.key + 1 }}</div></template
        >
      </c-list>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

## API

### List Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data | Data consumed by item slot | unknown[] | undefined |
| size | Implemented sizes only; xs/xl are not supported | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | md |
| bordered | Outer border | boolean | true |
| split | Item/header/footer separators, independent of border | boolean | true |
| loading | Initial loading/refresh feedback, not pagination state | boolean | false |
| max-height | Maximum ordinary viewport height; number in px or CSS length, zero means unlimited | number \| string | 0 |
| virtual-list-props | Data virtualization; ignored when default slot exists | ListVirtualListProps | undefined |
| scrollbar | Ordinary viewport custom scrollbar; false uses native scrolling | boolean \| ListScrollbarProps | true |

Virtual lists use a dedicated viewport without nesting a custom scrollbar. virtualListProps.height overrides maxHeight; with neither, height defaults to 200px. Numeric and unit-bearing CSS lengths are accepted. Invalid/nonpositive max-height does not constrain height.

ListVirtualListProps supports height, threshold, fixedSize, estimatedSize, buffer, itemKey and component. Removed isStaticItemHeight is unsupported; List.data supplies data. Counts at or below threshold render all items. Variable heights use measurements and estimatedSize; buffer controls overscan rows.

ListScrollbarProps supports type: 'track'|'embed', outerClass, outerStyle, hide, disableHorizontal and disableVertical. JavaScript object fields use camelCase.

### Events / Methods

- scroll(event: Event): one notification per real scroll event.
- scrollIntoView({ index?, key?, align }): virtual-list positioning. index overrides key; align is top/bottom/auto. auto does nothing for a fully visible item, otherwise scrolls the minimum distance required. Invalid targets or nonvirtual mode do nothing.

### Slots

List slots: default (overrides data), item({ item, index }), header, footer, empty. Empty state appears only without a default slot/data and while not loading. ListItem prefix/default/suffix retain list-item semantics without managing buttons/business interactions.

### Types

ListProps、ListSize、ListVirtualListProps、ListScrollbarProps、ListExpose、ListSlots、ListEmits、ListInstance、ListItemInstance。

List handles display and an optional virtual viewport. Compose InfiniteScroll status/target behavior for pagination rather than duplicating its loading state machine inside List.

```vue
    <h4>简单用法</h4>
    <c-switch v-model="simpleLoading" />
    <c-card
      v-c-loading="simpleLoading"
      title="介绍"
      description="v-c-loading 会在当前容器内渲染 Loading 遮罩，不会改变内容结构。"
    />

    <h4>复杂配置</h4>
    <c-switch v-model="configuredLoading" />
    <c-card
      v-c-loading="{
        loading: configuredLoading,
        tip: '加载中...',
        color: 'var(--c-color-primary)',
        background: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-color-bg-1) 72%, transparent)',
      }"
      title="介绍"
      description="v-c-loading 会在当前容器内渲染 Loading 遮罩，不会改变内容结构。"
    />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from "vue";

const simpleLoading = ref(false);
const configuredLoading = ref(false);
</script>
```

## API

### `<Loading>` Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------- | -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| type | Loading animation type | `circle \| wave \| cube \| rect \| disappear` | `circle` |
| size | Loading-indicator size; numbers are px | `xs \| sm \| md \| lg \| xl \| number` | `md` |
| radius | Radius for `circle` indicators | `string \| number` | - |
| color | Indicator and hint-text color | `string` | - |
| loading | Whether loading; effective only when wrapping content | `boolean` | `false` |
| tip | Prompt copy | `string` | - |
| hide-icon | Whether to hide the loading indicator | `boolean` | `false` |

`v-c-loading` accepts boolean shorthand or `{ loading, tip, type, size, radius, color, hideIcon, fullscreen, background }`. The object's `loading` field controls state; other props match `Loading`.

#### Registration

`v-c-loading` renders Cedar's built-in `Loading` component. The `c-` prefix avoids collisions with other libraries’ directives. Register it in any of the following ways.

```ts
// 1. Full installation: registers Loading and v-c-loading automatically
import CedarVue from "@cedar-design/ui";

app.use(CedarVue);
```

```ts
// 2. Install Loading on demand: registers the component and directive
import { Loading } from "@cedar-design/ui";

app.use(Loading);
```

```ts
// 3. Register only the directive manually
import { vLoading } from "@cedar-design/ui";

app.directive("c-loading", vLoading);
```

With `CedarResolver()`, `unplugin-vue-components` resolves template `v-c-loading` automatically. `directives: false` disables directive resolution.

### `<Loading>` Slots

| Slot | Description |
| ------- | ---------------------- |
| default | Content covered by the loading mask |
| tip | Custom hint content |
| icon | Custom loading indicator |

The `icon` slot replaces every built-in `type` animation. Without it, the ConfigProvider `loading` slot takes precedence over built-in animations. `hide-icon=true` hides all indicators while allowing tip content to remain visible.

## Type definitions

The component exports the following types:

```ts
import type { LoadingProps } from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

The loading-directive mask prevents default click behavior and propagation. Clicking it does not activate Card or ordinary parent click handlers. Normal clicking resumes after loading. It does not disable keyboard access to underlying controls; set those controls’ `disabled` props to block all interaction.

### Overlay styles

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-loading-overlay-background` | Directive overlay background; the background option overrides this value. |

Content-overlay class: `.c-loading__content-overlay`.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### `<mention>` Props

| Parameter                 | Description                                  | Type                                                                                                       |   Default   | Version |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------: | :------ |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Bound value                                  | `string`                                                                                                   |     `-`     |         |
| default-value             | Default value (uncontrolled state)           | `string`                                                                                                   |    `''`     |         |
| data                      | Data for automatic completion                | `(string \| number \| SelectOptionData \| SelectOptionGroup)[]` / `(query, { signal }) => Array / Promise` | `undefined` |         |
| prefix                    | Keywords that trigger auto-completion        | `string \| string[]`                                                                                       |    `'@'`    |         |
| split                     | Before and after the selected item separator | `string`                                                                                                   |    `' '`    |         |
| type                      | default input or textarea                    | `'input' \| 'textarea'`                                                                                    |  `'input'`  |         |
| disabled                  | Whether disabled                             | `boolean`                                                                                                  |   `false`   |         |
| clearable                 | Whether to allow the input to be cleared     | `boolean`                                                                                                  |   `false`   | 2.23.0  |

### `<mention>` Events

| Event  | Description                                               | Arguments                                                     | Version |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | :------ |
| change | Emitted when the value changes                            | value: `string`                                               |         |
| search | Emitted during dynamic search; prefix was added in 2.47.0 | value: `string`<br>prefix: `string`                           |         |
| select | Emitted when a dropdown option is selected                | value: `string \| number \| Record<string, any> \| undefined` |         |
| clear  | Emitted when the user clicks the clear button             | -                                                             | 2.23.0  |
| focus  | Emitted when the text input gains focus                   | ev: `FocusEvent`                                              | 2.42.0  |
| blur   | Emitted when the text input loses focus                   | ev: `FocusEvent`                                              | 2.42.0  |

### `<mention>` Methods

| Method | Description     | Arguments | Returns | Version |
| ------ | --------------- | --------- | ------- | :------ |
| focus  | Focus the input | -         | -       | 2.24.0  |
| blur   | Blur the input  | -         | -       | 2.24.0  |

### `<mention>` Slots

| Slot   |  Description   | Arguments          | Version |
| ------ | :------------: | ------------------ | :------ |
| option | Option content | data: `OptionInfo` | 2.13.0  |

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { MentionInstance } from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

Mention reuses Input/Textarea typography and spacing; its measurement mirror copies computed native input styles. Override the corresponding input variables. Ineffective mention-font-size, mention-line-height and mention-padding-* variables are removed.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty.
Text and person-ID models remain strings; use an empty string or a business-defined string sentinel.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

`data` accepts an array or (query, { signal }) => array/Promise. The component manages loading, cancellation and stale-result isolation; failures emit load-error. Single/multiple groups initialize with an empty query; searchable fields reload when queries change. Tree root loading is independent of existing load-more child loading.

### Active Rendering

- `options`: Supplies the available options.

Example source: src/menu/__demos__/active-rendering.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { MenuRenderContext } from '@cedar-design/ui'

const selectedValue = ref('account')
const status = ({ active }: MenuRenderContext) => active ? '当前项已选中' : '当前项未选中'
const options = [
  { label: '设置', value: 'settings', extra: status, children: [
    { label: '账户', value: 'account', extra: status },
    { label: '通知', value: 'notifications', extra: status },
  ] },
  { label: '帮助', value: 'help', extra: status },
]

</script>

      <c-button>渲染函数中的 active</c-button>
    </c-menu>

      <c-button>作用域插槽中的 active</c-button>
      <template #option-extra="{ active }">
        <c-tag :status="active ? 'primary' : 'default'">{{ active ? '当前项已选中' : '当前项未选中' }}</c-tag>
      </template>
    </c-menu>
    <c-menu v-model="selectedValue" :hide-on-select="false">
      <c-button>自定义子项与 highlight</c-button>
      <template #content>
        <c-menu-option value="account">
          <template #default="{ active }">账户：{{ active ? '已选中' : '未选中' }}</template>
        </c-menu-option>
        <c-menu-option value="help" :label="helpLabel" highlight />
      </template>
    </c-menu>
  </c-space>
</template>
```
