## Async options

### Async Options

Preview configuration: `edit-mode="direct"`, `:options="options"`.

Example source: src/radio/__demos__/async-options.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onDeactivated, onUnmounted, ref, shallowRef } from "vue";

const value = ref("remote");
const options = ref([]);
const loading = ref(false);
const changeCount = ref(0);
let pendingTimer;
const manual = ref(false);
const waiting = shallowRef([]);
const applied = ref(0);
const ignored = ref(0);
let version = 0;
let sequence = 0;

function cancelPending() {
  version++;
  if (pendingTimer !== undefined) {
    clearTimeout(pendingTimer);
  }
  pendingTimer = undefined;
  loading.value = false;
}

function load() {
  cancelPending();
  loading.value = true;
  const ticket = version;
  const id = ++sequence;
  const complete = () => {
    if (ticket !== version) {
      ignored.value++;
      return;
    }
    applied.value = id;
    options.value = [
      { label: "异步设备", value: "remote" },
      { label: "设备 A", value: "a" },
      { label: "停用设备", value: "locked", disabled: true },
    ];
    pendingTimer = undefined;
    loading.value = false;
  };
  if (manual.value) {
    new Promise((resolve) => {
      waiting.value = [...waiting.value, { id, resolve }];
    }).then(complete);
  } else {
    pendingTimer = setTimeout(complete, 800);
  }
}

function settle(latest) {
  const jobs = [...waiting.value];
  const job = latest ? jobs.pop() : jobs.shift();
  waiting.value = jobs;
  job?.resolve();
}

function cleanup() {
  cancelPending();
  const jobs = waiting.value;
  waiting.value = [];
  jobs.forEach((job) => job.resolve());
}

function remove() {
  cancelPending();
  options.value = [];
}

onDeactivated(cleanup);
onUnmounted(cleanup);
</script>

<template>
  <c-space class="radio-async-demo" direction="column">
    <p>业务值独立于当前选项，加载或移除选项不会清空已选值：{{ value }}</p>
    <c-checkbox v-model="manual" edit-mode="direct" @change="remove"
      >Manual responses / 手动返回</c-checkbox
    >
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button size="sm" @click="load">加载选项</c-button>
      <c-button size="sm" @click="remove">移除选项</c-button>
      <c-button size="sm" @click="value = 'a'">设为设备 A</c-button>
      <c-button size="sm" @click="value = null">清空选择</c-button>
      <c-button
        size="sm"
        :disabled="waiting.length === 0"
        @click="settle(false)"
        >返回最早加载</c-button
      >
      <c-button size="sm" :disabled="waiting.length === 0" @click="settle(true)"
        >返回最新加载</c-button
      >
    </c-space>
    <p aria-live="polite">
      {{
        loading
          ? "加载中，可在完成前移除选项以取消本次加载。"
          : "加载完成后保留当前选值和键盘焦点。"
      }}
    </p>
    <c-radio-group
      v-model="value"
      edit-mode="direct"
      :options="options"
      @change="changeCount++"
    />
    <p>用户变更次数：{{ changeCount }}</p>
    <p role="status">
      Applied: {{ applied }} · Ignored: {{ ignored }} · Pending:
      {{ waiting.length }}
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

`ChoiceValue = string | number | boolean`；`CheckboxModel = boolean | ChoiceValue[]`；`RadioModel = ChoiceValue | null`。

### Radio Props

| Prop                  | Description                                               | Type                      | Default   |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | --------- |
| model-value (v-model) | Controlled value                                          | ChoiceValue \| null       | undefined |
| default-value         | Initial uncontrolled value                                | ChoiceValue \| null       | null      |
| value                 | Option `value`                                            | `string\|number\|boolean` | `true`    |
| variant               | Radio variant                                             | `'radio'\|'button'`       | `'radio'` |
| disabled              | Disabled state; inherits from the form/group when omitted | boolean                   | undefined |
| readonly              | Readonly state; inherits from the form/group when omitted | boolean                   | undefined |
| error                 | Error state; inherits from the form/group when omitted    | boolean                   | undefined |

### Radio Events

| Event              | Description          | Arguments                         |
| ------------------ | -------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| update:model-value | Proposes a new value | value: ChoiceValue                |
| change             | Value change         | value: ChoiceValue, event?: Event |
| focus              | Focus                | event: FocusEvent                 |
| blur               | Blur                 | event: FocusEvent                 |

### Radio Methods

| Method | Arguments              | Returns |
| ------ | ---------------------- | ------- |
| select | -                      | void    |
| focus  | options?: FocusOptions | void    |
| blur   | -                      | void    |

### Radio Slots

| Slot  | Description          | Arguments                                |
| ----- | -------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| radio | Custom radio control | `checked:boolean`<br/>`disabled:boolean` |

### RadioGroup Props

| Prop                  | Description                                                                                            | Type                                                                                                    | Default        |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- |
| model-value (v-model) | Controlled value                                                                                       | RadioModel                                                                                              | undefined      |
| default-value         | Initial uncontrolled value                                                                             | RadioModel                                                                                              | null           |
| variant               | Radio-group variant                                                                                    | `'radio'\|'button'`                                                                                     | `'radio'`      |
| size                  | Radio-group size                                                                                       | `'xs'\|'sm'\|'md'\|'lg'\|'xl'`                                                                          | `-`            |
| options               | Options; replaces default slot when supplied                                                           | Array<ChoiceValue \| RadioOption \| Record<string, unknown>> / `(query, { signal }) => Array / Promise` | `undefined`    |
| orientation           | Horizontal/vertical arrangement of radio-group options, default horizontal; not text reading direction | `'horizontal'\|'vertical'`                                                                              | `'horizontal'` |
| disabled              | Disabled state; inherits from the form/group when omitted                                              | boolean                                                                                                 | undefined      |
| readonly              | Readonly state; inherits from the form/group when omitted                                              | boolean                                                                                                 | undefined      |
| error                 | Error state; inherits from the form/group when omitted                                                 | boolean                                                                                                 | undefined      |
| field-names           | Option field mapping                                                                                   | ChoiceFieldNames                                                                                        | undefined      |
| aria-label            | Accessible group name                                                                                  | string                                                                                                  | ''             |

### RadioGroup Events

| Event              | Description                          | Arguments                                      |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------- |
| update:model-value | Proposes a new value                 | value: string \| number \| boolean             |
| change             | Value change; notified once by Group | value: string \| number \| boolean, ev?: Event |

### RadioGroup Slots

| Slot  | Description          | Arguments                                |
| ----- | -------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| radio | Custom radio control | `checked:boolean`<br/>`disabled:boolean` |
| label | Radio label content  | `data: RadioOption, checked: boolean`    |

### RadioOption

| Field    | Description              | Type                                                              |
| -------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| value    | Option identity          | ChoiceValue                                                       |
| label    | Label or render function | VNodeChild \| (data: RadioOption, checked: boolean) => VNodeChild |
| disabled | Disable interaction      | boolean                                                           |
| readonly | Read-only interaction    | boolean                                                           |

## Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { RadioProps } from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

### ChoiceFieldNames

`{ label?: string; value?: string; disabled?: string; readonly?: string; indeterminate?: string }`

Exported types：`RadioOption`、`ChoiceFieldNames`。

### Native attributes and appearance

| Component          | Prop                            | Description                                                       | Type                | Default   |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | --------- |
| Radio / RadioGroup | name                            | Native field name; child overrides group                          | string              | undefined |
| Radio              | aria-label                      | Native control accessible name                                    | string              | undefined |
| Radio              | input-attrs                     | Native input attributes                                           | InputHTMLAttributes | undefined |
| Radio              | checked-color / unchecked-color | Instance checked/unchecked colors; error/disabled take precedence | string              | undefined |
| Radio              | icon-size                       | Icon dimension; numbers are px, strings are CSS lengths           | number \| string    | undefined |
| Radio              | ripple                          | Touch ripple feedback                                             | boolean             | true      |

### Icons and default slot

checked-icon and unchecked-icon are supported on both platforms. default and radio slots receive { checked, disabled }. click emits the original MouseEvent once. Disabled emits no click; readonly may emit click without changing the value.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

The `options` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. The component manages loading, cancellation and stale-result isolation; failures emit load-error. Single/multiple groups initialize with an empty-string query, searchable fields reload when the query changes, and root loading for tree fields remains independent of existing load-more child loading.

```vue
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>Tab 聚焦；方向键按半分调整；Home 清零，End 满分。重复点击当前分数可清空。</p>
    <c-rate v-model="score" allow-half clearable aria-label="服务评分" />
    <span>当前评分：{{ score }}</span>
    <c-rate :default-value="3" readonly aria-label="只读评分" />
    <c-rate :default-value="3" disabled aria-label="禁用评分" />
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Props

| Prop           | Description                                                              | Type                             | Default       |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------- | ------------- |
| model-value    | Controlled value, including zero; external updates emit no events        | number                           | undefined     |
| default-value  | Initial uncontrolled value; subsequent changes do not reset it           | number                           | 0             |
| count          | Positive finite number, rounded down; invalid values fall back to 5      | number \| string                 | 5             |
| allow-half     | Enable half-point steps                                                  | boolean                          | false         |
| clearable      | Click the current score again to clear; keyboard boundaries do not clear | boolean                          | false         |
| grading        | Fixed five-face rating; overrides slots and icon props                   | boolean                          | false         |
| disabled       | Disable interaction; inherits Form when omitted                          | boolean                          | undefined     |
| readonly       | Focusable but not editable; inherits Form when omitted                   | boolean                          | undefined     |
| aria-label     | Accessible business label                                                | string                           | undefined     |
| size           | Icon dimension: number/numeric string in px, otherwise CSS length        | number \| string                 | Style default |
| gap            | Icon spacing: number/numeric string in px, otherwise CSS length          | number \| string                 | Style default |
| color          | Active color or increasing per-icon threshold color map                  | string \| Record<string, string> | undefined     |
| empty-color    | Inactive color                                                           | string                           | undefined     |
| disabled-color | Disabled color, overriding active/inactive colors                        | string                           | undefined     |
| icon           | Checked icon                                                             | string \| Component              | Filled star   |
| half-icon      | Half icon                                                                | string \| Component              | Half star     |
| empty-icon     | Unchecked icon                                                           | string \| Component              | Empty star    |
| ripple         | Click ripple                                                             | boolean                          | true          |

size/gap do not accept xs/sm/md/lg/xl presets. Omitted, invalid or nonpositive values retain style defaults. CSS var/calc/min/max/clamp lengths are supported. Ratings normalize to 0–count in steps of 1 or 0.5. Nonfinite ratings display 0 without rewriting the external value.

### Events

| Event              | Arguments     | Description                                                   |
| ------------------ | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| update:model-value | value: number | User produces a new value                                     |
| change             | value: number | Confirmed new value; no duplicate for equal values            |
| hover-change       | value: number | Hover preview; resets to zero on leave/blur/disabled/readonly |

### Slots

| Slot      | Arguments                | Description                                                   |
| --------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| character | { index, value, active } | index starts at 0; value starts at 1. Replaces rating symbols |

Precedence: grading > character > icon/half-icon/empty-icon > default icon. String icons require global registration; component values do not.

### Methods

focus() focuses the rating; blur() removes focus. Readonly remains focusable, while disabled leaves the Tab sequence. Arrow keys adjust, Home clears and End selects the maximum. Keyboard events from interactive children and Alt/Ctrl/Meta combinations are not intercepted. Touch and mouse share half-selection/clearing rules.

### Type definitions

Exports RateProps, RateColor, RateIcon, RateInstance, RateExpose, RateEmits and RateCharacterSlotProps.

### Style variables

| Token                                 | Default                                        |
| ------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `--c-rate-disabled-color`             | `var(--c-sys-color-content-disabled)`          |
| `--c-rate-error-color`                | `var(--c-sys-color-content-danger)`            |
| `--c-rate-active-scale`               | `1.2`                                          |
| `--c-rate-focus-color`                | `var(--c-sys-color-content-brand)`             |
| `--c-rate-focus-width`                | `2px`                                          |
| `--c-rate-focus-offset`               | `2px`                                          |
| `--c-rate-size`                       | `var(--c-font-size-title-3)`                   |
| `--c-rate-gap`                        | `var(--c-spacing-4)`                           |
| `--c-rate-min-height`                 | `var(--c-size-md)`                             |
| `--c-rate-action-padding`             | `0px`                                          |
| `--c-rate-empty-color`                | `var(--c-color-fill-3)`                        |
| `--c-rate-active-color`               | `rgb(var(--c-gold-6))`                         |
| `--c-rate-transition-duration`        | `var(--c-transition-duration-2)`               |
| `--c-rate-scale-duration`             | `var(--c-transition-duration-4)`               |
| `--c-rate-transition-timing-function` | `var(--c-transition-timing-function-standard)` |

Public token suffixes/meanings match across platforms. Cedar retains gold stars and compact spacing; Maple retains primary-color stars and touch padding. Defaults are recorded in the theme contract. Sources are maintained independently without a shared runtime.

`transition-duration` controls hover/color transitions, `scale-duration` controls selection animation, and `transition-timing-function` controls easing. Reduced motion disables these animations. `size` and `gap` props override the corresponding tokens for a single instance.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

## API

### `<resize-box>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------- | :---------: |
| width **(v-model)** | Width | `number` | `-` |
| height **(v-model)** | Surface height | `number` | `-` |
| component | The html tag of the telescopic box | `string` | `'div'` |
| directions | Edges with enabled resize handles, right only by default. Any combination of top/right/bottom/left; describes neither pointer movement nor popup placement | `('left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom')[]` | `['right']` |

### `<resize-box>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------ | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| moving-start | Emitted when dragging starts | ev: `MouseEvent` |
| moving | Emitted during dragging | size: `{ width: number; height: number; }`<br>ev: `MouseEvent` |
| moving-end | Emitted when dragging ends | ev: `MouseEvent` |

### `<resize-box>` Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| ------------------- | :----------: | --------------------------------------------------- |
| resize-trigger | Resize-handle content | direction: `'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom'` |
| resize-trigger-icon | Resize-handle icon | direction: `'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom'` |

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { ResizeBoxInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```


### Placement semantics and configuration

directions means edges with enabled resize handles; the existing name is retained. Only the right edge is enabled by default; multiple edges can be combined. It is neither an orientation axis nor popup placement. Edges is a more direct name for a new design, but this update does not rename the API.


## Reading direction and interaction

ResizeBox directions name physical edges: left/right/top/bottom retain their sides in RTL. Handles support the corresponding axis arrow keys, mouse and touch pointers; Shift increases the step from 10px to 50px. Dimensions clamp at zero. Direction changes, edge removal and teardown cancel active gestures and release cursor ownership.

```vue
  border-radius: var(--c-sys-radius-sm);
  color: var(--c-sys-color-action-primary);
  background: var(--c-sys-color-surface-overlay);
  cursor: pointer;
}
</style>
```

## Options

| Options | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| color | Ripple color | `string` | `currentColor` |
| disabled | Prevent ripples and cancel pending animation | `boolean` | `false` |

Use `v-ripple="{ color, disabled }"`. Unmount cancels animations/timers and removes listeners; each element maintains independent keyboard state.

## Styles

For direct directive registration, import `@cedar-design/ui/ripple/style`. Runtime imports no CSS, supporting SSR package imports. Variables use `--c-ripple-*` and are declared in `style/token.less`. Theme defaults may differ from mobile while motion/consumption protocols stay aligned.

| Variable | Default | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| --c-ripple-color | currentColor | Ripple background; color option takes precedence |
| --c-ripple-cubic-bezier | cubic-bezier(0.68, 0.01, 0.62, 0.6) | Transform expansion easing |
| --c-ripple-expand-duration | 200ms | Transform expansion duration |
| --c-ripple-fade-duration | 140ms | Linear opacity appear/fade duration |

Variables belong on the actual directive host and inherit into ripples. Defaults currently match across platforms. 250ms is the minimum postcreation display/postfade removal wait, not visual duration or the entire lifecycle. Runtime reads computed transition duration/delay. Fade waits until the later of creation+250ms or activation+expansion duration; removal waits max(250ms, fade duration). Long overrides are not truncated. 0ms/unstyled retain cleanup floors. Reduced motion hides decoration. Expansion samples on creation/activation, fade on fade start; arbitrary midphase CSS changes/animations are not guaranteed.

Repeated release queues once. Disabling/unmounting cleans owned timers/direct ripples without deleting nested instances. Document listeners bind/remove against mount-time ownerDocument, without automatic cross-document rebinding. Only host Enter/Space and matching keyup/blur participate. The directive does not supply button semantics, accessible names or business clicking to plain divs. Real touch/OS preferences need separate validation.

# Row

24-column Flex layout. Row manages gutters and alignment; Col manages spans, offsets, ordering and breakpoints. Use Grid for CSS Grid collapse and suffix items.

> **Choosing a layout**
>
> - Grid + GridItem: Use for form columns and card grids with consistent column widths, spans, responsive column counts, or collapsed rows and suffix items.
> - Row + Col: Use for 24-column Flex layouts that need horizontal/vertical alignment, wrapping control, fixed and flexible widths together, or responsive ordering. Row controls the row; Col controls width, offset and order.
> - Space: Use for simple groups of buttons, tags or text that only need spacing, direction and alignment. Use native Flex for more flexible width allocation.

## Basic examples

### 24-column layout

Example source: src/row/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template><div>
  <c-row :gutter="12"><c-col :span="12"><div class="cell">12</div></c-col><c-col :span="12"><div class="cell soft">12</div></c-col></c-row>
  <c-row :gutter="12"><c-col v-for="i in 3" :key="i" :span="8"><div class="cell">8</div></c-col></c-row>
</div></template>

<style scoped>
.controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.cell { box-sizing: border-box; padding: 12px; min-width: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--c-color-primary); color: var(--c-color-white); text-align: center; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.soft { opacity: .7; }
</style>
```

<!-- same-source-api:start -->
### Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| gutter | Gutter: number, responsive object or [horizontal, vertical] | `RowGutter` | `0` |
| justify | Horizontal alignment | `start / center / end / space-around / space-between` | `start` |
| align | Vertical alignment | `start / center / end / stretch` | `start` |
| wrap | Wrap columns | `boolean` | `true` |
| div | Use Row and Col as plain divs without layout styles | `boolean` | `false` |

### Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |
| click | Native MouseEvent, emitted once per click |

### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Layout content |

### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

Wrapping examples compare wrapped and ordinary `div` modes. Ordinary mode removes Row layout and child Col spacing. Gap examples distinguish horizontal/vertical spacing. Row uses Flex, not CSS Grid.

## Responsiveness and accessibility

Breakpoints use the browser viewport: xs is the base; sm ≥576, md ≥768, lg ≥992, xl ≥1200 and xxl ≥1600px. Configured values resolve downward from the largest matching breakpoint. SSR starts with xs and responds to the viewport after mounting. Grid collapsing and dynamic ordering are calculated after mounting. These layout containers add no keyboard shortcuts; callers supply content semantics and focusable elements. There are no public methods or dedicated theme tokens.

## Imports

Grid contains only Grid.Item. Row and Col are independent components with their own source, styles, navigation, documentation and demos. Grid.Row/Grid.Col, Row/Col re-exports from Grid and GridRowInstance/GridColInstance are removed. Import them from the library root or separate row/col entries. Installing Grid no longer registers Row/Col automatically.

# Scheduler

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Reading direction

Scheduler inherits `dir` from the page, a local container, or ConfigProvider. Use the documentation navigation switch to change LTR/RTL at runtime. Month/week/resource columns and horizontal time follow inline start; vertical time continues downwards. Switching direction preserves dates, event data, selection and the horizontal reading offset, and cancels active drag or resize gestures.

Hourly resource timelines support moving events and resizing both start and end, respecting `snapDuration`, readonly state, milestones and event `resizable`. Zoom preserves the date at the center of the visible time area. Resource labels stick to inline start; virtual rows and their heading scroll together.

Default overlap layouts use inline start. A custom `eventLayout` return value keeps the physical meaning of `left`; callers control that geometry. RTL does not reverse dates, time zones, dependencies or source resource order.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Preview configuration: `default-date="2026-09-09"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { SchedulerEvent } from '@cedar-design/ui'
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  { id: 'meeting', title: '项目同步', start: '2026-09-09T09:00:00', end: '2026-09-09T10:00:00' },
])
</script>
<template>
  <c-scheduler v-model="events" default-date="2026-09-09" />
</template>
```

## Views and layout

### Layout Groups

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default-date` | Initial navigation date | Layout Groups, Without Resources, Resource Week |
| `default-mode` | Default uncontrolled view | Layout Groups, Timeline, Hidden Days |
| `resources` | Currently visible resource rows/columns and local options; a complete directory is unnecessary | Resource Week, Timeline, Now Indicator |
| `start-hour` | Time-grid start hour, 0–23 | Layout Groups, Now Indicator, Stacked Events |
| `end-hour` | Time-grid end hour; greater than start and at most 24 | Layout Groups, Now Indicator, Stacked Events |
| `modes` | Views available for switching | Without Resources, Hidden Days, Now Indicator |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Preview configuration: `:default-date="today"`, `default-mode="day"`, `:event-layout="custom ? layout : 'stack'"`, `:show-sidebar="false"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/layout-groups.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >分组仅共享布局位置。业务关联保存在
      metadata，修改单块不会自动修改整组。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space>
      <c-checkbox v-model="grouped">连续日程组成布局组</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="custom">自定义横向留白</c-checkbox>
    </c-space>
    <c-scheduler
      v-model="displayEvents"
      :default-date="today"
      default-mode="day"
      :event-layout="custom ? layout : 'stack'"
      :show-sidebar="false"
      :start-hour="8"
      :end-hour="17"
    >
      <template #event="{ event }">
        <strong>{{ event.title }}</strong>
        <div v-if="event.metadata?.reference">
          关联：{{ event.metadata.reference }}
        </div>
      </template>
    </c-scheduler>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerEvent, SchedulerEventLayout } from "../core";
const today = new Date();
const grouped = ref(true);
const custom = ref(false);
const at = (hour: number) => {
  const date = new Date(today);
  date.setHours(hour, 0, 0, 0);
  return date;
};
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "a",
    title: "阶段一",
    start: at(9),
    end: at(11),
    metadata: { reference: "A" },
  },
  {
    id: "b",
    title: "阶段二",
    start: at(11),
    end: at(13),
    metadata: { reference: "A" },
  },
  { id: "c", title: "独立日程", start: at(10), end: at(12) },
  {
    id: "d",
    title: "间隔后的阶段",
    start: at(15),
    end: at(16),
    metadata: { reference: "A" },
  },
]);
// Only the application interprets metadata and chooses which blocks share layout.
const displayEvents = computed({
  get: () =>
    events.value.map((event) => ({
      ...event,
      layoutGroupId:
        grouped.value && typeof event.metadata?.reference === "string"
          ? event.metadata.reference
          : undefined,
    })),
  set: (value: SchedulerEvent[]) => {
    events.value = value;
  },
});
// Product-specific percentages stay in the demo. Fractions are relative to one date/resource column.
const layout: SchedulerEventLayout = ({ column, columns }) => {
  const left = (column * 0.9) / columns;
  return {
    left,
    width: Math.min(Math.max(0.45, 1 - 0.1 * columns), 0.9 - left),
  };
};
</script>
```

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default-date` | Initial navigation date | Resources, Resource Cross Groups, Resource Dimensions |
| `default-mode` | Default uncontrolled view | Resources, Resource Cross Groups, Resource Dimensions |

| `resource-filters` | Combined resource-dimension filters; supports v-model:resource-filters | Resource Cross Groups, Resource Dimensions, Virtual Resources |

### Assignment Load

Preview configuration: `default-date="2026-09-22"`, `default-mode="resource-timeline"`, `default-scale="hour"`, `:resources="resources"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/assignment-load.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >每条日程可配置资源占用量和角色。两条各占 0.5 的日程恰好占满容量
      1；尝试新增一条可验证阻止或提醒策略。详情中可直接修改分配信息，资源表头显示本日峰值负载。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space
      ><c-button @click="policy = {}">超载时阻止</c-button
      ><c-button @click="policy = { capacity: 'warn' }">超载时提醒</c-button
      ><c-button @click="add">新增 0.5 占用</c-button></c-space
    >
    <c-scheduler
      ref="scheduler"
      v-model="events"
      default-date="2026-09-22"
      default-mode="resource-timeline"
      default-scale="hour"
      :resources="resources"
      :rule-policy="policy"
      show-assignment-details
      show-resource-load
      history
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerInstance } from "../index";
import type { SchedulerEvent, SchedulerRulePolicy } from "../core";
const scheduler = ref<SchedulerInstance>();
const resources = [{ id: "device", label: "实验设备", capacity: 1 }];
const policy = ref<SchedulerRulePolicy>({});
let sequence = 2;
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>(
  [0, 1].map((i) => ({
    id: `load${i}`,
    title: `任务 ${i + 1}`,
    start: "2026-09-22T09:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-22T10:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["device"],
    resourceDetails: { device: { units: 0.5, role: i ? "协作" : "负责" } },
  })),
);
function add() {
  const id = sequence++;
  return scheduler.value?.change({
    type: "create",
    event: { ...events.value[0], id: `load${id}`, title: `任务 ${id + 1}` },
  });
}
</script>
```

## Working hours and capacity

### Recurring and date-specific working hours

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default-date` | Initial navigation date | Recurring and date-specific working hours, Maintenance, Resource Capacity |
| `default-mode` | Default uncontrolled view | Recurring and date-specific working hours, Maintenance, Resource Capacity |
| `resources` | Currently visible resource rows/columns and local options; a complete directory is unnecessary | Recurring and date-specific working hours, Maintenance, Resource Capacity |
| `resource-label` | Resource field name, such as equipment or meeting room | Recurring and date-specific working hours, Maintenance |
| `allow-overlap` | Allow overlapping times for the same resource | Recurring and date-specific working hours |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Compare recurring hours with date-specific overrides. Attempt creation or editing inside and outside available periods to inspect full-duration validation.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/working-hours-comparison.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
import type { SchedulerEvent } from "../core"
import type { SchedulerWorkingHours } from "../core"
import type { SchedulerDateWorkingHours } from "../core"
import { proxyRefs as demoProxyRefs } from 'vue'

const scene1 = demoProxyRefs((() => {

const rooms = [
  { id: "room-a", label: "会议室 A" },
  { id: "room-b", label: "会议室 B" },
];

const hours: SchedulerWorkingHours[] = [
  { daysOfWeek: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], startMinute: 540, endMinute: 720 },
  { daysOfWeek: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], startMinute: 780, endMinute: 1080 },
];

  {
    id: "meeting",

    start: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",

    resourceIds: ["room-a"],
  },
]);
return { rooms, hours, events }
})())

const scene2 = demoProxyRefs((() => {

const enabled = ref(true);

const resources = [
  { id: "lin", label: "小林" },
  { id: "chen", label: "小陈" },
  { id: "device", label: "设备" },
];

const hours = [
  { daysOfWeek: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], startMinute: 540, endMinute: 1080 },
];

const overrides: SchedulerDateWorkingHours[] = [
  { date: "2026-09-12", intervals: [{ startMinute: 540, endMinute: 720 }] },
  {
    date: "2026-09-12",
    resourceIds: ["lin"],
    intervals: [
      { startMinute: 600, endMinute: 720 },
      { startMinute: 780, endMinute: 900 },
    ],
  },
  { date: "2026-09-12", resourceIds: ["device"], intervals: [] },
  { date: "2026-09-30", intervals: [{ startMinute: 540, endMinute: 720 }] },
];

const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "makeup",
    title: "补班协作任务",
    start: "2026-09-12T10:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-12T11:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["lin", "chen"],
  },
]);
return { enabled, resources, hours, overrides, events }
})())
</script>

<template>
<div class="demo-comparison">
  <section class="demo-comparison-case demo-comparison-case--1" data-comparison-scene="working-hours">
    <h4><span lang="zh-CN">工作时间与维护时段</span><span lang="en-US">working hours</span></h4>
    <c-space direction="column" block>
        <c-alert
          >会议室工作日 09:00–12:00、13:00–18:00
          可预约。灰色时段包含午休和非工作时间；新建、拖动和编辑均会校验完整时长。</c-alert
        >

  <section class="demo-comparison-case demo-comparison-case--2" data-comparison-scene="date-working-hours">

          10:00–12:00、13:00–15:00；设备全天关闭。关闭开关后恢复周一至周五规则。已有任务保留，再次保存时重新校验。</c-alert
```

### Resource Capacity

Preview configuration: `:status="span.exceeded ? 'danger' : 'success'"`, `default-date="2026-09-15"`, `default-mode="resource-timeline"`, `default-scale="hour"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/resource-capacity.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >检测设备默认可并行处理 2 个任务。09:00–11:00 与 10:00–12:00 的两单已占满
      10:00–11:00；尝试追加第三单，或提高容量后重试。降低容量保留已有日程，并在下方标出超额时段。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="capacity = 1">容量设为 1</c-button>
      <c-button @click="capacity = 2">容量设为 2</c-button>
      <c-button @click="capacity = 3">容量设为 3</c-button>
      <c-button status="primary" @click="addThird">尝试追加第三单</c-button>
      <c-button @click="reset">重置容量示例</c-button>
      <c-tag>当前容量：{{ capacity }}</c-tag>
      <c-tag v-if="result">{{ result }}</c-tag>
    </c-space>
    <c-space direction="column" block>
      <c-tag
        v-for="span in load"
        :key="+span.start"
        :status="span.exceeded ? 'danger' : 'success'"
      >
        {{ format(span.start) }}–{{ format(span.end) }}：{{ span.load }}/{{
          span.capacity
        }}
        {{ span.exceeded ? "超出容量" : "容量内" }}
      </c-tag>
      <c-tag v-if="!load.length">当前可见范围没有占用</c-tag>
    </c-space>
    <c-scheduler
      key="resource-capacity"
      ref="scheduler"
      v-model="events"
      default-date="2026-09-15"
      default-mode="resource-timeline"
      default-scale="hour"
      :resources="resources"
      history
      @range-change="range = $event"
    >
      <template #resource-header="{ resource }">
        <c-space
          ><span>{{ resource?.label }}</span
          ><c-tag>容量 {{ resource?.capacity }}</c-tag></c-space
        >
      </template>
    </c-scheduler>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerInstance } from "../index";
import type { SchedulerEvent } from "../core";
import {
  getSchedulerResourceLoad,
  getSchedulerRange,
  schedulerDateKey,
} from "../core";
const scheduler = ref<SchedulerInstance>();
const capacity = ref(2);
const resources = computed(() => [
  { id: "lab", label: "检测设备", capacity: capacity.value },
]);
const initial: SchedulerEvent[] = [
  {
    id: "sample-a",
    title: "样品甲",
    start: "2026-09-15T09:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-15T11:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["lab"],
  },
  {
    id: "sample-b",
    title: "样品乙",
    start: "2026-09-15T10:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-15T12:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["lab"],
  },
];
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([...initial]);
const range = ref(getSchedulerRange("2026-09-15", "day"));
const load = computed(() =>
  getSchedulerResourceLoad(events.value, resources.value[0], range.value),
);
const result = ref("");
const format = (date: Date) =>
  `${schedulerDateKey(date)} ${String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
async function addThird() {
  if (events.value.some((event) => event.id === "sample-c")) {
    result.value = "第三单已存在，可撤销或重置后重试";
    return;
  }
  const saved = await scheduler.value?.change({
    type: "create",
    event: {
      id: "sample-c",
      title: "样品丙",
      start: "2026-09-15T10:30:00",
      end: "2026-09-15T11:00:00",
      resourceIds: ["lab"],
    },
  });
  result.value = saved ? "第三单已保存" : "第三单未保存：超出容量";
}
function reset() {
  events.value = [...initial];
  capacity.value = 2;
  result.value = "";
  scheduler.value?.goToDate(new Date(2026, 8, 15));
}
</script>
```

## Recurrence and calendars

### Recurring Events

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default-mode` | Default uncontrolled view | Recurring Events, Calendar Recurrence, Business Calendar |
| `default-date` | Initial navigation date | Recurring Events, Business Calendar, Recurrence Following |
| `model-value` | Schedule data; supports v-model and becomes controlled when provided | Calendar Recurrence, Recurrence Following, Zoned Recurrence |
| `readonly` | Viewing/navigation allowed, editing blocked | Calendar Recurrence, Recurrence Following, Zoned Recurrence |
| `resources` | Currently visible resource rows/columns and local options; a complete directory is unnecessary | Recurring Events |
| `date` | Navigation date; supports v-model:date | Calendar Recurrence |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Preview configuration: `:options="frequencies"`, `aria-label="重复频率"`, `:min="1"`, `:max="12"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/recurring-events.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >重复会议按可见范围展开。编辑、拖动或删除卡片只影响这一次；新建日程是独立安排。修改上方规则会重建系列并清除本例中的例外。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-select
        v-model="frequency"
        :options="frequencies"
        aria-label="重复频率"
      />
      <c-input-number
        v-model="interval"
        :min="1"
        :max="12"
        aria-label="重复间隔"
      />
      <c-tag>{{
        frequency === "daily" ? "天一次" : "周一次（周一、三、五）"
      }}</c-tag>
      <c-input-number
        v-model="count"
        :min="1"
        :max="60"
        aria-label="重复次数"
      />
      <c-tag>次后结束</c-tag>
      <c-button :disabled="!exceptions.length" @click="exceptions = []"
        >恢复全部例外</c-button
      >
    </c-space>
    <c-tag
      >{{ exceptions.length }} 条本次例外 ·
      {{ standalone.length }} 条独立安排</c-tag
    >
    <c-scheduler
      v-model="events"
      default-date="2026-09-09"
      default-mode="week"
      :resources="resources"
      :before-transaction="validateChange"
      @range-change="range = $event"
    >
      <template #event="{ event }">
        {{ event.title }}
        <c-tag v-if="occurrenceIds.has(event.id)" size="small"
          >重复 · 仅本次</c-tag
        >
      </template>
    </c-scheduler>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from "vue";
import {
  SchedulerError,
  applySchedulerChange,
  diffSchedulerEvents,
  expandSchedulerRecurrences,
  getSchedulerRange,
  setSchedulerRecurrenceException,
} from "../core";
import type {
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerRecurrenceException,
  SchedulerRecurrenceRule,
  SchedulerRecurringEvent,
} from "../core";
import type { SchedulerBeforeTransaction } from "../props";
const validateChange: SchedulerBeforeTransaction = ({ changes }) => {
  if (
    changes.some(
      (change) =>
        occurrenceIds.value.has(change.event.id) &&
        change.type !== "remove" &&
        change.event.start == null,
    )
  ) {
    throw new SchedulerError(
      "invalid-event",
      "重复实例必须保留排期；取消本次请使用删除",
    );
  }
};
const frequencies = [
  { label: "每天", value: "daily" },
  { label: "每周", value: "weekly" },
];
const frequency = ref<SchedulerRecurrenceRule["frequency"]>("weekly");
const interval = ref(1);
const count = ref(12);
const range = ref(getSchedulerRange("2026-09-09", "week"));
const resources = [
  { id: "design", label: "林夏 · 设计" },
  { id: "dev", label: "陈舟 · 前端" },
];
const exceptions = ref<SchedulerRecurrenceException[]>([]);
const standalone = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([]);
const series = computed<SchedulerRecurringEvent[]>(() => [
  {
    event: {
      id: "weekly-review",
      title: "项目同步会",
      start: "2026-09-07T09:00:00",
      end: "2026-09-07T10:00:00",
      resourceIds: ["design", "dev"],
    },
    rule: {
      frequency: frequency.value,
      interval: interval.value || 1,
      count: count.value || 1,
      daysOfWeek: frequency.value === "weekly" ? [1, 3, 5] : undefined,
    },
  },
]);
watch([frequency, interval, count], () => {
  exceptions.value = [];
});
const occurrences = computed(() =>
  expandSchedulerRecurrences(series.value, range.value, {
    exceptions: exceptions.value,
  }),
);
const occurrenceIds = computed(
  () => new Set(occurrences.value.map((event) => event.id)),
);
const events = computed<SchedulerEvent[]>({
  get: () => [...occurrences.value, ...standalone.value],
  set: (next) => {
    const previous = [...occurrences.value, ...standalone.value];
    const originals = new Map(
      occurrences.value.map((event) => [event.id, event]),
    );
    let nextExceptions = exceptions.value;
    let nextStandalone = standalone.value;
    for (const change of diffSchedulerEvents(previous, next)) {
      const original = originals.get(change.event.id);
      if (original)
        nextExceptions = setSchedulerRecurrenceException(
          nextExceptions,
          original,
          change.type === "remove" ? undefined : change.event,
        );
      else nextStandalone = applySchedulerChange(nextStandalone, change);
    }
    // A real backend saves these series/exception records atomically, not expanded instances.
    exceptions.value = nextExceptions;
    standalone.value = nextStandalone;
  },
});
</script>
```

### Calendar Recurrence

- `readonly`: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/calendar-recurrence.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >按月、按年安排任务。无效日期可选择跳过或落到月底；“最后一个工作日”仅按周一至周五计算，不包含节假日调休。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space direction="column" align="stretch" wrap>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="月年重复规则">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="preset"
          aria-label="月年重复规则"
          :options="presets"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-input-number
        v-model="interval"
        :min="1"
        :max="12"
        aria-label="月年重复间隔"
      />
      <c-tag>{{ preset === "leap" ? "年一次" : "个月一次" }}</c-tag>
      <c-input-number
        v-model="count"
        :min="1"
        :max="10"
        aria-label="月年重复次数"
      />
      <c-tag>次后结束</c-tag>
      <c-checkbox
        v-if="preset === 'day31' || preset === 'leap'"
        v-model="lastDay"
        >缺少该日期时落到月底</c-checkbox
      >
    </c-space>
    <c-tag>未来 40 年内的前 {{ preview.length }} 次安排（点日期定位）</c-tag>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button
        v-for="item in preview"
        :key="item.id"
        @click="date = schedulerDate(item.start!)"
        >{{ schedulerDateKey(item.start!) }}</c-button
      >
    </c-space>
    <c-scheduler
      key="calendar-recurrence-preview"
      v-model:date="date"
      :model-value="events"
      default-mode="month"
      readonly
      @range-change="range = $event"
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from "vue";
import {
  expandSchedulerRecurrences,
  getSchedulerRange,
  schedulerDate,
  schedulerDateKey,
} from "../core";
import type { SchedulerDate, SchedulerRecurringEvent } from "../core";
const preset = ref("day31");
const interval = ref(1);
const count = ref(6);
const lastDay = ref(false);
const presets = [
  { label: "每月 31 日", value: "day31" },
  { label: "每月最后一个工作日", value: "weekday" },
  { label: "每月第二个星期一", value: "monday" },
  { label: "每年 2 月 29 日", value: "leap" },
];
const date = ref<SchedulerDate>("2026-01-31");
const range = ref(getSchedulerRange(date.value, "month"));
watch(preset, () => {
  date.value = preset.value === "leap" ? "2024-02-29" : "2026-01-01";
});
const series = computed<SchedulerRecurringEvent[]>(() => {
  const start =
    preset.value === "leap"
      ? "2024-02-29"
      : preset.value === "day31"
        ? "2026-01-31"
        : "2026-01-01";
  return [
    {
      event: {
        id: "calendar-plan",
        title: presets.find((item) => item.value === preset.value)!.label,
        start: `${start}T09:00:00`,
        end: `${start}T10:00:00`,
      },
      rule: {
        frequency: preset.value === "leap" ? "yearly" : "monthly",
        interval: interval.value || 1,
        count: count.value || 1,
        ...(preset.value === "weekday"
          ? { weekOfMonth: -1, daysOfWeek: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] }
          : preset.value === "monday"
            ? { weekOfMonth: 2, daysOfWeek: [1] }
            : {
                overflow: lastDay.value
                  ? ("last-day" as const)
                  : ("skip" as const),
              }),
      },
    },
  ];
});
const events = computed(() =>
  expandSchedulerRecurrences(series.value, range.value),
);
const preview = computed(() => {
  const start = schedulerDate(series.value[0].event.start!);
  const end = new Date(start);
  end.setFullYear(end.getFullYear() + 40);
  return expandSchedulerRecurrences(series.value, { start, end }).slice(0, 10);
});
</script>
```

### Business Calendar

Preview configuration: `default-date="2026-02-26"`, `default-mode="week"`, `:working-hours="hours"`, `:disabled-ranges="blocked"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/business-calendar.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >以下日期均为模拟企业日历，不是官方放假通知。示例包含模拟春节休假、周末补班和月末企业休假；同一配置用于月末工作日计算和预约校验。</c-alert
    >
    <c-checkbox v-model="enabled">启用模拟休假与补班</c-checkbox>
    <c-space wrap
      ><c-tag v-for="item in settlements" :key="item.id"
        >结算日：{{ schedulerDateKey(item.start!) }}</c-tag
      ></c-space
    >
    <c-tag
      >2 月 27 日企业休假、28
      日周六补班。可尝试新增或移动任务，对比开关前后的保存结果。</c-tag
    >
    <c-scheduler
      key="business-calendar-bookings"
      v-model="bookings"
      default-date="2026-02-26"
      default-mode="week"
      :working-hours="hours"
      :disabled-ranges="blocked"
      :before-transaction="validateCalendar"
      @range-change="range = $event"
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import {
  expandSchedulerRecurrences,
  getSchedulerAvailabilityIssues,
  getSchedulerRange,
  schedulerDate,
  schedulerDateKey,
  SchedulerError,
} from "../core";
import { getSchedulerCalendarDisabledRanges } from "../core/business-calendar";
import type { SchedulerBusinessCalendar, SchedulerEvent } from "../core";
import type { SchedulerBeforeTransaction } from "../props";
const enabled = ref(true);
const range = ref(getSchedulerRange("2026-02-26", "week"));
const overrides: NonNullable<SchedulerBusinessCalendar["overrides"]> = [
  ...[16, 17, 18, 19, 20].map((day) => ({
    date: `2026-02-${day}`,
    working: false,
    label: "模拟春节休假",
  })),
  { date: "2026-02-14", working: true, label: "模拟补班" },
  { date: "2026-02-27", working: false, label: "企业休假" },
  { date: "2026-02-28", working: true, label: "模拟补班" },
];
const calendar = computed<SchedulerBusinessCalendar>(() => ({
  overrides: enabled.value ? overrides : [],
}));
// Calendar decides which dates work; hours separately decide when those dates work.
const hours = [
  { daysOfWeek: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], startMinute: 540, endMinute: 1080 },
];
const blocked = computed(() =>
  getSchedulerCalendarDisabledRanges(calendar.value, range.value),
);
const bookings = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "regular-job",
    title: "常规工作日任务",
    start: "2026-02-26T10:00:00",
    end: "2026-02-26T11:00:00",
  },
]);
const settlements = computed(() =>
  expandSchedulerRecurrences(
    [
      {
        event: {
          id: "settlement",
          title: "月末结算",
          start: "2026-02-01T09:00:00",
          end: "2026-02-01T10:00:00",
        },
        rule: {
          frequency: "monthly",
          weekOfMonth: -1,
          businessCalendar: calendar.value,
          count: 3,
        },
      },
    ],
    { start: new Date(2026, 1, 1), end: new Date(2026, 4, 1) },
  ),
);
const validateCalendar: SchedulerBeforeTransaction = ({ changes }) => {
  for (const change of changes) {
    if (
      change.type === "remove" ||
      change.event.start == null ||
      change.event.end == null
    )
      continue;
    // Editor changes can extend outside the visible window: validate the full proposal.
    const disabledRanges = getSchedulerCalendarDisabledRanges(calendar.value, {
      start: schedulerDate(change.event.start),
      end: schedulerDate(change.event.end),
    });
    const issues = getSchedulerAvailabilityIssues(change.event, {
      disabledRanges,
    });
    if (issues.length)
      throw new SchedulerError("unavailable", "日程包含非工作日", issues);
  }
};
</script>
```

### Recurrence Following

- `readonly`: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/recurrence-following.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >点击会议选择“仅本次”或“本次及以后”。周五预设了一条“客户参会”例外：默认保护它，明确选择清除后才允许拆分。修改日期时需保留原规则的星期。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="reset">重置示例</c-button>
      <c-checkbox v-model="reject">模拟保存失败</c-checkbox>
      <c-tag
        >{{ state.series.length }} 个系列 ·
        {{ state.exceptions.length }} 条例外</c-tag
      >
    </c-space>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-tag v-for="item in state.series" :key="item.event.id"
        >{{ item.event.title }} · {{ item.rule.count ?? "不限" }} 次</c-tag
      >
    </c-space>
    <c-tag>{{ status }}</c-tag>
    <c-scheduler
      key="recurrence-following-calendar"
      :model-value="events"
      default-date="2026-09-09"
      default-mode="week"
      readonly
      :editable="false"
      @range-change="range = $event"
      @event-click="openEditor"
    />
    <c-dialog v-model:open="open" title="调整重复安排" :footer="false">
      <c-form
        v-if="draft"
        :model="draft"
        layout="vertical"
        @submit="save(false)"
      >
        <c-form-item label="修改范围">
          <c-select v-model="scope" :options="scopes" aria-label="修改范围" />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item v-if="scope === 'following'" label="后续例外">
          <c-select
            v-model="policy"
            :options="policies"
            aria-label="后续例外处理"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="会议标题"
          ><c-input v-model="draft.title" aria-label="会议标题"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="开始时间"
          ><c-date
            v-model="draft.start"
            show-time
            value-format="Date"
            aria-label="会议开始"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="结束时间"
          ><c-date
            v-model="draft.end"
            show-time
            value-format="Date"
            aria-label="会议结束"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-alert v-if="error" status="danger">{{ error }}</c-alert>
        <c-space wrap>
          <c-button status="primary" @click="save(false)">保存修改</c-button>
          <c-button @click="save(true)">取消所选安排</c-button>
          <c-button @click="open = false">返回</c-button>
        </c-space>
      </c-form>
    </c-dialog>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, shallowRef } from "vue";
import {
  cloneSchedulerEvent,
  expandSchedulerRecurrences,
  getSchedulerRange,
  schedulerDate,
  setSchedulerRecurrenceException,
  splitSchedulerRecurrence,
} from "../core";
import type {
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerOccurrence,
  SchedulerRecurringEvent,
  SchedulerRecurrenceException,
} from "../core";
const range = ref(getSchedulerRange("2026-09-09", "week"));
function initialState(): {
  series: SchedulerRecurringEvent[];
  exceptions: SchedulerRecurrenceException[];
} {
  const series: SchedulerRecurringEvent[] = [
    {
      event: {
        id: "team-sync",
        title: "团队同步会",
        start: "2026-09-07T09:00:00",
        end: "2026-09-07T10:00:00",
      },
      rule: { frequency: "weekly", daysOfWeek: [1, 3, 5], count: 9 },
    },
  ];
  const friday = expandSchedulerRecurrences(
    series,
    getSchedulerRange("2026-09-09", "week"),
  )[2];
  return {
    series,
    exceptions: setSchedulerRecurrenceException([], friday, {
      ...friday,
      title: "客户参会",
    }),
  };
}
const state = shallowRef(initialState());
const events = computed(() =>
  expandSchedulerRecurrences(state.value.series, range.value, {
    exceptions: state.value.exceptions,
  }),
);
const open = ref(false);
const reject = ref(false);
const scope = ref<"single" | "following">("single");
const policy = ref<"reject" | "discard">("reject");
const scopes = [
  { label: "仅本次", value: "single" },
  { label: "本次及以后", value: "following" },
];
const policies = [
  { label: "保护已有例外", value: "reject" },
  { label: "清除后续例外", value: "discard" },
];
const selected = shallowRef<SchedulerOccurrence>();
const draft = ref<{ title: string; start: Date; end: Date }>();
const error = ref("");
const status = ref("点击日程调整安排");
let baseline = state.value;
let nextId = 0;
function openEditor(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  const occurrence = events.value.find((item) => item.id === event.id);
  if (!occurrence) return;
  selected.value = { ...occurrence };
  draft.value = {
    title: occurrence.title,
    start: schedulerDate(occurrence.start!),
    end: schedulerDate(occurrence.end!),
  };
  scope.value = "single";
  policy.value = "reject";
  error.value = "";
  baseline = state.value;
  open.value = true;
}
function save(remove: boolean) {
  if (!selected.value || !draft.value) return;
  error.value = "";
  try {
    if (state.value !== baseline)
      throw new Error("安排已变化，请关闭后重新打开。");
    const replacement = {
      ...cloneSchedulerEvent(selected.value),
      ...draft.value,
    };
    let proposal: typeof state.value;
    let discarded = 0;
    if (scope.value === "following") {
      const affected = state.value.exceptions.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.seriesId === selected.value!.seriesId &&
          +schedulerDate(item.originalStart) >=
            +schedulerDate(selected.value!.originalStart),
      );
      if (affected.length && policy.value === "reject")
        throw new Error(
          `后续有 ${affected.length} 条例外，请选择清除后续例外或仅修改本次。`,
        );
      const result = splitSchedulerRecurrence(
        state.value.series,
        state.value.exceptions,
        selected.value,
        {
          nextEvent: remove
            ? undefined
            : { ...replacement, id: `team-sync-part-${nextId + 1}` },
          exceptionPolicy: policy.value,
        },
      );
      proposal = { series: result.series, exceptions: result.exceptions };
      discarded = result.removedExceptions.length;
    } else
      proposal = {
        series: state.value.series,
        exceptions: setSchedulerRecurrenceException(
          state.value.exceptions,
          selected.value,
          remove ? undefined : replacement,
        ),
      };
    // Save this complete canonical proposal atomically before publishing the projection.
    if (reject.value) throw new Error("模拟保存失败，原系列和例外均保留。");
    state.value = proposal;
    nextId++;
    status.value = `${remove ? "已取消" : "已修改"}${scope.value === "following" ? "本次及以后" : "本次"}；清除 ${discarded} 条后续例外`;
    open.value = false;
  } catch (cause) {
    error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "保存失败";
  }
}
function reset() {
  state.value = initialState();
  open.value = false;
  status.value = "点击日程调整安排";
  reject.value = false;
}
</script>
```

## Editing and interaction

### Drag Feedback

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default-date` | Initial navigation date | Drag Feedback, Duplicate Events, Custom Cards |
| `default-mode` | Default uncontrolled view | Drag Feedback, Duplicate Events, Custom Event |
| `resources` | Currently visible resource rows/columns and local options; a complete directory is unnecessary | Drag Feedback, Duplicate Events, Custom Cards |
| `before-change` | Return false to cancel; supports asynchronous interception and save APIs | Custom Event, Custom Editor, External Editor |
| `resource-label` | Resource field name, such as equipment or meeting room | Drag Feedback |
| `start-hour` | Time-grid start hour, 0–23 | Drag Feedback |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

### Custom Event

Preview configuration: `default-date="2026-09-09"`, `default-mode="week"`, `:resources="resources"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/custom-event.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-alert>
    这里的工作、会议、休息和不可用时段都是 Demo 自己定义的业务类型，并非
    Scheduler
    内置枚举。新增时可选择类型，由业务配置映射标题建议、外观和默认权限。
  </c-alert>
  <c-space>
    <c-checkbox v-model="rejectSave">模拟后端保存失败</c-checkbox>
    <span>{{ requestStatus }}</span>
  </c-space>

        readonly,
        pending,
        errorMessage,
      }"

          >

            </c-option>

          <strong>{{ typeOf(event).label }}</strong>
          <span>{{ typeOf(event).description }}</span>
        </div>

        <c-form-item label="标题">
          <c-input
            v-model="event.title"
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            placeholder="请输入日程标题"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="开始时间">
          <c-date
            :model-value="
              event.start == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(event.start)
            "
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            show-time
            value-format="Date"
            @update:model-value="event.start = $event"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="结束时间">
          <c-date
            :model-value="
              event.end == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(event.end)
            "
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            show-time
            value-format="Date"
            @update:model-value="event.end = $event"
          />
        </c-form-item>
        <c-form-item>
          <c-checkbox
            :model-value="!event.readonly"
            :disabled="readonly || pending"
            @update:model-value="event.readonly = !$event"
          >
            创建后允许修改和拖拽
          </c-checkbox>
        </c-form-item>
        <c-space>
          <c-button :disabled="pending" @click="close">取消</c-button>
          <c-button
            v-if="action === 'edit' && !readonly"
            status="danger"
            :disabled="pending"
            @click="remove"
            >删除</c-button
          >
          <c-button
            v-if="!readonly"
            html-type="submit"
            status="primary"
            :loading="pending"
            >保存日程</c-button
          >
        </c-space>
      </c-form>
    </template>
  </c-scheduler>
  </c-loading>
  <c-collapse class="scheduler-mock-log">
    <c-collapse-item name="request" title="查看最近一次 Mock API 请求">
      <pre>{{ lastRequest || "尚未提交" }}</pre>
    </c-collapse-item>
  </c-collapse>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from "vue";
import { resources } from "./data";
import { cloneSchedulerEvent, schedulerDate } from "../core";
import type {
  SchedulerBeforeChange,
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerEventBackgroundPattern,
} from "../index";

type EventType = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  title: string;
  color: string;
  backgroundColor: string;
  backgroundPattern: SchedulerEventBackgroundPattern;
  readonly: boolean;
};

const eventTypes: EventType[] = [
  {
    id: "work",
    label: "工作安排",
    description: "普通任务，可继续编辑和拖拽调整时间。",
    title: "工作安排",
    color: "#1677ff",
    backgroundColor: "#e6f4ff",
    backgroundPattern: "solid",
    readonly: false,
  },
  {
    id: "meeting",
    label: "会议",
    description: "用圆点背景区分协作和沟通类日程。",
    title: "会议",
    color: "#d48806",
    backgroundColor: "#fffbe6",
    backgroundPattern: "dots",
    readonly: false,
  },
  {
    id: "rest",
    label: "休息",
    description: "休息时段默认锁定，保存后不允许修改或拖拽。",
    title: "休息",
    color: "#00a854",
    backgroundColor: "#f0fff4",
    backgroundPattern: "diagonal-stripes",
    readonly: true,
  },
  {
    id: "blocked",
    label: "不可用时段",
    description: "用于停机、封场等占用，默认只读。",
    title: "不可用时段",
    color: "#722ed1",
    backgroundColor: "#f9f0ff",
    backgroundPattern: "crosshatch",
    readonly: true,
  },
];

const seedEvents: SchedulerEvent[] = [
  createEvent("work", "work-1", "需求评审", "09:00", "10:30"),
  createEvent("meeting", "meeting-1", "项目周会", "10:00", "11:30"),
  createEvent("rest", "rest-1", "张志强 休息", "13:00", "15:00"),
  createEvent("blocked", "blocked-1", "会议室维护", "15:30", "17:30"),
];
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([]);
const loading = ref(true);
const rejectSave = ref(false);
const requestStatus = ref("正在从 Mock API 加载…");
const lastRequest = ref("");
let mockDatabase = seedEvents.map(cloneSchedulerEvent);

const wait = (milliseconds: number) =>
  new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds));
const mockApi = {
  async list() {
    await wait(300);
    return mockDatabase.map(cloneSchedulerEvent);
  },
  async save(next: SchedulerEvent[]) {
    await wait(500);
    if (rejectSave.value) throw new Error("Mock API：保存被拒绝");
    mockDatabase = next.map(cloneSchedulerEvent);
    return {
      revision: Date.now(),
      events: mockDatabase.map(cloneSchedulerEvent),
    };
  },
};

onMounted(async () => {
  events.value = await mockApi.list();
  loading.value = false;
  requestStatus.value = `已加载 ${events.value.length} 条日程`;
});

const saveToMockServer: SchedulerBeforeChange = async (context) => {
  lastRequest.value = JSON.stringify(
    {
      method: "PUT",
      url: "/api/scheduler/events",
      change: context.type,
      event: context.event,
      events: context.value,
    },
    null,
    2,
  );
  requestStatus.value = "正在提交 metadata 和日程数据…";
  try {
    const response = await mockApi.save(context.value);
    requestStatus.value = `保存成功 · revision ${response.revision}`;
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    requestStatus.value = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "保存失败";
    throw error;
  }
};

function createEvent(
  typeId: string,
  id: string,
  title: string,
  start: string,
  end: string,
): SchedulerEvent {
  const event: SchedulerEvent = {
    id,
    title,
    start: `2026-09-09T${start}:00`,
    end: `2026-09-09T${end}:00`,
    resourceIds: [],
  };
  applyType(event, typeId, false);
  return event;
}

function typeOf(event: SchedulerEvent): EventType {
  return (
    eventTypes.find((type) => type.id === event.metadata?.typeId) ??
    eventTypes[0]
  );
}

function applyType(event: SchedulerEvent, value: unknown, suggestTitle = true) {
  const previous = typeOf(event);
  const type = eventTypes.find((item) => item.id === value) ?? eventTypes[0];
  const replaceTitle =
    suggestTitle && (!event.title.trim() || event.title === previous.title);
  event.color = type.color;
  event.backgroundColor = type.backgroundColor;
  event.backgroundPattern = type.backgroundPattern;
  event.metadata = { ...event.metadata, typeId: type.id };
  event.readonly = type.readonly;
  if (replaceTitle) event.title = type.title;
}

function prepareAndSave(
  event: SchedulerEvent,
  save: (event?: SchedulerEvent) => void,
) {
  const type = typeOf(event);
  event.color ??= type.color;
  event.backgroundColor ??= type.backgroundColor;
  event.backgroundPattern ??= type.backgroundPattern;
  event.metadata = {
    ...event.metadata,
    typeId: type.id,
    clientRequestId: `demo-${Date.now()}`,
  };
  save(event);
}

function previewStyle(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  const color = event.color ?? "#1677ff";
  const background = event.backgroundColor ?? "#e6f4ff";
  const pattern = event.backgroundPattern;
  const images: Record<SchedulerEventBackgroundPattern, string> = {
    solid: `linear-gradient(${background}, ${background})`,
    "diagonal-stripes": `repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 8px, color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 18%, transparent) 8px 16px)`,
    dots: `radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 28%, transparent) 1.5px, transparent 1.5px)`,
    crosshatch: `repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 0 9px, color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 14%, transparent) 9px 11px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent 0 9px, color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 14%, transparent) 9px 11px)`,
  };
  return {
    color,
    backgroundColor: background,
    backgroundImage: images[pattern ?? "solid"],
    backgroundSize: pattern === "dots" ? "10px 10px" : undefined,
    borderColor: color,
  };
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.scheduler-type-preview {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.scheduler-type-preview span {
  font-size: 12px;
  opacity: 0.75;
}

.scheduler-mock-log {
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.scheduler-mock-log pre {
  max-height: 260px;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--c-color-fill-1);
  font-size: 12px;
}
</style>
```
