### External Editor

Preview configuration: `:editable="false"`, `default-date="2026-09-09"`, `default-mode="day"`, `:before-change="beforeChange"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/external-editor.vue

```vue
<template>
  <p>
    关闭内置编辑器，统一接收工具栏、日期格、卡片拖入及已有日程请求，使用独立
    Dialog。取消不写入，保存失败保留表单。
  </p>
  <c-checkbox v-model="reject">下一次模拟接口提交失败</c-checkbox>
  <c-scheduler
    ref="scheduler"
    v-model="events"
    :editable="false"
    default-date="2026-09-09"
    default-mode="day"
    :before-change="beforeChange"
    @editor-request="openEditor"
    @change-error="showError"
  >
    <template #sidebar-extra="{ startDrag, cancelDrag, disabled }">
      <c-button
        :draggable="!disabled"
        :disabled="disabled"
        @dragstart="startDrag(card, $event)"
        @dragend="cancelDrag"
        >拖入：现场检查 · 60 分钟</c-button
      >
    </template>
  </c-scheduler>
  <c-dialog
    v-model:open="open"
    :title="request?.action === 'create' ? '业务新增窗口' : '业务详情窗口'"
    :footer="false"
    :closable="!saving"
    :overlay-closable="!saving"
    :esc-to-close="!saving"
  >
    <template v-if="draft">
      <p>请求来源：{{ request?.source }}；业务页面也可接收相同请求。</p>
      <c-alert v-if="errorMessage" status="danger">{{ errorMessage }}</c-alert>
      <c-form :model="draft" layout="vertical" @submit="submit()">
        <c-form-item label="任务名称"
          ><c-input
            v-model="draft.title"
            :disabled="request?.readonly || saving"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="开始"
          ><c-date
            :model-value="draft.start == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(draft.start)"
            @update:model-value="draft.start = $event"
            :show-time="!draft.allDay"
            value-format="Date"
            :disabled="request?.readonly || saving"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="结束（不含）"
          ><c-date
            :model-value="draft.end == null ? undefined : schedulerDate(draft.end)"
            @update:model-value="draft.end = $event"
            :show-time="!draft.allDay"
            value-format="Date"
            :disabled="request?.readonly || saving"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-form-item label="工作说明"
          ><c-textarea
            v-model="draft.description"
            :disabled="request?.readonly || saving"
        /></c-form-item>
        <c-space>
          <c-button :disabled="saving" @click="open = false">取消</c-button>
          <c-button
            v-if="request?.action === 'edit' && !request.readonly"
            status="danger"
            :disabled="saving"
            @click="submit(true)"
            >删除</c-button
          >
          <c-button
            v-if="!request?.readonly"
            status="primary"
            html-type="submit"
            :loading="saving"
            >确认保存</c-button
          >
        </c-space>
      </c-form>
    </template>
  </c-dialog>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { cloneSchedulerEvent, schedulerDate } from "@cedar-design/ui/scheduler/core";
import type {
  SchedulerInstance,
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerEditorRequest,
  SchedulerEventTemplate,
  SchedulerBeforeChange,
} from "@cedar-design/ui";
const scheduler = ref<SchedulerInstance>();
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "inspection",
    title: "设备例行检查",
    start: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-09T11:00:00",
  },
]);
const card: SchedulerEventTemplate = {
  title: "现场检查",
  duration: 60,
  description: "核对运行参数",
};
const request = ref<SchedulerEditorRequest>();
const draft = ref<SchedulerEvent>();
const open = ref(false);
const saving = ref(false);
const reject = ref(false);
const errorMessage = ref("");
let snapshot: string | undefined;
function openEditor(value: SchedulerEditorRequest) {
  if (open.value || saving.value) return;
  request.value = value;
  draft.value = cloneSchedulerEvent(value.event);
  snapshot = JSON.stringify(
    events.value.find((item) => item.id === value.event.id),
  );
  errorMessage.value = "";
  open.value = true;
}
const beforeChange: SchedulerBeforeChange = async () => {
  if (reject.value) {
    reject.value = false;
    throw new Error("模拟接口提交失败，请保留草稿直接重试");
  }
  return true;
};
function showError(error: unknown) {
  errorMessage.value = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "保存失败";
}
async function submit(remove = false) {
  if (
    !draft.value ||
    !request.value ||
    request.value.readonly ||
    saving.value ||
    !scheduler.value
  )
    return;
  if (
    draft.value.id !== request.value.event.id ||
    JSON.stringify(events.value.find((item) => item.id === draft.value!.id)) !==
      snapshot
  ) {
    errorMessage.value = "原日程已变化，请关闭并重新打开。";
    return;
  }
  saving.value = true;
  errorMessage.value = "";
  try {
    const success = await scheduler.value.change({
      type: remove
        ? "remove"
        : request.value.action === "create"
          ? "create"
          : "update",
      event: cloneSchedulerEvent(draft.value),
    });
    if (success) open.value = false;
    else if (!errorMessage.value)
      errorMessage.value = "保存被取消或当前不可提交，请重试。";
  } finally {
    saving.value = false;
  }
}
</script>
```

### Atomic Swap

Preview configuration: `default-date="2026-09-09"`, `default-mode="resource-day"`, `:resources="[{ id: 'room', label: '会议室 A' }]"`, `:allow-overlap="false"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/atomic-swap.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >会议室禁止重叠。两条日程可以通过一次事务交换时间；整体校验最终结果，任一项失败都不会改变另一项。</c-alert
    >
    <c-button @click="swap">交换两个会议的时间</c-button>
    <c-scheduler
      ref="scheduler"
      v-model="events"
      default-date="2026-09-09"
      default-mode="resource-day"
      :resources="[{ id: 'room', label: '会议室 A' }]"
      :allow-overlap="false"
      history
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerEvent } from "../core";
import type { SchedulerInstance } from "../index";
const scheduler = ref<SchedulerInstance>();
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "a",
    title: "产品评审",
    start: "2026-09-09T09:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["room"],
  },
  {
    id: "b",
    title: "技术评审",
    start: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-09T11:00:00",
    resourceIds: ["room"],
  },
]);
async function swap() {
  const [a, b] = events.value;
  await scheduler.value?.transaction([
    { type: "move", event: { ...a, start: b.start, end: b.end } },
    { type: "move", event: { ...b, start: a.start, end: a.end } },
  ]);
}
</script>
```

## Async loading and saving

### Async Resources

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default-mode` | Default uncontrolled view | Async Resources, Remote Events, Async Change |
| `resources` | Currently visible resource rows/columns and local options; a complete directory is unnecessary | Async Resources, Async Change |
| `before-change` | Return false to cancel; supports asynchronous interception and save APIs | Async Resources, Async Change |
| `default-date` | Initial navigation date | Async Resources, Async Change |
| `resource-label` | Resource field name, such as equipment or meeting room | Async Resources |
| `request-resources` | Query resource candidates by keyword and cursor | Async Resources |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Preview configuration: `options`, `:resources="visibleResources"`, `:resource-label="kind === 'device' ? '设备' : '人员'"`, `:request-resources="requestResources"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/async-resources.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch" wrap>
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" hide-label>
      <c-select
        v-model="kind"
        :options="[
          { value: 'device', label: '设备接口' },
          { value: 'person', label: '人员接口' },
        ]"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-button @click="failNextSearch = true">下次搜索模拟失败</c-button>
    <c-button @click="retryHydration">模拟回显失败并重新加载</c-button>
    <c-button @click="useNextPage">切换可见资源页</c-button>
  </c-space>
  <p>
    当前仅提供 {{ visibleResources.length }} 条可见资源。已有日程关联第 12
    条，不在本页，仍通过 ID 接口回显名称。进入编辑器，搜索“12”或滚动加载更多。
  </p>
  <p role="status">{{ feedback }}</p>
  <c-scheduler
    :key="`${kind}-${revision}`"
    v-model="events"
    :resources="visibleResources"
    :resource-label="kind === 'device' ? '设备' : '人员'"
    :request-resources="requestResources"
    :resolve-resources="resolveResources"
    :before-change="beforeChange"
    default-mode="agenda"
    default-date="2026-09-09"
    @resource-error="resourceError"
  />
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onScopeDispose, ref, watch } from "vue";
import type {
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerRequestResources,
  SchedulerResolveResources,
  SchedulerBeforeChange,
  SchedulerResourceErrorContext,
} from "@cedar-design/ui";

const kind = ref<"device" | "person">("device");
// 业务接口字段在接入层适配，Scheduler 始终只认识 id / label。
const devices = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, index) => ({
  deviceId: `device-${index + 1}`,
  deviceName: `实验设备 ${index + 1}`,
}));
const people = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, index) => ({
  userId: `person-${index + 1}`,
  displayName: `工程师 ${index + 1}`,
}));
const directory = computed(() =>
  kind.value === "device"
    ? devices.map((item) => ({ id: item.deviceId, label: item.deviceName }))
    : people.map((item) => ({ id: item.userId, label: item.displayName })),
);
const page = ref(0);
const revision = ref(0);
const visibleResources = computed(() =>
  directory.value.slice(page.value * 4, page.value * 4 + 4),
);
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([]);
const feedback = ref("打开详情查看名称回显，或在资源下拉框搜索。");
const failNextSearch = ref(false);
const failNextResolve = ref(false);
const failedOperation = ref<"search" | "resolve">();
watch(
  kind,
  () => {
    failedOperation.value = undefined;
    feedback.value = "打开详情查看名称回显，或在资源下拉框搜索。";
    page.value = 0;
    events.value = [
      {
        id: `${kind.value}-job`,
        title: "已有排期：关联不在本页的资源",
        start: "2026-09-09T09:00:00",
        end: "2026-09-09T10:00:00",
        resourceIds: [`${kind.value}-12`],
      },
    ];
  },
  { immediate: true, flush: "sync" },
);

const lifetime = new AbortController();
onScopeDispose(() => lifetime.abort());
// 模拟接口延时；真实接入时直接 fetch(url, { signal })。
function delay(signal: AbortSignal) {
  return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    if (signal.aborted) {
      reject(new Error("Aborted"));
      return;
    }
    const abort = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
      reject(new Error("Aborted"));
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
      resolve();
    }, 500);
    signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
  });
}
const requestResources: SchedulerRequestResources = async ({
  query,
  cursor,
  signal,
}) => {
  const data = directory.value;
  const fail = failNextSearch.value;
  failNextSearch.value = false;
  await delay(signal);
  if (fail) throw new Error("模拟搜索网络错误");
  const matches = data.filter(
    (item) => item.label.includes(query) || item.id.includes(query),
  );
  const offset = Number(cursor ?? 0);
  if (failedOperation.value === "search") {
    failedOperation.value = undefined;
    feedback.value = "搜索重试成功，可继续选择资源。";
  }
  return {
    items: matches.slice(offset, offset + 4),
    nextCursor: offset + 4 < matches.length ? String(offset + 4) : undefined,
  };
};
const resolveResources: SchedulerResolveResources = async (ids, { signal }) => {
  const data = directory.value;
  const fail = failNextResolve.value;
  failNextResolve.value = false;
  await delay(signal);
  if (fail) throw new Error("模拟回显网络错误");
  if (failedOperation.value === "resolve") {
    failedOperation.value = undefined;
    feedback.value = "资源名称回显成功，关联 ID 保持不变。";
  }
  return data.filter((item) => ids.includes(item.id));
};
const beforeChange: SchedulerBeforeChange = async ({ event, type }) => {
  const data = directory.value;
  await delay(lifetime.signal);
  // 演示服务端校验；生产环境还应验证权限、版本和全量时段冲突。
  if (
    type !== "remove" &&
    event.resourceIds?.some((id) => !data.some((item) => item.id === id))
  )
    throw new Error("资源不存在");
  feedback.value = "模拟接口保存成功，日程只保存 resourceIds，不保存显示名称。";
};
function resourceError(
  _error: unknown,
  context: SchedulerResourceErrorContext,
) {
  failedOperation.value = context.type;
  feedback.value =
    context.type === "resolve"
      ? "回显失败：ID 仍保留，点击日程内的重试按钮。"
      : "搜索失败：可在下拉框内重试。";
}
function retryHydration() {
  failNextResolve.value = true;
  revision.value++;
}
function useNextPage() {
  page.value = (page.value + 1) % 6;
}
</script>
```

### Remote Events

- `readonly`: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/remote-events.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >翻页按可见范围请求；返回已访问日期命中 30
      秒缓存。可模拟失败后重试，也可连续切换日期，验证慢响应不会覆盖最新页面。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="refresh()">刷新 / 重试</c-button>
      <c-button @click="jump(1)">下一天</c-button>
      <c-button @click="jump(-1)">上一天</c-button>
      <c-checkbox v-model="fail">模拟加载失败</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="outOfOrder">模拟乱序响应</c-checkbox>
    </c-space>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-tag>请求 {{ requests }} 次</c-tag>
      <c-tag>{{
        loading
          ? "加载中"
          : error
            ? "加载失败，请重试"
            : `已加载 ${events.length} 项`
      }}</c-tag>
      <c-tag>{{ status }}</c-tag>
    </c-space>
    <c-scheduler
      v-model="events"
      v-model:date="date"
      default-mode="day"
      :readonly="loading || !!error"
      :before-transaction="persist"
      @range-change="range = $event"
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { useSchedulerDataSource } from "../use-data-source";
import {
  applySchedulerTransaction,
  cloneSchedulerEvent,
  isSchedulerEventInRange,
  schedulerDate,
} from "../core";
import type { SchedulerDate, SchedulerEvent, SchedulerRange } from "../core";
import type { SchedulerBeforeTransaction } from "../props";
const date = ref<SchedulerDate>("2026-09-09");
const range = ref<SchedulerRange>();
const fail = ref(false);
const outOfOrder = ref(false);
const requests = ref(0);
const status = ref("编辑日程会保存到模拟服务端");
let database: SchedulerEvent[] = Array.from({ length: 90 }, (_, index) => ({
  id: `remote-${index}`,
  title: `远程计划 ${index + 1}`,
  start: new Date(2026, 7, 15 + index, 9),
  end: new Date(2026, 7, 15 + index, 10),
}));
const { events, loading, error, refresh } = useSchedulerDataSource({
  range,
  requestEvents: async (query) => {
    const sequence = ++requests.value;
    const shouldFail = fail.value;
    const ignoreAbort = outOfOrder.value;
    const result = database
      .filter((event) => isSchedulerEventInRange(event, query))
      .map(cloneSchedulerEvent);
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const abort = () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        reject(new Error("Aborted"));
      };
      const timer = setTimeout(
        () => {
          query.signal.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
          resolve();
        },
        ignoreAbort ? (sequence % 2 ? 1800 : 200) : 450,
      );
      if (!ignoreAbort)
        query.signal.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
    });
    if (shouldFail) throw new Error("模拟接口失败");
    return result;
  },
});
function jump(offset: number) {
  const next = schedulerDate(date.value);
  next.setDate(next.getDate() + offset);
  date.value = next;
}
const persist: SchedulerBeforeTransaction = async (context) => {
  // Send the delta to the backend, never replace the full database with a loaded window.
  database = applySchedulerTransaction(database, context.changes);
  status.value = `已保存 ${context.changes.length} 项变更；查询缓存随 v-model 更新失效`;
};
</script>
```

### Async Change

Preview configuration: `:model-value="events"`, `default-date="2026-09-09"`, `default-mode="resource-day"`, `:resources="resources"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/async-change.vue

```vue
<template>
  <section class="scheduler-async-demo">
    <c-space direction="column" block>
      <c-space>
        <c-checkbox v-model="reject">下一次模拟保存失败</c-checkbox>
        <c-checkbox v-model="accept">父组件接受更新</c-checkbox>
        <c-button @click="reset">重置日程</c-button>
      </c-space>
      <p>
        本地模拟 600ms
        保存；失败开关在一次失败后自动复位，可直接重试。取消或父组件拒绝提案不改变已保存值。
      </p>
      <c-scheduler
        :model-value="events"
        default-date="2026-09-09"
        default-mode="resource-day"
        :resources="resources"
        :before-change="beforeChange"
        @update:model-value="update"
        @change="outcome = accept ? '父组件已接受' : '父组件未接受提案'"
        @change-error="outcome = '保存失败，原值不变'"
      />
      <p role="status">{{ outcome }}；活动请求：{{ pendingCount }}</p>
      <ul aria-label="异步已提交日程">
        <li v-for="event in events" :key="event.id" :data-demo-event="event.id">
          {{ event.title }}：{{ event.start ?? "未排期" }} →
          {{ event.end ?? "未排期" }}；资源：{{ event.resourceIds?.join(",") }}
        </li>
      </ul>
    </c-space>
  </section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from "vue";
import type { SchedulerBeforeChange } from "../props";
import type { SchedulerEvent } from "../core";
import { createEvents, resources } from "./data";
const events = ref(createEvents());
const reject = ref(false);
const accept = ref(true);
const outcome = ref("尚未操作");
const pendingCount = ref(0);
const pending = new Map<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>, () => void>();
const beforeChange: SchedulerBeforeChange = () =>
  new Promise<boolean>((resolve, rejectRequest) => {
    const fail = reject.value;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      pending.delete(timer);
      pendingCount.value = pending.size;
      if (fail) {
        reject.value = false;
        rejectRequest(new Error("模拟接口失败"));
      } else resolve(true);
    }, 600);
    pending.set(timer, () => resolve(false));
    pendingCount.value = pending.size;
  });
function update(value: SchedulerEvent[]) {
  if (accept.value) events.value = value;
}
function cancelPending() {
  pending.forEach((cancel, timer) => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    cancel();
  });
  pending.clear();
  pendingCount.value = 0;
}
function reset() {
  cancelPending();
  events.value = createEvents();
  outcome.value = "已重置";
}
onBeforeUnmount(cancelPending);
onDeactivated(cancelPending);
</script>
```

### Calendar Integration

Preview configuration: `placeholder="ICS 文本"`, `:rows="4"`, `default-date="2026-09-22"`, `default-mode="week"`.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/calendar-integration.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" block>
    <c-alert
      >模拟服务端持有版本号：编辑保存延迟
      300ms，期间模拟远端更新会触发过期保护。导入/导出使用真实 ICS
      文本；打印生成独立文档，不打印整页组件文档。</c-alert
    >
    <c-space
      ><c-button @click="remote">模拟远端更新</c-button
      ><c-button @click="exportIcs">导出 ICS 文本</c-button
      ><c-button @click="importIcs">导入 ICS 文本</c-button
      ><c-button @click="print">打印日程</c-button
      ><c-tag>版本 {{ revision }}</c-tag></c-space
    >
    <c-alert v-if="error" status="danger">{{ error }}</c-alert>
    <c-textarea v-model="ical" placeholder="ICS 文本" :rows="4" />
    <c-scheduler
      v-model="events"
      default-date="2026-09-22"
      default-mode="week"
      :before-transaction="save"
      history
    />
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onBeforeUnmount } from "vue";
import {
  createSchedulerMemoryProvider,
  exportSchedulerICalendar,
  importSchedulerICalendar,
  createSchedulerPrintHtml,
} from "../adapters";
import type { SchedulerEvent, SchedulerTransactionContext } from "../core";
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>([
  {
    id: "meeting",
    title: "团队会议",
    start: "2026-09-22T09:00:00",
    end: "2026-09-22T10:00:00",
  },
]);
const source = createSchedulerMemoryProvider(events.value),
  revision = ref(0),
  ical = ref(""),
  error = ref("");
const stop = source.subscribe!((snapshot, origin) => {
  if (origin === "editor") return;
  revision.value = snapshot.revision;
  events.value = snapshot.events;
});
onBeforeUnmount(stop);
async function save(context: SchedulerTransactionContext) {
  const expected = revision.value;
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
  const next = await source.commit(context.changes, expected, "editor");
  revision.value = next.revision;
}
async function remote() {
  try {
    await source.commit(
      [
        {
          type: "update",
          event: {
            ...events.value[0],
            title: `远端更新 ${revision.value + 1}`,
          },
        },
      ],
      revision.value,
      "remote",
    );
  } catch (cause) {
    error.value = String(cause);
  }
}
function exportIcs() {
  try {
    ical.value = exportSchedulerICalendar(events.value, {
      stamp: new Date(),
      name: "Cedar demo",
    });
    error.value = "";
  } catch (cause) {
    error.value = String(cause);
  }
}
async function importIcs() {
  try {
    const parsed = importSchedulerICalendar(ical.value, {
      timeZone: "Asia/Shanghai",
    });
    if (parsed.series.length)
      throw new Error("含重复系列，请先通过 RRULE 适配器展开");
    const existing = new Set(events.value.map((event) => event.id));
    await source.commit(
      parsed.events.map((event) => ({
        type: existing.has(event.id) ? "update" : "create",
        event,
      })),
      revision.value,
      "import",
    );
    error.value = "";
  } catch (cause) {
    error.value = String(cause);
  }
}
function print() {
  const page = window.open("", "_blank");
  if (!page) return;
  page.document.open();
  page.document.write(
    createSchedulerPrintHtml(events.value, { title: "团队日程" }),
  );
  page.document.close();
  page.focus();
  page.print();
}
</script>
```

```vue
  { id: "person-li", label: "李卫东" },
  { id: "person-zhang", label: "张志强" },
  { id: "device-a", label: "月检站 A" },
  { id: "device-c", label: "预警处理台 C" },
];
const orders = ref<TaskCalendarOrder[]>([
  {
    id: "detail-101",
    kind: "work",
    status: "review",
    source: "设备待办",
    personId: "person-li",
    plannedStart: "2026-09-09T09:00:00",
    plannedEnd: "2026-09-09T11:00:00",
    tasks: [
      {
        id: "WO-301",
        title: "月检与运行参数复核",
        deviceId: "device-a",
        skill: "inspection",
        standardMinutes: 120,
      },
    ],
    punchRecords: [
      {
        id: "punch-1",
        deviceId: "device-a",
        checkedInAt: "2026-09-09T09:12:00",
        checkedOutAt: "2026-09-09T10:48:00",
      },
    ],
    color: "#1677ff",
  },
  {
    id: "detail-102",
    kind: "work",
    status: "closed",
    source: "站长负责范围",
    personId: "person-zhang",
    plannedStart: "2026-09-09T13:00:00",
    plannedEnd: "2026-09-09T14:00:00",
    actualStart: "2026-09-09T13:08:00",
    actualEnd: "2026-09-09T13:52:00",
    tasks: [
      {
        id: "WO-302",
        title: "预警处理",
        deviceId: "device-c",
        skill: "warning",
        standardMinutes: 60,
      },
    ],
    punchRecords: [
      {
        id: "punch-2",
        deviceId: "device-c",
        checkedInAt: "2026-09-09T13:08:00",
        checkedOutAt: "2026-09-09T13:52:00",
      },
    ],
    color: "#86909c",
  },
  {
    id: "detail-rest",
    kind: "rest",
    status: "planned",
    source: "个人安排",
    personId: "person-li",
    plannedStart: "2026-09-09T12:00:00",
    plannedEnd: "2026-09-09T13:00:00",
    tasks: [],
    punchRecords: [],
    color: "#00a854",
  },
]);
const events = ref<SchedulerEvent[]>(orders.value.map(toTaskCalendarEvent));
const previewId = ref<string>();
const activeOrderId = ref<string>();
const detailsOpen = ref(false);
const activeOrder = computed(() =>
  orders.value.find((order) => order.id === activeOrderId.value),
);

function activate(request: SchedulerEditorRequest) {
  if (request.action !== "edit") return;
  previewId.value = request.event.id;
  activeOrderId.value = businessId(request.event);
}
function openDetails(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  activeOrderId.value = businessId(event);
  previewId.value = undefined;
  detailsOpen.value = true;
}
function closeOrder(order: TaskCalendarOrder) {
  const punches = order.punchRecords;
  const first = punches[0]?.checkedInAt;
  const last = punches.at(-1)?.checkedOutAt;
  if (!first || !last) return;
  orders.value = orders.value.map((item) =>
    item.id === order.id
      ? { ...item, status: "closed", actualStart: first, actualEnd: last }
      : item,
  );
  events.value = orders.value.map(toTaskCalendarEvent);
}
function businessId(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  return String(event.metadata?.attendanceOrderId ?? event.id);
}
function orderOf(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  return orders.value.find((order) => order.id === businessId(event));
}
function totalMinutes(order: TaskCalendarOrder) {
  return order.tasks.reduce((total, task) => total + task.standardMinutes, 0);
}
function deviceLabels(order: TaskCalendarOrder) {
  return (
    [...new Set(order.tasks.map((task) => resourceLabel(task.deviceId)))].join(
      "、",
    ) || "无"
  );
}
function personLabel(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  return resourceLabel(orderOf(event)?.personId);
}
function resourceLabel(id?: string) {
  return resources.find((resource) => resource.id === id)?.label ?? "未知";
}
function skillLabel(skill: string) {
  return { inspection: "巡检", warning: "预警处理" }[skill] ?? skill;
}
function statusLabel(order: TaskCalendarOrder) {
  if (order.kind === "rest") return "休息";
  return {
    planned: "计划中",
    active: "执行中",
    review: "待关单",
    closed: "已完成",
  }[order.status];
}
function latestPunch(order: TaskCalendarOrder) {
  const record = order.punchRecords.at(-1);
  return record
    ? `${displayTime(record.checkedInAt)} – ${displayTime(record.checkedOutAt)}`
    : "暂无";
}
function timeRange(event: SchedulerEvent) {
  return `${displayTime(event.start)} – ${displayTime(event.end)}`;
}
function displayTime(value?: string | number | Date) {
  return value == null
    ? "未记录"
    : new Date(value).toLocaleString("zh-CN", {
        month: "numeric",
        day: "numeric",
        hour: "2-digit",
        minute: "2-digit",
        hour12: false,
      });
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.completed-event {
  opacity: 0.55;
}
</style>
```

### Task Calendar Workbench

- `step`: Controls the allowed increment.
- `readonly`: Displays the current value without allowing edits.
- `disabled`: Prevents user interaction.

Example source: src/scheduler/__demos__/task-calendar-workbench.vue

```vue

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  computed,
  nextTick,
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onMounted,
  ref,
  watch,
} from "vue";
import type {
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerEventTemplate,
  SchedulerEditorRequest,
  SchedulerChangeContext,
} from "../index";
import { schedulerDateKey } from "../core";
import type { TreeNodeData } from "../../tree";
import WorkbenchPunches from "./workbench-punches.vue";
import {
  createWorkbenchApi,
  createWorkbenchMock,
  copyData,
  moveWorkbenchOrder,
  orderEnd,
  orderTasks,
  pendingWorkbenchTasks,
  projectWorkbench,
  remainingDays,
  weekLabel,
  workbenchLayout,
  type WorkbenchOrder,
  type WorkbenchTask,
  type WorkbenchPunch,
  type SaveResult,
} from "./workbench-model";

const today = new Date();
const api = createWorkbenchApi(createWorkbenchMock(today));
const data = ref(api.load());
const date = ref(new Date(today));
const role = ref<"dispatcher" | "viewer">("dispatcher");
const roles = [
  { value: "dispatcher", label: "调度员（可编辑）" },
  { value: "viewer", label: "查看者（只读）" },
];
const statuses = {
  planned: "待出发",
  active: "进行中",
  submit: "待提交",
  review: "待审核",
  closed: "已完成",
};
const rejectSave = ref(false),
  conflict = ref(false),
  saving = ref(false),
  navigationOpen = ref(false),
  datePickerOpen = ref(false);
const query = ref(""),
  recent = ref<string[]>(["li", "station-a"]),
  selected = ref<string[]>(["me"]);
const selectedTasks = ref<string[]>([]),
  draggingTasks = ref<string[]>([]),
  dragDeadline = ref<string>();
const notice = ref(""),
  noticeError = ref(false),
  editorError = ref(""),
  lastPayload = ref("");
const editorOpen = ref(false),
  draft = ref<WorkbenchOrder>(),
  hoverOrder = ref("");
const closing = ref(false),
  manualPunch = ref(false),
  punchStart = ref<Date>(),
  punchEnd = ref<Date>();
const addTaskId = ref<string>(),
  workOrderTask = ref<WorkbenchTask>();
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
const scheduler = ref();
let opener: HTMLElement | undefined;
let sequence = 0;
let staged: (() => SaveResult) | undefined;
const events = computed(() => projectWorkbench(data.value, selected.value));
const pending = computed(() => pendingWorkbenchTasks(data.value, today));
const resource = (id: unknown) =>
  data.value.resources.find((item) => item.id === id);
const task = (id: unknown) => data.value.tasks.find((item) => item.id === id);
const draftTasks = computed(() =>
  draft.value ? orderTasks(draft.value, data.value) : [],
);
const calculatedEnd = computed(() =>
  draft.value ? orderEnd(draft.value.start, draftTasks.value) : "",
);
const readOnly = computed(
  () =>
    role.value === "viewer" ||
    draft.value?.kind === "rest" ||
    draft.value?.status === "closed",
);
const activeOrder = computed(() =>
  editorOpen.value ? draft.value?.id : hoverOrder.value,
);
const personOptions = computed(() =>
  data.value.resources
    .filter((r) => r.dimensionId === "person")
    .map((r) => ({ value: r.id, label: r.label })),
);
const availableTaskOptions = computed(() =>
  pending.value
    .filter(
      (entry) =>
        !draft.value?.taskIds.includes(entry.id) &&
        (!draftTasks.value.length ||
          entry.deviceId === draftTasks.value[0].deviceId),
    )
    .map((entry) => ({
      value: entry.id,
      label: `${entry.title} · ${resource(entry.deviceId)?.label}`,
    })),
);
const eligiblePunches = computed(() =>
  data.value.punches.filter(
    (record) =>
      record.personId === draft.value?.personId &&
      record.deviceId === draftTasks.value[0]?.deviceId,
  ),
);
const linkedPunches = computed(() =>
  data.value.punches.filter((record) =>
    draft.value?.punchIds.includes(record.id),
  ),
);
const preview = computed<SchedulerEvent | undefined>(() =>
  editorOpen.value && draft.value?.version === 0
    ? {
        id: "workbench-draft",
        title:
          draftTasks.value.map((entry) => entry.title).join("、") || "新出勤单",
        start: draft.value.start,
        end: draft.value.allDay
          ? draft.value.end
          : draft.value.taskIds.length
            ? calculatedEnd.value
            : new Date(+new Date(draft.value.start) + 3600000).toISOString(),
        allDay: draft.value.allDay,
        color: resource(draft.value.personId)?.color,
        backgroundColor: resource(draft.value.personId)?.background,
      }
    : undefined,
);

interface Node extends TreeNodeData {
  resourceId?: string;
  taskId?: string;
  children?: Node[];
}
const group = (key: string, title: string, ids: string[]): Node => ({
  value: key,
  label: title,
  children: ids.map((id) => ({
    value: `${key}/${id}`,
    label: resource(id)?.label,
    resourceId: id,
  })),
});
const sourceTree = computed<Node[]>(() => [
  ...(query.value.trim()
    ? [
        group(
          "search",
          "搜索结果",
          data.value.resources
            .filter((r) =>
              `${r.label} ${r.account ?? ""}`
                .toLowerCase()
                .includes(query.value.trim().toLowerCase()),
            )
            .map((r) => r.id),
        ),
      ]
    : []),
  group("self", "自己", ["me"]),
  group("stations", "我的站", ["station-a", "station-b"]),
  group("favorites", "收藏", ["station-a", "station-c"]),
  group("recent", "最近使用", recent.value),
]);
const expandedSources = ref<Array<string | number>>([
  "self",
  "stations",
  "favorites",
  "recent",
  "search",
]);
const sourceKeys = computed(() =>
  sourceTree.value
    .flatMap((node) => node.children ?? [])
    .filter((node) => selected.value.includes(node.resourceId!))
    .map((node) => node.value!),
);
function checkSources(
  _keys: Array<string | number>,
  context: { checked?: boolean; node?: Node },
) {
  if (saving.value || !context.node) return;
  const ids = context.node.resourceId
    ? [context.node.resourceId]
    : (context.node.children ?? []).map((node) => node.resourceId!);
  selected.value = context.checked
    ? [...new Set([...selected.value, ...ids])]
    : selected.value.filter((id) => !ids.includes(id));
  if (context.checked)
    recent.value = [...new Set([...ids, ...recent.value])].slice(0, 12);
}
function toggleResource(id: string) {
  selected.value = selected.value.includes(id)
    ? selected.value.filter((value) => value !== id)
    : [...selected.value, id];
  recent.value = [...new Set([id, ...recent.value])].slice(0, 12);
}
const pendingTree = computed<Node[]>(() =>
  selected.value.flatMap((id) => {
    const owner = resource(id);
    const ids =
      owner?.dimensionId === "device"
        ? [id]
        : data.value.resources
            .filter((r) => r.managers?.includes(id))
            .map((r) => r.id);
    const tasks = pending.value.filter((entry) => ids.includes(entry.deviceId));
    return tasks.length
      ? [
          {
            value: `pending/${id}`,
            label: owner?.label,
            children: tasks.map((entry) => ({
              value: `pending/${id}/${entry.id}`,
              label: entry.title,
              taskId: entry.id,
            })),
          },
        ]
      : [];
  }),
);
const expandedPending = ref<Array<string | number>>(
  data.value.resources.map((r) => `pending/${r.id}`),
);
const pendingKeys = computed(() =>
  pendingTree.value
    .flatMap((node) => node.children ?? [])
    .filter((node) => selectedTasks.value.includes(node.taskId!))
    .map((node) => node.value!),
);
function checkPending(
  _keys: Array<string | number>,
  context: { checked?: boolean; node?: Node },
) {
  if (!context.node) return;
  const ids = context.node.taskId
    ? [context.node.taskId]
    : (context.node.children ?? []).map((node) => node.taskId!);
  const next = context.checked
    ? [...new Set([...selectedTasks.value, ...ids])]
    : selectedTasks.value.filter((id) => !ids.includes(id));
  if (new Set(next.map((id) => task(id)?.deviceId)).size > 1)
    return showNotice("请勾选同一设备的任务", true);
  selectedTasks.value = next;
}
const deadlineClass = (entry?: WorkbenchTask) => ({
  overdue: entry && remainingDays(entry, today) < 0,
  urgent:
    entry &&
    remainingDays(entry, today) >= 0 &&
    remainingDays(entry, today) <= 3,
});
const deadlineText = (entry?: WorkbenchTask) => {
  if (!entry) return "";
  const days = remainingDays(entry, today);
  return days < 0
    ? `逾期 ${-days} 天`
    : days === 0
      ? "今天截止"
      : `剩 ${days} 天`;
};
function beginPending(
  id: string,
  startDrag: (template: SchedulerEventTemplate, event: DragEvent) => void,
  event: DragEvent,
) {
  const ids = selectedTasks.value.includes(id)
    ? [...selectedTasks.value]
    : [id];
  draggingTasks.value = ids;
  dragDeadline.value = ids
    .map((key) => task(key)?.deadline ?? "")
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort()[0];
  startDrag(
    {
      title: ids.map((key) => task(key)?.title).join("、"),
      duration: ids.reduce((sum, key) => sum + (task(key)?.minutes ?? 0), 0),
      metadata: { taskIds: ids },
    },
    event,
  );
}
function captureDrag(event: PointerEvent) {
  const node = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest<HTMLElement>(
    "[data-order-id]",
  );
  const order = data.value.orders.find(
    (item) => item.id === node?.dataset.orderId,
  );
  if (
    order &&
    order.kind === "work" &&
    order.status !== "closed" &&
    role.value !== "viewer"
  )
    dragDeadline.value = orderTasks(order, data.value)
      .map((entry) => entry.deadline)
      .sort()[0];
}
function endDrag() {
  dragDeadline.value = undefined;
  draggingTasks.value = [];
}
function allowMerge(event: DragEvent, target: SchedulerEvent) {
  if (
    draggingTasks.value.length &&
    !target.readonly &&
    !saving.value &&
    role.value !== "viewer"
  )
    event.preventDefault();
}
async function dropMerge(event: DragEvent, target: SchedulerEvent) {
  if (!draggingTasks.value.length) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  event.stopPropagation();
  const ids = [...draggingTasks.value];
  endDrag();
  const current = data.value.orders.find(
    (order) => order.id === target.metadata?.orderId,
  );
  if (!current || target.readonly || saving.value || role.value === "viewer")
    return showNotice("当前记录不可合并", true);
  const next = copyData(current);
  next.taskIds = [...new Set([...next.taskIds, ...ids])];
  if (!next.allDay)
    next.end = orderEnd(next.start, orderTasks(next, data.value));
  await persist(next);
}
function openEditor(request: SchedulerEditorRequest) {
  editorError.value = "";
  closing.value = false;
  manualPunch.value = false;
  addTaskId.value = undefined;
  opener =
    document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement
      ? document.activeElement
      : undefined;
  if (request.action === "edit") {
    const order = data.value.orders.find(
      (item) => item.id === request.event.metadata?.orderId,
    );
    if (!order) return;
    draft.value = copyData(order);
  } else {
    const templateIds = request.event.metadata?.taskIds;
    const ids = Array.isArray(templateIds)
      ? templateIds.filter((id): id is string => typeof id === "string")
      : [...selectedTasks.value];
    const start = new Date(request.event.start ?? date.value);
    if (request.source === "toolbar") start.setHours(9, 0, 0, 0);
    else if (request.source === "cell") start.setMinutes(0, 0, 0);
    draft.value = {
      id: `ATT-${Date.now()}-${++sequence}`,
      version: 0,
      personId:
        selected.value.find((id) => resource(id)?.dimensionId === "person") ??
        "me",
      taskIds: ids,
      start: start.toISOString(),
      end: request.event.allDay
        ? new Date(request.event.end!).toISOString()
        : orderEnd(
            start.toISOString(),
            ids.map(task).filter((entry): entry is WorkbenchTask => !!entry),
          ),
      allDay: request.event.allDay,
      kind: "work",
      status: "planned",
      punchIds: [],
    };
  }
  punchStart.value = new Date(draft.value.start);
  punchEnd.value = new Date(draft.value.end);
  editorOpen.value = true;
  endDrag();
}
function setStart(value: Date | undefined) {
  if (draft.value && value && Number.isFinite(+value))
    draft.value.start = value.toISOString();
}
function setAllDayEnd(value: Date | undefined) {
  if (draft.value && value && Number.isFinite(+value))
    draft.value.end = value.toISOString();
}
function addTask(id: string) {
  if (draft.value && id)
    draft.value.taskIds = [...new Set([...draft.value.taskIds, id])];
  addTaskId.value = undefined;
}
function addSelected() {
  if (!draft.value) return;
  const ids = [...new Set([...draft.value.taskIds, ...selectedTasks.value])];
  if (new Set(ids.map((id) => task(id)?.deviceId)).size > 1) {
    editorError.value = "一张出勤单只能安排同一设备的任务";
    return;
  }
  draft.value.taskIds = ids;
}
function removeDraftTask(id: string) {
  if (draft.value)
    draft.value.taskIds = draft.value.taskIds.filter((value) => value !== id);
}
function taskStart(index: number) {
  return draft.value
    ? orderEnd(draft.value.start, draftTasks.value.slice(0, index))
    : "";
}
function togglePunch(id: string, checked: boolean) {
  if (draft.value)
    draft.value.punchIds = checked
      ? [...new Set([...draft.value.punchIds, id])]
      : draft.value.punchIds.filter((key) => key !== id);
}
function options() {
  const value = {
    role: role.value,
    fail: rejectSave.value,
    conflict: conflict.value,
  };
  conflict.value = false;
  return value;
}
function accept(result: SaveResult) {
  data.value = result.data;
  selectedTasks.value = selectedTasks.value.filter((id) =>
    pending.value.some((entry) => entry.id === id),
  );
  showNotice(result.warnings.join("；") || "已保存", false);
}
async function persist(
  value: WorkbenchOrder,
  remove = false,
  manual?: WorkbenchPunch,
) {
  saving.value = true;
  editorError.value = "";
  lastPayload.value = JSON.stringify(
    {
      operation: remove ? "remove" : "save",
      order: value,
      manualPunch: manual,
    },
    null,
    2,
  );
  try {
    accept(await api.save(value, options(), remove, manual));
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    editorError.value = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "保存失败";
    showNotice(editorError.value, true);
    return false;
  } finally {
    saving.value = false;
  }
}
async function saveDraft(remove = false) {
  if (!draft.value || saving.value || readOnly.value) return;
  const value = copyData(draft.value);
  const dissolve = !!value.version && !value.taskIds.length;
  if (!value.allDay && value.taskIds.length)
    value.end = orderEnd(value.start, orderTasks(value, data.value));
  let manual: WorkbenchPunch | undefined;
  if (closing.value && !remove && !dissolve) {
    value.status = "closed";
    if (manualPunch.value) {
      if (
        !punchStart.value ||
        !punchEnd.value ||
        !Number.isFinite(+punchStart.value) ||
        !Number.isFinite(+punchEnd.value)
      ) {
        editorError.value = "请填写登录和注销时间";
        return;
      }
      manual = {
        id: `punch-${Date.now()}-${++sequence}`,
        personId: value.personId,
        deviceId: draftTasks.value[0]?.deviceId ?? "",
        start: punchStart.value.toISOString(),
        end: punchEnd.value.toISOString(),
      };
      value.punchIds = [...value.punchIds, manual.id];
    }
  }
  if (await persist(value, remove || dissolve, manual)) closeEditor();
}
async function prepareMove(context: SchedulerChangeContext) {
  if (!context.previous || context.type !== "move")
    throw new Error("请在出勤单详情中修改");
  if (context.event.allDay !== context.previous.allDay)
    throw new Error("请在详情中调整全天安排");
  const next = moveWorkbenchOrder(data.value, context.event, context.previous);
  lastPayload.value = JSON.stringify(
    { operation: "move", order: next },
    null,
    2,
  );
  staged = await api.prepare(next, options());
  return true;
}
function finishMove() {
  try {
    if (staged) accept(staged());
  } catch (error) {
    moveError(error);
  } finally {
    staged = undefined;
    endDrag();
  }
}
function moveError(error: unknown) {
  staged = undefined;
  showNotice(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "保存失败", true);
  endDrag();
}
function showNotice(message: string, error: boolean) {
  notice.value = message;
  noticeError.value = error;
}
function reload() {
  data.value = api.load();
  if (draft.value?.version)
    draft.value = copyData(
      data.value.orders.find((item) => item.id === draft.value?.id) ??
        draft.value,
    );
  editorError.value = "";
  showNotice("已重新加载", false);
}
async function onEditorVisibility(open: boolean) {
  if (open) return;
  hoverOrder.value = "";
  await nextTick();
  if (opener?.isConnected) opener.focus({ preventScroll: true });
}
function closeEditor() {
  editorOpen.value = false;
  void onEditorVisibility(false);
}
async function chooseDate(value: Date | undefined) {
  if (value && Number.isFinite(+value)) date.value = value;
  datePickerOpen.value = false;
}
async function goToday() {
  date.value = new Date();
  await nextTick();
  const container =
    host.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".c-scheduler__main");
  const heading = [
    ...(host.value?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
      "[data-scheduler-heading-date]",
    ) ?? []),
  ].find(
    (element) =>
      schedulerDateKey(element.dataset.schedulerHeadingDate!) ===
      schedulerDateKey(new Date()),
  );
  const cell = host.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
    ".c-scheduler__time-cell",
  );
  if (container && cell) {
    container.scrollTop = (cell.getBoundingClientRect().height || 36) * 7;
    if (heading) container.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, heading.offsetLeft - 64);
  }
}
const time = (value: SchedulerEvent["start"]) =>
  value == null
    ? ""
    : new Date(value).toLocaleTimeString("zh-CN", {
        hour: "2-digit",
        minute: "2-digit",
        hour12: false,
      });
const format = (value: string) =>
  new Date(value).toLocaleString("zh-CN", {
    month: "numeric",
    day: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hour12: false,
  });
const cancelWithEscape = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.key === "Escape") endDrag();
};
onMounted(() => {
  window.addEventListener("pointerup", endDrag);
  window.addEventListener("pointercancel", endDrag);
  window.addEventListener("blur", endDrag);
  window.addEventListener("keydown", cancelWithEscape);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  window.removeEventListener("pointerup", endDrag);
  window.removeEventListener("pointercancel", endDrag);
  window.removeEventListener("blur", endDrag);
  window.removeEventListener("keydown", cancelWithEscape);
});
watch(query, () => {
  if (!expandedSources.value.includes("search"))
    expandedSources.value.push("search");
});
</script>
```

## API

### `<c-scheduler>` Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| model-value | Schedule data; supports v-model and becomes controlled when provided | SchedulerEvent[] | — |
| preview-event | Unsaved new-event placeholders; visual only | SchedulerEvent | — |
| default-value | Initial uncontrolled data | SchedulerEvent[] | [] |
| mode | Current view; supports v-model:mode | SchedulerMode | — |
| default-mode | Default uncontrolled view | SchedulerMode | week |
| date | Navigation date; supports v-model:date | Date / string / number | — |
| default-date | Initial navigation date | Date / string / number | Current date |
| resource-dimensions | Dimension definitions: `{ id, label }[]` | SchedulerResourceDimension[] | [] |
| resource-filters | Combined resource-dimension filters; supports v-model:resource-filters | SchedulerResourceFilters | — |
| default-resource-filters | Initial uncontrolled filters | SchedulerResourceFilters | {} |
| resource-dimension | Resource row/column dimension; an empty string shows all | string | — |
| default-resource-dimension | Initial uncontrolled display dimension | string | '' |
| resources | Currently visible resource rows/columns and local options; a complete directory is unnecessary | SchedulerResource[] | [] |
| resource-label | Resource field name, such as equipment or meeting room | string | Localized resource label |
| request-resources | Query resource candidates by keyword and cursor | SchedulerRequestResources | — |
| resolve-resources | Batch-resolve resource names by ID | SchedulerResolveResources | — |
| modes | Views available for switching | SchedulerMode[] | All six views |
| first-day-of-week | Week start: 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday | number | 1 |
| start-hour | Time-grid start hour, 0–23 | number | 8 |
| end-hour | Time-grid end hour; greater than start and at most 24 | number | 20 |
| initial-scroll-minute | Minute of day initially scrolled into view; subsequent renders retain user scroll position | number | — |
| step | Grid/snap interval in minutes; a positive integer dividing 60 | number | 30 |
| slot-duration | Grid interval in minutes; positive integer | number | step |
| snap-duration | Pointer snap interval in minutes; positive integer | number | step |
| default-duration | Default duration for click-to-create, in positive integer minutes | number | step |
| drag-to-create | Drag-select empty slots in day/week/resource-day views | boolean | false |
| month-event-limit | Maximum directly displayed events per month-view day; extra events use Popover | number | 3 |
| overlap-event-limit | Maximum directly displayed events per overlapping time-grid group; extra events use Popover | number | — |
| zoom / default-zoom | Timeline zoom, 0.5–4 | number | 1 |
| show-date-header | Tiered timeline date headers | boolean | true |
| show-assignment-details | Edit resource occupancy and roles | boolean | false |
| show-resource-load | Resource peak load, capacity and utilization within the range | boolean | false |
| rule-policy | allow/warn/block policies for capacity/unavailable/conflict | SchedulerRulePolicy | {}（block） |
| dependencies | Task dependencies | SchedulerDependency[] | [] |
| event-layout | Time-grid layout: stack / columns / geometry callback. Week defaults to stack; others to columns | SchedulerEventLayout | Depends on the view |
| readonly | Viewing/navigation allowed, editing blocked | boolean | false |
| disabled | Disable interaction | boolean | false |
| hidden-days | Hide specified weekdays in week/month/agenda, 0–6; cannot hide every day | number[] | [] |
| show-now-indicator | Show the current local-time line in day/week/resource-day views | boolean | false |
| show-sidebar | Show filters and the unscheduled list | boolean | true |
| allow-overlap | Allow overlapping times for the same resource | boolean | true |
| editable | Enable the built-in editor; false delegates through editor-request | boolean | true |
| before-change | Return false to cancel; supports asynchronous interception and save APIs | SchedulerBeforeChange / SchedulerBeforeChange[] | — |

mode is `day | week | month | agenda | resource-day | resource-timeline`. Agenda/resource-timeline navigate by week. Events outside time-grid hours remain visible in month/agenda/timeline.

With controlled model-value, the component proposes data and waits for parent acceptance before changing the UI; it does not move first and roll back after request failure. Input arrays/objects are not mutated. before-change receives detached copies; editing them does not alter the committed proposal.

### `<c-scheduler>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| update:model-value | Proposes a new main value | SchedulerEvent[] |
| update:resourceFilters | Combined resource-filter changes; controlled mode waits for parent acceptance | SchedulerResourceFilters |
| update:resourceDimension | Resource row/column display-dimension changes | string |
| update:mode | View changes | SchedulerMode |
| update:zoom | Timeline zoom changes | number |
| rule-warning | Advisory rule issues on an accepted proposal | SchedulerError[] |
| update:date | Navigation-date changes | Date |
| change | Validation/hooks complete; controlled mode has proposed a validated value | value, SchedulerChangeContext |
| change-error | Validation, conflict, save or stale-proposal errors | error, SchedulerChange |
| event-click | Activate an event with a copy; stacked events support click/Enter too, while multiselection does not activate | SchedulerEvent |
| cell-click | Click an empty time slot | SchedulerCell |
| range-change | Initial and actual visible-date-range changes | SchedulerRange |
| resource-error | Resource search/display resolution fails without changing schedule data | error, SchedulerResourceErrorContext |
| editor-request | Only with editable=false: request external creation or viewing/editing | SchedulerEditorRequest |

### `<c-scheduler>` Slots

| Slot | Arguments | Description |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| event | { event } | Event-button content |
| sidebar | { startDrag, cancelDrag, disabled, unscheduled } | Replace the entire sidebar, e.g. with a resource tree/task pool; hidden when show-sidebar=false |
| sidebar-extra | { startDrag, cancelDrag, disabled } | Content above the default sidebar; startDrag(template: SchedulerEventTemplate, event: DragEvent). Hidden when show-sidebar=false |
| resource-header | { resource?, resources?, date } | Resource or date header |
| toolbar | { date, mode, navigate, create } | Replace the toolbar; navigate(-1/1) changes range, create() follows toolbar creation |
| column-background | { date, resource? } | Background for day/week/resource-day columns without intercepting pointers; useful for soft warnings/heatmaps |
| toolbar-extra | { date, mode } | Toolbar extension |
| editor | SchedulerEditorSlotProps | Custom drawer content: action, event, error, errorMessage, save, remove, close, readonly, pending |
| empty | — | Empty state |

### Instance methods

| Method | Description |
| ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `change(change): Promise<boolean>` | Execute create/update/remove/move/resize with all validation/hooks |
| duplicateEvent(id: string) | Open a separately copied draft or request custom creation; returns boolean without automatically saving |
| goToDate(date: Date) | Navigate to a date; respects controlled models |

## Type definitions

```ts
import type {
  SchedulerProps,
  SchedulerInstance,
  SchedulerMode,
  SchedulerEvent,
  SchedulerResource,
  SchedulerChange,
  SchedulerChangeContext,
  SchedulerBeforeChange,
  SchedulerEventTemplate,
  SchedulerRequestResources,
  SchedulerResolveResources,
  SchedulerResourcePage,
  SchedulerResourceQuery,
  SchedulerResourceErrorContext,
  SchedulerEditorRequest,
  SchedulerEditorAction,
  SchedulerEditorSlotProps,
} from "@cedar-design/ui";

interface SchedulerEvent {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  start?: Date | string | number;
  end?: Date | string | number;
  allDay?: boolean;
  resourceIds?: string[];
  resourceDetails?: Record<string, { units?: number; role?: string }>;
  milestone?: boolean;
  layoutGroupId?: string;
  description?: string;
  color?: string;
  accentColor?: string;
  backgroundColor?: string;
  backgroundPattern?: "solid" | "diagonal-stripes" | "dots" | "crosshatch";
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  readonly?: boolean;
  resizable?: boolean; // false disables time-grid resizing while preserving moving/viewing
}
type SchedulerEventTemplate = Pick<
  SchedulerEvent,
  | "title"
  | "description"
  | "color"
  | "accentColor"
  | "backgroundColor"
  | "backgroundPattern"
  | "metadata"
  | "resourceIds"
> & {
  duration?: number; // positive minutes; defaults to default-duration or step
};
interface SchedulerResource {
  id: string;
  dimensionId?: string;
  label: string;
  color?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  capacity?: number; // nonnegative safe integer; omission leaves concurrent event counts unlimited
}
interface SchedulerResourceQuery {
  dimensionId?: string;
  query: string;
  cursor?: string;
  signal: AbortSignal;
}
interface SchedulerResourcePage {
  items: SchedulerResource[];
  nextCursor?: string;
}
type SchedulerRequestResources = (
  query: SchedulerResourceQuery,
) => SchedulerResourcePage | Promise<SchedulerResourcePage>;
type SchedulerResolveResources = (
  ids: string[],
  context: { signal: AbortSignal },
) => SchedulerResource[] | Promise<SchedulerResource[]>;
type SchedulerResourceErrorContext =
  | { type: "search"; query: string; cursor?: string }
  | { type: "resolve"; ids: string[] };

type SchedulerEditorAction = "create" | "edit";
type SchedulerEditorRequest = { event: SchedulerEvent; readonly: boolean } & (
  | { action: "create"; source: "toolbar" | "cell" | "drop" }
  | { action: "edit"; source: "event" }
);
interface SchedulerEditorSlotProps {
  action: SchedulerEditorAction;
  event: SchedulerEvent;
  error?: SchedulerError;
  errorMessage?: string;
  readonly: boolean;
  pending: boolean;
  save: (event?: SchedulerEvent) => void;
  remove: () => void;
  close: () => void;
}
```

Every event id must be unique. Omitting both start/end means unscheduled; otherwise end must follow start, except timed milestones requiring start=end. All intervals are `[start, end)`, so adjacent intervals do not conflict. allDay uses `YYYY-MM-DD` strings with an exclusive end, e.g. September 9–10 for a one-day event.

Display currently uses the runtime's local zone; timed events should use ISO instants. Arbitrary IANA display zones are not promised. Cross-zone RRULE, ICS and version synchronization come from separate adapters; business code must connect real external accounts. Configure virtual resource rows with virtual-list-props. See examples for local undo and range-based remote loading. Pointer drag supports moving/resizing; Escape cancels. Keyboard/touch users can also schedule/assign through the editor. Disabled resource options prevent new assignments/drops while existing associations may remain or be removed.

## Independent core

`src/scheduler/core` imports no Vue, DOM or external calendar library. It can be tested independently and later extracted as scheduler-core. The published pure-core subentry avoids importing component runtime:

```ts
import {
  applySchedulerChange,
  getSchedulerConflicts,
  layoutSchedulerEvents,
} from "@cedar-design/ui/scheduler/core";
```

Other date/timeline utilities are exported from this entry too. The core computes and applies immutable changes; it does not handle networking, authorization or database transactions.

| -------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |

| --c-scheduler-column-min-width | 120px |

| --c-scheduler-lane-height | 38px |
| --c-scheduler-ghost-opacity | 0.75 |
| --c-scheduler-preview-opacity | 0.85 |
| --c-scheduler-preview-duration | 100ms |
| --c-scheduler-ghost-z-index | 2000 |

### Before-hook waiting feedback

Before-hook waits show visible feedback and aria-busy. Rejected or failed operations recover; duplicate submissions do not start another copy. Notification event Promises never drive loading.

```vue
import { ref } from 'vue'

const mounted = ref(true)
const scrolls = ref(0)
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">Activate / 停用与激活</c-button>
```

### Lifecycle

Example source: src/scrollbar/__demos__/lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { ScrollbarInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui'
const active = ref(true)
const mounted = ref(true)
const bar = ref<ScrollbarInstance>()
let retained: ScrollbarInstance | undefined
function remember() { retained = bar.value }
function scrollRetained() { retained?.scrollTo(100, 100) }
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="remember">Remember handle / 保留句柄</c-button>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">Activate / 停用与激活</c-button>
    <c-button @click="mounted = !mounted">Mount / 卸载与挂载</c-button>
    <c-button @click="scrollRetained">Retained scroll / 调用保留滚动</c-button>
    <c-button @click="bar?.scrollTo(0, 0)">Origin / 回到原点</c-button>
    <p>Remember the handle, deactivate or unmount, then call it. It must be inert. Activate for fresh commands; zero coordinates must work.</p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <c-scrollbar v-if="active" ref="bar" style="height: 160px; width: 260px; overflow: auto">
        <div style="height: 800px; width: 700px">Scrollable content / 可滚动内容</div>
      </c-scrollbar>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

# Search

Search submits keywords and controlled field models. The application handles requests and loading.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

```vue
import { ref } from 'vue'

</script>
<template>
  <c-search v-model="keyword" placeholder="Enter keywords and press Enter" @search="onSearch" />
  <p role="status">Submitted: {{ submitted || 'No search yet' }}</p>
</template>
```

### With Fields

Example source: src/search/__demos__/with-fields.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-search
      v-model="keyword"
      v-model:model-field="modelField"
      v-model:model="model"
      :style="inputStyle"
      :fields="fields"
      :recent-searches="recentSearches"
      :select-style="{ minWidth: '140px' }"
      default-field="name"
      placeholder="请输入搜索内容"
      search-button
      @change="handleChange"
      @search="handleSearch"
    />
    <c-button @click="resetModel">Reset Model</c-button>
    <div>最近提交：{{ latestChange || "-" }}</div>
    <pre v-if="latestResult">{{ JSON.stringify(latestResult, null, 2) }}</pre>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SearchResult, SearchField } from "@cedar-design/ui";

const inputStyle = { width: "420px" };
const keyword = ref("");
const modelField = ref("name");
const model = ref<Record<string, unknown>>({});
const recentSearches = ref<string[]>(["设备 A", "设备 B", "设备 C"]);
const latestChange = ref("");
const latestResult = ref<SearchResult>();

const fields: SearchField[] = [
  {
    value: "id",
    label: "设备 ID",
    placeholder: "请输入设备 ID",
  },
  {
    value: "name",
    label: "设备名称",
    placeholder: "请输入设备名称",
  },
  {
    value: "desc",
    label: "设备描述",
    placeholder: "请输入设备描述",
  },
];

function handleSearch(data: SearchResult) {
  recentSearches.value = data.recentSearches;
  latestResult.value = data;
}

function handleChange(value: string) {
  latestChange.value = value;
}

function resetModel() {
  model.value = {};
  keyword.value = "";
}
</script>
```

### Controlled history

Example source: src/search/__demos__/local-storage.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-search
      v-model="keyword"
      :style="inputStyle"
      placeholder="业务侧使用 localStorage 保存搜索历史"
      :recent-searches="recentSearches"
      @search="handleSearch"
    />
    <c-button @click="clearRecentSearches">Clear History</c-button>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SearchResult } from "@cedar-design/ui";

const inputStyle = { width: "360px" };
const storageKey = "__cedar_search_history__";

const keyword = ref("");
const recentSearches = ref<string[]>(loadRecentSearches());

function loadRecentSearches() {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || "[]");
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveRecentSearches(list: string[]) {
  localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(list));
  recentSearches.value = list;
}

function handleSearch(data: SearchResult) {
  saveRecentSearches(data.recentSearches);
}

function clearRecentSearches() {
  saveRecentSearches([]);
}
</script>
```

### Controlled Fields

Example source: src/search/__demos__/en-US/controlled-fields.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SearchResult } from "@cedar-design/ui";

const field = ref("name");
const model = ref<Record<string, unknown>>({
  name: "Device A",
  tenant: "demo",
});
const accepted = ref(true);
const history = ref(["Device A", "42"]);
const result = ref<SearchResult>();
const fields = [
  { value: "name", label: "Device name", placeholder: "Enter name" },
  { value: "id", label: "Device ID", placeholder: "Enter ID" },
];
function updateModel(proposal: Record<string, unknown>) {
  if (accepted.value) model.value = proposal;
}
function updateField(proposal: string) {
  if (accepted.value) field.value = proposal;
}
function search(next: SearchResult) {
  result.value = next;
  history.value = next.recentSearches;
}
</script>
<template>
  <div class="search-demo">
    <c-checkbox v-model="accepted"
      >Accept updates (uncheck to demonstrate controlled rejection)</c-checkbox
    >
    <c-search
      :model="model"
      :model-field="field"
      :fields="fields"
      :recent-searches="history"
      edit-mode="direct"
      search-button
      button-text="Search"
      clearable
      @update:model="updateModel"
      @update:model-field="updateField"
      @search="search"
    />
    <c-button
      variant="text"
      @click="model = { name: 'External value', tenant: 'demo' }"
      >Replace model externally</c-button
    >
    <div>Accepted model：{{ model }}</div>
    <pre v-if="result">{{ JSON.stringify(result, null, 2) }}</pre>
  </div>
</template>
<style scoped>
.search-demo {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.search-demo pre {
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>
```

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Props

| Arguments                  | Description                                                                             | Type                      | Default                               |
| -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `v-model`                  | Search keyword                                                                          | _string_                  | `-`                                   |
| `default-value`            | Uncontrolled default keyword                                                            | _string_                  | `''`                                  |
| `v-model:model-field`      | Current search field                                                                    | _string_                  | `-`                                   |
| `default-field`            | Uncontrolled default field                                                              | _string_                  | `-`                                   |
| `v-model:model`            | Object updated by field in field-search mode                                            | _Record<string, unknown>_ | `-`                                   |
| `fields`                   | Search field options                                                                    | _SearchField[]_           | `[]`                                  |
| `select-style`             | Field selector style                                                                    | _StyleValue_              | `-`                                   |
| `recent-searches`          | Controlled search history                                                               | _string[]_                | `[]`                                  |
| `max-search-history-count` | Maximum items in the next history list                                                  | _number_                  | `5`                                   |
| `edit-mode`                | Search editing mode: direct searches in place; popup opens the search editor in a popup | `'direct' \| 'popup'`     | `'direct'`                            |
| `search-button`            | Whether to show the shared search button                                                | _boolean_                 | `false`                               |
| `button-text`              | Shared search button text                                                               | _string_                  | `-`                                   |
| `button-props`             | Shared search button props                                                              | _ButtonProps_             | `-`                                   |
| `loading`                  | Loading state; submission is blocked while loading                                      | _boolean_                 | `false`                               |
| `clearable`                | Whether the value can be cleared                                                        | _boolean_                 | `false`                               |
| `variant`                  | Input variant: `filled`, `outline`, or `standard`                                       | _string_                  | `outline`                             |
| `size`                     | Input size inherited from Form / ConfigProvider                                         | `xs / sm / md / lg / xl`  | `md`                                  |
| `placeholder`              | Placeholder                                                                             | _string_                  | `-`                                   |
| `disabled`                 | Whether disabled                                                                        | _boolean_                 | `false`                               |
| `readonly`                 | Whether readonly                                                                        | _boolean_                 | `false`                               |
| `label`                    | Text to the left of the search input                                                    | _string_                  | `-`                                   |
| `shape`                    | Inner field shape: `round` or `square`                                                  | _string_                  | `square`                              |
| `background`               | Outer background color                                                                  | _string_                  | `-`                                   |
| `input-background`         | Inner field background color                                                            | _string_                  | `-`                                   |
| `show-action`              | Whether to show the mobile action                                                       | _boolean_                 | `false`                               |
| `action-text`              | Action button text                                                                      | `string`                  | Follows global locale and action-type |
| `action-type`              | Action type: `cancel` or `search`                                                       | _string_                  | `cancel`                              |
| `search-icon`              | Search icon name                                                                        | _string_                  | `magnify`                             |
| `max-length`               | Maximum length                                                                          | _string \| number_        | `-`                                   |
| `enterkeyhint`             | Virtual keyboard Enter hint                                                             | _string_                  | `search`                              |

### Events

| Event               | Description                                              | Callback arguments                   |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `update:modelValue` | Emitted when the keyword updates                         | `value: string`                      |
| `update:modelField` | Emitted when the field updates                           | `field: string`                      |
| `update:model`      | Emitted when the field model updates                     | `model: Record<string, unknown>`     |
| `input`             | Emitted during live editing                              | `value: string, event: Event`        |
| `change`            | Emitted on blur, Enter commit, or field change           | `value: string, event: Event`        |
| `clear`             | Emitted when clearing                                    | `event: Event`                       |
| `search`            | Emitted by the icon, button, Enter, or history selection | `result: SearchResult, event: Event` |
| `focus`             | Emitted on focus                                         | `event: FocusEvent`                  |
| `blur`              | Emitted on blur                                          | `event: FocusEvent`                  |
| `cancel`            | Emitted by the mobile cancel action                      | `event: Event`                       |

### Slots

| Name             | Description                                    | Arguments   |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ----------- |
| `prefix`         | Input prefix; replaces the default search icon | `-`         |
| `suffix`         | Input suffix                                   | `-`         |
| `clear-icon`     | Clear icon                                     | `{ clear }` |
| `button-default` | Shared search button content                   | `-`         |
| `button-icon`    | Shared search button icon                      | `-`         |
| `label`          | Left label                                     | `-`         |
| `action`         | Action content                                 | `-`         |

### Methods

| Method  | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| ------- | ----------- | --------- | ------- |
| `focus` | Focus       | `-`       | `-`     |
| `blur`  | Blur        | `-`       | `-`     |

### SearchField

| Arguments     | Description                                         | Type     |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| `label`       | Field label                                         | _string_ |
| `value`       | Field value                                         | _string_ |
| `placeholder` | Field `placeholder`; overrides Search `placeholder` | _string_ |

### SearchResult

| Arguments        | Description         | Type                                   |
| ---------------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `modelField`     | Search field        | _string \| undefined_                  |
| `modelValue`     | Raw search keyword  | _string_                               |
| `model`          | Field model object  | _Record<string, unknown> \| undefined_ |
| `recentSearches` | Next search history | _string[]_                             |

Input event contract: editing emits `input` before `update:modelValue`; committing on blur emits `change` only for a changed value. Clearing emits `clear → input → update:modelValue → change` once, updates the search field model once, and does not submit a search.

input fires before model updates. Enter waits for Input submission and controlled-value reconciliation before producing search results. If the parent rejects a trim proposal, search still uses the actual controlled value. Clearing notifies clear → input → update:modelValue → change without automatically searching.

## Controlled-model protocol

Value precedence is `modelValue` > `model`[current field] > uncontrolled `defaultValue`. With `model` and a current field, missing/null values display an empty string. Keep simultaneously bound models consistent in the parent. `modelField` overrides `defaultField` and the first field. Internal logic never forcibly overrides controlled values.

`model` is not mutated in place. Every logical update emits a new `update:model` object, clearing other declared fields while retaining undeclared properties. Use `v-model:model` or explicitly accept proposals. Switching fields produces one `update:modelField → update:modelValue → update:model → change` sequence. Parents can reject proposals. Enter/button/history searches wait one update cycle, then read the actually accepted field, keyword and `model`.

History is neither filtered by current input nor persisted internally. New history returned by `search` is trimmed, emptied entries removed, deduplicated and limited to the configured maximum. Empty keywords are not added. Nonfinite/negative limits are treated as 0. Clearing does not `search`; cancel proposes an empty string and emits cancel/change without searching.

Editing emits `input → update:modelValue`; changed commits emit `change`. Clear emits `clear → input → update:modelValue → change` once. Disabled, readonly and loading block search, cancel, history and field actions. Form / FormItem / InputGroup state is inherited. Deactivation or unmount cancels pending asynchronous search.

### Platform boundaries

The controller, public API and history content are independently copied. Both default to `presentation=inline`; Cedar defaults to `shape=square` and Maple to `shape=round`. Fullscreen history uses local Drawer / Popup instances. Desktop InputGroup and mobile search-bar layout/touch spacing remain independent. Input supports `xs/sm/md/lg/xl`; outer bar density is configured by Search tokens rather than scaled by size.

### Public types

`SearchPresentation`、`SearchProps`, `SearchEmits`, `SearchSlots`, `SearchExpose`, `SearchField`, `SearchResult`.

### Forwarded Input props

Explicit Input props include `modelModifiers`, `type`, `ariaLabel`, `placeholder`, `maxLength`, `readonly`, `disabled`, `autofocus`, `enterkeyhint`, `textColor`, `focusColor`, `blurColor`, `size`, `variant`, `clearable`, `inputAttrs` and `error`. `inputAttrs` carries native name/autocomplete/ARIA attributes to both outer and fullscreen Input; `error` overrides inherited `error` state. Search actions, popup cancellation and dialog labels follow the global locale. Programmatic cancel, field and history selection notify Form change once; native edits retain the Input event pipeline.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty.
Text and person-ID models remain strings; use an empty string or a business-defined string sentinel.
