<!-- Source: src/select/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/select/ -->

# Select

Single or multiple selection with array options, controlled values and shared field presentation.

## Reading direction

Select inherits source `dir`. Standalone fields align to inline start; FormItem content-align still takes precedence when inherited. Explicit left/right alignment remains physical. Tags keep their array order and empty-search Backspace removes the last closable value. Dropdowns and picker panels retain source direction, including in a custom popup-container.

## Async arrays and clearing

useAsyncData is a public composable exported by @cedar-design/use. Pass a loader to that composable and bind its data/loading to Select. Options remain arrays. An initialization call is per owner; share a parent result to avoid duplicate loading.

empty-value sets the single-selection clear result. Omitted preserves the existing behavior: empty string unless an empty-string option exists, in which case clearing may produce undefined. The event types include undefined. Multiple selection keeps its array semantics and cannot clear disabled selected options.

case-sensitive defaults to false. search-fields defaults to ['label']; ['value', 'label'] matches either field. Custom filters retain priority.

| Variable                              | Default                             |
| ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `--c-select-popup-option-check-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-action-primary)` |
| `--c-select-popup-option-check-size`  | `var(--c-sys-font-size-md)`         |
| `--c-select-popup-option-check-gap`   | `var(--c-sys-space-4)`              |

## Selection modes and options

### Multiple

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose                                                                 | Related examples                     |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder                                                             | Multiple, Same Label, Optgroup       |
| `multiple`    | Multiple selection; enables search by default                           | Multiple, Same Label, Optgroup       |
| `clearable`   | Allow clearing; preserve disabled selections                            | Multiple, Same Label, Options Review |
| `filterable`  | Enable search; optionally retainInputValue                              | Same Label, Options Review           |
| `options`     | Primitive, object or grouped options; one source for every presentation | Same Label, Group Spacing            |
| `scrollbar`   | Whether to enable virtual scroll bar                                    | Multiple                             |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

### Options Review

Example source: src/select/__demos__/options-review.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch } from 'vue'
const multiple = ref(true)
const filterable = ref(true)
const disabled = ref(false)
const value = ref<string | string[] | undefined>([])
watch(multiple, (next) => { value.value = next ? [] : undefined })
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-space>
      <c-checkbox v-model="multiple">多选</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="filterable">允许搜索</c-checkbox>
      <c-checkbox v-model="disabled">禁用研发选项</c-checkbox>
      <c-button @click="value = multiple ? [] : undefined">清空选择</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-select v-model="value" :multiple="multiple" :filterable="filterable" clearable placeholder="子组件选项审查" :style="{ width: '280px' }">
      <c-optgroup label="研发组">
        <template #label><c-tag>研发组插槽</c-tag></template>
        <c-option value="dev" label="研发" :disabled="disabled" :tag-props="{ size: 'sm' }" :index="0">
          <template #default="{ selected }"><c-tag>{{ selected ? '已选研发' : '选择研发' }}</c-tag></template>
          <template #icon><c-tag>图标</c-tag></template>
          <template #suffix><c-tag>后缀</c-tag></template>
        </c-option>
      </c-optgroup>
    </c-select>
    <p role="status">当前值：{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Search and filtering

### Filterable

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration    | Purpose                                                                 | Related examples                             |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `placeholder`    | Placeholder                                                             | Filterable, Search Matching, Dropdown Scroll |
| `options`        | Primitive, object or grouped options; one source for every presentation | Filterable, Search Matching, Virtual List    |
| `filterable`     | Enable search; optionally retainInputValue                              | Filterable, Search Matching                  |
| `loading`        | Loading state; blocks selection and confirmation                        | Filterable                                   |
| `multiple`       | Multiple selection; enables search by default                           | Filterable                                   |
| `case-sensitive` | Case-sensitive built-in filtering; custom filters take priority         | Search Matching                              |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

Example source: src/select/__demos__/filterable.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <c-select :style="{ width: '320px' }" placeholder="Please select ..." filterable>
      <c-option>Beijing</c-option>
      <c-option>Shanghai</c-option>
      <c-option>Guangzhou</c-option>
      <c-option disabled>Disabled</c-option>
      <c-option>Shenzhen</c-option>
      <c-option>Chengdu</c-option>
      <c-option>Wuhan</c-option>
    </c-select>
    <c-select :style="{ width: '320px' }" placeholder="Please select ..." :filterable="{ retainInputValue: true }">
      <c-option>Beijing</c-option>
      <c-option>Shanghai</c-option>
      <c-option>Guangzhou</c-option>
      <c-option disabled>Disabled</c-option>
      <c-option>Shenzhen</c-option>
      <c-option>Chengdu</c-option>
      <c-option>Wuhan</c-option>
    </c-select>
    <c-select
      :options="options"
      :style="{ width: '320px' }"
      :loading="loading"
      placeholder="Please select ..."
      multiple
      @search="handleSearch" />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent, ref } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const options = ref(['Option1', 'Option2', 'Option3'])
    const loading = ref(false)

    const handleSearch = (value: any) => {
      if (value) {
        loading.value = true
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          options.value = [`${value}-Option1`, `${value}-Option2`, `${value}-Option3`]
          loading.value = false
        }, 2000)
      } else {
        options.value = []
      }
    }

    return {
      options,
      loading,
      handleSearch,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

### Search Matching

Example source: src/select/__demos__/search-matching.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
const value = ref("");
const mode = ref("label");
const caseSensitive = ref(false);
const modes = [
  { value: "label", label: "默认：只匹配 label" },
  { value: "both", label: "配置：value 或 label" },
];
const options = [
  { value: "USER_A", label: "Apple" },
  { value: "USER_B", label: "Banana" },
];
const searchFields = computed<("label" | "value")[]>(() =>
  mode.value === "both" ? ["value", "label"] : ["label"],
);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch" fill>
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="匹配字段">
      <c-radio-group
        v-model="mode"
        aria-label="匹配字段"
        :options="modes"
        variant="button"
        size="sm"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-space
      ><c-switch v-model="caseSensitive" /><span>区分大小写</span></c-space
    >
    <c-select
      v-model="value"
      :options="options"
      :case-sensitive="caseSensitive"
      :search-fields="searchFields"
      :search-delay="0"
      filterable
      placeholder="输入 Apple、apple 或 USER_A"
    />
    <p>
      默认搜索 label，不区分大小写；配置两字段后，USER_A 和 Apple
      都能找到同一个选项。
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Value model and linked fields

### Selection Data Flow

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration                 | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                 | Related examples                                                 |
| ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`                     | Primitive, object or grouped options; one source for every presentation                                                                                                                 | Selection Data Flow, Linkage, Empty recognition and clear output |
| `clearable`                   | Allow clearing; preserve disabled selections                                                                                                                                            | Empty recognition and clear output, Interaction state comparison |
| `edit-mode`                   | Field presentation; inherits FormItem/Form when omitted                                                                                                                                 | Selection Data Flow                                              |
| `default-active-first-option` | On opening, activate the first enabled candidate if no valid selected option exists. Highlighting does not update modelValue or emit change; an existing valid selection takes priority | Selection Data Flow                                              |
| `placeholder`                 | Placeholder                                                                                                                                                                             | Selection Data Flow                                              |
| `empty-value`                 | Clear output override; return an array for multiple selection and preserve protected items                                                                                              | Empty recognition and clear output                               |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

Example source: src/select/__demos__/selection-data-flow.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, reactive, ref } from "vue";

const props = defineProps<{ english?: boolean }>();
const autoFirst = ref(true);
const generation = ref(0);
const form = reactive<{ city?: string; panelCity?: string }>({
  city: undefined,
  panelCity: undefined,
});
const logs = reactive<{ inline: string[]; panel: string[] }>({
  inline: [],
  panel: [],
});
const counts = reactive({ inline: 0, panel: 0 });
const options = computed(() => [
  { label: props.english ? "Hangzhou" : "杭州", value: "hangzhou" },
  { label: props.english ? "Shanghai" : "上海", value: "shanghai" },
  {
    label: props.english ? "Beijing (disabled)" : "北京（禁用）",
    value: "beijing",
    disabled: true,
  },
]);
function show(value: unknown) {
  return value === undefined ? "undefined" : JSON.stringify(value);
}
function record(kind: "inline" | "panel", event: string, value: unknown) {
  if (event === "update:modelValue") {
    counts[kind]++;
  }
  logs[kind].unshift(`${event}(${show(value)})`);
  logs[kind].splice(8);
}
function reset() {
  generation.value++;
  form.city = undefined;
  form.panelCity = undefined;
  counts.inline = counts.panel = 0;
  logs.inline = [];
  logs.panel = [];
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="selection-data-flow">
    <c-checkbox v-model="autoFirst" @change="reset"
      >defaultActiveFirstOption = {{ autoFirst }}</c-checkbox
    >
    <c-button @click="reset">{{
      english ? "Reset both forms and logs" : "重置两组表单和日志"
    }}</c-button>
    <p>
      {{
        english
          ? "Each field starts empty. Open it and inspect the highlighted candidate: highlighting does not select a city. Change the switch to remount both fields."
          : "两组字段初始都没有值。打开后观察候选行的高亮：高亮不代表选中城市。切换开关会重建两组字段，便于从空值重新比较。"
      }}
    </p>

    <section>
      <h4>
        inline · {{ english ? "Selection commits immediately" : "选择即提交" }}
      </h4>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" hide-label>
        <c-select
          :key="`inline-${generation}`"
          v-model="form.city"
          edit-mode="direct"
          :options="options"
          :default-active-first-option="autoFirst"
          :placeholder="english ? 'Choose a city' : '请选择城市'"
          @update:model-value="record('inline', 'update:modelValue', $event)"
          @change="record('inline', 'change', $event)"
          @open-change="record('inline', 'open-change', $event)"
        >
          <template #footer>
            <p class="panel-value">
              form.city = {{ show(form.city) }} · update:modelValue ×
              {{ counts.inline }}
            </p>
          </template>
        </c-select>
      </c-form-item>
      <p>
        {{
          english
            ? "Move with arrow keys, then press Enter, or click a city. Closing without selecting leaves the form unchanged."
            : "上下键移动后按 Enter，或点击城市，才更新表单。只打开、移动候选或关闭，不更新表单。"
        }}
      </p>
      <p role="status">
        form.city = <code>{{ show(form.city) }}</code> · update:modelValue ×
        {{ counts.inline }}
      </p>
      <ol v-if="logs.inline.length" aria-live="polite">
        <li v-for="(entry, index) in logs.inline" :key="index">
          <code>{{ entry }}</code>
        </li>
      </ol>
      <p v-else>
        {{ english ? "No component events yet." : "尚无组件事件。" }}
      </p>
    </section>

    <section>
      <h4>
        click · {{ english ? "Confirm commits the draft" : "确认后提交草稿" }}
      </h4>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" hide-label>
        <c-select
          :key="`panel-${generation}`"
          v-model="form.panelCity"
          edit-mode="click"
          :options="options"
          :default-active-first-option="autoFirst"
          :placeholder="
            english ? 'Choose a city, then confirm' : '选择城市后确认'
          "
          @update:model-value="record('panel', 'update:modelValue', $event)"
          @change="record('panel', 'change', $event)"
          @open-change="record('panel', 'open-change', $event)"
        >
          <template #footer>
            <p class="panel-value">
              {{ english ? "Committed form value" : "已提交表单值" }}：{{
                show(form.panelCity)
              }}
              · update:modelValue × {{ counts.panel }}
            </p>
          </template>
        </c-select>
      </c-form-item>
      <p>
        {{
          english
            ? "Choose a city in the editor: the selection mark is a draft. Confirm saves it; cancel or Escape discards it. Highlighting a candidate alone is not a draft selection."
            : "在编辑面板选择城市后，勾选标记表示草稿；确认才保存，取消或 Escape 丢弃草稿。只有候选高亮、尚未选择，不算草稿选择。"
        }}
      </p>
      <p role="status">
        form.panelCity = <code>{{ show(form.panelCity) }}</code> ·
        update:modelValue × {{ counts.panel }}
      </p>
      <ol v-if="logs.panel.length" aria-live="polite">
        <li v-for="(entry, index) in logs.panel" :key="index">
          <code>{{ entry }}</code>
        </li>
      </ol>
      <p v-else>
        {{ english ? "No component events yet." : "尚无组件事件。" }}
      </p>
    </section>
    <p>
      {{
        english
          ? "Logs are newest first. open-change only changes panel visibility; update:modelValue is the event that writes the form value."
          : "日志按最新在前排列。open-change 只表示打开或关闭面板；update:modelValue 才对应表单值更新。"
      }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>

  min-width: 0;
}
```

### Linkage

Example source: src/select/__demos__/linkage.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space>
    <c-select :style="{ width: '200px' }" v-model="province">
      <c-option v-for="value of Object.keys(data)" :key="value">{{ value }}</c-option>
    </c-select>
    <c-select :style="{ width: '200px' }" :options="data[province] || []" v-model="city" />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent, ref, watch } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const province = ref('Sichuan')
    const city = ref('Chengdu')
    const data = {
      Beijing: ['Haidian', 'Chaoyang', 'Changping'],
      Sichuan: ['Chengdu', 'Mianyang', 'Aba'],
      Guangdong: ['Guangzhou', 'Shenzhen', 'Shantou'],
    }

    watch(province, () => {
      city.value = ''
    })

    return {
      province,
      city,
      data,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

### Empty recognition and clear output

This example keeps an empty string as the valid All option and clears to null. Compare the selected All option with the cleared state in the model output. Deleting the search query does not remove the selected value. The additional fields show multiple selection clearing to [] and a factory explicitly producing undefined, each with its own model output.

Example source: src/select/__demos__/en-US/empty-value.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const model = reactive({ status: "" as string | null });
const multiple = ref(["active"]);
const optional = ref<string | undefined>("active");
const options = [
  { value: "", label: "All" },
  { value: "active", label: "Active" },
];
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>
      All uses an empty string as a valid option value. Clearing produces null.
    </p>
    <c-form :model="model" layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item field="status" label="Status">
        <c-select
          v-model="model.status"
          :options="options"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-values="[null, undefined]"
          :empty-value="null"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-button @click="model.status = ''">Choose All</c-button>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ JSON.stringify(model.status) }}</output>
    </p>
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item label="Multiple: clear to []">
        <c-select
          v-model="multiple"
          :options="options"
          edit-mode="direct"
          multiple
          clearable
          :empty-value="() => []"
        />
        <output>{{ JSON.stringify(multiple) }}</output>
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="Single: clear to undefined">
        <c-select
          v-model="optional"
          :options="options"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-value="() => undefined"
        />
        <output>{{ String(optional) }}</output>
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Search

Example source: src/select/__demos__/search.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <div>Show selections after search options</div>
    <c-select
      :style="{ width: '320px' }"
      :loading="loading"
      placeholder="Please select ..."
      multiple
      :filter-option="false"
      @search="handleSearch"
    >
      <c-option v-for="item of options" :key="item" :value="item">{{ item }}</c-option>
    </c-select>
    <div>Hide selections after search options</div>
    <c-select
      :options="options"
      :style="{ width: '320px' }"
      :loading="loading"
      placeholder="Please select ..."
      multiple
      :filter-option="false"
      :show-extr-options="false"
      @search="handleSearch" />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import { defineComponent, ref } from 'vue'
export default defineComponent({
  setup() {
    const options = ref(['Option1', 'Option2', 'Option3'])
    const loading = ref(false)

    const handleSearch = (value: any) => {
      if (value) {
        loading.value = true
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          options.value = [`${value}-Option1`, `${value}-Option2`, `${value}-Option3`]
          loading.value = false
        }, 2000)
      } else {
        options.value = []
      }
    }

    return {
      options,
      loading,
      handleSearch,
    }
  },
})
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const value = ref([2])
const options = ref<{ id: number; name: string; disabled?: boolean }[]>([])
const loading = ref(false)
async function load() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    options.value = await Promise.resolve(Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, index) => ({
      id: index + 1, name: `设备 ${index + 1}`, disabled: index === 3,
    })))
  } finally { loading.value = false }
}
</script>
<template>

    <c-select v-model="value" :options="options" :loading="loading"

      :limit="3" multiple filterable clearable placeholder="最多选择三个设备" />
    <p>已提交 ID：{{ value }}。加载前显示 ID，加载后自动回显名称。</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Async Data

Example source: src/select/__demos__/en-US/async-data.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const value = ref('')
// Replace this loader body with your API and response mapping.
async function request(query: string, { signal }: { signal: AbortSignal }) {
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const abort = () => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(new Error('Cancelled')) }
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort); resolve() }, 300)
    if (signal.aborted) { abort(); return }
    signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true })
  })
  return [{ value: 'a', label: 'Alice' }, { value: 'b', label: 'Bob' }].filter(option => option.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))
}
const error = ref('')
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-select v-model="value" :options="request" filterable @load-error="error = 'Load failed'" />
    <p role="alert">{{ error }}</p>
    <p>Selected: {{ value }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Configuration and lifecycle

### Passthrough Options

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration         | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                 | Related examples                                              |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`             | Primitive, object or grouped options; one source for every presentation                                                                                                                 | Passthrough Options, Scheduler Lifecycle, Copying and editing |
| `edit-mode`           | Field presentation; inherits FormItem/Form when omitted                                                                                                                                 | Passthrough Options, Copying and editing                      |
| `trigger-props`       | Optional dropdown Trigger settings. Placement defaults to bottom-start and automatically adjusts when space is limited. The field owns open state; there is no top-level placement prop | Passthrough Options                                           |
| `open-trigger-target` | Pointer opening target: the whole field or only the suffix icon. Explicit keyboard opening and controlled open remain available.                                                        | Copying and editing                                           |
| `filterable`          | Enable search; optionally retainInputValue                                                                                                                                              | Copying and editing                                           |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

Example source: src/select/__demos__/passthrough-options.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { SelectTriggerOptions } from "@cedar-design/ui";
const open = ref(false);
const triggerOptions: SelectTriggerOptions = {
  placement: "top-start",
  popupOffset: 8,
  popupContainer: false,
};
const options = [
  { value: "USER_A", label: "Apple" },
  { value: "USER_B", label: "Banana" },
];
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" fill>
    <c-button @click="open = !open">{{
      open ? "关闭面板" : "打开面板"
    }}</c-button>
    <c-select
      edit-mode="direct"
      v-model:open="open"
      :options="options"
      :trigger-props="triggerOptions"
      aria-label="透传配置示例"
    />
    <p role="status">顶层 open：{{ open }}；嵌套配置：向上展开并调整偏移。</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Select

| Prop                                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                             | Type                                                        | Default                          |
| --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `open-trigger-target`                         | Pointer opening target: the whole field or only the suffix icon. Explicit keyboard opening and controlled open remain available.                                                        | `'field' \| 'icon'`                                         | `'field'`                        |
| `model-value / default-value`                 | Controlled value / uncontrolled initial value                                                                                                                                           | `Value`                                                     | `Single: ''; multiple: []`       |
| `open / default-open`                         | Controlled / initial open state                                                                                                                                                         | `boolean`                                                   | `undefined / false`              |
| `input-value / default-input-value`           | Search text, independent of selected values                                                                                                                                             | `string`                                                    | `undefined / ''`                 |
| `multiple`                                    | Multiple selection; enables search by default                                                                                                                                           | `boolean`                                                   | `false`                          |
| `size`                                        | Supports all five sizes; inherits group/form settings                                                                                                                                   | `ComponentSize`                                             | `md`                             |
| `variant`                                     | filled, outline, standard; inherits InputGroup                                                                                                                                          | `FormControlVariant`                                        | `filled`                         |

### Scheduler Lifecycle

Example source: src/select/__demos__/scheduler-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const active = ref(true);
const open = ref(false);
const value = ref("Item 101");
const options = Array.from(
  { length: 200 },
  (_, index) => "Item " + (index + 1),
);
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <c-button @click="open = !open">Open / close</c-button>
    <c-button @click="active = !active">Activate / deactivate</c-button>
    <p>
      Open the menu, navigate with Arrow keys, then close or deactivate. Old
      scrolling must not replay.
    </p>
    <KeepAlive>
      <c-select
        v-if="active"
        v-model="value"
        v-model:open="open"
        :options="options"
        style="width: 240px"
      />
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Api Review

### Copying and editing

With open-trigger-target="icon", use the input area to edit or copy and the suffix button to open. Existing text remains copyable when editing or search is disabled.

Example source: src/select/__demos__/open-trigger-target.en-US.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch">
    <c-radio-group
      v-model="target"
      :options="[
        { label: 'Whole field', value: 'field' },
        { label: 'Suffix icon only', value: 'icon' },
      ]"
    />
    <label><c-switch v-model="editable" /> Allow editing / search</label>
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" hide-label>
      <c-select
        v-model="value"
        edit-mode="direct"
        :open-trigger-target="target"
        :filterable="editable"
        :options="[
          { value: 'a', label: 'Alpha' },
          { value: 'b', label: 'Beta' },
        ]"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <p>
      Disable editing to copy existing text. In icon mode, editing does not open
      the panel.
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const target = ref<"field" | "icon">("icon");
const editable = ref(true);
const value = ref("a");
</script>
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

Selected rows show a primary-colored right-side checkmark in both single/multiple modes; candidate highlighting alone does not. In click/dblclick editors, checkmarks reflect draft selection, committed to Form only on confirmation. Disabled selected items retain disabled appearance.

### Cleared values and 1.x compatibility

`SelectValue` includes `undefined`. By default, single-select clear emits `''`; if the current options contain a `value: ''` option, it emits `undefined` to distinguish clearing from selecting that option. This published behavior is preserved. Both `change` and `update:modelValue` use `SelectValue`.

`empty-value` defines clear output; omission preserves the existing fallback. Single selection can use `() => undefined` to explicitly return undefined; multiple selection should return an array matching its model shape. Protected disabled selections take priority and prevent the clear override from running. Controlled mode still requires parent acceptance.

Root and component entries export `SelectValue` and `SelectEmptyValue`.

### Select props

Use `v-model`, `v-model:open` and `v-model:input-value` for controlled state. Clear values are `''` for single selection and `[]` for multiple selection. Select uses `undefined` when an actual empty-string option exists.

### Events and methods

- `update:modelValue`, `change(value)`: emitted on commit, not while editing a draft.
- `update:open`, `open-change(open)`: request an expanded-state change.
- `update:inputValue`, `input-value-change(text)`, `search(text)`: search state.
- `focus(event)`, `blur(event)`, `clear(event)`: native field events; only the field owner notifies Form.
- Methods: `focus()`, `blur()`.

Select also emits `remove(value)`, `exceed-limit(value, event)`, `dropdown-scroll(event)`, and `dropdown-reach-bottom(event)`.

### Slots and option data

Use `label({ data })` for custom `selected` labels; `selected` replaces the whole selection area. Also supports `prefix`, `suffix`, `clear-icon({ clear })`, `arrow-icon`, `loading-icon`, `search-icon`, `empty`, and `option({ data })`.

Option `label` is searchable plain text. Use `render` or the `option` slot for custom `option` content, and `format-label` or `label` slot for selected content. Values identify selections; labels never do. `disabled` blocks selection/removal, and `tagProps` customizes selected tags.

Select additionally supports `header`, `footer`, `trigger`, and default `Option / Optgroup` children. Option props: `value`, `label`, `disabled`, `tagProps`, `index`; its default slot receives `selected`. Group data uses `{ isGroup: true, label, options }`. List and Picker also accept slot options; Picker displays their text labels.

Single/multiple options both use popup-option-padding-horizontal. There is no implicit search-highlight DOM; custom option slots style their own highlighted fragments. Unused multi-popup-option-padding-horizontal and popup-option-highlight-* variables are removed.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

### Public type exports

Root and component entries export `SelectEmits`、`SelectSlots`、`SelectExpose` alongside Props and Instance. Emits are event argument tuples derived from the runtime validators; Expose contains focus/blur.

### Built-in search fields

`searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node.

## Loading options through a function prop

Pass options(query, { signal }) directly; useAsyncData is unnecessary. options still accepts arrays, and an explicit array, including [], takes precedence. The component manages loading, stale-result isolation and cancellation. load-error reports failures, and the instance refresh() method retries. A business loader may accept only query and ignore the second argument.

filterable enables entering a search query. filterOption controls only local matching and never sends requests. With an options loader, remote results are not filtered again by default; with only an array, local matching is enabled by default. Most callers do not need filter-option.

```vue
<c-select v-model="value" :options="loadOptions" filterable />
```

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise&lt;void&gt; allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

## Shared implementation and platform boundaries

Each platform maintains a complete local implementation. They do not import a common core or share component instances or reactive state. Changes must update both implementations. Component bodies, props, key styles and paired tests have read-only source consistency checks; theme tokens and installation entries remain local to each library.

Skeleton, SkeletonLine and SkeletonShape use independently copied source. Each library maintains its skeleton theme and size tokens.

### Motion variables

| Token | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-skeleton-animation-duration` | `1s` |
| `--c-skeleton-transition-duration` | `var(--c-sys-motion-duration-slow)` |

Built-in motion follows prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, preserving content/state feedback while disabling decorative spinning, shimmer and ripples. Icon name changes skip waiting and cancel unfinished transitions. Ripple duration variables affect only CSS; the 250ms lifecycle timer remains unchanged, so each visual stage should not exceed 250ms. Callers must adapt custom animation classes.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Props

| Prop                                     | Description                                                                                                             | Type                             | Default        |
| ---------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | -------------- |
| model-value                              | Controlled value; range uses a tuple                                                                                    | `SliderValue`                    | —              |
| default-value                            | Initial uncontrolled value                                                                                              | `SliderValue`                    | `0`            |
| min / max                                | Finite bounds; numeric strings are accepted. Invalid values fall back to 0/100. max<=min blocks interaction             | `number \| string`               | `0 / 100`      |
| step                                     | Positive finite step aligned to min; max remains reachable                                                              | `number \| string`               | `1`            |
| range                                    | Fixed low/high thumbs; initial reversed values are sorted                                                               | `boolean`                        | `false`        |
| orientation                              | Horizontal/vertical axis of the slider track and interaction, default horizontal; not the direction of value increments | `horizontal \| vertical`         | `horizontal`   |
| disabled / readonly / error              | Inherits applicable FormItem/Form state when omitted; readonly is focusable but cannot change values                    | `boolean`                        | Inherited      |
| show-ticks                               | Show step ticks; dense ticks are reduced, up to 1000                                                                    | `boolean`                        | `false`        |
| marks                                    | Map positions within the finite range to text                                                                           | `Record<number,string>`          | —              |
| show-input                               | InputNumber; Enter or blur commits via the same model                                                                   | `boolean`                        | `false`        |
| show-tooltip                             | true on hover/focus/drag, false hidden, always persistent                                                               | `boolean \| 'always'`            | `true`         |
| format-tooltip                           | Formats tooltip and aria-valuetext                                                                                      | `(value:number)=>string\|number` | Original value |
| aria-label                               | Name, or separate names for range thumbs                                                                                | `string \| [string,string]`      | —              |
| active-color / track-color / thumb-color | Active track/background/thumb fill colors                                                                               | `string`                         | CSS variable   |
| label-color / label-text-color           | Tooltip background/text colors                                                                                          | `string`                         | CSS variable   |
| track-height / thumb-size                | Track thickness/thumb diameter in numeric px or CSS lengths; invalid values retain theme defaults                       | `number \| string`               | CSS variable   |

### Behavior and keyboard

Arrows adjust by step, PageUp/PageDown by 10 steps, Home/End reach available endpoints. Range-thumb ARIA min/max follow the other thumb. When overlapping, clicks left/down separate the lower thumb, right/up the upper thumb. Keyboard events inside interactive thumb content are not intercepted. Readonly retains focus/tooltips; disabled leaves the Tab sequence.

Pointer Events unify mouse, touch and pen. pointerup commits final coordinates; pointercancel/lost capture ends the latest proposal. Disabling, unmounting or KeepAlive deactivation cleans listeners/capture and stops value events. Horizontal sliders allow vertical page scrolling; vertical sliders allow horizontal scrolling.

Controlled display changes only after parent updates; normalization does not emit automatically. change/update:model-value report distinct proposals; end includes the final proposal without guaranteeing acceptance. Each keyboard/numeric-input operation has start/end; a drag has one pair. Internal InputNumber does not duplicate Form validation. label-visible is removed; use show-tooltip without a compatibility alias.

### Events

| Event              | Arguments     | Meaning                                               |
| ------------------ | ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| update:model-value | `SliderValue` | Request an update                                     |
| change             | `SliderValue` | Distinct numeric proposal paired with the model event |
| start              | —             | Interaction starts                                    |
| end                | `SliderValue` | Final proposal when interaction ends                  |

### Slots / Methods

The button slot receives `{ currentValue:number,index:number }`. Custom content retains keyboard, ARIA and tooltip behavior. focus(index=0) focuses thumbs in display order; blur() removes focus.

Exports SliderProps, SliderValue, SliderOrientation, SliderTooltipFormatter, SliderTooltipVisibility, SliderEmits, SliderSlots, SliderExpose, SliderInstance and runtime sliderProps. Component bodies/styles are independently copied; installation/Form integration remain local to each library.

### Style variables

| -------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `--c-slider-active-color`        | `var(--c-sys-color-content-brand)`     |
| `--c-slider-track-color`         | `var(--c-sys-color-state-hover)`       |
| `--c-slider-thumb-color`         | `var(--c-sys-color-surface-default)`   |
| `--c-slider-thumb-border-color`  | `var(--c-sys-color-content-brand)`     |
| `--c-slider-text-color`          | `var(--c-sys-color-content-secondary)` |
| `--c-slider-tooltip-background`  | `var(--c-sys-color-surface-tooltip)`   |
| `--c-slider-tooltip-color`       | `var(--c-sys-color-content-on-dark)`   |
| `--c-slider-error-color`         | `var(--c-sys-color-content-danger)`    |
| `--c-slider-disabled-color`      | `var(--c-sys-color-content-disabled)`  |
| `--c-slider-track-height`        | `4px`                                  |
| `--c-slider-thumb-size`          | `16px`                                 |
| `--c-slider-control-height`      | `var(--c-sys-control-height-md)`       |
| `--c-slider-font-size`           | `var(--c-sys-font-size-sm)`            |
| `--c-slider-gap`                 | `var(--c-sys-space-4)`                 |
| `--c-slider-radius`              | `var(--c-sys-radius-md)`               |
| `--c-slider-transition-duration` | `var(--c-sys-motion-duration-fast)`    |
| `--c-slider-input-width`         | `80px`                                 |

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

## Interaction and control

### Interactive Layout

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wrap` | Whether to exceed the line break | Interactive Layout |
| `size` | Gap: `xs`/`sm`/`md`/`lg`/`xl` or `[rowGap, columnGap]`, supporting CSS lengths and shorthand | Interactive Layout |
| `direction` | Row/column order of children, default row; column stacks them vertically. Does not use horizontal/vertical values | Interactive Layout |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `size`: Controls the component size.
- `direction`: Controls the content direction.

Example source: src/space/__demos__/interactive-layout.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const direction = ref<'row' | 'column'>('row')
const gap = ref(8)
const wrap = ref(false)
const count = ref(3)
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <c-space wrap :size="8">
      <c-button @click="direction = direction === 'row' ? 'column' : 'row'">Toggle direction</c-button>
      <c-button @click="gap = gap === 8 ? 24 : 8">Toggle gap</c-button>
      <c-button @click="wrap = !wrap">Toggle wrap</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="count >= 6" @click="count++">Add item</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="count <= 1" @click="count--">Remove item</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p aria-live="polite">{{ direction }} / gap {{ gap }} / wrap {{ wrap }} / items {{ count }}</p>
    <div style="max-width: 100%; overflow: auto">
      <c-space data-demo-layout :direction="direction" :size="[8, gap]" :wrap="wrap" style="width: 260px; max-width: 100%">
        <div v-for="item in count" :key="item" style="width: 72px; padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid currentColor">Item {{ item }}</div>
      </c-space>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`. Row layout follows reading order; column layout stays top to bottom. Flex-start/flex-end follows the corresponding flex axis. The size pair always means [rowGap,columnGap], including in RTL. Wrapping and split slots preserve content order. Direction changes do not reverse data or recreate children with stable keys.

## API

### Space Props

### Props

| Arguments | Description | Type | Default |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| direction | Row/column order of children, default row; column stacks them vertically. Does not use horizontal/vertical values | _string_ | `row` |
| justify | Main axis arrangement, Can be set to `flex-start` `flex-end` `center` `space-around` `space-between` `space-evenly` | _string_ | `flex-start` |
| align | Cross-axis alignment: `flex-start`, `flex-end`, `center`, `stretch` or `baseline`. When omitted, inferred from `direction`: `row` → `center`, `column` → `stretch` | _string_ | `-` |
| size | Gap: `xs`/`sm`/`md`/`lg`/`xl` or `[rowGap, columnGap]`, supporting CSS lengths and shorthand | _string \| number \| [string \| number, string \| number]_ | `md` |
| wrap | Whether to exceed the line break | _boolean_ | `false` |
| block | Whether to use a flex container | _boolean_ | `true` |

### Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| --------- | ---------- | ---- |
| `default` | Content of space | `-` |
| `split` | Range separator | `-` |

### Style variables

| Variable | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-space-size-xs-row-gap` | `var(--c-sys-space-2)` |
| `--c-space-size-xs-column-gap` | `var(--c-sys-space-2)` |
| `--c-space-size-sm-row-gap` | `var(--c-sys-space-4)` |
| `--c-space-size-sm-column-gap` | `var(--c-sys-space-3)` |
| `--c-space-size-md-row-gap` | `var(--c-sys-space-5)` |
| `--c-space-size-md-column-gap` | `var(--c-sys-space-4)` |
| `--c-space-size-lg-row-gap` | `var(--c-sys-space-6)` |
| `--c-space-size-lg-column-gap` | `var(--c-sys-space-5)` |
| `--c-space-size-xl-row-gap` | `var(--c-sys-space-8)` |
| `--c-space-size-xl-column-gap` | `var(--c-sys-space-6)` |

## Shared implementation and platform boundaries

Each platform maintains complete local source without a common core or shared instances/reactive state. Update both implementations together. Read-only parity checks cover bodies, props, child flattening, main styles, size tokens and paired tests. Only installation entries/namespaces are adapted locally.

Both default to `size="md"`, `wrap=false`, `block=true` and `direction="row"`. Omitted align means center for row and stretch for column. Maple callers previously relying on default wrapping must add `wrap` explicitly.

`size` supports all five presets, numbers/numeric strings in px, CSS lengths/expressions such as 1rem or var(--gap), and `[rowGap, columnGap]`. Arrays are always row then column; direction does not swap them. Array entries are lengths, not preset names. Shared [row,column] presets: xs=[4,4], sm=[8,6], md=[12,8], lg=[16,12], xl=[24,16] px, overridable through CSS variables.

# Split Button

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

- `placement`: Chooses the position relative to the trigger.

Example source: src/split-button/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Message } from "@cedar-design/ui";

const publish = () => {
  Message.info("发布成功");
};
const handleSelect = (_value: unknown, option: { label?: unknown }) => {
  Message.info(String(option.label));
};
</script>

<template>
  <c-split-button
    placement="bottom-end"
    @click="publish"
    @select="handleSelect"
  >
    发布

    <template #content>
      <c-menu-option label="保存草稿" value="draft" />
      <c-menu-option label="保存并发布" value="publish" />
      <c-menu-option label="暂无权限" value="restricted" disabled />
    </template>
  </c-split-button>
</template>
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
```

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |

```vue
  Message.info(String(option.label));
};

      placement="bottom-start"
      :offset-y="8"

      @select="handleSelect"

      选择操作

        <c-menu-option label="保存草稿" value="draft" />
        <c-menu-option label="保存并发布" value="publish" />
        <c-menu-option label="暂无权限" value="restricted" disabled />
```

```vue
        <c-menu-option label="保存草稿" value="draft" />
        <c-menu-option label="保存并发布" value="publish" />
        <c-menu-option label="暂无权限" value="restricted" disabled />
      </template>
    </c-split-button>
    <span aria-live="polite">{{ open ? "已展开" : "已关闭" }}</span>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Async and dynamic data

### Async Action

click is a normal emitted event and supports async handlers. Business state controls loading; restore it in finally. Listener Promises do not automatically drive loading. Disabled/loading links have no effective href.

Example source: src/split-button/__demos__/async-action.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { Message } from "@cedar-design/ui";

const completed = ref(0);
const publishing = ref(false)
const publish = async () => {
  if (publishing.value) return
  publishing.value = true
  try {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800))
    completed.value += 1
    Message.info('发布成功 / Published')
  } finally { publishing.value = false }
}
const handleSelect = (_value: unknown, option: { label?: unknown }) => {
  Message.info(String(option.label));
};
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="flex-start">
    <c-split-button :button-props="{ loading: publishing }" @click="publish" @select="handleSelect">
      发布

      <template #content>
        <c-menu-option label="保存草稿" value="draft" />
        <c-menu-option label="保存并发布" value="publish" />
        <c-menu-option label="暂无权限" value="restricted" disabled />
      </template>
    </c-split-button>
    <span aria-live="polite">完成次数: {{ completed }}</span>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

The primary action sits at reading start and the menu button at reading end. Direction changes neither swap actions nor select a value. Enter/Space retains native button behavior. Up/Down opens the menu and skips disabled items; Home/End focuses boundaries, Enter selects and Escape closes and restores focus. Popovers inherit the reference direction; start/end alignment follows reading direction while explicit left/right remains physical. Downward slot graphics are not mirrored.

## API

### `<split-button>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | :-------: |
| open **(v-model)** | Whether the menu is open | `boolean` | `-` |
| default-open | Default menu open state in uncontrolled mode | `boolean` | `false` |
| disabled | Whether the entire split button is disabled | `boolean` | `false` |
| status | Button group semantic status | `SemanticStatus` | `default` |
| variant | Button group variant | `ButtonVariant` | `default` |
| size | Button group size | `ComponentSize` | `md` |
| color | Background color | `string` | `''` |
| text-color | Custom text color | `string` | `''` |
| elevation | Button group elevation | `boolean \| number` | `true` |
| button-props | Props for the primary button | `Partial<ButtonProps>` | `-` |
| trigger-button-props | Props for the menu trigger button | `Partial<ButtonProps>` | `-` |
| trigger | Menu trigger method | `'hover' \| 'click' \| 'focus' \| 'contextMenu'` | `click` |
| placement | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | `MenuPlacement`: the standard twelve placements | `bottom` |
| popup-container | Menu mount container | `PopupContainer` | `-` |
| popup-max-height | Maximum menu height | `boolean \| number` | `true` |
| popup-class | Menu popup class | `string \| array \| object` | `-` |
| offset-x | Screen-horizontal offset; numbers are px, strings are converted as lengths | `string \| number` | `0` |
| offset-y | Screen-vertical offset; numbers are px, strings are converted as lengths | `string \| number` | `0` |
| hide-on-select | Close the menu after selection | `boolean` | `true` |

### `<split-button>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ----------- | -------------------------- | -------------------- |
| update:open | Emitted when an open-state update is requested | open: `boolean` |
| open-change | Emitted when the menu open state changes | open: `boolean` |
| click | Emitted when the primary button is clicked | event: `MouseEvent` |
| select | Emitted when a menu option is selected | value, option, event |

### `<split-button>` Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| ------- | ---------------- | --------------- |
| default | Primary button content | - |
| icon | Menu trigger button icon | open: `boolean` |
| content | Menu content | - |

### Instance methods

| Method | Description |
| -------- | -------------------------- |
| open() | Request menu opening; disabled prevents it |
| close() | Request menu closing |
| resize() | Recalculate menu position |

Controlled `open` emits update requests only; callers must update it. Main-button clicks bubble normally without opening the menu.

Like Button, `click` is a Promise-consuming `onClick` callback prop supporting `@click`, not a second emitted notification. If `button-props.onClick` is also supplied, each handler runs once.

Both platforms independently copy bodies, props, style dependency entries and contract tests. Cedar adapts positioning through Menu without shared instances/runtime.

## Type definitions

```ts
import type { SplitButtonInstance, SplitButtonProps } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```


### Placement semantics and configuration

The menu side passes through the internal Menu placement to Trigger and uses MenuPlacement, without a second positioning entry.

# Split

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

## API

### `<split>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | :------------: |
| component | The html tag of the split box | `string` | `'div'` |
| orientation | Arrangement axis of the two panels: horizontal by default means left/right panels, whose divider handle is vertical | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` |
| size **(v-model)** | The size of the segmentation, it can be 0~1 representing a percentage, or a specific number of pixels, such as 300px | `number\|string` | `-` |
| default-size | Default split size, it can be 0~1 representing a percentage, or a specific number of pixels, such as 300px | `number\|string` | `0.5` |
| min | Minimum threshold, it can be 0~1 representing a percentage, or a specific number of pixels, such as 300px | `number\|string` | `-` |
| max | Maximum threshold, it can be 0~1 representing a percentage, or a specific number of pixels, such as 300px | `number\|string` | `-` |
| disabled | Whether disabled | `boolean` | `false` |

### `<split>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ---------- | ---------------- | ---- |
| move-start | Emitted before dragging starts | - |
| moving | Emitted during dragging | - |
| move-end | Emitted after dragging ends | - |

### `<split>` Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| ------------------- | :--------------: | ---- |
| first | First panel content | - |
| resize-trigger | Resize-handle content | - |
| resize-trigger-icon | Resize-handle icon | - |

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { SplitInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

`--c-split-trigger-size-icon-wrapper` (default 6px) controls handle thickness: width for vertical handles, height for horizontal handles. It does not change their 100% length along the panel.


## Reading direction and interaction

Split inherits the nearest native dir. Size and bounds always describe the first pane, preserving ratio or pixel units. In RTL, dragging left grows the first horizontal pane; vertical movement is unchanged. Focused separators support arrows, Shift, Home and End. Direction/orientation changes, disablement and teardown cancel gestures and restore the cursor without changing the size merely because direction changed.

Example source: src/statistic/__demos__/tabular-nums.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space size="xl" wrap>
    <c-statistic
      title="比例数字（右侧标记会跳动）"
      :value="count"
      suffix="|"
      :value-style="{ fontVariantNumeric: 'proportional-nums' }"
    />
    <c-statistic title="等宽数字（右侧标记保持稳定）" :value="count" suffix="|" tabular-nums />
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue'

const values = [1111, 8888, 1010, 9090]
const index = ref(0)
const count = ref(values[0])
let timer = 0

onMounted(() => {
  timer = window.setInterval(() => {
    index.value = (index.value + 1) % values.length
    count.value = values[index.value]
  }, 800)
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  window.clearInterval(timer)
})
</script>
```

## Shared implementation and platform boundaries

Each platform maintains a complete local implementation. They do not import a common core or share component instances or reactive state. Changes must update both implementations. Component bodies, props, key styles and paired tests have read-only source consistency checks; theme tokens and installation entries remain local to each library.

Placeholder text updates when the default slot appears/disappears. Animation pauses on unmount/KeepAlive deactivation.

### Step types and states

All four types share one current-step and status model. Click a step or select 1–3, then choose wait, process, finish or error: default, arrow, dot and navigation update together. Status changes the current node’s semantic state without changing its index. Titles and descriptions follow the page language to fit the phone preview.

```vue
  <section class="step-type-comparison">
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="Current step">
      <c-radio-group
        v-model="current"
        aria-label="Current step"
        :options="[
          { label: '1', value: 1 },
          { label: '2', value: 2 },
          { label: '3', value: 3 },
        ]"
        variant="button"
        size="sm"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="Status"><c-radio-group v-model="status" aria-label="Step status" :options="statuses.map(value => ({ label: value, value }))" /></c-form-item>
    <p>
      点击步骤或选择序号，对比同一进度的四种外观。Click a step to compare the
      same progress.
    </p>
    <section v-for="type in types" :key="type" :data-step-type="type">
      <p>
        <code>{{ type }}</code>
      </p>
      <c-steps v-model="current" :type="type" :status="status" changeable>
        <c-step><span lang="zh-CN">提交</span><span lang="en-US">Submit</span><template #description><span lang="zh-CN">提交信息</span><span lang="en-US">Details</span></template></c-step>
        <c-step><span lang="zh-CN">审核</span><span lang="en-US">Review</span><template #description><span lang="zh-CN">审核信息</span><span lang="en-US">Review</span></template></c-step>
        <c-step><span lang="zh-CN">完成</span><span lang="en-US">Done</span><template #description><span lang="zh-CN">完成信息</span><span lang="en-US">Complete</span></template></c-step>
      </c-steps>
    </section>
  </section>
</template>

<style scoped>
html:not([lang='en-US']) .step-type-comparison [lang='en-US'],
html[lang='en-US'] .step-type-comparison [lang='zh-CN'] { display: none; }
</style>
```

### Vertical

- `status`: Selects the semantic state.

Example source: src/steps/__demos__/vertical.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div class="frame-bg">
    <c-radio-group v-model="currentStatus" variant="button" style="margin-bottom: 16px">
      <c-radio v-for="status in statuses" :key="status" :value="status">{{ status }}</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
    <div class="frame-body">
      <div class="frame-aside">
        <c-steps :model-value="current" :status="currentStatus" orientation="vertical">
          <c-step>Succeeded</c-step>
          <c-step>Processing</c-step>
          <c-step>Pending</c-step>
        </c-steps>
      </div>
      <div class="frame-main">
        <div class="main-content">The content of this step.</div>
        <div class="main-bottom">
          <c-button :disabled="current === 1" @click="onPrev">
            <c-icon-left />
            Back
          </c-button>
          <c-button :disabled="current === 3" @click="onNext">
            Next
            <c-icon-right />
          </c-button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
<script lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

export default {
  setup() {
    const current = ref(1)
    const statuses = ['wait', 'process', 'finish', 'error'] as const
    const currentStatus = ref<(typeof statuses)[number]>('process')

    const onPrev = () => {
      current.value = Math.max(1, current.value - 1)
    }

    const onNext = () => {
      current.value = Math.min(3, current.value + 1)
    }

    return {
      current,
      statuses,
      currentStatus,
      onPrev,
      onNext,
    }
  },
}
</script>
```

## Interaction and control

### Changeable

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `changeable` | Whether clicking can change steps | Changeable |
| `status` | Current step status | Changeable |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `status`: Selects the semantic state.

Example source: src/steps/__demos__/changeable.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div>
    <c-radio-group v-model="currentStatus" variant="button" style="margin-bottom: 16px">
      <c-radio v-for="status in statuses" :key="status" :value="status">{{ status }}</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
    <c-steps changeable :model-value="current" :status="currentStatus" @change="setCurrent">
      <c-step description="This is a description">Succeeded</c-step>
      <c-step description="This is a description">Processing</c-step>
      <c-step description="This is a description">Pending</c-step>
    </c-steps>
    <div
      :style="{
        width: '100%',
        height: '200px',
        textAlign: 'center',
        background: 'var(--color-bg-2)',
        color: '#C2C7CC',
      }"
    >
      <div style="line-height: 160px">Step{{ current }} Content</div>
      <c-space size="lg">
        <c-button status="secondary" :disabled="current <= 1" @click="onPrev">
          <c-icon-left />
          Back
        </c-button>
        <c-button status="primary" :disabled="current >= 3" @click="onNext">
          Next
          <c-icon-right />
        </c-button>
      </c-space>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
<script lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

export default {
  setup() {
    const current = ref(1)
    const statuses = ['wait', 'process', 'finish', 'error'] as const
    const currentStatus = ref<(typeof statuses)[number]>('process')
    const onPrev = () => {
      current.value = Math.max(1, current.value - 1)
    }
    const onNext = () => {
      current.value = Math.min(3, current.value + 1)
    }

    const setCurrent = (step: number) => {
      current.value = step
    }

    return {
      current,
      statuses,
      currentStatus,
      onPrev,
      onNext,
      setCurrent,
    }
  },
}
</script>
```

## API

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the current step, starting at 1. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once; later changes do not reset it. Initialization emits no `update:modelValue`. When supplied, `modelValue` is controlled by the parent.

### Steps Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- | -------------- |
| type | Steps appearance type | `'default'` \| `'arrow'` \| `'dot'` \| `'navigation'` | `'default'` |
| orientation | Horizontal/vertical axis of the step flow, default horizontal; arrow and navigation variants remain horizontal | `'horizontal'` \| `'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` |
| content-placement | Content side relative to the step node: right or bottom, default right. Dot steps derive it from orientation; navigation steps always use right | `'right'` \| `'bottom'` | `'right'` |
| model-value(**v-model**) | Current step number | `number` | `-` |
| default-value | Default uncontrolled step number | `number` | `1` |
| status | Current step status | `'wait'` \| `'process'` \| `'finish'` \| `'error'` | `'process'` |
| show-line | Whether to show connectors | `boolean` | `true` |
| size | Steps size | `'sm'` \| `'md'` | `'md'` |
| changeable | Whether clicking can change steps | `boolean` | `false` |

### Steps Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------ | ---------------------------- |
| change | Emitted when the step number changes; requires `changeable` | current:`number`<br/>previous:`number`<br/>ev:`Event` |
| update:modelValue | `v-model` sync | step:`number` |

### Steps Slots

| Slot | Description |
| ----------- | ------------ |
| default | Step content |
| finish-icon | Finished status icon |
| error-icon | Error status icon |

### Step Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| title | Step title | `string` | `-` |
| description | Step description | `string` | `-` |
| status | Step status | `'wait'` \| `'process'` \| `'finish'` \| `'error'` | `-` |
| disabled | Whether the step is disabled | `boolean` | `false` |

### Step Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| ----------- | ---- | --------------------------------- |
| default | Title | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |
| title | Title | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |
| node | Node | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |
| icon | Icon | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |
| description | Description | `index`、`status`、`active`、`disabled` |

## Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type {
  StepsProps,
  StepProps,
  StepsType,
  StepStatus,
  StepsSize,
  StepsContentPlacement,
  StepsInstance,
  StepsStepInstance,
} from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

## Shared implementation and platform boundaries

Each platform maintains a complete local implementation. They do not import a common core or share component instances or reactive state. Changes must update both implementations. Component bodies, props, key styles and paired tests have read-only source consistency checks; theme tokens and installation entries remain local to each library.

Steps/Step bodies, props, context protocol and styles are source copies. Injection Symbols are defined separately per library, not shared. The four types and existing status/event contracts remain.

`active` indicates only whether the current one-based step index matches modelValue, independently of wait/process/finish/error status. A current error step remains `active`. Focus/hover do not change `active`.


### Placement semantics and configuration

content-placement shares side vocabulary and spelling, not an identical set across all components. Steps implements only right/bottom; dot and navigation variants have derived rules. Unsupported sides are not added for naming uniformity.


## Reading direction and keyboard interaction

Steps inherits the nearest native `dir` and supports live changes. Horizontal layout and directional geometry follow reading order; vertical progression stays top to bottom. With `changeable`, arrow keys move focus, Home/End reach the first/last enabled step, and Enter/Space activate it. Focus navigation and direction changes do not update progress.

# Style Provider

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Preview configuration: `tag="section"`, `:style-vars="active ? { '--c-demo-color': 'teal' } : null"`, `:style-vars="{ '--c-demo-color': 'coral' }"`.

Example source: src/style-provider/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(true)
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <c-button variant="outline" @click="active = !active">切换局部变量 / Toggle local variables</c-button>
    <c-style-provider tag="section" :style-vars="active ? { '--c-demo-color': 'teal' } : null">
      <p style="color: var(--c-demo-color, currentColor)">局部颜色 / Local color</p>
      <c-style-provider :style-vars="{ '--c-demo-color': 'coral' }">
        <p style="color: var(--c-demo-color)">嵌套覆盖 / Nested override</p>
      </c-style-provider>
    </c-style-provider>
    <p>外部不受影响 / Outside remains unchanged</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Global calls

```ts
import { StyleProvider, Themes } from '@cedar-design/ui'

StyleProvider.setStyleVars(Themes.default.dark)
StyleProvider.setStyleVars(Themes.maple.light)
StyleProvider.setStyleVars(null)
```

Each call replaces previous injected values rather than merging cumulatively. Values already equal to base styles are not written again.
`dark` sets `html[cedar-theme="dark"]`; `light` removes it. Without color-scheme, existing theme attributes remain. `null` removes this library's injection/theme attributes without affecting the other library. SSR calls have no side effects.

Variables accept full CSS names or camelCase such as `cColorScheme`. Library prefixes are not added automatically. Prefer full `--c-*` names.

## Installation and defaults

```ts
import { StyleProvider } from '@cedar-design/ui'

app.use(StyleProvider)

StyleProvider.setPropsDefaults({
  tag: 'section',
  styleVars: () => ({ '--c-demo-color': 'teal' }),
})
```

Set defaults during initialization before mounting; mounted instances are not retroactively updated. Explicit props take precedence. Object defaults are copied per instance; factories/`null` are supported. Defaults are local to each library, not shared.
Installation always registers `CStyleProvider` without modifying app global config. For aliases, use `app.component('MyStyleProvider', StyleProvider)`.

## API

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `style-vars` | Local CSS variables; null clears local overrides | `Record<string, string> \| null` | `{}` |
| `tag` | Wrapper tag | `string` | `div` |

The default slot supplies component content. No events.

## Type definitions

Exports `StyleVars`, `StyleProviderProps`, `StyleProviderDefaults` and `StyleProviderInstance`. `StyleProvider` is the only public component entry; `styleProviderProps` and resolver-facing `_StyleProviderComponent` are also exported.

No component-specific theme tokens. Variable values are strings; numeric dimensions should be unit-bearing strings.
