## Business workflows

### Typed Config

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | Column info of the table | Task Workbench, Form Attribute |
| `data` | Table data | Task Workbench, Form Attribute |
| `pagination` | Pagination properties configuration | Task Workbench |
| `bordered` | Whether to show border | Form Attribute |
| `hoverable` | Whether to show the hover effect | Form Attribute |
| `stripe` | Whether to enable the stripe effect | Form Attribute |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/table/__demos__/typed-config.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { defineTableConfig } from '@cedar-design/ui'
interface User {
  id: string
  name: string
  age: number
  profile: { city: string }
}
const rows = ref<User[]>([
  { id: 'alice', name: 'Alice', age: 28, profile: { city: '杭州' } },
  { id: 'bob', name: 'Bob', age: 16, profile: { city: '宁波' } },
])
const config = computed(() => defineTableConfig<User>({
  rowKey: 'id',
  data: rows.value,
  pagination: false,
  columns: [
    { title: '姓名', dataIndex: 'name', render: ({ record }) => record.name.toUpperCase() },
    { title: '城市', dataIndex: 'profile.city' },
    { title: '年龄', dataIndex: 'age',
      sortable: { sortDirections: ['ascend', 'descend'], sorter: (a, b) => a.age - b.age },
      filterable: { filters: [{ text: '仅成年人', value: 'adult' }], filter: (values, record) => !values.length || !values.includes('adult') || record.age >= 18 },
    },
  ],
}))
function addRow() {
  if (rows.value.length < 3) rows.value = [...rows.value, { id: 'carol', name: 'Carol', age: 35, profile: { city: '上海' } }]
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" fill>
    <c-button :disabled="rows.length >= 3" @click="addRow">增加一行</c-button>
    <c-table v-bind="config" />
    <p role="status">业务数据：{{ rows.length }} 行；年龄列支持排序和筛选。</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Task Workbench

- `columns`: Column info of the table
- `data`: Table data
- `pagination`: Pagination properties configuration

Example source: src/table/__demos__/task-workbench.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
const original = () => [
  { key: "01", name: "展厅设备巡检", department: "运营部", status: "待处理" },
  { key: "02", name: "网站交互验收", department: "研发部", status: "进行中" },
  { key: "03", name: "品牌物料审核", department: "设计部", status: "待处理" },
  { key: "04", name: "移动端体验走查", department: "研发部", status: "已完成" },
  { key: "05", name: "会议室设备维护", department: "运营部", status: "进行中" },
];
const rows = ref(original());
const keyword = ref("");
const status = ref("全部");
const applied = ref({ keyword: "", status: "全部" });
const message = ref("显示全部任务。输入条件后点击查询。");
const options = ["全部", "待处理", "进行中", "已完成"].map((value) => ({
  value,
  label: value,
}));
const filtered = computed(() =>
  rows.value.filter(
    (row) =>
      (!applied.value.keyword ||
        `${row.name} ${row.department}`.includes(applied.value.keyword)) &&
      (applied.value.status === "全部" || row.status === applied.value.status),
  ),
);
const completed = computed(
  () => rows.value.filter((row) => row.status === "已完成").length,
);
const columns = [
  { title: "任务", dataIndex: "name" },
  { title: "部门", dataIndex: "department" },
  { title: "状态", dataIndex: "status" },
  { title: "操作", slotName: "action" },
];
function search() {
  applied.value = { keyword: keyword.value.trim(), status: status.value };
  message.value = `查询完成，找到 ${filtered.value.length} 条任务。`;
}
function clear() {
  keyword.value = "";
  status.value = "全部";
  applied.value = { keyword: "", status: "全部" };
  message.value = "已清空筛选条件。";
}
function finish(row) {
  row.status = "已完成";
  message.value = `已完成“${row.name}”，统计与列表已同步。`;
}
function reset() {
  rows.value = original();
  clear();
  message.value = "任务和筛选已恢复，可以重新演示。";
}
</script>
<template>
  <section class="task-workbench" aria-label="巡检任务数据联动">
    <div class="task-workbench__metrics">
      <span
        >全部 <strong>{{ rows.length }}</strong></span
      ><span
        >已完成 <strong>{{ completed }}</strong></span
      ><span
        >当前结果 <strong>{{ filtered.length }}</strong></span
      >
    </div>
    <c-form :model="applied" layout="vertical" @submit="search">
      <c-form-item label="搜索任务或部门"
        ><c-input
          v-model="keyword"
          edit-mode="direct"
          placeholder="搜索任务或部门"
          clearable
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="任务状态"
        ><c-select v-model="status" :options="options" edit-mode="direct"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-space wrap
        ><c-button html-type="submit" status="primary">查询任务</c-button
        ><c-button @click="clear">清空筛选</c-button
        ><c-button @click="reset">恢复全部任务</c-button></c-space
      >
    </c-form>
    <p role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ message }}</p>
    <c-table :columns="columns" :data="filtered" :pagination="false"
      ><template #action="{ record }"
        ><c-button
          :disabled="record.status === '已完成'"
          :aria-label="`完成${record.name}`"
          @click="finish(record)"
          >完成</c-button
        ></template
      ></c-table
    >
    <p v-if="!filtered.length">
      没有匹配任务。修改关键词或点击“清空筛选”恢复结果。
    </p>
    <small
      >先查询“运营部”，完成一条任务，再用状态过滤；统计与结果来自同一份本地任务数据。</small
    >
  </section>
</template>
<style scoped>

  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
}

  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;

}

```

### Form Attribute

- `columns`: Column info of the table
- `data`: Table data
- `bordered`: Whether to show the border
- `hoverable`: Whether to show the hover effect

Example source: src/table/__demos__/form-attribute.vue


## API

### `<Table>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------: |
| columns | Column info of the table | `TableColumnData[]` | `[]` |
| data | Table data | `TableData[]` | `[]` |
| bordered | Whether to show border | `boolean \| TableBorder` | `true` |
| hoverable | Whether to show the hover effect | `boolean` | `true` |
| stripe | Whether to enable the stripe effect | `boolean` | `false` |
| size | The size of the table | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` |
| table-layout | Table layout algorithm, matching CSS `table-layout`. Defaults to `fixed`; calculated column widths are not expanded by content | `'fixed' \| 'auto'` | `'fixed'` |
| loading | Loading state | `boolean\|object` | `false` |
| row-selection | Table row selector configuration | `TableRowSelection` | `-` |
| expandable | Expand row configuration of the table | `TableExpandable` | `-` |
| height | Table height; fixes the header and scrolls the body. Numbers are px | `number \| string` | `-` |
| max-height | Maximum table height; shrinks for short content and scrolls the body on overflow. Numbers are px | `number \| string` | `-` |
| fit | Remaining-space allocation; the table always fills at least its parent `width`. `true` assigns it to flexible columns without `width`; `false` expands columns proportionally to their base widths | `boolean` | `true` |
| pagination | Pagination properties configuration | `boolean \| TablePaginationConfig` | `true` |
| page-position | Pagination region inside the table, currently tl/top/tr/bl/bottom/br; not the page-size dropdown placement | `'tl' \| 'top' \| tr' \| 'bl' \| 'bottom' \| 'br'` | `'br'` |
| indent-size | The indentation distance of the tree table | `number` | `16` |
| row-key | Value field of table row `key` | `string` | `'key'` |
| show-header | Whether to show the header | `boolean` | `true` |
| virtual-list-props | Virtual-list props; providing them enables virtual scrolling. See VirtualListProps | `VirtualListProps` | `-` |
| span-method | Cell merge method (The index starts counting from the data item) | `(data: {  record: TableData;  column: TableColumnData \| TableOperationColumn;  rowIndex: number;  columnIndex: number;}) => { rowspan?: number; colspan?: number } \| void` | `-` |
| span-all | Whether to make the index of the span method contain all | `boolean` | `false` |
| load-more | Load children asynchronously; call done(children), or done() to allow retry | `(record: TableData, done: (children?: TableData[]) => void) => void` | `-` |
| filter-icon-align-left | Whether the filter icon is aligned to the left | `boolean` | `false` |
| hide-expand-button-on-empty | Whether to hide expand button when subtree is empty | `boolean` | `false` |
| row-class | Class for table-row elements | `string\| any[]\| Record<string, any>\| ((record: TableData, rowIndex: number) => any)` | `-` |
| draggable | Table drag and drop sorting configuration | `TableDraggable` | `-` |
| column-resizable | Whether columns can be resized; drag handles render only under `table-layout: fixed` | `boolean` | `false` |
| summary | Show footer summary row | `boolean\| ((params: {    columns: TableColumnData[];    data: TableData[];  }) => TableData[])` | `-` |
| summary-text | The first column of text in the summary line | `string` | `'Summary'` |
| summary-span-method | Cell Merge Method for Summarizing Rows | `(data: {  record: TableData;  column: TableColumnData \| TableOperationColumn;  rowIndex: number;  columnIndex: number;}) => { rowspan?: number; colspan?: number } \| void` | `-` |
| selected-keys | Selected row (controlled mode) takes precedence over `rowSelection` | `(string \| number)[]` | `-` |
| default-selected-keys | The selected row by default (uncontrolled mode) takes precedence over `rowSelection` | `(string \| number)[]` | `-` |
| expanded-keys | Displayed Expanded Row, Subtree (Controlled Mode) takes precedence over `expandable` | `(string \| number)[]` | `-` |
| default-expanded-keys | Expand row, Subtree displayed by default (Uncontrolled mode) takes precedence over `expandable` | `(string \| number)[]` | `-` |
| default-expand-all-rows | Whether to expand all rows by default | `boolean` | `false` |
| sticky-header | Sticky header relative to the page/outer scroller; numeric values are top offsets in px | `boolean \| number` | `false` |
| sticky-pagination | Sticky pagination relative to the page/outer scroller; numeric values are bottom offsets in px | `boolean \| number` | `false` |
| scrollbar | Whether to enable virtual scroll bar | `boolean \| ScrollbarProps` | `true` |
| show-empty-tree | Whether to display empty subtrees | `boolean` | `false` |
| extra-column | Append an extra final column, e.g. settings; slots supply its content | `boolean \| TableExtraColumnConfig` | `false` |
| empty-type | Empty-state type | <br/>`default`\|`network`\|`unknown`\|`success` <br/> <br/> | `default` |
| empty-text | Empty-state text | <br/>`string` <br/> <br/> | `-` |

| row-click | Emitted when a row is clicked | record: `TableData`<br>ev: `Event` |

| row-contextmenu | Emitted when a row is right-clicked | record: `TableData`<br>ev: `Event` |

### Pagination configuration type

`TablePaginationConfig = Omit<PaginationProps, 'total'> & { total?: number }`. When `pagination.total` is omitted, Table derives it from the effective data count. Remote pagination can still provide `total` explicitly. Existing `PaginationProps` objects remain accepted by Table; standalone `Pagination` still requires `total`. `TablePaginationConfig` is exported from root/table entries.


### Existing precedence of forwarded configuration (F07)

Column filterable.triggerProps is spread after internal Trigger settings, so nested fields such as open can currently override filter-popup state. F07 preserves this order/type for compatibility without automatically forbidding existing capabilities. Future restrictions require separate migration assessment of filter/popup states.


## Optional business-row type configuration (F08-A)

```ts
import { defineTableConfig } from '@cedar-design/ui'
import type { TypedTableConfig, TypedTableColumn, TableDataPath } from '@cedar-design/ui/table'

interface User { id: string; name: string; age: number }
const users: User[] = [{ id: 'a', name: 'Alice', age: 20 }]
const config = defineTableConfig<User>({
  rowKey: 'id', data: users,
  columns: [{ dataIndex: 'age', render: ({ record }) => record.age.toFixed(0) }],
})
```

Use the config with `<c-table v-bind="config" />` or TSX `<Table {...config} />`. Business-side as any is unnecessary. Existing TableData, TableColumnData, TableProps and component props remain. The new entry validates inputs and returns existing TableProps for old components. Runtime returns the same object without copying rows/columns, changing sorting/filtering or wrapping components.

| Associated scope | New type rules |
| --- | --- |
| data / columns | The same Row type recursively applies to tree children |
| dataIndex | Validates fields/nested paths such as profile.city, tags[0].label and tags.0.label, up to five business-structure levels. Dynamic strings/deeper paths retain the old entry |
| render / sortable / filterable | record, comparators and filters receive Row, including grouped child columns |
| Row callbacks | Cell styles/classes, rowClass, expandable, loadMore, spanMethod and custom summaries associate with Row |
| rowKey | Explicitly provide a Row field whose value is string/number; this is a field name, not a nested path |
| summary | May be omitted, false or a custom function returning complete Row. Automatic summary=true is not guaranteed to be a business row, so the new entry rejects it; existing Table configuration still supports it |

Business interfaces normally need not extend TableData explicitly; its any index broadens keyof and weakens spelling checks. Use ordinary business interfaces and generic constraints to validate reserved Table metadata compatibility. Business code still validates backend contents; types do not ensure unique IDs.

Type association covers only this configuration. Component template slots/events and custom components extensions do not automatically become Row-generic. Returned TableProps remains the old broad type; arbitrary later mutations are not Row-validated. If reactive sources replace arrays, use `computed(() => defineTableConfig<Row>(...))`; passing rows.value once is not an ongoing ref subscription.

Automatic summary rows may contain text, totals and missing fields; render(record: User) must not assume a complete User. Keep the old broad configuration for automatic summaries or heterogeneous tree rows. The new custom-summary entry requires a complete business row. Neither entry changes Table runtime behavior.

Platform scope: Maple Table is a native-table display container without data/columns API, so no associated-config entry is added there. Select/Cascader type associations require separate assessment.


## Reading direction and interaction

Table inherits native reading direction. Normal columns follow reading order; explicit fixed left/right sides stay physical through stable visual partitions. Mixed frozen group headers are projected into matching physical sections without mutating source columns or business indexes. Default cell alignment follows reading start; explicit left/right alignment stays physical. Header/body/summary/sticky rail share a normalized nonnegative inline scroll distance, including native negative RTL scrollLeft. Virtual row positioning preserves horizontal distance. Teleported footers retain source direction. Resize handles support directional pointer and keyboard input; sticky rails support arrows and Home/End. Direction switches preserve business state and cancel stale resize gestures.

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <c-radio-group v-model="isVertical" type="button">
      <c-radio value="horizontal">Horizontal</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="vertical">Vertical</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
    <c-radio-group v-model="variant" type="button">
      <c-radio value="line">Line</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="card">Card</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="outline">Outline</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="plain">Plain</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="capsule">Capsule</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="enclosed">Enclosed</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
    <c-radio-group v-model="size" type="button">
      <c-radio value="xs">Xs</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="sm">Sm</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="md">Md</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="lg">Lg</c-radio>
      <c-radio value="xl">Xl</c-radio>
    </c-radio-group>
  </c-space>
  <c-tabs
    :variant="variant"
    :size="size"
    :orientation="isVertical"
    :editable="true"
    @add="handleAdd"
    @delete="handleDelete"
    show-add-button
    auto-switch
    :style="isVertical !== 'vertical' ? { height: '240px' } : undefined"
  >
    <c-tabs-navs>
      <c-tab-nav v-for="(item, index) of data" :key="item.key" :name="item.key" :title="item.title" :closable="index !== 2" />
      <template #prefix><c-button size="xs">Action</c-button></template>
      <template #suffix>suffix</template>
    </c-tabs-navs>
    <c-tabs-items>
      <c-tab-item v-for="(item, index) of data" :key="item.key" :name="item.key">{{ item?.content }}</c-tab-item>
    </c-tabs-items>
  </c-tabs>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
const variant = ref('line')
const size = ref('md')
const isVertical = ref('horizontal')
const data = ref([
  {
    key: '1',
    title: 'Tab 1',
    content: 'Content of Tab Panel 1',
  },
  {
    key: '2',
    title: 'Tab 2',
    content: 'Content of Tab Panel 2',
  },
  {
    key: '3',
    title: 'Tab 3',
    content: 'Content of Tab Panel 3',
  },
  {
    key: '4',
    title: 'Tab 4',
    content: 'Content of Tab Panel 4',
  },
])
let count = 5
const handleAdd = () => {
  const number = count++
  data.value = data.value.concat({
    key: `${number}`,
    title: `New Tab ${number}`,
    content: `Content of New Tab Panel ${number}`,
  })
}
const handleDelete = (key) => {
  data.value = data.value.filter((item) => item.key !== key)
}
</script>
```

## API

TabPane, TabNav and TabItem all require unique names. Selection and navigation/panel association use `name`; Vue key controls only node reuse. Provide `:key` separately in loops.

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the selected tab name. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once without later resets or initialization `update:modelValue`. When provided, the parent value controls selection.

### Tabs Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value | `string / number` | `undefined` | Current selected name; controlled when provided |
| default-value | `string / number` | `undefined` | Initial uncontrolled value; defaults to the first available item |
| variant | `line / card / outline / plain / capsule / enclosed` | `line` | Visual variant |
| size | `xs / sm / md / lg / xl` | Global value or md | Size |
| orientation | Horizontal/vertical axis of tab navigation, default horizontal; affects navigation layout and arrow-key behavior | `horizontal` | Navigation orientation |
| indicator-position | Indicator on the navigation side facing the content (normal) or the opposite side (reverse), default normal; does not use four-side values | `normal` | Indicator on the content side or opposite side |
| editable | `boolean` | `false` | Allow closing tabs |
| show-add-button | `boolean` | `false` | Show the add button in editable mode |
| auto-switch | `boolean` | `false` | Switch to the last available tab after adding |
| lazy-load | `boolean` | `false` | Mount on first activation |
| destroy-on-hide | `boolean` | `false` | Unmount content when hidden |
| justify | `boolean` | `false` | Fill container height in horizontal orientation |
| animation | `boolean` | `false` | Content fade-in animation |
| item-class | `string / object / array` | `undefined` | Inner class for each panel; merged with built-in classes |
| item-style | `StyleValue` | `undefined` | Inner style for each panel; supports string, object or array |
| item-wrapper-class | `string / object / array` | `undefined` | Outer class for each panel; merged with built-in classes |
| item-wrapper-style | `StyleValue` | `undefined` | Outer style for each panel; supports string, object or array |
| tab-class | `string / object / array` | `undefined` | Outer navigation-label class, including title/close button; merged with built-in classes |
| tab-style | `StyleValue` | `undefined` | Outer navigation-label style; supports string, object or array |
| hide-content | `boolean` | `false` | Hide the content area |
| trigger | `click / hover` | `click` | Mouse trigger mode; touch always uses click |
| scroll-position | Target position or numeric offset of the selected tab within the navigation scroll viewport, default auto; not popup placement | `auto` | Selected-tab scroll position; numbers are start offsets |
| scroll-buttons | `boolean / auto` | `auto` | Show arrows on overflow; auto hides them on touch devices |
| activation-mode | `automatic / manual` | `automatic` | Whether arrow keys immediately select |
| swipeable | `boolean` | `false` | Horizontal swipe between content panels; no looping |

### Tabs Events

| Event | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | name: string / number | Request a selected-value update |
| change | name: string / number | Notify on selecting a different available item; controlled mode still requires parent modelValue updates |
| tab-click | name, event: Event | Click an available item, including repeat clicks; hover/arrows/swipes do not emit click |
| add | event: Event | Request adding a tab; the caller updates data |
| delete | name, event: Event | Request removing a tab; the caller updates data |

### TabPane Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name **(required)** | string / number | — | Unique business identifier matching modelValue |
| title | string | undefined | Navigation title |
| disabled | boolean | false | Prevent selecting and closing |
| closable | boolean | true | Show the close button in editable mode |
| item-vertical | boolean | false | Vertical icon/text layout |
| lazy-load | boolean | undefined | Inherit Tabs; explicit false overrides it |
| destroy-on-hide | boolean | undefined | Inherit Tabs; explicit false overrides it |

### TabNav Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name **(required)** | string / number | — | Unique business identifier matching modelValue |
| title | string | undefined | Title |
| disabled | boolean | false | Prevent selecting and closing |
| closable | boolean | true | Show the close button in editable mode |
| item-vertical | boolean | false | Vertical icon/text layout |

TabNav/TabItem associate through the same `name`. Names are unique within a group; number `1` and string `'1'` differ. Vue `key` controls node reuse only; provide `:key` in loops independently. It does not determine selection.

### TabItem Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name **(required)** | string / number | — | Unique business identifier matching modelValue |
| lazy-load | boolean | undefined | Inherit Tabs; explicit false overrides it |
| destroy-on-hide | boolean | undefined | Inherit Tabs; explicit false overrides it |

Inactive panels always have hidden. The above props determine whether internal state survives. destroy-on-hide overrides lazy-load; active content remains mounted. TabsNavs/TabsItems have no business props.

### Slots

| Component | Slot | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tabs | default | TabPane list, or TabsNavs/TabsItems for advanced composition |
| TabPane | default / title | Panel content / custom navigation title |
| TabsNavs | default | TabNav list |
| TabsNavs | prefix / suffix / add-icon | Navigation prefix/suffix areas and add icon |
| TabNav | title / default / icon | title/default slots customize the title; icon supplies an icon |
| TabsItems | default | TabItem list |
| TabItem | default | Panel content |

### Expose

`TabsNavs.resize(): void` remeasures overflow and scrolls the selected tab into view. ResizeObserver watches size changes automatically.

### Keyboard and direction

Arrow keys skip disabled items and wrap; Home/End reach first/last. Delete requests closing editable tabs. Horizontal uses Left/Right, vertical uses Up/Down. Manual mode moves focus only; Enter/Space activates the native button. `dir="rtl"` supports right-to-left layout. Give TabsNavs an `aria-label` to name navigation.

### Types

Exports TabsName, TabsVariant, TabsTrigger, TabsIndicatorPosition, TabsScrollPosition, TabsActivationMode and Props/Instance/runtime props/`_XxxComponent` for all six components. Both platforms use the same prop definitions.

## Style variables

Both platforms keep the same API, state, lifecycle and keyboard behavior. Desktop and mobile differences use style tokens and pointer media queries; the packages remain independent at runtime.

## Independent source copies and public types

Both platforms independently maintain Tabs, TabPane, TabsNavs, TabNav, TabsItems and TabItem without cross-library runtimes or generic platform configuration. All xs/sm/md/lg/xl sizes are implemented. Cedar inherits ConfigProvider size/rtl. Maple defaults to md and supports setPropsDefaults, explicit size and DOM dir. Panels use native hidden; InfiniteScroll observes visibility directly rather than old panel registration.

Public types include TabsEmits, TabsSlots, TabPaneSlots, TabsNavsSlots, TabNavSlots, TabsItemsSlots, TabItemSlots and TabsNavsExpose. Only TabsNavs has its own method, resize(). Other members have no own imperative methods/notification events; selection/editing events belong to Tabs.

### Dynamic Tag

Preview configuration: `:closable="index !== 0"`, `size="xs"`.

Example source: src/tag/__demos__/dynamic-tag.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space wrap>
    <c-tag v-for="(tag, index) of tags" :key="tag" :closable="index !== 0" @close="handleRemove(tag)">
      {{ tag }}
    </c-tag>

    <c-input
      v-if="showInput"
      ref="inputRef"
      :style="{ width: '90px' }"
      size="xs"
      v-model.trim="inputVal"
      @keyup.enter="handleAdd"
      @blur="handleAdd" />
    <c-tag
      v-else
      :style="{
        width: '90px',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--color-fill-2)',
        border: '1px dashed var(--color-fill-3)',
        cursor: 'pointer',
      }"
      @click="handleEdit"
    >
      <template #icon>
        <c-icon-plus />
      </template>
      Add Tag
    </c-tag>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref, nextTick } from 'vue'
const tags = ref(['Tag 1', 'Tag 2', 'Tag 3'])
const inputRef = ref(null)
const showInput = ref(false)
const inputVal = ref('')

const handleEdit = () => {
  showInput.value = true

  nextTick(() => {
    if (inputRef.value) {
      inputRef.value.focus()
    }
  })
}

const handleAdd = () => {
  if (inputVal.value) {
    tags.value.push(inputVal.value)
    inputVal.value = ''
  }
  showInput.value = false
}

const handleRemove = (key) => {
  tags.value = tags.value.filter((tag) => tag !== key)
}
</script>
```

## API

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is a selectable tag's boolean checked state. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once; later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence, without initialization `update:modelValue`.

### `<Tag>` Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| color | Custom background (border color when outline) | `string` | - |
| text-color | Custom text color | `string` | - |
| status | Tag status `color`; mutually exclusive with `color`, which takes precedence | `'default' \| 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `'default'` |
| variant | Tag variant, aligned with Button | `'default' \| 'outline'` | `'default'` |
| size | Tag size | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` |
| show **(v-model)** | Whether the tag is visible | `boolean` | - |
| default-show | Default tag visibility | `boolean` | `true` |
| loading | Whether the tag is loading | `boolean` | `false` |
| closable | Whether the tag can be closed | `boolean` | `false` |
| checkable | Whether the tag is selectable | `boolean` | `false` |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Whether a selectable tag is checked | `boolean` | - |
| default-value | Default checked state of a selectable tag | `boolean` | `true` |
| nowrap | Whether content is nowrap with ellipsis | `boolean` | `false` |
| round | Whether to use a pill shape | `boolean` | `false` |

### `<Tag>` Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------ | -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| close | Triggered when the Close button is clicked and can only be used when the Close button is displayed | `(event: MouseEvent) => void` |
| check | Emitted on user selection, only in selectable mode | `(check: boolean, event: MouseEvent) => void` |
| update:show | Visibility changed | `(show: boolean) => void` |
| update:model-value | Checked-state change | `(checked: boolean) => void` |

### `<Tag>` Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| ---------- | -------------- | ---- |
| default | Tag content | - |
| icon | Icon | - |
| close-icon | Close-button icon | - |

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { TagProps } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

## Shared implementation and platform boundaries

Each platform maintains a complete local implementation. They do not import a common core or share component instances or reactive state. Changes must update both implementations. Component bodies, props, key styles and paired tests have read-only source consistency checks; theme tokens and installation entries remain local to each library.

Both retain independent show/checked state, with controlled values updated by callers. Fade-out remains; class/style fall through explicitly to the actual tag. Size configuration, RTL context and icons are locally adapted. Mobile touch dimensions remain in tokens.

### Complete variable defaults and boundaries

Status text and outline borders use readable system content colors; colored fills use palette level 1. Unchecked stays neutral; checked status colors override generic hover. Neutral fills use fill-2 → fill-3. color overrides status; preset colors are outside this contrast guarantee. Callers must check custom backgrounds and set text-color if needed. Platform dimensions remain distinct. All public declarations are listed; 15 unused preset-icon hover-background/size variables, custom-icon-bg-hover and old InputTag references are removed without aliases.

| Variable | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-tag-status-primary-bg-color` | `rgb(var(--c-primary-1))` |
| `--c-tag-status-primary-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-brand)` |
| `--c-tag-status-secondary-bg-color` | `rgb(var(--c-gray-2))` |
| `--c-tag-status-secondary-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-secondary)` |
| `--c-tag-status-tertiary-bg-color` | `rgb(var(--c-gray-1))` |
| `--c-tag-status-tertiary-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-secondary)` |
| `--c-tag-status-info-bg-color` | `rgb(var(--c-blue-1))` |
| `--c-tag-status-info-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-info)` |
| `--c-tag-status-success-bg-color` | `rgb(var(--c-success-1))` |
| `--c-tag-status-success-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-success)` |
| `--c-tag-status-warning-bg-color` | `rgb(var(--c-warning-1))` |
| `--c-tag-status-warning-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-warning)` |
| `--c-tag-status-danger-bg-color` | `rgb(var(--c-danger-1))` |
| `--c-tag-status-danger-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-danger)` |
| `--c-tag-variant-outline-status-primary-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-brand)` |
| `--c-tag-variant-outline-status-secondary-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-secondary)` |

### Color override boundaries

Preset outline stays transparent; loading does not trigger preset fill hover. Dark backgrounds consume bg/bg-hover with instance overrides. Preset icon-color is separate from text-color. Unchecked presets remain neutral, while an explicit color still applies. Preset/custom colors do not guarantee contrast on arbitrary backgrounds.

### Motion variables

Built-in motion follows `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Reduced motion does not prevent loading-state or close-event updates.

| Token | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-tag-fade-duration` | `var(--c-sys-motion-duration-fast)` |

# Textarea

Multiline text input.

## Reading direction

The textarea inherits source `dir`, aligns text to inline start and its counter to inline end. Runtime direction changes retain the native editor, focus and selection; native caret and newline keys keep their meanings.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/textarea/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const value = ref('')
const trimmed = ref('')
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-textarea v-model="value" clearable placeholder="请输入多行文本" aria-label="受控文本" />
    <p role="status">当前值：{{ value || '（空）' }}</p>
    <c-textarea default-value="这是一段非受控初始文本" aria-label="非受控文本" />
    <c-textarea v-model.trim="trimmed" placeholder="输入首尾空白，失焦后去除" aria-label="去除首尾空白" />
    <p role="status">去除空白后的值：{{ JSON.stringify(trimmed) }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Appearance and states

### Status

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration   | Purpose                           | Related examples |
| --------------- | --------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `placeholder`   | Placeholder text                  | Status           |
| `variant`       | `filled` / `outline` / `standard` | Status           |
| `default-value` | Uncontrolled initial value        | Status           |
| `readonly`      | Whether readonly                  | Status           |
| `disabled`      | Whether disabled                  | Status           |
| `error`         | Show the error state              | Status           |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

- `variant`: Selects the visual variant.
- `readonly`: Displays the current value without allowing edits.
- `disabled`: Prevents user interaction.

Example source: src/textarea/__demos__/status.vue

```vue

  <c-space direction="column" size="lg" fill>
    <c-textarea placeholder="默认描边外观" />
    <c-textarea variant="filled" placeholder="填充外观" />
    <c-textarea variant="standard" placeholder="标准外观" />
    <c-textarea default-value="Readonly value" readonly />
    <c-textarea placeholder="Disabled status" disabled />
    <c-textarea placeholder="Error status" error />
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Interaction

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="lg" fill>
    <c-textarea
      v-model="value"
      clearable
      placeholder="输入、换行并失焦以观察事件"
      @input="record('input', $event)"
      @change="record('change', $event)"
      @keydown="record('keydown')"
      @clear="record('clear')"
      @blur="record('blur')"
    />
    <span>最近事件：{{ latest || "-" }}</span>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from "vue";

const value = ref("Cedar");
const latest = ref("");

const record = (name: string, value?: string) => {
  latest.value = value === undefined ? name : `${name}: ${value}`;
};
</script>
```

### Body Contract

Example source: src/textarea/__demos__/body-contract.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const value = ref('可编辑内容')
const events = ref<string[]>([])
const record = (name: string) => { events.value = [...events.value.slice(-7), name] }
</script>
<template>
  <div class="textarea-body-demo">
    <c-textarea v-model="value" hint clearable placeholder="工作备注" :auto-size="{ minRows: 2, maxRows: 5 }" :max-length="100" show-word-limit @clear="record('clear')" @input="record('input')" @update:model-value="record('update:modelValue')" @change="record('change')" />
    <c-textarea :line="false" hint placeholder="无边框提示" focus-color="#137547" :rows="2" />
    <p>Enter 保持换行；失焦提交 change；清空完整通知一次。</p>
    <output>{{ events.join(' → ') || '等待操作' }}</output>
  </div>
</template>
<style scoped>
.textarea-body-demo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.textarea-body-demo p { margin: 0; }
</style>
```

## Design notes

- Defaults to `outline` with `clearable` disabled.
- `input` means live editing; `change` commits on changed blur or clear. Enter remains a newline.
- `auto-size` lets content determine height, overriding visual effects of `rows`/manual `resize`.
- Form/FormItem own business validation/messages; Textarea supplies event signals/error appearance only.

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Textarea Props

Supports Input-compatible hint, line, text-color, focus-color and blur-color. Omitted hint inherits InputGroup/library defaults. An outer FormItem label hides the internal floating hint.

| Prop                    | Description                                                      | Type                                                | Default   |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| model-value (`v-model`) | Controlled value                                                 | `string`                                            | `-`       |
| default-value           | Uncontrolled initial value                                       | `string`                                            | `''`      |
| model-modifiers         | Supports the `trim` model modifier                               | `{ trim?: boolean }`                                | `{}`      |
| placeholder             | Placeholder text                                                 | `string`                                            | `-`       |
| variant                 | `filled` / `outline` / `standard`                                | `FormControlVariant`                                | `outline` |
| size                    | `xs` / `sm` / `md` / `lg` / `xl`                                 | `ComponentSize`                                     | `md`      |
| clearable               | Enables the clear action                                         | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| disabled                | Whether disabled                                                 | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| readonly                | Whether readonly                                                 | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| error                   | Show the error state                                             | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| rows                    | Native visible row count                                         | `string \| number`                                  | `-`       |
| resize                  | Allows vertical manual resizing                                  | `boolean`                                           | `true`    |
| auto-size               | Automatic height, optionally with minimum/maximum rows           | `boolean \| { minRows?: number; maxRows?: number }` | `false`   |
| max-length              | Truncating or error-only length limit                            | `number \| { length: number; errorOnly?: boolean }` | `0`       |
| show-word-limit         | Show the character counter                                       | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| word-length             | Custom length function                                           | `(value: string) => number`                         | `-`       |
| word-slice              | Custom slice function                                            | `(value: string, maxLength: number) => string`      | `-`       |
| aria-label              | Accessible name when no visible label exists                     | `string`                                            | `-`       |
| autofocus               | Focus automatically after mount                                  | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| enterkeyhint            | Virtual keyboard Enter hint                                      | `string`                                            | `-`       |
| textarea-attrs          | Supplemental native textarea attributes                          | `Record<string, unknown>`                           | `-`       |
| hint                    | Floating hint; inherits InputGroup/library defaults when omitted | boolean                                             | undefined |
| line                    | Show border/underline                                            | boolean                                             | true      |
| text-color              | Instance text color                                              | string                                              | undefined |
| focus-color             | Instance focus color                                             | string                                              | undefined |
| blur-color              | Instance unfocused hint color                                    | string                                              | undefined |

### Textarea Events

| Event   | Description                                    | Arguments                  |
| ------- | ---------------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| input   | User input after IME composition               | `value: string, ev: Event` |
| change  | Changed value committed on blur                | `value: string, ev: Event` |
| keydown | Native keydown signal; Enter remains a newline | `ev: KeyboardEvent`        |
| clear   | Clear → input → update:model-value → change    | `ev: Event`                |
| focus   | Emitted on focus                               | `ev: FocusEvent`           |
| blur    | Emitted on blur                                | `ev: FocusEvent`           |

### Textarea Slots

| Slot       | Description          | Arguments                     |
| ---------- | -------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| prefix     | Prefix content       | `-`                           |
| suffix     | Suffix content       | `-`                           |
| clear-icon | Clear icon or button | `clear: (ev?: Event) => void` |

### Textarea Methods

| Method | Description                 |
| ------ | --------------------------- |
| focus  | Focus the internal textarea |
| blur   | Blur the internal textarea  |

## Style variables

| Variable                          | Default                           |
| --------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `--c-textarea-height`             | `auto`                            |
| `--c-textarea-min-height`         | `--c-sys-control-height-xl`       |
| `--c-textarea-font-size`          | `--c-sys-font-size-md`            |
| `--c-textarea-line-height`        | `--c-line-height`                 |
| `--c-textarea-padding-horizontal` | `--c-sys-space-3`                 |
| `--c-textarea-padding-vertical`   | `--c-sys-space-1`                 |
| `--c-textarea-placeholder-color`  | `--c-sys-color-content-secondary` |
| `--c-textarea-counter-color`      | `--c-sys-color-content-secondary` |
| `--c-textarea-counter-font-size`  | `--c-sys-font-size-xs`            |
| `--c-textarea-counter-margin-top` | `var(--c-sys-space-2)`            |

Both counters sit outside the textarea. counter-margin-top controls their gap and avoids covering text.

### Native layout and public types

size supports five FieldDecorator densities: xs/sm/md/lg/xl. rows, auto-size and Textarea tokens still control textarea height/text metrics. Cedar allows manual resize by default; Maple does not. InputGroup/Form state is inherited, with explicit child values taking precedence. Exposes focus(options?), blur(), select() and textareaRef.

`TextareaProps`、`TextareaVariant`、`TextareaMaxLength`、`TextareaAutoSize`、`TextareaEmits`、`TextareaSlots`、`TextareaExpose`、`TextareaInstance`。

Native methods: `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`, `blur()`, `select()`; `textareaRef` is the native element.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`--c-field-caret-color` sets the shared caret color, defaulting to `currentColor`. `--c-textarea-caret-color` overrides this component and defaults to `var(--c-field-caret-color)`.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty.
Text and person-ID models remain strings; use an empty string or a business-defined string sentinel.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

```vue
<script setup>
```

```vue
const immediate = ref(false);

const readonly = ref(false);

</script>

    <c-checkbox v-model="readonly"> 只读（包括确认）</c-checkbox>

      >外部更新为 13:45，覆盖未提交草稿</c-button
    >
    <c-time-picker
      v-model="value"

      format="HH:mm"

      :readonly="readonly"
      :disabled-hours="disabledHours"

      >
    </c-time-picker>
    <span>有效确认次数: {{ confirmations }}</span>
    <span>已提交值: {{ value }}</span>
    <p>默认选择只修改草稿，点击确认后上方的已提交值才会更新。</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`. Direction changes neither change the time nor commit drafts. Time columns follow reading order; Left/Right moves focus visually between columns. Cedar Up/Down and Home/End move focus within a column, skipping disabled options; Enter/Space selects. Maple wheels retain their existing Up/Down and Home/End selection behavior. Existing confirmation settings control submission. Popovers inherit their source direction.

## API

The panel owns one draft/confirmation state, reused by its presentation. Examples show the extra slot and valid-confirm count. Confirming the same value again emits confirm without a duplicate change.

### Pure-panel event and slot boundaries

`TimePicker`/`TimeRangePicker` do not manage fields/popups. Pass `open`, `size`, `variant`, clearing and popup configuration to `Time`/`TimeRange`.

- `select(value, date)`: edit the draft.
- `change(value, date)`: valid confirmation with a changed value; updates the model.
- `confirm(value, date)`: every valid confirmation, including unchanged values. `disableConfirm` also emits it on valid selection commits. Disabled, readonly or invalid drafts do not emit it.
- `extra`: additional explanatory content.
- `actions({ confirm, canConfirm, value })`: replace default tools. `value` is the draft; call `confirm()` to commit and disable buttons according to `canConfirm`.

Single-time events carry formatted strings and Date objects; range events carry corresponding arrays. Pure panels no longer emit `open-change`, `update:open` or `clear`.

### Props

| Arguments | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model-value` | Bound value | `string \| number \| Date` | `-` |
| `format` | Display format | `string` | `-` |
| `use12-hours` | 12-hour clock | `boolean` | `false` |
| `hide-disabled-options` | Hide disabled time options | `boolean` | `false` |
| `disable-confirm` | Skip confirmation | `boolean` | `false` |
| `disabled` | Disable interaction | `boolean` | `false` |
| `step` | Hour/minute/second steps | `object` | `-` |

| `format`         | Display format           | Interaction state comparison, Text Entry, Default State |

| `readonly`       | Read-only interaction    | Interaction state comparison, Selection Events          |
| `input-editable` | Allow desktop text input | Text Entry, Copying and editing                         |
| `model-value`    | Bound value              | Default State                                           |

### Default State

- `format`: Controls the displayed format.

Example source: src/time-range/__demos__/default-state.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
const value = ref(["09:00", "10:00"]);
const open = ref(false);
const acceptValue = ref(true);
const acceptOpen = ref(true);
const acceptClose = ref(true);
const commits = ref(0);
const proposal = ref();
const openProposal = ref();
const updateValue = (next) => {
  proposal.value = next;
  if (acceptValue.value) {
    value.value = next;
  }
};
const updateOpen = (next) => {
  openProposal.value = next;
  if (acceptOpen.value && (next || acceptClose.value)) {
    open.value = next;
  }
};
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="12px" style="width: 100%">
    <p>非受控初始值，无需绑定 v-model</p>
    <c-time-range
      :default-value="['09:00', '10:00']"
      format="HH:mm"
      clearable
    />
    <p>受控值与展开状态</p>
    <c-checkbox v-model="acceptValue"> 接受值更新</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="acceptOpen"> 接受展开更新</c-checkbox>
    <c-time-range
      :model-value="value"
      :open="open"
      format="HH:mm"
      clearable
      @update:model-value="updateValue"
      @update:open="updateOpen"
      @change="commits++"
    />
    <span>{{ value }} / {{ open }}</span>
    <c-checkbox v-model="acceptClose"> 接受关闭请求</c-checkbox>
    <output aria-label="Commit count">{{ commits }}</output>
    <output aria-label="Controlled proposals">{{
      JSON.stringify({ value: proposal, open: openProposal })
    }}</output>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Selection Events

- `readonly`: Displays the current value without allowing edits.
- `disabled`: Prevents user interaction.
- `format`: Controls the displayed format.

Example source: src/time-range/__demos__/selection-events.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";

const value = ref(["09:00", "18:00"]);
const immediate = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const events = ref([]);
function record(name, value, dates) {
  const times = Array.isArray(dates)
    ? dates.map((date) => date?.toLocaleTimeString())
    : dates?.toLocaleTimeString();
  events.value = [
    JSON.stringify({ event: name, value: value ?? null, time: times ?? null }),
    ...events.value,
  ].slice(0, 5);
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="12px" style="width: 100%">
    <c-checkbox v-model="readonly"> 只读：可聚焦，不可修改</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="disabled"> 禁用：释放焦点，不可修改</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="immediate"> 选择后立即提交</c-checkbox>
    <p>select 记录草稿，change 记录提交；取消不改模型，清除返回 undefined。</p>
    <c-time-range
      v-model="value"
      :disable-confirm="immediate"
      :readonly="readonly"
      :disabled="disabled"
      format="HH:mm"
      clearable
      @select="(value, dates) => record('select', value, dates)"
      @change="(value, dates) => record('change', value, dates)"
      @clear="record('clear')"
      @click="record('click')"
      @open-change="(open) => record('open-change', open)"
      @focus="record('focus')"
      @blur="record('blur')"
    />
    <span>模型: {{ value === undefined ? "undefined" : value }}</span>
    <c-button variant="outline" @click="value = ['15:30', '18:00']"
      >从外部替换模型</c-button
    >
    <small>外部替换会更新反显，不触发 select 或 change。</small>
    <div
      v-for="(event, index) in events"
      :key="index"
      style="overflow-wrap: anywhere"
    >
      {{ event }}
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## Reading direction

Range values remain `[start, end]`; direction changes preserve endpoint order, drafts and overnight semantics. Panels and time columns follow reading order, with visual Left/Right focus movement across endpoint columns. Cedar Up/Down moves focus and Enter/Space selects; Maple retains wheel selection with Up/Down. Existing confirmation settings control submission. Popovers inherit their source direction.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Popup configuration and field notifications

`popup-props` configures local Trigger positioning/appearance, e.g. `{ placement: 'top-start' }`, without overriding field open, disabled, trigger or other state/interaction. Top-level `popup-container`, including false, takes precedence. `input-editable` defaults to true and can disable desktop typing. `time-range-picker-props`, including class/style, controls panel appearance. Undeclared attrs no longer supply panel/popup configuration; id/aria-* fall through to the field.

`click(event)` notifies only clicks on non-disabled fields. Readonly may notify without expanding. Closing consistently listens to `open-change(false)`, a close request that controlled open still requires the parent to accept. Neither platform has a field close event; a close request is not a value commit.

`suffix-icon` receives `focus: boolean` and `popupOpen: boolean`. `focus(index = 0)` focuses start (0) or end (1) without committing; `blur()` removes focus and requests closing.

A `placeholder` string applies to both endpoints; arrays provide start/end text, with missing entries empty. Explicit empty strings do not fall back to default text.

### Props

| Arguments                 | Description                                                                                                                      | Type                                                | Default   |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `open-trigger-target`     | Pointer opening target: the whole field or only the suffix icon. Explicit keyboard opening and controlled open remain available. | `'field' \| 'icon'`                                 | `'field'` |
| `model-value`             | Bound value                                                                                                                      | `(string \| number \| Date)[]`                      | `-`       |
| `open`                    | Controlled popup visibility                                                                                                      | `boolean`                                           | `-`       |
| `popup-props`             | Local Trigger presentation options; do not control field state                                                                   | `TimePopupPresentationProps<Partial<TriggerProps>>` | `{}`      |
| `input-editable`          | Allow desktop text input                                                                                                         | `boolean`                                           | `true`    |
| `clearable`               | Show the clear action                                                                                                            | `boolean`                                           | `true`    |
| `disabled`                | Disable interaction                                                                                                              | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| `readonly`                | Read-only interaction                                                                                                            | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| `size`                    | Size                                                                                                                             | `xs \| sm \| md \| lg \| xl`                        | `-`       |
| `variant`                 | Field appearance                                                                                                                 | `filled \| outline \| standard`                     | `filled`  |
| `placeholder`             | Placeholder                                                                                                                      | `string \| string[]`                                | `-`       |
| `format`                  | Display format                                                                                                                   | `string`                                            | `-`       |
| `use12-hours`             | 12-hour clock                                                                                                                    | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| `hide-disabled-options`   | Hide disabled time options                                                                                                       | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| `disable-confirm`         | Skip confirmation; valid selections commit immediately and request closing                                                       | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| `show-next-day`           | Allow end before start and show next day. Otherwise reversed ranges cannot commit. Endpoints are never swapped                   | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| `time-range-picker-props` | Forwarded to TimeRangePicker                                                                                                     | `object`                                            | `{}`      |

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

Inline date/time fields retain their existing confirmation policy. In click/dblclick editors, internal panels hide confirmation tools, and the edit layer supplies one confirm/cancel pair. Standalone DatePicker, DateRangePicker, TimePicker and TimeRangePicker retain panel APIs/confirmation and do not inherit Form field presentation.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

### Forwarded configuration boundaries (F07)

Existing TimePopupPresentationProps and runtime filtering remain. Fields own open/defaultOpen, disabled, trigger, closeOnClickReference, preventFocus and expansion updates. Explicit top-level popup-container takes precedence, otherwise nested configuration is used. popupClass merges internal classes. Inline popupOffset stays 4; Maple also fixes unmountOnClose=true. Such fields in old types are not guaranteed to control final values. Existing Time types/runtime behavior are not narrowed here.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

### Time formats and 12-hour clocks

Compare minute, second and 12-hour displays. Distinguish midnight (12 AM) from noon (12 PM); model formats and step constraints remain separate.

Example source: src/time/__demos__/format-comparison.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue"
```

### Step

- `format`: Controls the displayed format.
- `step`: Controls the allowed increment.

Example source: src/time/__demos__/step.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
const value = ref("09:30:00");
const coarse = ref(false);
const fiveHours = ref(false);
const blockAfternoon = ref(false);
const accept = ref(true);
const proposals = ref(0);
const disabledHours = () => (blockAfternoon.value ? [15] : []);
function update(next) {
  proposals.value++;
  if (accept.value) value.value = next;
}
const step = computed(() => ({
  hour: fiveHours.value ? 5 : 1,
  minute: coarse.value ? 30 : 15,
  second: 10,
}));
</script>

<template>
  <c-space
    class="time-step-demo"
    direction="column"
    :size="12"
    style="width: 100%"
  >
    <c-checkbox v-model="fiveHours"> 十二小时显示 + 5 小时步长</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="coarse"> 切换为 30 分钟步长</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="blockAfternoon"> 禁用 15 点（03 PM）</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="accept"> 父级接受更新</c-checkbox>
    <p>确认时按当前步长重新校验；切换规则不会自动修改已提交值。</p>
    <c-time
      :model-value="value"
      format="HH:mm:ss"
      :use12-hours="fiveHours"
      :step="step"
      :disabled-hours="disabledHours"
      style="width: 100%; max-width: 360px"
      @update:model-value="update"
    />
    <span>{{ value }}</span>
    <span role="status">提议次数：{{ proposals }}</span>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Selection Events

- `readonly`: Displays the current value without allowing edits.
- `disabled`: Prevents user interaction.
- `format`: Controls the displayed format.

Example source: src/time/__demos__/selection-events.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";

const value = ref("09:00");
const immediate = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const events = ref([]);
function record(name, value, dates) {
  const times = Array.isArray(dates)
    ? dates.map((date) => date?.toLocaleTimeString())
    : dates?.toLocaleTimeString();
  events.value = [
    JSON.stringify({ event: name, value: value ?? null, time: times ?? null }),
    ...events.value,
  ].slice(0, 5);
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-space direction="column" size="12px" style="width: 100%">
    <c-checkbox v-model="readonly"> 只读：可聚焦，不可修改</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="disabled"> 禁用：释放焦点，不可修改</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="immediate"> 选择后立即提交</c-checkbox>
    <p>select 记录草稿，change 记录提交；取消不改模型，清除返回 undefined。</p>
    <c-time
      v-model="value"
      :disable-confirm="immediate"
      :readonly="readonly"
      :disabled="disabled"
      format="HH:mm"
      clearable
      @select="(value, dates) => record('select', value, dates)"
      @change="(value, dates) => record('change', value, dates)"
      @clear="record('clear')"
      @click="record('click')"
      @open-change="(open) => record('open-change', open)"
      @focus="record('focus')"
      @blur="record('blur')"
    />
    <span>模型: {{ value === undefined ? "undefined" : value }}</span>
    <c-button variant="outline" @click="value = '15:30'"
      >从外部替换模型</c-button
    >
    <small>外部替换会更新反显，不触发 select 或 change。</small>
    <div
      v-for="(event, index) in events"
      :key="index"
      style="overflow-wrap: anywhere"
    >
      {{ event }}
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`. Direction changes neither change the time nor commit drafts. Time columns follow reading order; Left/Right moves focus visually between columns. Cedar Up/Down and Home/End move focus within a column, skipping disabled options; Enter/Space selects. Maple wheels retain their existing Up/Down and Home/End selection behavior. Existing confirmation settings control submission. Popovers inherit their source direction.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Popup configuration and field notifications

`popup-props` configures local Trigger positioning/appearance, e.g. `{ placement: 'top-start' }`, without overriding field state/interaction such as open, disabled or trigger. Top-level `popup-container`, including false, takes precedence. `input-editable` defaults to true and can disable desktop typing. `time-picker-props`, including class/style, controls panel appearance. Undeclared attrs no longer supply panel/popup configuration; id/aria-* fall through to the field.

`click(event)` notifies only clicks on non-disabled fields. Readonly may notify without expanding. Closing consistently listens to `open-change(false)`, a close request that controlled open still requires the parent to accept. Neither platform has a field close event; a close request is not a value commit.

The field icon slot is `suffix-icon` with `focus: boolean` and `popupOpen: boolean`. `focus(index = 0)` focuses an endpoint without committing; `blur()` removes focus and requests closing.

### Props

| Arguments               | Description                                                                                                                      | Type                                                | Default   |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `open-trigger-target`   | Pointer opening target: the whole field or only the suffix icon. Explicit keyboard opening and controlled open remain available. | `'field' \| 'icon'`                                 | `'field'` |
| `model-value`           | Bound value                                                                                                                      | `string \| number \| Date`                          | `-`       |
| `open`                  | Controlled popup visibility                                                                                                      | `boolean`                                           | `-`       |
| `popup-props`           | Local Trigger presentation options; do not control field state                                                                   | `TimePopupPresentationProps<Partial<TriggerProps>>` | `{}`      |
| `input-editable`        | Allow desktop text input                                                                                                         | `boolean`                                           | `true`    |
| `clearable`             | Show the clear action                                                                                                            | `boolean`                                           | `true`    |
| `disabled`              | Disable interaction                                                                                                              | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| `readonly`              | Read-only interaction                                                                                                            | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| `size`                  | Size                                                                                                                             | `xs \| sm \| md \| lg \| xl`                        | `-`       |
| `variant`               | Field appearance                                                                                                                 | `filled \| outline \| standard`                     | `filled`  |
| `placeholder`           | Placeholder                                                                                                                      | `string`                                            | `-`       |
| `format`                | Display format                                                                                                                   | `string`                                            | `-`       |
| `use12-hours`           | 12-hour clock                                                                                                                    | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| `hide-disabled-options` | Hide disabled time options                                                                                                       | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| `step`                  | Hour/minute/second steps                                                                                                         | `object`                                            | `-`       |
| `disable-confirm`       | Skip confirmation                                                                                                                | `boolean`                                           | `false`   |
| `time-picker-props`     | Forwarded to TimePicker                                                                                                          | `object`                                            | `{}`      |

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

Inline date/time fields retain their existing confirmation policy. In click/dblclick editors, internal panels hide confirmation tools, and the edit layer supplies one confirm/cancel pair. Standalone DatePicker, DateRangePicker, TimePicker and TimeRangePicker retain panel APIs/confirmation and do not inherit Form field presentation.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

### Forwarded configuration boundaries (F07)

Existing TimePopupPresentationProps and runtime filtering remain. Fields own open/defaultOpen, disabled, trigger, closeOnClickReference, preventFocus and expansion updates. Explicit top-level popup-container takes precedence, otherwise nested configuration is used. popupClass merges internal classes. Inline popupOffset stays 4; Maple also fixes unmountOnClose=true. Such fields in old types are not guaranteed to control final values. Existing Time types/runtime behavior are not narrowed here.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.
