## Content and presentation

### Pending

Preview configuration: `align="center"`, `:checked="!!pendingProps.orientation"`, `:checked="!!pendingProps.reverse"`, `:checked="!!pendingProps.pending"`.

Example source: src/timeline/__demos__/pending.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-row align="center" :style="{ marginBottom: '24px' }">
    <c-checkbox :checked="!!pendingProps.orientation" @change="(v) => onChange({ orientation: v ? 'horizontal' : '' })">
      horizontal &nbsp; &nbsp;
    </c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox :checked="!!pendingProps.reverse" @change="(v) => onChange({ reverse: v })">
      reverse &nbsp; &nbsp;
    </c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox
      :checked="!!pendingProps.pending"
      @change="(v) => onChange({ pending: v ? 'This is a pending dot' : false })"
    >
      pending &nbsp; &nbsp;
    </c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox :checked="!!pendingProps.hasPendingDot" @change="(v) => onChange({ hasPendingDot: v })">
      custom pendingDot
    </c-checkbox>
  </c-row>
  <c-timeline v-bind="pendingProps">
    <template v-if="pendingProps.hasPendingDot" #dot>
      <c-icon-fire :style="{ color: '#e70a0a' }" />
    </template>
    <c-timeline-item label="2017-03-10" dotColor="#52C419"> The first milestone </c-timeline-item>
    <c-timeline-item label="2018-05-12" dotColor="#F5222D"> The second milestone </c-timeline-item>
    <c-timeline-item label="2020-09-30">The third milestone</c-timeline-item>
  </c-timeline>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const pendingProps = ref({})

const onChange = (newProps) => {
  pendingProps.value = {
    ...pendingProps.value,
    ...newProps,
  }
}
</script>
```

## API

### `<timeline>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | :----------: |
| reverse | Whether reverse order | `boolean` | `false` |
| orientation | Horizontal/vertical axis of the timeline line, default vertical; constrains valid item sides | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'vertical'` |
| mode | The display mode of Timeline | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'alternate'` | `'left'` |
| pending | Whether to display ghost nodes. When set to true, only ghost nodes are displayed. When passed to ReactNode, it will be displayed as node content | `boolean\|string` | `-` |
| label-position | Position of label text | `'relative' \| 'same'` | `'same'` |

### `<timeline>` Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| ------ | :------: | ---- |
| dot | Ghost node | - |

### `<timeline-item>` Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ---------- | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------- | :-------: |
| dot-color | Node color | `string` | `-` |
| dot-type | Node type: outlined/filled circle | `'hollow' \| 'solid'` | `'solid'` |
| line-type | Timeline line style: solid/dashed/dotted | `'solid' \| 'dashed' \| 'dotted'` | `'solid'` |
| line-color | Timeline color | `string` | `-` |
| label | Label text | `string` | `-` |
| content-placement | Current per-item side relative to the timeline in alternate mode: left/right for vertical and top/bottom for horizontal. Constrained by mode and orientation | `TimelineItemContentPlacement` | `-` |

### `<timeline-item>` Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments | Version |
| ------ | :--------: | ---- | :----- |
| dot | Custom node | - |  |
| label | Custom label | - | 2.50.0 |

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { MentionInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```


## Reading direction and keyboard interaction

Horizontal timelines follow the inherited reading direction, including connecting lines. `reverse` independently controls visual reversal; switching direction does not reorder the data. Explicit vertical `left`/`right` sides retain their physical meaning.

### Appearance configuration comparison

Choose an axis to compare its available values with the same content and model. Other settings remain unchanged while comparing.

Example source: src/tooltip/__demos__/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive as __demoReactive } from "vue";

const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ status: "default", size: "md" });

import { computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from 'vue'
const demoCompareFields = [{"name":"status","values":["default","primary","info","success","warning","danger"]},{"name":"size","values":["xs","md"]}]
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef("status")
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(() => demoCompareFields.find(field => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)?.values ?? [])
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="status">
        <c-select
          v-model="__demoAppearance['status']"
          :clearable="false"
          :options="[
            { label: 'default', value: 'default' },
            { label: 'primary', value: 'primary' },
            { label: 'info', value: 'info' },
            { label: 'success', value: 'success' },
            { label: 'warning', value: 'warning' },
            { label: 'danger', value: 'danger' },
          ]"
          aria-label="status"
        />
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="size">
        <c-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['size']"
          aria-label="size"
          :options="[
            { label: 'xs', value: 'xs' },
            { label: 'md', value: 'md' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint"><span lang="zh-CN">选择一个对比维度；其他配置和内容保持一致。输入类示例共享同一个值，便于比较外观。</span><span lang="en-US">Compare one dimension while keeping the other settings and content identical. Input specimens share the same value.</span></p>
<c-radio-group v-model="demoCompareAxis" aria-label="Compare configuration" :options="demoCompareFields.map(field => ({ label: field.name, value: field.name }))" />
<div class="demo-config-comparison">
<section v-for="sample in demoComparedOptions" :key="String(sample)">
<p><code>{{ demoCompareAxis }}={{ sample }}</code></p>
<c-tooltip
      content="This is tooltip content"
      color="#3491FA"
      v-bind="{ ...__demoAppearance, [demoCompareAxis]: sample }"
    >
      <c-button>#3491FA</c-button>
    </c-tooltip>
</section>
</div>
  </c-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
```

## Layout and arrangement

### Placement

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | Hint content | Placement |
| `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default top. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | Placement |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `placement`: Chooses the position relative to the trigger.

Example source: src/tooltip/__demos__/placement.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div :style="{ position: 'relative', width: '440px', height: '280px' }">
    <c-tooltip content="This is a Tooltip" placement="top-start">
      <c-button class="button" :style="{ position: 'absolute', top: '0', left: '70px' }">TL</c-button>
    </c-tooltip>
    <c-tooltip content="This is a Tooltip" placement="top">
      <c-button class="button" :style="{ position: 'absolute', top: '0', left: '180px' }">TOP</c-button>
    </c-tooltip>
    <c-tooltip content="This is a Tooltip" placement="top-end">
      <c-button class="button" :style="{ position: 'absolute', top: '0', left: '290px' }">TR</c-button>
    </c-tooltip>
```

## API

Tooltip inherits Trigger positioning, containers, controlled state, closing policies and public methods.

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| content | Hint content | `string` | — |
| status | Panel intent | `default \| primary \| info \| success \| warning \| danger` | `default` |
| size | Implemented sizes | `xs \| md` | `md` |
| color | Background color | `string` | — |
| text-color | Custom text color | `string` | — |
| trigger | Interaction | `TriggerEvent \| TriggerEvent[]` | `['hover', 'focus']` |
| placement | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default top. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | `TriggerPlacement` | `top` |
| show-arrow | Show the arrow | `boolean` | `true` |
| popup-offset | Main-axis distance | `number` | `10` |
| unmount-on-close | Unmount after close | `boolean` | `true` |

Events: `update:open`, `open-change`, `open`, `opened`, `close`, `closed`, `click-outside`. Slots: `default`, `content`. Exposes `open`, `close`, `resize`, `allowClose`, `getReference`, `setReference` and `focusReference`.

Content has `role="tooltip"`. Opening adds its ID to the actual trigger's `aria-describedby`; closing, changing external reference or unmounting removes it.

## Shared-source contract

Cedar/Maple independently maintain matching bodies, props, appearance mappings and structural styles. Only prefixes, local imports and theme-token values differ. No `backgroundColor` or boolean `xs` compatibility entry exists.

## Public CSS variables

These are actual :root defaults. Prefer component variables for business customization; internal positioning variables are not public API.

| Variable | Default | Meaning and use case |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--c-tooltip-background` | `var(--c-sys-color-surface-tooltip)` | Content and arrow background |
| `--c-tooltip-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-on-dark)` | Body foreground |
| `--c-tooltip-status-primary-background` | `var(--c-sys-color-action-primary)` | Primary content/arrow background |
| `--c-tooltip-status-info-background` | `var(--c-sys-color-status-info)` | Info content/arrow background |
| `--c-tooltip-status-success-background` | `var(--c-sys-color-status-success)` | Success content/arrow background |
| `--c-tooltip-status-warning-background` | `var(--c-sys-color-status-warning)` | Warning content/arrow background |
| `--c-tooltip-status-danger-background` | `var(--c-sys-color-status-danger)` | Danger content/arrow background |
| `--c-tooltip-status-primary-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-on-dark)` | Primary text; set together with its background |
| `--c-tooltip-status-info-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-on-dark)` | Info text; set together with its background |
| `--c-tooltip-status-success-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-on-dark)` | Success text; set together with its background |
| `--c-tooltip-status-warning-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-on-dark)` | Warning text; set together with its background |
| `--c-tooltip-status-danger-text-color` | `var(--c-sys-color-content-on-dark)` | Danger text; set together with its background |
| `--c-tooltip-padding-horizontal` | `var(--c-sys-space-6)` | Horizontal content padding |
| `--c-tooltip-padding-vertical` | `var(--c-sys-space-4)` | Vertical content padding |
| `--c-tooltip-font-size` | `var(--c-sys-font-size-md)` | Content font size |
| `--c-tooltip-line-height` | `var(--c-line-height)` | Content line height |
| `--c-tooltip-border-radius` | `var(--c-sys-radius-md)` | Content border radius |
| `--c-tooltip-max-width` | `350px` | Maximum tooltip-content width |
| `--c-tooltip-opacity` | `1` | Content/arrow opacity; changes require contrast checks |
| `--c-tooltip-size-xs-padding-horizontal` | `var(--c-sys-space-4)` | xs horizontal content padding |
| `--c-tooltip-size-xs-padding-vertical` | `var(--c-sys-space-2)` | xs vertical content padding |
| `--c-tooltip-size-xs-font-size` | `var(--c-sys-font-size-xs)` | xs content font size |
| `--c-tooltip-animation-duration` | `var(--c-sys-motion-duration-standard)` | Enter/leave duration; reduced motion may override it |

All built-in themes use opacity 1. Colored solid text follows Button on-dark in both light/dark modes. Maple dark mode retains 4px radius, 14px font and 8px/16px vertical/horizontal padding. Neutral surfaces remain dark in both modes. `color` sets content/arrow backgrounds; `text-color` sets text. Explicit content-style/arrow-style override their respective nodes. Recheck custom colors/opacity.

With Teleport, variables must be in the actual popup scope, for example through `popup-style`. Trigger-button variables do not automatically inherit into popups.

```vue
const targetActions = [{ key: 'custom', label: '自定义弹窗' }]
```

### Tree

- `data`: Data of the transfer
- `default-value`: The default value in the target selection box (uncontrolled state)

Example source: src/transfer/__demos__/tree.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-transfer :data="transferData" :default-value="value">
    <template #source="{ data, selectedKeys, onSelect }">
      <c-tree
        :checkable="true"
        checked-strategy="child"
        :checked-values="selectedKeys"
        :data="getTreeData(data)"
        @check="onSelect"
      />
    </template>
  </c-transfer>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
const treeData = [
  {
    label: 'Trunk 0-0',
    value: '0-0',
    children: [
      {
        label: 'Leaf 0-0-1',
        value: '0-0-1',
      },
      {
        label: 'Branch 0-0-2',
        value: '0-0-2',
        children: [
          {
            label: 'Leaf 0-0-2-1',
            value: '0-0-2-1',
          },
          {
            label: 'Leaf 0-0-2-2',
            value: '0-0-2-2',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Trunk 0-1',
    value: '0-1',
    children: [
      {
        label: 'Branch 0-1-1',
        value: '0-1-1',
        children: [
          {
            label: 'Leaf 0-1-1-1',
            value: '0-1-1-1',
          },
          {
            label: 'Leaf 0-1-1-2',
            value: '0-1-1-2',
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        label: 'Leaf 0-1-2',
        value: '0-1-2',
      },
    ],
  },
]

const getTransferData = (treeData = [], transferDataSource = []) => {
  treeData.forEach((item) => {
    if (item.children) getTransferData(item.children, transferDataSource)
    else transferDataSource.push({ label: item.label, value: item.value })
  })
  return transferDataSource
}

const getTreeData = (data = []) => {
  const values = data.map((item) => item.value)

  const travel = (_treeData = []) => {
    const treeDataSource = []
    _treeData.forEach((item) => {
      if (item.children || values.includes(item.value)) {
        treeDataSource.push({ label: item.label, value: item.value, children: travel(item.children) })
      }
    })
    return treeDataSource
  }

  return travel(treeData)
}

const transferData = getTransferData(treeData)

const value = [{ value: '0-0-2-1' }]
</script>
```

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### `<transfer>` Props

| Parameter                 | Description                                          | Type                                                        |             Default             |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | :-----------------------------: |
| data                      | Data of the transfer                                 | `TransferItem[]` / `(query, { signal }) => Array / Promise` |           `undefined`           |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Complete ordered target-side state                   | `TransferTargetItem[]`                                      |               `-`               |
| default-value             | Complete uncontrolled target-side state              | `TransferTargetItem[]`                                      |              `[]`               |
| disabled                  | Whether disabled                                     | `boolean`                                                   |             `false`             |
| virtual-scroll            | Whether virtual scrolling is enabled                 | `boolean`                                                   |             `false`             |
| target-draggable          | Whether the target list can be reordered by dragging | `boolean`                                                   |             `false`             |
| target-operation          | Target actions shown as a remove icon or action menu | `'remove' \| 'menu'`                                        |           `'remove'`            |
| clear-text                | Target clear-button text                             | `string`                                                    |             `清空`              |
| target-actions            | Custom actions appended to the target menu           | `TransferTargetAction[]`                                    |              `[]`               |
| source-filterable         | Show the source search input                         | `boolean`                                                   |             `false`             |
| target-filterable         | Show the target search input                         | `boolean`                                                   |             `false`             |
| show-search               | Show both search inputs                              | `boolean`                                                   |             `false`             |
| filter                    | Custom filter callback                               | `TransferFilter`                                            | Case-insensitive label matching |
| source-filter-placeholder | Source search placeholder                            | `string`                                                    |               `-`               |
| target-filter-placeholder | Target search placeholder                            | `string`                                                    |               `-`               |
| show-selected             | Keep selected items in the source list               | `boolean`                                                   |             `true`              |
| source-title              | Source list title                                    | `string`                                                    |               `-`               |
| target-title              | Target list title                                    | `string`                                                    |               `-`               |
| show-select-all           | Whether show select all checkbox on the header       | `boolean`                                                   |             `true`              |
| title                     | Source/target list titles                            | `string[]`                                                  |     `['Source', 'Target']`      |
| source-search-props       | Source Search configuration in Cedar                 | `object`                                                    |               `-`               |
| target-search-props       | Target Search configuration in Cedar                 | `object`                                                    |               `-`               |

### `<transfer>` Events

| Event         | Description                             | Arguments                                     |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| change        | Emitted when target state changes       | value: `TransferTargetItem[]`                 |
| search        | Emitted on user search                  | value: `string`<br>type: `'target'\|'source'` |
| rename        | Emitted when renaming is confirmed      | value: `TransferValue`, label: `string`       |
| target-action | Emitted when a custom action is clicked | key: `string`, item: `TransferItem`           |

### `<transfer>` Slots

| Slot           |       Description        | Arguments                                                                                                                                                                                             | Version |
| -------------- | :----------------------: | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------ |
| source         |       Source panel       | data: `TransferItem[]`<br>selectedKeys: `string[]`<br>onSelect: `(value: string[]) => void`                                                                                                           | 2.39.0  |
| source-title   |    Source-title slot     | countTotal: `number`<br>countSelected: `number`<br>searchValue: `string`<br>checked: `boolean`<br>indeterminate: `boolean`<br>onSelectAllChange: `(checked:boolean) => void`<br>onClear: `() => void` | 2.45.0  |
| to-target-icon | Move-to-target icon slot | -                                                                                                                                                                                                     | 2.52.0  |
| to-source-icon | Move-to-source icon slot | -                                                                                                                                                                                                     | 2.52.0  |
| target         |       Target panel       | data: `TransferItem[]`<br>selectedKeys: `string[]`<br>onSelect: `(value: string[]) => void`                                                                                                           | 2.39.0  |
| target-title   |    Target-title slot     | countTotal: `number`<br>countSelected: `number`<br>searchValue: `string`<br>checked: `boolean`<br>indeterminate: `boolean`<br>onSelectAllChange: `(checked:boolean) => void`<br>onClear: `() => void` | 2.45.0  |
| item           |         Options          | value: `TransferValue`<br>label: `string`<br>item: `TransferItem`                                                                                                                                     |         |

### TransferItem

| Parameter | Description                                        | Type                           | Default |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | :-----: |
| value     | Option value                                       | `string \| number`             |   `-`   |
| label     | Option label                                       | `string`                       |   `-`   |
| disabled  | Whether disabled                                   | `boolean`                      | `false` |
| group     | Source-group title                                 | `string`                       |   `-`   |
| tip       | Option hint                                        | `string \| (() => VNodeChild)` |   `-`   |
| required  | Whether required; required items cannot be removed | `boolean`                      | `false` |

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type {
  TransferFilter,
  TransferFixed,
  TransferInstance,
  TransferItem,
  TransferTargetAction,
  TransferTargetItem,
  TransferTargetOperation,
  TransferValue,
} from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`data` accepts an array or (query, { signal }) => array/Promise. The component manages loading, cancellation and stale-result isolation; failures emit load-error. Single/multiple groups initialize with an empty query; searchable fields reload when queries change. Tree root loading is independent of existing load-more child loading.

## Reading direction and keyboard interaction

Transfer places candidates at inline-start and selected items at inline-end. Direction changes preserve selected identity/order, filters and frozen state. Native checkboxes and removal buttons support keyboard interaction. Vertical drag ordering and existing left/right freeze values keep their business meaning.

<!-- Source: src/tree-select/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/tree-select/ -->

# TreeSelect

A tree-backed selection field with explicit search fields and controlled selection.

## Reading direction

Inherits source dir. Horizontal keys expand, enter children, return or collapse according to reading direction; vertical keys and Home/End keep logical order. Search uses the actual active match. Values and multiple-value arrays are not reversed. Portaled content retains source direction in custom containers.

## Search migration

filterable replaces allowSearch. The old object retainInputValue option is now the independent retain-input-value boolean. filterable enables search; retain-input-value only retains query text after selecting. Default single selection disables search and multiple selection enables it.

Default local matching now searches label and ignores case. Restore the previous matching with search-fields=['value'] and case-sensitive=true. Multiple configured fields use OR matching. Custom filter-tree-node owns its matching rules. disableFilter bypasses built-in filtering.

## Basic examples

### Basic

Example source: src/tree-select/__demos__/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <c-tree-select v-model="value" :data="data" selectable placeholder="选择部门" />
    <p role="status">当前部门：{{ value || '未选择' }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const value = ref<string>()
const data = [
  { value: 'design', label: '设计部' },
  { value: 'engineering', label: '研发部' },
]
</script>
```

## Data and options

### Search Matching

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
const value = ref("");
const mode = ref("label");
const caseSensitive = ref(false);
const modes = [
  { value: "label", label: "默认：只匹配 label" },
  { value: "both", label: "配置：value 或 label" },
];
const options = [
  { value: "USER_A", label: "Apple" },
  { value: "USER_B", label: "Banana" },
];
const searchFields = computed<("label" | "value")[]>(() =>
  mode.value === "both" ? ["value", "label"] : ["label"],
);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch" fill>
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="匹配字段">
      <c-radio-group
        v-model="mode"
        aria-label="匹配字段"
        :options="modes"
        variant="button"
        size="sm"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-space
      ><c-switch v-model="caseSensitive" /><span>区分大小写</span></c-space
    >
    <c-tree-select
      v-model="value"
      :data="options"
      :case-sensitive="caseSensitive"
      :search-fields="searchFields"
      filterable
      placeholder="输入 Apple、apple 或 USER_A"
    />
    <p>
      默认搜索 label，不区分大小写；配置两字段后，USER_A 和 Apple
      都能找到同一个选项。
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Retain the query after selecting

Type Al, then select Alice: the selected model contains Alice in both examples. Without retain-input-value the search text becomes empty; with it enabled, Al remains so Alan is still easy to select next. This does not control the selected label or whether the field is searchable. filterable enables searching.

Example source: src/tree-select/__demos__/en-US/retain-input-value.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const cleared = ref<string[]>([])
const retained = ref<string[]>([])
const clearQuery = ref('')
const retainedQuery = ref('')
const data = [{ key: 'alice', title: 'Alice' }, { key: 'alan', title: 'Alan' }, { key: 'bob', title: 'Bob' }]
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>Type Al and select Alice. Both fields select Alice; only the remaining query text differs.</p>
    <c-tree-select v-model="cleared" v-model:input-value="clearQuery" :data="data" filterable multiple placeholder="Clear query after selecting" />
    <output>Selected: {{ cleared }}; query: {{ JSON.stringify(clearQuery) }}</output>
    <c-tree-select v-model="retained" v-model:input-value="retainedQuery" :data="data" filterable multiple retain-input-value placeholder="Keep query after selecting" />
    <output>Selected: {{ retained }}; query: {{ JSON.stringify(retainedQuery) }}</output>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

The candidate `data` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. Components own loading, cancellation and stale results, and emit load-error on failure. Choice groups initialize with an empty query; searchable fields load when queries change. Root tree loaders remain independent of existing load-more child loading.

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

## Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { TreeSelectProps } from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

### Form field presentation and confirmation

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

### In-place editing and keyboard precedence

`click`/`dblclick` use Form's editing inheritance. Hover/focus shows an edit icon that opens editing directly. disabled, readonly and readPretty hide edit entries. Panel clicks change only the draft.

While open, arrows navigate visible enabled nodes; Left/Right collapse/expand or move to parents/children; Home/End reach first/last nodes. Enter selects/checks the current node, or toggles an unselectable branch. Search prioritizes matching nodes; multiple selection uses Tree checking rules. Esc first closes the panel, retaining the draft and restoring input focus. With the panel closed, Enter saves and Esc cancels editing. Compare AutoComplete/PeopleSelect in Form's unified field-presentation examples.

Duplicate expansion requests for the same asynchronously loaded node are merged. Replacing nodes, closing editors or resetting Form invalidates old requests so they cannot expand/check nodes. Arrows can enter loaded children immediately. Query/candidate changes clear old filters before Enter can choose stale options. Field confirmation still validates before asynchronous commit.

### Node fields and business values

Nodes default to `{ value, label, children }`. `value` is a tree-wide unique string/number, including `0`; `label` is display content. Map other backend fields with `fieldNames: { value: 'id', label: 'text', children: 'items' }` without changing backend data. Declarative child `name`, Vue `:key` and Table `rowKey` retain separate meanings.

Independent Tree state uses `selectedValues/defaultSelectedValues`, `checkedValues/defaultCheckedValues`, `halfCheckedValues` and `expandedValues/defaultExpandedValues`, updated through corresponding named v-models. `check` event indeterminate sets use `halfCheckedValues`. Node content uses `label`; TreeSelect forwards `tree-slot-label`. `scrollIntoView({ value })` locates business values; explicit `index` remains a zero-based virtual-list array `index`.

### Search configuration

Use `filterable` to enable search: single defaults false, multiple true. `retain-input-value` separately controls whether selection retains the search query, default false.

Migration: `allow-search` becomes `filterable`; `{ retainInputValue: true }` becomes `filterable` plus `retain-input-value`. Old entries are removed without compatibility aliases and require a major release.

### Built-in search fields

`searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty.

```vue
      <c-tree :default-selected-values="['0-0-1']" :data="scene3.treeData" :show-line="scene3.showLine" />
  </section>
</div>
</template>
```

## Search and drag

### Search

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | Pass in `data` to generate the corresponding tree structure | Search, Draggable |
| `draggable` | Whether it can be dragged | Draggable |
| `block-node` | Whether the node occupies a row | Draggable |
| `checkable` | Add a checkbox before nodes | Draggable |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


- `data`: Pass in `data` to generate the corresponding tree structure

Example source: src/tree/__demos__/search.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div>
    <c-search style="margin-bottom: 8px; max-width: 240px" v-model="searchKey" />
    <c-tree :data="treeData">
      <template #label="nodeData">
        <template v-if="(index = getMatchIndex(nodeData?.title)) < 0">
          {{ nodeData?.title }}
        </template>
        <span v-else>
          {{ nodeData?.label?.substr(0, index) }}
          <span style="color: var(--color-primary-light-4)">
            {{ nodeData?.label?.substr(index, searchKey.length) }} </span
          >{{ nodeData?.label?.substr(index + searchKey.length) }}
        </span>
      </template>
    </c-tree>
  </div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

let index

const originTreeData = [
  {
    label: 'Trunk 0-0',
    value: '0-0',
    children: [
      {
        label: 'Branch 0-0-1',
        value: '0-0-1',
        children: [
          {
            label: 'Leaf 0-0-1-1',
            value: '0-0-1-1',
          },
          {
            label: 'Leaf 0-0-1-2',
            value: '0-0-1-2',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Trunk 0-1',
    value: '0-1',
    children: [
      {
        label: 'Branch 0-1-1',
        value: '0-1-1',
        children: [
          {
            label: 'Leaf 0-1-1-0',
            value: '0-1-1-0',
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        label: 'Branch 0-1-2',
        value: '0-1-2',
        children: [
          {
            label: 'Leaf 0-1-2-0',
            value: '0-1-2-0',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
]
const searchKey = ref('')
const treeData = computed(() => {
  if (!searchKey.value) return originTreeData
  return searchData(searchKey.value)
})

function searchData(keyword) {
  const loop = (data) => {
    const result = []
    data.forEach((item) => {
      if (item.title.toLowerCase().indexOf(keyword.toLowerCase()) > -1) {
        result.push({ ...item })
      } else if (item.children) {
        const filterData = loop(item.children)
        if (filterData.length) {
          result.push({
            ...item,
            children: filterData,
          })
        }
      }
    })
    return result
  }

  return loop(originTreeData)
}

function getMatchIndex(title) {
  if (!searchKey.value) return -1
  return title.toLowerCase().indexOf(searchKey.value.toLowerCase())
}
</script>
```

### Draggable

- `draggable`: Whether it can be dragged
- `block-node`: Whether the node occupies a row
- `checkable`: Whether to add a checkbox before the node, function format is supported since `2.27.0`
- `data`: Pass in `data` to generate the corresponding tree structure

Example source: src/tree/__demos__/draggable.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-checkbox v-model="checked" style="margin-bottom: 20px"> checkable </c-checkbox>
  <c-tree class="tree-demo" draggable blockNode :checkable="checked" :data="treeData" @drop="onDrop" />
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const defaultTreeData = [
  {
    label: 'Trunk 0-0',
    value: '0-0',
    children: [
      {
        label: 'Leaf 0-0-1',
        value: '0-0-1',
      },
      {
        label: 'Branch 0-0-2',
        value: '0-0-2',
        disableCheckbox: true,
        children: [
          {
            draggable: false,
            label: 'Leaf 0-0-2-1 (Drag disabled)',
            value: '0-0-2-1',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Trunk 0-1',
    value: '0-1',
    children: [
      {
        label: 'Branch 0-1-1',
        value: '0-1-1',
        checkable: false,
        children: [
          {
            label: 'Leaf 0-1-1-1',
            value: '0-1-1-1',
          },
          {
            label: 'Leaf 0-1-1-2',
            value: '0-1-1-2',
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        label: 'Leaf 0-1-2',
        value: '0-1-2',
      },
    ],
  },
]

const treeData = ref(defaultTreeData)
const checkedValues = ref([])
const checked = ref(false)

function onDrop({ dragNode, dropNode, dropPosition }) {
  const data = treeData.value
  const loop = (data, key, callback) => {
    data.some((item, index, arr) => {
      if (item.key === key) {
        callback(item, index, arr)
        return true
      }
      if (item.children) {
        return loop(item.children, key, callback)
      }
      return false
    })
  }

  loop(data, dragNode.key, (_, index, arr) => {
    arr.splice(index, 1)
  })

  if (dropPosition === 0) {
    loop(data, dropNode.key, (item) => {
      item.children = item.children || []
      item.children.push(dragNode)
    })
  } else {
    loop(data, dropNode.key, (_, index, arr) => {
      arr.splice(dropPosition < 0 ? index : index + 1, 0, dragNode)
    })
  }
}
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
  <c-tree :data="treeData" :load-more="loadMore" />
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const treeData = ref([
  {
    label: 'Trunk 0-0',
    value: '0-0',
  },
  {
    label: 'Trunk 0-1',
    value: '0-1',
    children: [
      {
        label: 'Branch 0-1-1',
        value: '0-1-1',
      },
    ],
  },
])

const loadMore = (nodeData) => {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      nodeData.children = [{ label: `leaf`, value: `${nodeData.key}-1`, isLeaf: true }]
      resolve()
    }, 1000)
  })
}
</script>
```

### Virtual

- `block-node`: Whether the node occupies a row
- `checkable`: Whether to add a checkbox before the node, function format is supported since `2.27.0`
- `data`: Pass in `data` to generate the corresponding tree structure
- `virtual-list-props`: Pass virtual list properties, pass in this parameter to turn on virtual scrolling, [VirtualListProps](#VirtualListProps)

Example source: src/tree/__demos__/virtual.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-button status="primary" :style="{ marginBottom: '20px' }" @click="scrollIntoView">
    Scroll to 0-0-2-2, i.e. the 26th.
  </c-button>
  <c-tree
    ref="treeRef"
    blockNode
    checkable
    :data="treeData"
    :virtualListProps="{
      height: 200,
    }" />
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

function loop(path = '0', level = 2) {
  const list = []
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i += 1) {
    const key = `${path}-${i}`
    const treeNode: {
      label: string
      value: string
      children?: ReturnType<typeof loop>
    } = {
      label: key,
      key,
    }

    if (level > 0) {
      treeNode.children = loop(key, level - 1)
    }

    list.push(treeNode)
  }
  return list
}

const treeRef = ref()
const treeData = loop()
const scrollIntoView = () => {
  treeRef.value && treeRef.value.scrollIntoView({ value: '0-0-2-2' })
}
</script>
```

| action-on-node-click | The action triggered when the node is clicked | `'expand'` | `-` |

### Type definitions

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { TreeInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

### Five densities and icons

xs/sm/md/lg/xl consume their icon-size, font-size, line-height and title-padding-vertical. Icon sizes also determine expansion-button/indent geometry; show-line follows the matching line height.

| Variable | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-tree-size-xl-icon-size` | `var(--c-size-4)` |
| `--c-tree-size-xl-font-size` | `var(--c-sys-font-size-lg)` |
| `--c-tree-size-xl-line-height` | `var(--c-size-xl)` |
| `--c-tree-size-xl-title-padding-vertical` | `12px` |

### Node fields and business values

Nodes default to `{ value, label, children }`. `value` is a tree-wide unique string/number, including `0`; `label` is display content. Map other backend fields with `fieldNames: { value: 'id', label: 'text', children: 'items' }` without changing backend data. Declarative child `name`, Vue `:key` and Table `rowKey` retain separate meanings.

Independent Tree state uses `selectedValues/defaultSelectedValues`, `checkedValues/defaultCheckedValues`, `halfCheckedValues` and `expandedValues/defaultExpandedValues`, updated through corresponding named v-models. `check` event indeterminate sets use `halfCheckedValues`. Node content uses `label`; TreeSelect forwards `tree-slot-label`. `scrollIntoView({ value })` locates business values; explicit `index` remains a zero-based virtual-list array `index`.


| Focus outline token | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-tree-focus-outline-width` | `2px` |

## Reading direction and keyboard interaction

Tree mirrors indentation, connectors, disclosure icons and horizontal branch keys. Up/down and Home/End navigate enabled visible nodes independently of selection. Enter selects; Space checks a checkable node or selects it. The tree keeps DOM focus through virtual scrolling using aria-activedescendant. Vertical drop semantics remain unchanged. Embedded TreeSelect retains its own focus owner.

| duration | Transition duration | `number \| { enter: number; leave: number }` | `-` |
| auto-fit-transform-origin | Derive transform origin from final placement | `boolean` | `false` |
| opened-class | Class added to the first reference node while open | `ClassName` | `-` |

### Expose

`open()`、`close()`、`resize()`、`allowClose()`、`getReference()`、`setReference(reference?)`、`focusReference()`、`isTopLayer(event?)`。

## Keyboard and accessibility

`trigger="focus"` supports keyboard focus. `esc-to-close` lets only the topmost popup handle Escape. Trigger does not assign `role`, `aria-describedby` or business labels; semantic wrappers such as Tooltip, Popover and Menu must supply them.

## Public CSS variables

These are actual :root defaults. Prefer component variables for business customization; internal positioning variables are not public API.

| Variable | Default | Meaning and use case |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--c-trigger-arrow-background` | `var(--c-sys-color-surface-overlay)` | Standalone Trigger arrow background; wrappers use their own variables |
| `--c-trigger-arrow-size` | `var(--c-sys-space-4)` | Arrow square size |
| `--c-trigger-arrow-radius` | `var(--c-sys-radius-sm)` | Arrow border radius |
| `--c-trigger-transition-duration` | `var(--c-sys-motion-duration-fast)` | Default Trigger fade duration |
| `--c-trigger-transition-easing` | `var(--c-sys-motion-easing-standard)` | Default Trigger easing |

Tooltip/Popover define arrow appearance themselves. Override their component variables rather than Trigger arrow-background.

With Teleport, variables must be in the actual popup scope, for example through `popup-style`. Trigger-button variables do not automatically inherit into popups.

### Reduced motion

Built-in CSS transitions follow `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Removing transitions does not change final visibility, selected/expanded state or event semantics. Applications control custom animations inside slots.


### Placement semantics and configuration

placement is a preferred side; final placement may change while auto-fit-position is true (the default). It is not a position coordinate. top-start is anchor-side alignment, whereas top-left denotes a container corner. Current Trigger start/end follows physical cross-axis geometry; automatic RTL mirroring is not promised.

```vue
import { ref } from "vue";

const active = ref(true);
const mounted = ref(true);
const copies = ref(0);
</script>

  <div>
    <c-button html-type="button" @click="active = !active"
      >切换 KeepAlive</c-button
    >

      >卸载／挂载</c-button
    >

    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <TypographyText
        v-if="active"
        copyable
        :ellipsis="{ rows: 1, expandable: true }"
        @copy="copies++"
      >
        Typography
        测量调度与复制反馈生命周期示例：重复复制只保留最新反馈，停用和卸载取消待处理工作。
      </TypographyText>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

## API

### Common Props

`Typography.Title`, `Typography.Paragraph` and `Typography.Text` share these props.

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | :---: |
| status | Semantic text status | `SemanticStatus` | `-` |
| bold | Bold | `boolean` | `false` |
| mark | Mark styling | `boolean \| { color: string }` | `false` |
| underline | Underline styling | `boolean` | `false` |
| delete | Strikethrough styling | `boolean` | `false` |
| code | Code-block styling | `boolean` | `false` |
| disabled | Whether to disable link | `boolean` | `false` |
| editable | Enable editing | `boolean` | `false` |
| editing **(v-model)** | Whether currently editing | `boolean` | `-` |
| default-editing | Default editing state | `boolean` | `false` |
| edit-text **(v-model)** | Edited text | `string` | `-` |
| copyable | Enable copying | `boolean` | `false` |
| copy-text | Text to copy | `string` | `-` |
| copy-delay | Delay in ms before the copy button becomes clickable again after successful copying | `number` | `3000` |
| ellipsis | Automatic truncation; see EllipsisConfig | `boolean \| EllipsisConfig` | `false` |
| edit-tooltip-props | Edit-button Tooltip options | `object` | `-` |
| copy-tooltip-props | Copy-button Tooltip options | `object` | `-` |

### Common Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| edit-start | Editing starts | `-` |
| change | Edited content changes | `text: string` |
| edit-end | Editing ends | `-` |
| copy | Copy | `text: string` |
| ellipsis | Ellipsis-state change | `isEllipsis: boolean` |
| expand | Expand/collapse event | `expanded: boolean` |

### Common Slots

| Slot | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| expand-node | Custom expand/collapse buttons | `expanded: boolean` |
| copy-icon | Custom copy-button icon | `copied: boolean` |
| copy-tooltip | Custom copy-button tooltip content | `copied: boolean` |

### `<TypographyTitle>` Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | :---: |
| heading | Heading level, equivalent to `h1`/`h2`/`h3`/`h4`/`h5`/`h6` | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `1` |

### `<TypographyParagraph>` Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | :---: |
| blockquote | Block quotation | `boolean` | `false` |
| spacing | Paragraph line height; use the default for long text and `close` for short text | `'default' \| 'close'` | `'default'` |

### EllipsisConfig

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | :---: |
| rows | Number of displayed lines before truncation | `number` | `1` |
| expandable | Whether expand/collapse is supported | `boolean` | `false` |
| ellipsisStr | Ellipsis | `string` | `'...'` |
| suffix | Suffix | `string` | `-` |
| showTooltip | Popup options for truncated content | `boolean \| { type: 'tooltip' \| 'popover'; props: Record<string, any> }` | `false` |
| css | Use CSS truncation; currently does not support expansion, custom ellipsis or suffix | `boolean` | `false` |

<!-- Source: src/upload/README.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/components/upload/ -->

# Upload

Upload UI and a headless useUploader composable. The application owns transport and server file deletion.

## Replacement and video metadata

Enable reupload for per-item replacement, or call replace(file, replacementFile). Validation and beforeRemove rejection preserve the original item. An accepted replacement occupies the same position with a new UID and emits replace/change, not remove. A failed new upload can be retried; it does not automatically restore the old server file or delete it.

Video duration is expressed in seconds and rendered as mm:ss or h:mm:ss. Local files are inspected; remote echoes provide duration from application metadata. Temporary resources are released on success, error, cancellation and disposal.

| Variable                                | Default                                  |
| --------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| --c-upload-gap                          | var(--c-sys-space-4)                     |
| --c-upload-trigger-min-height           | var(--c-sys-control-height-md)           |
| --c-upload-trigger-padding-horizontal   | var(--c-sys-space-6)                     |
| --c-upload-trigger-draggable-min-height | calc(var(--c-sys-control-height-md) * 2) |
| --c-upload-card-size                    | calc(var(--c-sys-control-height-md) * 2) |
| --c-upload-item-min-height              | var(--c-sys-control-height-md)           |
| --c-upload-item-padding                 | var(--c-sys-space-4)                     |
| --c-upload-thumb-size                   | var(--c-sys-control-height-lg)           |

```vue
<script setup>
```

```vue
const disabled = ref(false);
const chooseCount = ref(0);
const previewCount = ref(0);
const initialFile = {
  uid: "state-image",
  name: "state-example.svg",
  type: "image/svg+xml",
  url: "data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%22120%22 height=%22120%22%3E%3Crect width=%22120%22 height=%22120%22 fill=%22%236750a4%22/%3E%3C/svg%3E",

  percent: 100,

      :readonly="readonly"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :request-choose="choose"
      @preview="previewCount++"
```

| Prop                                                         | Type                                                     | Default/Description                                                               |
| ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| model-value / default-value                                  | UploadFileItem[]                                         | Controlled value / initial uncontrolled value []                                  |
| accept / capture                                             | string / native capture                                  | Unspecified                                                                       |
| multiple / directory / draggable                             | boolean                                                  | false                                                                             |
| disabled / readonly                                          | boolean                                                  | undefined; inherits Form; explicit false wins                                     |
| action / method                                              | string                                                   | None / post                                                                       |
| headers / data                                               | object or async(file) => object                          | Request preparation remains cancellable                                           |
| name                                                         | string / (file) => string                                | file                                                                              |
| with-credentials                                             | boolean                                                  | false                                                                             |
| custom-request                                               | (UploadRequestOptions) => UploadRequest / Promise / void | Custom transport; may return an abort handle                                      |
| auto-upload                                                  | boolean                                                  | true; starts only when action or custom-request is provided                       |
| max-files / max-file-size / max-total-size                   | number                                                   | Unspecified; sizes are bytes; max-files applies when greater than zero            |
| resolve-type                                                 | file / data-url / object-url                             | object-url; all files get a URL and images also get thumbnailUrl                  |
| create-thumbnail-url                                         | (options) => string / Promise                            | Custom URLs are caller-owned and are not automatically revoked                    |
| before-add                                                   | async(files) => File[]                                   | Filter or replace a batch                                                         |
| before-read                                                  | async(file) => boolean / File                            | false/rejection rejects; replacement files are revalidated                        |
| before-upload                                                | async(item) => boolean / File / Blob                     | false/rejection cancels preparation; replacements are revalidated                 |
| before-remove                                                | async(item,list) => boolean                              | false/rejection keeps the file                                                    |
| is-success-response                                          | (xhr,item) => boolean                                    | HTTP 2xx by default                                                               |
| request-choose                                               | (chooseFile,event) => void / Promise                     | Own file selection; errors do not automatically fall back to a native file picker |
| list-type                                                    | text / picture / picture-card                            | text; supported on both platforms                                                 |
| image-fit                                                    | fill / contain / cover / none / scale-down               | cover; item.fit takes priority                                                    |
| preview                                                      | boolean                                                  | true                                                                              |
| show-file-list / show-upload-button / show-remove-button     | boolean                                                  | true                                                                              |
| show-retry-button / show-cancel-button / show-preview-button | boolean                                                  | true                                                                              |
| show-download-button                                         | boolean                                                  | false; unavailable while interaction is disabled                                  |
| elevation / ripple                                           | boolean or number / boolean                              | false / true                                                                      |

### Clipboard

Example source: src/upload/__demos__/clipboard.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useUploader, type UploadFileItem } from '@cedar-design/ui'
const files = ref<UploadFileItem[]>([])
const message = ref('')
const rejectionMessages: Record<string, string> = { 'max-files': '最多接收 3 张图片', 'max-file-size': '单张图片不能超过 1 MiB', accept: '仅支持图片文件' }
const uploader = useUploader({
  modelValue: () => files.value,
  onUpdateModelValue: value => { files.value = value },
  accept: () => 'image/*',
  maxFiles: () => 3,
  maxFileSize: () => 1024 * 1024,
  autoUpload: () => false,
  onRejected: rejected => { message.value = rejected.map(item => rejectionMessages[item.reason] ?? '文件未能读取，请重新选择').join(', ') },
})
function paste(event: ClipboardEvent) {
  const incoming = Array.from(event.clipboardData?.files ?? [])
  if (!incoming.length) return
  event.preventDefault()
  message.value = ''
  uploader.addFiles(incoming)
}
function addExample() {
  message.value = ''
  uploader.addFiles([new File(['<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="8" height="8"/>'], 'local-example.svg', { type: 'image/svg+xml' })])
}
function reset() { uploader.reset(); message.value = '' }
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>将剪贴板图片粘贴到输入区。最多 3 张，每张不超过 1 MiB；只读取文件，不上传。普通文本粘贴仍按原生输入处理。</p>
    <c-textarea placeholder="在这里粘贴图片或文本" @paste="paste" />
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="addExample">加入本地示例图片</c-button>
      <c-button @click="reset">清空列表</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p role="status">已接收 {{ files.length }} 个文件。{{ message }}</p>
    <ul><li v-for="file in files" :key="file.uid">{{ file.name }}</li></ul>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Replacement Validation

Example source: src/upload/__demos__/replacement-validation.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref, shallowRef } from "vue";
import { useUploader } from "@cedar-design/ui";

const files = ref([]);
const readDataUrl = ref(false);
const readObjectUrl = ref(false);
const pauseThumbnail = ref(false);
const pendingThumbnails = shallowRef([]);
const decoded = ref(0);
const reasons = ref([]);
const replacements = new WeakMap();
const maxFileSize = 1048576;
const maxTotalSize = 2097152;
const maxFiles = 3;
const svg =
  '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16"><rect width="16" height="16" fill="#4caf50"/></svg>';
let sequence = 0;

function replace(file) {
  const mode = replacements.get(file);
  if (mode === "type") {
    return new File(["text replacement"], file.name.replace(".svg", ".txt"), {
      type: "text/plain",
    });
  }
  if (mode === "size") {
    return new File([new Uint8Array(maxFileSize + 1)], file.name, {
      type: file.type,
    });
  }
  return new File([file], file.name, { type: file.type });
}

const uploader = useUploader({
  modelValue: () => files.value,
  onUpdateModelValue: (value) => {
    files.value = value;
  },
  accept: () => "image/*",
  maxFiles: () => maxFiles,
  createThumbnailUrl: () =>
    pauseThumbnail.value
      ? () =>
          new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            pendingThumbnails.value = [
              ...pendingThumbnails.value,
              { resolve, reject },
            ];
          })
      : undefined,
  maxFileSize: () => maxFileSize,
  maxTotalSize: () => maxTotalSize,
  resolveType: () =>
    readObjectUrl.value
      ? "object-url"
      : readDataUrl.value
        ? "data-url"
        : "file",
  beforeRead: () => replace,
  onRejected: (items) => {
    reasons.value = items.map((item) => item.reason);
  },
});

function probe(mode) {
  reasons.value = [];
  const payload = mode === "total" ? svg.padEnd(786432, " ") : svg;
  const file = new File([payload], `sample-${++sequence}.svg`, {
    type: "image/svg+xml",
  });
  replacements.set(file, mode);
  return uploader.addFiles([file]);
}

function reset() {
  uploader.reset();
  decoded.value = 0;
  reasons.value = [];
}
function settleThumbnail(fail = false, latest = false) {
  const tasks = [...pendingThumbnails.value];
  const task = latest ? tasks.pop() : tasks.shift();
  if (!task) return;
  pendingThumbnails.value = tasks;
  if (fail) task.reject(new Error("Local thumbnail failure"));
  else task.resolve("data:image/svg+xml," + encodeURIComponent(svg));
}
function cleanupThumbnails() {
  const tasks = pendingThumbnails.value;
  pendingThumbnails.value = [];
  tasks.forEach((task) => task.resolve(undefined));
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanupThumbnails);
onDeactivated(cleanupThumbnails);
</script>

<template>
  <div class="upload-read-demo">
    <p class="thumbnail-pending">
      Pending thumbnails: {{ pendingThumbnails.length }}
    </p>
    <c-button
      html-type="button"
      :disabled="!pendingThumbnails.length"
      @click="settleThumbnail(false, true)"
    >
      返回最新缩略图
    </c-button>
    <c-button
      html-type="button"
      :disabled="!pendingThumbnails.length"
      @click="settleThumbnail()"
      >返回最早缩略图</c-button
    >
    <c-button
      html-type="button"
      :disabled="!pendingThumbnails.length"
      @click="settleThumbnail(true)"
      >拒绝最早缩略图</c-button
    >
    <c-checkbox v-model="readDataUrl" edit-mode="direct"
      >使用原生 FileReader 读取为 data-url</c-checkbox
    >
    <c-checkbox v-model="readObjectUrl" edit-mode="direct"
      >使用原生 Blob/object-url（优先）</c-checkbox
    >
    <output
      >Blob URLs:
      {{ files.filter((file) => file.url?.startsWith("blob:")).length }}</output
    >
    <p role="status">
      Data URLs:
      {{ files.filter((file) => file.url?.startsWith("data:")).length }} ·
      Decoded images: {{ decoded }}
    </p>
    <img
      v-for="file in files.filter((file) =>
        /^(data:|blob:)/.test(file.thumbnailUrl || ''),
      )"
      :key="file.uid"
      :src="file.thumbnailUrl"
      :alt="file.name"
      width="16"
      height="16"
      @load="decoded++"
    />
    <p>
      仅接受图片；单文件 1 MiB、合计 2 MiB、最多 3 个。每个示例均经过
      before-read。
    </p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="probe('valid')">加入小图片</c-button>
      <c-button @click="probe('type')">替换为文本</c-button>
      <c-button @click="probe('size')">替换为超大图片</c-button>
      <c-button @click="probe('total')">加入 768 KiB 图片</c-button>
      <c-button @click="reset">重置队列</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-checkbox v-model="pauseThumbnail" edit-mode="direct"
      >暂停本地缩略图 Promise</c-checkbox
    >
    <c-upload
      v-model="files"
      edit-mode="direct"
      :show-upload-button="false"
      :preview="false"
    />
    <p>队列：{{ files.map((file) => file.name).join(", ") || "空" }}</p>
    <p>拒绝原因：{{ reasons.join(", ") || "无" }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Queues and progress

### External State

Example source: src/upload/__demos__/external-state.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from "vue";

const files = ref([]);
const hasUploading = computed(() =>
  files.value.some((file) => file.status === "uploading"),
);
const hasRetryable = computed(() =>
  files.value.some((file) => ["error", "canceled"].includes(file.status)),
);
let sequence = 0;

function read(file) {
  file.status = "uploading";
  file.percent = 40;
}

function addExample() {
  const file = new File(
    ["Local external upload demo."],
    `external-${++sequence}.txt`,
    { type: "text/plain" },
  );
  const item = {
    uid: `external-${sequence}`,
    name: file.name,
    size: file.size,
    type: file.type,
    file,
    status: "ready",
    percent: 0,
  };
  read(item);
  files.value = [...files.value, item];
}

function complete() {
  files.value = files.value.map((file) =>
    file.status === "uploading"
      ? { ...file, status: "success", percent: 100 }
      : file,
  );
}

function retry() {
  files.value = files.value.map((file) =>
    ["error", "canceled"].includes(file.status)
      ? { ...file, status: "uploading", percent: 40 }
      : file,
  );
}
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <p>业务端托管进度和结果；可加入本地示例项，无需选择文件，也不发送请求。</p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="addExample">加入外部上传项</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!hasUploading" @click="complete"
        >模拟外部完成</c-button
      >
      <c-button :disabled="!hasRetryable" @click="retry">模拟外部重试</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-upload
      v-model="files"
      edit-mode="direct"
      :show-retry-button="false"
      @read="read"
    />
    <p>
      队列状态：{{
        files
          .map((file) => `${file.name}: ${file.status} (${file.percent}%)`)
          .join("；") || "空"
      }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>
```
