### Queue Request

Example source: src/upload/__demos__/queue-request.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from "vue";
import type {
  UploadFileItem,
  UploadInstance,
  UploadProgressEvent,
  UploadRequestOptions,
} from "@cedar-design/ui";

const files = ref<UploadFileItem[]>([]);
const uploader = ref<UploadInstance>();
const failOnce = ref(false);
const activeRequests = ref(0);
const timers = new Set<ReturnType<typeof setInterval>>();
const attempts = new Map<string, number>();
const exampleUrls = new Set<string>();
let sequence = 0;

function addExample() {
  const file = new File(
    ["Local upload demo; no network."],
    `example-${++sequence}.txt`,
    { type: "text/plain" },
  );
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
  exampleUrls.add(url);
  files.value = [
    ...files.value,
    {
      uid: `demo-queue-${sequence}`,
      name: file.name,
      size: file.size,
      type: file.type,
      file,
      url,
      status: "ready",
      percent: 0,
    },
  ];
}

function request({
  file,
  onProgress,
  onSuccess,
  onError,
}: UploadRequestOptions) {
  const attempt = (attempts.get(file.uid) ?? 0) + 1;
  attempts.set(file.uid, attempt);
  const reject = failOnce.value && attempt === 1;
  let percent = 0;
  const stop = () => {
    clearInterval(timer);
    timers.delete(timer);
    activeRequests.value = timers.size;
  };
  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    percent += 10;
    onProgress({ percent } as UploadProgressEvent);
    if (percent >= 100) {
      stop();
      if (reject) {
        onError(new Error("Simulated first-attempt failure"));
      } else {
        onSuccess({ ok: true, attempt });
      }
    }
  }, 200);
  timers.add(timer);
  activeRequests.value = timers.size;
  return { abort: stop };
}

function cleanup() {
  uploader.value?.abort();
  timers.forEach((timer) => clearInterval(timer));
  timers.clear();
  activeRequests.value = 0;
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  cleanup();
  exampleUrls.forEach((url) => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));
  exampleUrls.clear();
});
onDeactivated(cleanup);
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <p>本地模拟请求；支持取消、重试和手动提交，不访问网络。</p>
    <c-checkbox v-model="failOnce" edit-mode="direct"
      >首次请求失败（重试成功）</c-checkbox
    >
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="addExample">加入示例文件</c-button>
      <c-button @click="uploader?.submit()">提交队列</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-upload
      ref="uploader"
      v-model="files"
      edit-mode="direct"
      multiple
      :auto-upload="false"
      :custom-request="request"
    />
    <p>
      队列状态：{{
        files
          .map((file) => `${file.name}: ${file.status} (${file.percent}%)`)
          .join("；") || "空"
      }}
    </p>
    <p>活动请求：{{ activeRequests }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Async hooks and requests

### Before Remove

Example source: src/upload/__demos__/before-remove.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref, shallowRef } from "vue";
import type { UploadFileItem } from "@cedar-design/ui";

const files = ref<UploadFileItem[]>([
  {
    uid: "sample",
    name: "sample.txt",
    type: "text/plain",
    status: "success",
    percent: 100,
  },
]);
const allow = ref(false);
const manual = ref(false);
const blocked = ref(false);
const attempts = ref(0);
const removed = ref(0);
const uploadRef = ref();
const mounted = ref(true);
const pending = shallowRef<
  Array<{
    resolve: (accepted: boolean) => void;
    reject: (error: Error) => void;
  }>
>([]);
const beforeRemove = () => {
  attempts.value++;
  if (!manual.value) return allow.value;
  return new Promise<boolean>((resolve, reject) => {
    pending.value = [...pending.value, { resolve, reject }];
  });
};
function settle(accepted: boolean | "reject") {
  const jobs = pending.value;
  pending.value = [];
  jobs.forEach((job) =>
    accepted === "reject"
      ? job.reject(new Error("Local removal rejection"))
      : job.resolve(accepted),
  );
}
function replace() {
  files.value = files.value.map((item) => ({
    ...item,
    name: "replacement.txt",
    type: "text/plain",
    file: new File(["local replacement"], "replacement.txt", {
      type: "text/plain",
    }),
  }));
}
function restore() {
  files.value = [
    {
      uid: "sample",
      name: "restored.txt",
      type: "text/plain",
      status: "success",
      percent: 100,
      file: new File(["local sample"], "restored.txt", { type: "text/plain" }),
    },
  ];
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => settle(false));
onDeactivated(() => settle(false));
</script>

<template>
  <section class="remove-confirm-demo">
    <c-checkbox v-model="allow"> 允许此操作</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="manual"> 手动异步确认</c-checkbox>
    <c-checkbox v-model="blocked"> 禁用上传组件</c-checkbox>
    <c-button
      html-type="button"
      :disabled="!pending.length"
      @click="settle(true)"
      >确认删除</c-button
    >
    <c-button
      html-type="button"
      :disabled="!pending.length"
      @click="settle(false)"
      >取消删除</c-button
    >
    <c-button
      html-type="button"
      :disabled="!pending.length"
      @click="settle('reject')"
      >异常拒绝删除</c-button
    >
    <c-button html-type="button" :disabled="!files.length" @click="replace"
      >替换同 UID 文件</c-button
    >
    <c-button html-type="button" @click="uploadRef?.reset()"
      >重置上传队列</c-button
    >
    <c-button html-type="button" @click="restore">恢复示例文件</c-button>
    <c-checkbox v-model="mounted"> 激活上传组件</c-checkbox>
    <KeepAlive>
      <c-upload
        v-if="mounted"
        ref="uploadRef"
        v-model="files"
        :before-remove="beforeRemove"
        :disabled="blocked"
        @remove="removed++"
      />
    </KeepAlive>
    <p role="status">
      文件：{{ files.length }}；等待：{{ pending.length }}；钩子：{{
        attempts
      }}；删除：{{ removed }}
    </p>
  </section>
</template>
```

### Prepare Request

Example source: src/upload/__demos__/prepare-request.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from 'vue'
import { useUploader } from '@cedar-design/ui'

const files = ref([])
const reasons = ref([])
const mode = ref('valid')
const preparing = ref(0)
const requestCount = ref(0)
const pending = new Set()
const modes = [
  { label: '有效副本', value: 'valid' },
  { label: '替换为文本', value: 'type' },
  { label: '替换为超大图片', value: 'size' },
  { label: '每项替换600B，合计上限1024B', value: 'total' },
]
let sequence = 0

function beforeUpload(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    pending.add({ file, resolve })
    preparing.value = pending.size
  })
}

const uploader = useUploader({
  modelValue: () => files.value,
  onUpdateModelValue: (value) => {
    files.value = value
  },
  accept: () => 'image/*',
  maxFileSize: () => 1024,
  maxFiles: () => mode.value === 'total' ? 2 : 1,
  maxTotalSize: () => 1024,
  resolveType: () => 'file',
  autoUpload: () => false,
  beforeUpload: () => beforeUpload,
  customRequest:
    () =>
    ({ onSuccess }) => {
      requestCount.value++
      onSuccess({ ok: true })
    },
  onRejected: (items) => {
    reasons.value = items.map((item) => item.reason)
  },
})

function add() {
  const svg = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1" height="1"/>'
  return uploader.addFiles([new File([svg], `prepare-${++sequence}.svg`, { type: 'image/svg+xml' })])
}

function submit() {
  reasons.value = []
  return uploader.submit()
}

function finish() {
  const jobs = [...pending]
  pending.clear()
  preparing.value = 0
  jobs.forEach(({ file, resolve }) => {
    const raw = file.file
    if (mode.value === 'type') {
      resolve(new File(['text'], 'replacement.txt', { type: 'text/plain' }))
    } else if (mode.value === 'size') {
      resolve(new File([new Uint8Array(1025)], raw.name, { type: raw.type }))
    } else if (mode.value === 'total') {
      resolve(new File([new Uint8Array(600)], raw.name, { type: raw.type }))
    } else {
      resolve(new File([raw], raw.name, { type: raw.type }))
    }
  })
}

function cleanup() {
  uploader.abort()
  pending.forEach(({ resolve }) => resolve(false))
  pending.clear()
  preparing.value = 0
}

function reset() {
  cleanup()
  uploader.reset()
  reasons.value = []
  requestCount.value = 0
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup)
onDeactivated(cleanup)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="upload-prepare-demo">
    <p>提交后暂停 before-upload；可取消后再次提交，再统一完成准备，只有当前有效尝试可以发起本地请求。</p>
    <c-radio-group v-model="mode" :options="modes" />
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button :disabled="files.length >= (mode === 'total' ? 2 : 1)" @click="add">加入示例图片</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!files.some((file) => ['ready', 'error', 'canceled'].includes(file.status))" @click="submit"
        >准备并提交</c-button
      >
      <c-button :disabled="preparing === 0" @click="uploader.abort()">取消准备</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="preparing === 0" @click="finish">完成准备</c-button>
      <c-button @click="reset">重置队列</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-upload v-model="files" :show-upload-button="false" :show-retry-button="false" :preview="false" />
    <p>待返回准备任务：{{ preparing }}</p>
    <p>请求次数：{{ requestCount }}</p>
    <p>队列状态：{{ files.map((file) => `${file.status} (${file.percent}%)`).join(', ') || '空' }}</p>
    <p>队列字节：{{ files.map((file) => file.size).join(', ') || '0' }}</p>
    <p>拒绝原因：{{ reasons.join(', ') || '无' }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Metadata Request

Example source: src/upload/__demos__/metadata-request.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref, shallowRef } from "vue";
import { useUploader } from "@cedar-design/ui";
const endpoint = ref("");
const files = ref([]);
const headers = shallowRef([]);
const data = shallowRef([]);
const successes = ref(0);
const errors = ref(0);
const response = ref(null);
let sequence = 0;
function wait(queue, file) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    queue.value = [...queue.value, { file, resolve, reject }];
  });
}
function finish(queue, kind) {
  const jobs = queue.value;
  queue.value = [];
  jobs.forEach((job) =>
    job.resolve(
      kind === "headers"
        ? { "X-Demo-Upload": job.file.name }
        : { auditMarker: "audit-local" },
    ),
  );
}
const uploader = useUploader({
  modelValue: () => files.value,
  onUpdateModelValue: (value) => {
    files.value = value;
  },
  action: () => endpoint.value,
  headers: () => (file) => wait(headers, file),
  data: () => (file) => wait(data, file),
  name: () => "attachment",
  autoUpload: () => false,
  resolveType: () => "file",
  onSuccess: (file) => {
    successes.value++;
    response.value = file.response;
  },
  onError: () => {
    errors.value++;
  },
});
function add() {
  return uploader.addFiles([
    new File(["Synthetic upload audit only."], `metadata-${++sequence}.txt`, {
      type: "text/plain",
    }),
  ]);
}
function cleanup() {
  uploader.abort();
  finish(headers, "headers");
  finish(data, "data");
}
function finishHeaders() {
  finish(headers, "headers");
}
function finishData() {
  finish(data, "data");
}
function rejectHeaders() {
  rejectPending(headers, "headers");
}
function rejectData() {
  rejectPending(data, "data");
}
function rejectPending(queue, kind) {
  const jobs = queue.value;
  queue.value = [];
  jobs.forEach((job) => job.reject(new Error(`Synthetic ${kind} rejection`)));
}
function reset() {
  cleanup();
  uploader.reset();
  successes.value = 0;
  errors.value = 0;
  response.value = null;
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup);
onDeactivated(cleanup);
</script>
<template>
  <section class="metadata-upload-demo">
    <p>
      默认 XHR 请求；先配置你控制的本地接口。headers 与 data
      分别等待手动返回，默认不访问任何地址。
    </p>
    <label
      >Local upload endpoint
      <c-input v-model="endpoint" placeholder="http://127.0.0.1:4197/upload"
    /></label>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button :disabled="files.length > 0" @click="add"
        >加入合成文件</c-button
      >
      <c-button
        :disabled="
          !endpoint ||
          !files.some((file) =>
            ['ready', 'error', 'canceled'].includes(file.status),
          )
        "
        @click="uploader.submit()"
        >提交元数据请求</c-button
      >
      <c-button
        :disabled="!files.some((file) => file.status === 'uploading')"
        @click="uploader.abort()"
        >取消元数据请求</c-button
      >
      <c-button :disabled="!headers.length" @click="finishHeaders"
        >返回 headers</c-button
      >
      <c-button :disabled="!data.length" @click="finishData"
        >返回 data</c-button
      >
      <c-button :disabled="!headers.length" @click="rejectHeaders"
        >拒绝 headers</c-button
      >
      <c-button :disabled="!data.length" @click="rejectData"
        >拒绝 data</c-button
      >
      <c-button @click="reset">重置元数据示例</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-upload
      v-model="files"
      :show-upload-button="false"
      :show-retry-button="false"
      :preview="false"
    />
    <p role="status">
      headers 等待：{{ headers.length }}；data 等待：{{ data.length }}；成功：{{
        successes
      }}；错误：{{ errors }}
    </p>
    <p>
      模型：{{
        files.map((file) => file.name + ": " + file.status).join(", ") || "空"
      }}
    </p>
    <pre>{{ response }}</pre>
  </section>
</template>
```

### Late Request

Example source: src/upload/__demos__/late-request.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { useUploader } from '@cedar-design/ui'

const files = ref([])
const handles = shallowRef([])
const callbacks = shallowRef([])
const requests = ref(0)
const aborts = ref(0)
const accepted = ref(0)
let sequence = 0
let generation = 0
const uploader = useUploader({
  modelValue: () => files.value,
  onUpdateModelValue: value => { files.value = value },
  resolveType: () => 'file',
  autoUpload: () => false,
  customRequest: () => options => {
    const current = generation
    requests.value++
    callbacks.value = [...callbacks.value, options]
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      handles.value = [...handles.value, {
        resolve: () => resolve({ abort: () => { if (current === generation) aborts.value++ } }),
      }]
    })
  },
  onSuccess: () => { accepted.value++ },
})
function add() {
  return uploader.addFiles([new File(['Local delayed transport; no network.'], `late-${++sequence}.txt`, { type: 'text/plain' })])
}
function release() {
  const pending = handles.value
  handles.value = []
  pending.forEach(job => job.resolve())
}
function complete() {
  const pending = callbacks.value
  callbacks.value = []
  pending.forEach(options => options.onSuccess({ local: true }))
}
function cleanup() {
  generation++
  uploader.abort()
  release()
  callbacks.value = []
}
function reset() {
  cleanup()
  uploader.reset()
  requests.value = 0
  aborts.value = 0
  accepted.value = 0
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup)
onDeactivated(cleanup)
</script>

<template>
  <section class="late-upload-demo">
    <p>请求句柄延迟返回；先取消再返回句柄，旧句柄应立即 abort，迟到成功回调不能恢复取消项。不访问网络。</p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button :disabled="files.length > 0" @click="add">加入本地文件</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!files.some(file => ['ready', 'error', 'canceled'].includes(file.status))" @click="uploader.submit()">发起模拟请求</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!files.some(file => file.status === 'uploading')" @click="uploader.abort()">取消模拟请求</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!handles.length" @click="release">返回所有句柄</c-button>
      <c-button :disabled="!callbacks.length" @click="complete">返回所有成功回调</c-button>
      <c-button @click="reset">重置模拟</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-upload v-model="files" :show-upload-button="false" :show-retry-button="false" :preview="false" />
    <p role="status">句柄等待：{{ handles.length }}；发起：{{ requests }}；abort：{{ aborts }}；有效成功：{{ accepted }}</p>
    <p>模型：{{ files.map(file => file.name + ': ' + file.status).join(', ') || '空' }}</p>
  </section>
</template>
```

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Props

| Prop                                                         | Type                                                     | Default / description                                                        |
| ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| model-value / default-value                                  | UploadFileItem[]                                         | Controlled value / uncontrolled initial []                                   |
| accept / capture                                             | string / native capture                                  | Unspecified                                                                  |
| multiple / directory / draggable                             | boolean                                                  | false                                                                        |
| disabled / readonly                                          | boolean                                                  | undefined inherits Form; explicit false overrides                            |
| action / method                                              | string                                                   | None / post                                                                  |
| headers / data                                               | object or async(file) => object                          | Cancelable during request preparation                                        |
| name                                                         | string / (file) => string                                | file                                                                         |
| with-credentials                                             | boolean                                                  | false                                                                        |
| custom-request                                               | (UploadRequestOptions) => UploadRequest / Promise / void | Custom transport; may return abort                                           |
| auto-upload                                                  | boolean                                                  | true; requires action or custom-request to start                             |
| max-files / max-file-size / max-total-size                   | number                                                   | Unspecified; sizes use bytes, max-files applies when >0                      |
| resolve-type                                                 | file / data-url / object-url                             | object-url; all files get url, images also get thumbnailUrl                  |
| create-thumbnail-url                                         | (options) => string / Promise                            | Custom URLs belong to callers and are not automatically revoked              |
| before-add                                                   | async(files) => File[]                                   | Batch filtering/replacement                                                  |
| before-read                                                  | async(file) => boolean / File                            | false/rejection rejects; replacements are revalidated                        |
| before-upload                                                | async(item) => boolean / File / Blob                     | false/rejection cancels preparation; replacements are revalidated            |
| before-remove                                                | async(item,list) => boolean                              | false/rejection prevents removal                                             |
| is-success-response                                          | (xhr,item) => boolean                                    | HTTP 2xx by default                                                          |
| request-choose                                               | (chooseFile,event) => void / Promise                     | Own the selection entry; exceptions do not automatically open a file chooser |
| list-type                                                    | text / picture / picture-card                            | text; supported on both platforms                                            |
| image-fit                                                    | fill / contain / cover / none / scale-down               | cover; item.fit overrides                                                    |
| preview                                                      | boolean                                                  | true                                                                         |
| show-file-list / show-upload-button / show-remove-button     | boolean                                                  | true                                                                         |
| show-retry-button / show-cancel-button / show-preview-button | boolean                                                  | true                                                                         |
| show-download-button                                         | boolean                                                  | false; disabled prevents interaction                                         |
| elevation / ripple                                           | boolean or number / boolean                              | false / true                                                                 |

UploadFileItem requires uid, status and percent. name/size/type/file/url/thumbnailUrl/fit/response/error are optional. status is ready/reading/uploading/success/error/canceled/removed.

### Events

- update:model-value(files), change(files, changedFile?): queue proposal order; Form receives one change notification per change, including progress/state updates.
- read(item): reading completed; business code may take over uploading. It does not indicate server success.
- rejected(UploadRejectedFile[]): reason is accept/before-add/before-read/read-error/max-file-size/max-total-size/max-files.
- exceed(nativeFiles, acceptedList): file-count limit exceeded.
- progress(item,event?), success(item), error(item): active-request notifications. Stale/canceled callbacks have no effect.
- remove(item): removal proposal after removal hooks accept it.
- preview(item, UploadPreviewEvent): event.preventDefault() cancels built-in image/video preview. Programmatic previews are cancelable too; originalEvent is optional.

### Slots

- trigger({chooseFile,dragOver,disabled}): custom selection entry.
- item({file,index,remove,retry,abort}): custom complete item.
- remove-button({file,index,remove,retry,abort}): custom removal action.

### Expose

chooseFile(), submit(file?), abort(file?), retry(file), remove(file), reset(), clearSuccess(), clearError(), getFiles(status?), preview(file), closePreview(). useUploader(options) supplies matching UI-free logic plus addFiles(files) and input/drag handlers.

### Controlled state and lifecycle

If a controlled parent rejects an addition, only read/list proposals emit; automatic upload waits until that uid is accepted, then runs once. Same-tick proposals merge transactionally; across ticks, the actual parent list is authoritative. Rejected entries do not count toward total size. Parents own consistency of late list replacements. Explicit removal of rejected items, reset or unmount releases generated URLs; external URLs are never revoked. Built-in preview retains its own URL ownership until closing and does not close another component's later preview.

Cancellation covers before-upload, asynchronous headers/data/name and asynchronous custom-request handles. Retrying or replacing a File under the same uid invalidates old callbacks. before-read/before-upload replacements recheck limits. max-total-size counts accepted entries and the current valid prepared batch/request only. Disabled/readonly block selection, removal, submission and other mutations; readonly allows preview/download. KeepAlive deactivation cancels preparation/requests; reactivation allows new operations.

## Type definitions

UploadProps、UploadEmits、UploadSlots、UploadExpose、UploadPublicMethods、UploadFileItem、UploadStatus、UploadListType、UploadResolveType、UploadImageFit、UploadCapture、UploadRejectedFile、UploadRejectedReason、UploadRequestOptions、UploadRequest、UploadCustomRequest、UploadProgressEvent、UploadData、UploadHeaders、UploadBeforeRead、UploadBeforeUpload、UploadBeforeRemove、UploadCreateThumbnailUrl、UploadIsSuccessResponse、UploadRequestChoose、UploadPreviewEvent、UseUploaderOptions、UploadInstance。

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

Attachment confirmation commits file-list relationships; it cannot undo completed remote uploads or permanent deletion. To defer network side effects, set `auto-upload="false"` and upload after the final business submission.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

## Cover attachments and video duration

`reupload` (default false) enables a per-item replacement action, including when maxFiles has been reached. `replace(file, replacement?: File): Promise<void>` opens a single-file chooser or validates the supplied File. It respects readonly/disabled and the chooser hook. Validation and beforeRemove run before an atomic in-place replacement proposal with a new UID; count and total size exclude the old item. Cancellation, rejection, guard veto and stale targets preserve the old item. A controlled parent decides acceptance. The `replace(next, previous)` event is a model proposal, not remote success or removal; remove is not emitted. Once accepted, obsolete transport callbacks are ignored; new upload failures can be retried. The item slot also exposes replace().

`UploadFileItem.duration?: number` uses seconds, displayed as mm:ss / h:mm:ss; unknown/invalid durations are hidden. Metadata reads local File objects only, waits at most 5 seconds and cleans temporary resources. Business code supplies remote durations. Video previews use popupContainer.

Duration-badge variables: `--c-upload-duration-background: var(--c-sys-color-surface-tooltip)`, `--c-upload-duration-color: var(--c-sys-color-content-on-dark)`, `--c-upload-duration-radius: var(--c-sys-radius-sm)`, `--c-upload-duration-padding: var(--c-sys-space-1) var(--c-sys-space-2)`, `--c-upload-duration-font-size: var(--c-sys-font-size-sm)`.

### Before-hook waiting feedback

Before-hook waits show visible feedback and aria-busy. Rejected or failed operations recover; duplicate submissions do not start another copy. Notification event Promises never drive loading. Independent file operations retain concurrency and share aggregate hook feedback.

`useUploader()` exposes readonly `guardPending`, aggregating currently awaited before hooks. It does not represent upload progress.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"` and supports runtime and nested overrides. Codes form an LTR content island: display, paste and focus navigation preserve string order. Outer start/end alignment still follows reading direction. RTL never reverses code characters; numeric and text codes share this ordering contract.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit empty-values, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](llms/en-US/guide/empty-values.md).

| Prop         | Type               | Default and scope                                                           |
| ------------ | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text   | string             | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid                         |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Events

| Event              | Arguments               | Semantics                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| input              | character, index, event | Starting character and zero-based index of each valid native input proposal                                                                 |
| update:model-value | value                   | Complete-code proposal                                                                                                                      |
| change             | value                   | Complete-code proposal for each valid edit, not necessarily accepted by a controlled parent                                                 |
| finish             | value                   | The changed complete code was accepted and filled all cells; accepted edits to already-full codes also emit it. External assignments do not |
| paste              | text, event             | Pasted text after paste-transform/type processing                                                                                           |
| focus / blur       | FocusEvent              | Focus enters/leaves the whole component; moving between cells does not duplicate notifications                                              |
| click              | MouseEvent              | Non-disabled click                                                                                                                          |

Valid input order: input → update:modelValue → change. finish waits until the parent accepts the complete value in that render. Rejected controlled values restore native inputs; later asynchronous parent assignments do not add finish. reset() proposes empty and emits update:modelValue/change without simulating native input. Disabled, readonly or composing state prevents reset from changing values.

Paste overwrites from the current cell; pasting on the root starts at cell 1. Input beyond the first empty cell is redirected there. SMS autofill entered as a whole code distributes across later cells. Typing one character in a filled cell replaces it even with the caret after the old character. IME prefers the current compositionend text and distributes multiple code points, falling back to native value only when committed text is absent. Processing is type filter → formatter → length trim; rejected characters occupy no cells. text counts Unicode code points, not grapheme clusters. External updates affect display without formatting/writeback.

### Slots

| Slot      | Arguments            | Description                                           |
| --------- | -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| separator | { index, character } | Overrides separator; not rendered after the last cell |

### Expose

- focus(index?): zero-based index; omission selects the first empty cell or last cell when full. Disabled prevents focusing; readonly allows focus/copy.
- blur(): remove focus.
- reset(): propose clearing, respecting controlled/disabled/readonly state.

### Keyboard and Form

Left/Right move between cells. Backspace removes the current character, or the previous one when empty. Delete removes the current character; following characters shift forward. IME composition does not trim, delete or move focus. Each native input has an SSR-stable id. Cell 1 uses autocomplete=one-time-code, others off. Provide aria-label.

InputGroup/Form state is inherited, with explicit disabled/readonly/error/size taking precedence. Internal cell Inputs do not duplicate Form notifications; the complete control notifies input/change once per edit. Both platforms implement three variants/five sizes using local FieldDecorator tokens.

## Type definitions

VerificationCodeProps、VerificationCodeType、VerificationCodeAlign、VerificationCodeVariant、VerificationCodeFormatter、VerificationCodeSeparator、VerificationCodeEmits、VerificationCodeSlots、VerificationCodeExpose、VerificationCodeInstance。

## Style variables

| Variable                              | Default              | Description                                                      |
| ------------------------------------- | -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| --c-verification-code-gutter          | var(--c-sys-space-2) | Cell gap                                                         |
| --c-verification-code-cell-height     | initial              | Follows size-specific field-size-*-height when not overridden    |
| --c-verification-code-cell-max-width  | initial              | Follows size-specific field-size-*-height when not overridden    |
| --c-verification-code-input-font-size | initial              | Follows size-specific field-size-*-font-size when not overridden |

initial means no public override. CSS reads size fallbacks at the component element. Override through component style or theme. Old Cedar column-gap is removed; use gutter.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

<!-- Source: docs/en/guide/controlled-uncontrolled.md; locale: en-US; page: /en/guide/controlled-uncontrolled/ -->

# Controlled state, defaults and clear values: learn by interaction

Start with Input behavior, then expand v-model and finally examine emptyValue. This guide describes current workspace behavior; the proposed unified contract is discussed separately at the end.

Register components and include styles as described in Quick Start. Each complete Vue example is independent. Input examples explicitly use `edit-mode="direct"` so popup confirmation drafts do not obscure ownership.

## 1. Separate the questions

| Question                                | What determines it?                          | Example                                                |
| --------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| Who decides the final current value?    | modelValue and the component ownership check | Parent supplies A, rejects B, final value remains A    |
| Is this only an initial value?          | defaultValue                                 | Start with Hangzhou, let the user change it later      |
| What value does a clear action propose? | emptyValue, written empty-value in templates | null, an empty string, or a configured value           |
| Does a value look empty?                | Component type, options and formatting       | Input renders null as blank, but EMPTY as literal text |

Controlled means the parent owns the final value. It does not mean disabled, unfocusable, without input events, or stored on a server. The parent is the Vue component containing `<c-input ... />`; its ref or form object holds the external state.

emptyValue answers the clear-output question. It does not automatically answer ownership or empty-value recognition. It is not a list of values considered empty.

## 2. Uncontrolled: provide a seed, let the component store later edits

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";

const seed = ref("Hangzhou");
const instanceKey = ref(0);
const lastRequest = ref<string | null>();
function record(next: string | null) {
  lastRequest.value = next;
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-input
    :key="instanceKey"
    :default-value="seed"
    edit-mode="direct"
    @update:model-value="record"
  />
  <p>Initial seed: {{ seed }}</p>
  <p>Last update request: {{ JSON.stringify(lastRequest) }}</p>
  <button type="button" @click="seed = 'Beijing'">Change default only</button>
  <button type="button" @click="instanceKey++">Remount</button>
</template>
```

| Action                             | Input text   | Parent seed | Explanation                                                            |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------ | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Mount                              | Hangzhou     | Hangzhou    | The component reads the default                                        |
| Select all and replace with Suzhou | Suzhou       | Hangzhou    | The component stores the edit; recording an event does not modify seed |
| Change default only                | Still Suzhou | Beijing     | Defaults do not overwrite current edits                                |
| Remount                            | Beijing      | Beijing     | The new instance reads the current default                             |

An update listener only observes candidates. Without binding the recorded value back through modelValue, it does not control the component. Initialization does not emit an initial value to populate the parent.

Changing defaultValue is not a reset command. Use controlled binding when the application needs to replace the current value programmatically.

## 3. Controlled and accepting updates

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const text = ref<string | null>("A");
</script>

<template>
  <c-input v-model="text" edit-mode="direct" />
  <p>Parent value: {{ JSON.stringify(text) }}</p>
  <button type="button" @click="text = 'C'">Parent sets C</button>
</template>
```

Select A and replace it with B. Parent text becomes B and the input follows that parent value. Click the button and the parent replaces it with C.

```text
Parent text=A → input receives A
User enters B → component emits update:modelValue(B)
Parent assigns text=B → prop becomes B → final display is B
```

Writing back means assigning the parent's own ref/form field and passing that value down again. The child does not directly modify the parent variable. v-model generates the write-back binding for you. [Vue documentation](https://vuejs.org/guide/components/v-model.html)

## 4. Controlled and rejecting updates

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const text = ref<string | null>("A");
const requested = ref<string | null>();
const count = ref(0);
function recordOnly(next: string | null) {
  requested.value = next;
  count.value++;
  // Deliberately do not assign text.value = next.
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-input
    :model-value="text"
    edit-mode="direct"
    @update:model-value="recordOnly"
  />
  <p>Parent value: {{ JSON.stringify(text) }}</p>
  <p>Candidate: {{ JSON.stringify(requested) }}; requests: {{ count }}</p>
</template>
```

Select all of A and try entering B. The candidate becomes B and the counter increases, but parent text stays A. The settled input remains A. Native editing text can appear briefly before the component reconciles; judge the final state after the current update settles.

| Item                | Before | After proposing B |
| ------------------- | ------ | ----------------- |
| Parent text         | A      | A                 |
| Candidate           | None   | B                 |
| Final model/display | A      | A                 |

An update event is not proof of acceptance. The parent can accept, reject or correct a candidate.

For an intentionally non-editable field, use readonly/disabled and their documented focus, copy and event semantics. Ignoring updates here demonstrates ownership; it is not the recommended way to implement readonly UI.

## 5. Accept conditionally

A boolean Switch makes the decision easy to see:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const enabled = ref(false);
const allowUpdate = ref(false);
const requested = ref<string | number | boolean | null>();
function decide(next: string | number | boolean | null) {
  requested.value = next;
  if (allowUpdate.value && typeof next === "boolean") {
    enabled.value = next;
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <label
    ><input v-model="allowUpdate" type="checkbox" />Parent accepts
    updates</label
  >
  <c-switch :model-value="enabled" @update:model-value="decide" />
  <p>Parent value: {{ enabled }}；Candidate: {{ JSON.stringify(requested) }}</p>
</template>
```

With the native checkbox unchecked, clicking Switch proposes true but leaves the parent and Switch false. Enable the checkbox, click again, and the parent accepts true.

This uses Switch's default boolean values. Adapt the parent type and decision if checkedValue/uncheckedValue are customized. When acceptance requires asynchronous work, show pending explicitly so a request is not mistaken for a completed change.

## 6. What does v-model generate?

```html
<c-input v-model="text" />
```

The corresponding template binding is:

```html
<c-input :model-value="text" @update:model-value="text = $event" />
```

Script functions assign `text.value = next`; templates unwrap refs automatically.

| Binding                             | Passes an external value? | Writes updates back?                                          | Meaning for strict controlled components |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| default-value only                  | No                        | No                                                            | Component stores subsequent values       |
| Update listener only                | No                        | Depends on listener, but not controlling without binding back | Observation                              |
| model-value=A only                  | Yes                       | No                                                            | Final value remains A                    |
| model-value plus recording listener | Yes                       | No                                                            | Observe candidates, keep A               |
| model-value plus assignment handler | Yes                       | Yes                                                           | Parent may filter updates                |
| v-model=text                        | Yes                       | Automatically                                                 | Usually accepts every update             |

For components checking modelValue !== undefined, a v-model ref initialized to undefined still starts uncontrolled. Local proxy exceptions also exist; see section 15.

Adding an update listener to v-model and returning false does not cancel v-model's generated assignment. Use an explicit value binding and handler when rejection matters. Returning false from change is not a guard either. Do not execute the same save twice in both update and change handlers.

## 7. Does emptyValue conflict with controlled state?

The features are compatible. The specific problem is undefined carrying two meanings in a particular binding.

For models using this ownership rule, including Input, InputNumber, Switch, Slider and Select:

```ts
// Conceptual rule, not code users need to add.
const isControlled = modelValue !== undefined;
```

An empty string, 0, false and a supported null are defined values. Validity remains component-specific: a defined 0 is not automatically a valid page number.

| Clear candidate | Parent decision                    | Returned modelValue | Result                                             |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| null            | Accept                             | null                | Controlled if null is supported                    |
| Empty string    | Accept                             | Empty string        | Controlled                                         |
| undefined       | Accept unchanged                   | undefined           | Becomes uncontrolled                               |
| undefined       | Normalize to null                  | null                | Remains controlled                                 |
| Any candidate   | Ignore, retain A                   | A                   | Retains the original controlled state              |
| undefined       | Component was already uncontrolled | Unbound             | Internal empty state; no parent control to release |

Do not infer ownership loss from emptyValue alone. The mode changes when the parent actually passes undefined back, not merely when the factory runs or an event is observed.

## 8. The empty-value forms are different

Current resolveEmptyValue behavior uses each component's fallback when no override is provided:

| Configuration                    | Meaning                                                                 |
| -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Omitted                          | Component's current default clear output                                |
| `:empty-value="undefined"`       | Same fallback; does not force undefined output                          |
| `:empty-value="() => undefined"` | Explicit undefined output, where the component type permits the factory |
| `:empty-value="null"`            | Explicit null output                                                    |
| `empty-value="EMPTY"`            | Literal EMPTY string, not necessarily a blank display                   |
| `:empty-value="0"`               | Numeric zero, if valid for this component                               |
| `:empty-value="() => []"`        | New empty array, subject to model and business constraints              |

The factory distinguishes absence from an explicit undefined result. Input's clear type is string/null or a matching factory; do not bypass its type to force an unsupported undefined factory. The next undefined example uses InputNumber, which supports it.

Vue binding matters: `empty-value="null"` is a string, while `:empty-value="null"` is null. An unbound `empty-value="0"` is not a numeric binding.

Verified current default paths:

| Component/path                               | Default candidate without an override                   |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| Input clear button                           | Empty string                                            |
| InputNumber clear button                     | undefined                                               |
| Select single without an empty-string option | Usually empty string                                    |
| Select single with a value='' option         | undefined, distinguishing that option from no selection |
| Select multiple                              | Usually []; protected disabled selections may remain    |

This is not an inventory of all component empty-value contracts. Dates, times and panels have additional paths. emptyValue does not bypass disabled/readonly, pending transactions or protected selections.

## 9. Input clears to null and stays controlled

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const text = ref<string | null>("A");
const updates = ref<string[]>([]);
function accept(next: string | null) {
  updates.value.push(JSON.stringify(next));
  text.value = next;
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-input
    :model-value="text"
    :empty-value="null"
    edit-mode="direct"
    clearable
    @update:model-value="accept"
  />
  <p>Parent value: {{ JSON.stringify(text) }}</p>
  <p>Update log: {{ updates.join(" → ") }}</p>
</template>
```

| Action                               | Candidate    | Parent text  | Display |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------ | ------------ | ------- |
| Mount                                | None         | A            | A       |
| Click clear                          | null         | null         | Blank   |
| Type B                               | B            | B            | B       |
| Select all and delete with Backspace | Empty string | Empty string | Blank   |

null and an empty string look blank but are different model values. Current emptyValue controls the clear action; it does not transform manual deletion into null. If your business requires every empty text value to be null, assign `text.value = next === '' ? null : next` in the parent.

Likewise, an Input configured with literal EMPTY emits and displays EMPTY on clear. A clear button does not guarantee a blank final model.

## 10. Why can undefined clear change ownership?

This example observes current behavior. It is not the recommended configuration for a persistently controlled form.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const quantity = ref<number | null | undefined>(12);
const clearToUndefined = () => undefined;
const describe = (value: unknown) =>
  value === undefined ? "undefined" : JSON.stringify(value);
const lastRequest = ref("No update yet");
function accept(next: number | null | undefined) {
  lastRequest.value = describe(next);
  quantity.value = next;
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-input-number
    :model-value="quantity"
    :empty-value="clearToUndefined"
    edit-mode="direct"
    clearable
    @update:model-value="accept"
  />
  <p>Parent value: {{ describe(quantity) }}；Candidate: {{ lastRequest }}</p>
  <p>Controlled by the current check: {{ quantity !== undefined }}</p>
</template>
```

| Step                                                     | Parent quantity | quantity !== undefined | Final owner                                      |
| -------------------------------------------------------- | --------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| Initially 12                                             | 12              | true                   | Parent                                           |
| Component proposes undefined, before handling            | Still 12        | true                   | Still parent                                     |
| Parent accepts unchanged                                 | undefined       | false                  | Component                                        |
| Later interaction while parent supplies no defined value | undefined       | false                  | Component may store subsequent values internally |

The trigger is the actual modelValue becoming undefined, not the blank display. A later defined parent value makes it controlled again. Current handoff retention varies between components; do not rely on mode changes for reset.

A ref's declared number/null type does not convert a runtime undefined event into null automatically.

## 11. Recommended: normalize at the parent boundary

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const quantity = ref<number | null>(12);
const lastRequest = ref("No update yet");
function acceptNormalized(next: number | null | undefined) {
  lastRequest.value = next === undefined ? "undefined" : JSON.stringify(next);
  quantity.value = next ?? null;
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-input-number
    :model-value="quantity"
    :empty-value="null"
    edit-mode="direct"
    clearable
    @update:model-value="acceptNormalized"
  />
  <p>组件Candidate: {{ lastRequest }}</p>
  <p>Final parent value: {{ JSON.stringify(quantity) }}</p>
  <p>Controlled by the current check: {{ quantity !== undefined }}</p>
</template>
```

This handles the clear button and other update paths producing undefined: null → null, undefined → null, 0 → 0, other numbers unchanged. The parent's quantity remains defined, preserving final controlled ownership.

Why use a handler as well as empty-value=null? InputNumber's clear-button path calls resolveEmptyValue, while manual deletion followed by commit can directly produce undefined. modelEvent='input' may propose the empty value earlier. emptyValue is not an input parser or a normalizer for every submission path.

Avoid `next || null`, which also discards valid zero. Use `next ?? null` for null/undefined only. Do not apply this nullable-number example to a model such as pagination that does not accept null.

A writable computed setter can perform the same normalization behind v-model; a readonly computed cannot accept assignments. Separate local updates from persistence. Usually update the form synchronously and save on explicit submission; if acceptance must wait for approval, keep the old value and show pending deliberately.

## 12. A valid empty-string option differs from no selection

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const selected = ref<string | null>(null);
const options = [
  { label: "All", value: "" },
  { label: "Enabled only", value: "enabled" },
];
</script>

<template>
  <c-select
    v-model="selected"
    :options="options"
    :empty-value="null"
    edit-mode="direct"
    clearable
  />
  <p>Parent value: {{ JSON.stringify(selected) }}</p>
</template>
```

| Action              | Parent selected | Meaning                        |
| ------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Initially           | null            | No selection                   |
| Choose All          | Empty string    | A valid selected option        |
| Choose Enabled only | enabled         | Another valid option           |
| Clear               | null            | No selection, still controlled |

Do not use selected === '' to mean both All and no selection. Element Plus illustrates a similar case but exposes separate empty-values and value-on-clear APIs. Our emptyValue does not automatically provide its empty-values functionality.

For multiple selection, initialize and clear according to the array model. A nullable single-selection example does not imply that every multi-selection should use null. Protected disabled selections can survive clear; emptyValue does not override that rule.

## 13. Value and popup visibility are separate models

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
const selected = ref<string | null>(null);
const panelOpen = ref(false);
const allowClose = ref(true);
const options = [
  { label: "Hangzhou", value: "hz" },
  { label: "Beijing", value: "bj" },
];
function acceptOpen(next: boolean) {
  if (next || allowClose.value) panelOpen.value = next;
}
</script>

<template>
  <label
    ><input v-model="allowClose" type="checkbox" />Accept close requests</label
  >
  <c-select
    v-model="selected"
    :open="panelOpen"
    :options="options"
    :empty-value="null"
    edit-mode="direct"
    clearable
    @update:open="acceptOpen"
  />
  <p>Value: {{ JSON.stringify(selected) }}; open: {{ panelOpen }}</p>
  <button type="button" @click="panelOpen = false">
    Parent closes directly
  </button>
</template>
```

The value binding accepts updates directly; the visibility handler can reject close requests. Disable Accept close requests: value changes can still be accepted while close requests are ignored. Parent closes directly changes panelOpen itself.

There is no single global controlled flag for the whole component. Each model has its own owner. v-model:open is shorthand for open plus its update assignment.

This example uses Select's direct editing mode. Confirmation presentations additionally own a draft: selecting edits the draft, confirmation submits it and cancellation discards it. A visible draft changing does not prove the committed model is uncontrolled.

## 14. Initialize, reset and serialize form data

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const form = reactive<{ name: string | null; quantity: number | null }>({
  name: null,
  quantity: null,
});
const payloadText = ref("Not submitted yet");
function updateQuantity(next: number | null | undefined) {
  form.quantity = next ?? null;
}
function reset() {
  form.name = null;
  form.quantity = null;
}
function submit() {
  const payload = {
    name: form.name === null ? undefined : form.name,
    quantity: form.quantity === null ? undefined : form.quantity,
  };
  payloadText.value = JSON.stringify(payload);
}
</script>

<template>
  <c-input
    v-model="form.name"
    :empty-value="null"
    edit-mode="direct"
    clearable
  />
  <c-input-number
    :model-value="form.quantity"
    :empty-value="null"
    edit-mode="direct"
    clearable
    @update:model-value="updateQuantity"
  />
  <button type="button" @click="reset">Reset parent data</button>
  <button type="button" @click="submit">Build payload</button>
  <p>Payload: {{ payloadText }}</p>
</template>
```

This uses an ordinary reactive object without depending on Form layout/validation APIs. The parent initializes and resets its fields. defaultValue does not populate an empty parent form; initialize form.name directly when a name is required initially.

Serialization maps UI null to undefined object properties, which JSON omits, without changing the UI model itself. If the API expects explicit JSON null, retain null in the payload instead.

UI empty values and transport formats need not match. A backend's omitted-field convention does not require modelValue to be undefined. Empty strings are still sent unchanged in this example; omit them explicitly at the serialization boundary if your business requires it.

## 15. Current exceptions

These describe current behavior, not an implemented target contract:

| Scope                                | Difference                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Maple ActionSheet.open               | Default useVModel local proxy can change internal state                                    |
| Maple NumberKeyboard.open/modelValue | Both use the default proxy                                                                 |
| Maple FloatingPanel.modelValue       | Proxy anchor plus separate gesture display height                                          |
| Maple Popup with beforeClose         | Internal visible can intercept external open=false and emit update:open(true) on rejection |
| Both Collapse implementations        | Nullish fallback; null falls back internally, use [] to collapse all                       |

For the first three, ignoring update does not guarantee the display remains unchanged. Passing the same external value again may not trigger the proxy watcher. Both libraries have equivalent useVModel helpers, but Input/Switch/Slider manage their own ownership.

InputNumber may retain intermediate text, Input has IME composition, and Popup can retain transition DOM. Distinguish final models from editing/gesture state and animation retention.

## 16. Documentation patterns worth borrowing

These are references for explanation style, not interchangeable APIs, empty values or handoff rules. All examples above were written for our components.

| Reference                                                                                                                            | Useful teaching pattern                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Reka controlled state](https://www.reka-ui.com/docs/guides/controlled-state)                                                        | Place explicit write-back, v-model and defaultValue side by side              |
| [React Input](https://react.dev/reference/react-dom/components/input#controlling-an-input-with-a-state-variable)                     | Explain ownership through visible reversion when updates are ignored          |
| [Radix async Dialog submission](https://www.radix-ui.com/primitives/docs/components/dialog#close-after-asynchronous-form-submission) | Show why a parent closes only after saving                                    |
| [Element Plus Select empty values](https://element-plus.org/en-US/component/select.html#empty-values)                                | Separate empty recognition and clear output using a valid empty-string option |
| [Naive UI controlled state](https://www.naiveui.com/zh-CN/docs/controlled-uncontrolled)                                              | State how undefined affects ownership explicitly                              |

React's native controlled text input should not receive null/undefined. Our Input supports null and renders it blank. Borrow explanations, not framework-specific empty-value constraints. A value-only binding can also be intentional; it is an error only relative to an expectation of accepting edits.

## 17. Proposed design and existing emptyValue

The unified design is not implemented. The recommendation is parent-owned final state, initialize-only defaults, defined domain values for standard clear output, and separate drafts/gestures/animation.

Retain configurable emptyValue output rather than treating every () => undefined as invalid. It remains useful with explicit parent normalization, published APIs and intentional business behavior. Passing the result back unchanged as undefined must still mean uncontrolled under the chosen predicate.

Audit all empty paths separately: clear buttons, keyboard deletion, panel clearing and Form reset. Fixing the button alone leaves gaps. Changing published default empty values, ownership handoff or proxy behavior requires a versioned migration; changing documentation does not implement that behavior.

## 18. Troubleshooting order

1. Identify the exact state: modelValue, open or a draft.
2. Inspect the actual external value, not only the ref's static type or blank display.
3. Record update candidates and inspect whether/how the parent assigns them.
4. Distinguish clear button, manual deletion, panel confirmation and Form reset.
5. Check whether emptyValue is omitted, null, a string or an undefined-returning factory.
6. Check the proxy/guard exceptions in section 15.

Source references: both libraries' packages/_-ui/src/input/use-input-value.ts, input-number/use-number-value.ts, select/use-select-controller.ts and empty-value helpers; packages/_-use/src/useVModel.ts; Maple's listed proxy components and Popup. Expected-value tables explain audited paths; they are not a claim that every component and browser interaction has been verified.

# Empty recognition, clear output and reading placeholders

## Choose the setting for your task

| Task                                                       | Setting                                    | Example                               |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------- |
| Emit null, -1 or another supported value when clearing     | empty-value / emptyValue                   | Clear icon and manual deletion        |
| Treat API marker -1 as unselected and missing for required | empty-values / emptyValues                 | Empty markers and required validation |
| Keep an empty string as a valid All option                 | Exclude the empty string from empty-values | Valid empty-string option             |
| Show '-' or No data for empty reading content              | empty-text / emptyText                     | Reading placeholders and inheritance  |

Each prop has one job. emptyValue defines clear output, emptyValues defines empty identity, and emptyText defines reading text. They do not derive one another. Rendering or configuration changes do not write the model or change controlled ownership.

## Learn by scenario

### Clear icon and manual deletion

Clear with the icon to produce null. Restore the initial value and delete all text with Backspace to produce `''`. The model output quotes strings so the two outcomes are visible.

Example source: src/input/__demos__/en-US/empty-value.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive } from "vue";
const model = reactive({ text: "Hello" as string | null });
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>
      The clear icon produces null; Backspace to empty produces an empty string.
    </p>
    <c-form :model="model" layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item field="text" label="Keyword">
        <c-input
          v-model="model.text"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-value="null"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-button @click="model.text = 'Hello'">Restore initial value</c-button>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ JSON.stringify(model.text) }}</output>
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

Manual deletion is an input event and does not invoke emptyValue. Form reset restores recorded initial values. See [Input value model and interaction](llms/en-US/components/input.md).

### Valid empty-string option

All has value `''` and remains selected. emptyValues excludes it with `[null, undefined]`, while emptyValue independently clears to null. Clear, then choose All again and compare model outputs.

Example source: src/select/__demos__/en-US/empty-value.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const model = reactive({ status: "" as string | null });
const multiple = ref(["active"]);
const optional = ref<string | undefined>("active");
const options = [
  { value: "", label: "All" },
  { value: "active", label: "Active" },
];
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>
      All uses an empty string as a valid option value. Clearing produces null.
    </p>
    <c-form :model="model" layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item field="status" label="Status">
        <c-select
          v-model="model.status"
          :options="options"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-values="[null, undefined]"
          :empty-value="null"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-button @click="model.status = ''">Choose All</c-button>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ JSON.stringify(model.status) }}</output>
    </p>
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item label="Multiple: clear to []">
        <c-select
          v-model="multiple"
          :options="options"
          edit-mode="direct"
          multiple
          clearable
          :empty-value="() => []"
        />
        <output>{{ JSON.stringify(multiple) }}</output>
      </c-form-item>
      <c-form-item label="Single: clear to undefined">
        <c-select
          v-model="optional"
          :options="options"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-value="() => undefined"
        />
        <output>{{ String(optional) }}</output>
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

Select preserves empty-string options by default. Explicit settings align field and required semantics. Deleting the search query does not delete selection. See [Select value model and linked fields](llms/en-US/components/select.md).

### Empty markers and valid zero

Include -1 in emptyValues when an API uses it for missing data; also set emptyValue=-1 if clearing should emit it. The initial input is blank while the model stays -1. Set it to 0 to see a valid zero, then clear back to -1.

Example source: src/input-number/__demos__/en-US/empty-value.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const model = reactive({ quantity: -1 as number | null | undefined });
const restored = ref<number | null | undefined>(12);
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>
      -1 means missing and renders blank; 0 remains a valid number. Clearing
      produces -1.
    </p>
    <c-form :model="model" layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item field="quantity" label="Quantity">
        <c-input-number
          v-model="model.quantity"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-values="[null, undefined, -1]"
          :empty-value="-1"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="model.quantity = 0">Set to 0</c-button>
      <c-button @click="model.quantity = -1">Set to -1</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ String(model.quantity) }}</output>
    </p>
    <p>This field clears to 0 without treating 0 as missing.</p>
    <c-form layout="vertical">
      <c-form-item label="Clear restores valid zero">
        <c-input-number
          v-model="restored"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-value="0"
        />
        <output>{{ String(restored) }}</output>
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

0 and false are valid by default; do not classify both with `!value`. InputNumber manual empty commits retain numeric parsing rules and may emit undefined. See [InputNumber numeric input and formatting](llms/en-US/components/input-number.md).

### Empty markers and required validation

Form provides `[null, undefined, -1]` to its fields, while Select defines clear output -1. Validate the initial value, select a department and validate again, then clear and validate the missing value.

Example source: src/form/__demos__/en-US/empty-values-validation.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const model = reactive({ department: -1 as number | null | undefined });
const form = ref();
const result = ref("Not validated");
const options = [
  { value: 1, label: "Engineering" },
  { value: 2, label: "Product" },
];
async function validate() {
  const errors = await form.value.validate();
  result.value = errors ? "Required error" : "Valid";
}
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>
      Validate the initial -1, then select a department and validate again.
      Clearing restores -1.
    </p>
    <c-form
      ref="form"
      :model="model"
      layout="vertical"
      :empty-values="[null, undefined, -1]"
    >
      <c-form-item field="department" label="Department" required>
        <c-select
          v-model="model.department"
          :options="options"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-value="-1"
        />
      </c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <c-button @click="validate">Validate</c-button>
    <p role="status">{{ result }}</p>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ String(model.department) }}</output>
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

emptyValue=-1 alone does not identify -1 as empty; emptyValues alone does not change clear output. Required runs on validation calls or configured triggers, not merely because an input looks blank. See [Form validation and submission](llms/en-US/components/form.md).

### Reading placeholders and inheritance

Initially, Name inherits Form's default `'-'`, Code uses the FormItem override, Nickname uses the field override, and Quantity remains 0. Change Form's text to No data: only inheriting empty fields change. Toggle reading/editing and observe the unchanged model.

Example source: src/form/__demos__/en-US/empty-text.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from "vue";
const reading = ref(true);
const emptyText = ref("-");
const model = reactive({
  name: null as string | null,
  code: null as string | null,
  nickname: null as string | null,
  quantity: 0 as number | null | undefined,
});
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column">
    <p>
      Initially, reading mode shows “-” for Name, overrides for Code and
      Nickname, and the valid number 0 for Quantity.
    </p>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button @click="reading = !reading">Toggle reading/editing</c-button>
      <c-button @click="emptyText = 'No data'">Use “No data”</c-button>
      <c-button @click="emptyText = '-'">Use default “-”</c-button>
    </c-space>
    <c-form
      :model="model"
      layout="vertical"
      :read-pretty="reading"
      :empty-text="emptyText"
    >
      <c-form-item field="name" label="Name: inherits Form"
        ><c-input v-model="model.name"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="code"
        label="Code: FormItem override"
        empty-text="Unassigned"
        ><c-input v-model="model.code"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item
        field="nickname"
        label="Nickname: field override"
        empty-text="Unassigned"
        ><c-input v-model="model.nickname" empty-text="Anonymous"
      /></c-form-item>
      <c-form-item field="quantity" label="Quantity"
        ><c-input-number v-model="model.quantity"
      /></c-form-item>
    </c-form>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ JSON.stringify(model) }}</output>
    </p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

Precedence is **Field > FormItem > Form > '-'**. Explicit emptyText=`''` renders blank; custom read slots win. This text is separate from an input placeholder and never becomes validation or submitted data. See [Form field presentation and interaction](llms/en-US/components/form.md).

## Rules and boundaries

### emptyValues: recognize the current model

Field settings override FormItem, which overrides Form. Lists replace rather than merge. Unconfigured text fields recognize null, undefined and the empty string; Select and numeric fields retain their nullish defaults.

Scalars use includes; 0 and false remain valid by default. Objects use reference identity. Empty arrays always mean an empty collection; nonempty `[null]` does not. An explicit empty list removes additional scalar markers without turning an empty collection into a selection.

Fixed state controls and Upload consume the policy for reading and required without rewriting checked state, bounds or transport. Invalid dates and unfinished numeric drafts retain domain rules.

### emptyValue: define clear output

Omission preserves component defaults. Check each component's supported types: Input declares string/null and corresponding factories. Where undefined output is supported, such as InputNumber and date/time fields, use `:empty-value="() => undefined"`; a directly bound undefined leaves the fallback in place.

Factories run during actual clear actions, not initialization, reading or validation. Arrays follow existing independent-result rules. Output is not automatically classified as empty: clearing to 0 can restore valid data.

Some shared editing panels fall back to defaultValue. Their clear action updates a draft; confirmation commits and cancellation discards it. Clear icons, manual deletion, removing the last item and reset retain component-specific behavior.

### Required and custom rules

With explicit emptyValues, built-in required follows the primary field policy. Unconfigured validation retains each library's behavior; Cedar b-validate and Maple function/Zod validation need not agree on every boundary value.

Custom validators, Zod, min/max and enum receive raw values. A UI marker -1 does not make `number().positive()` accept it; business schemas define optional handling. Recognition also does not imply business validity.

false is valid by default, so required does not mean must agree. Classify false explicitly or require true in a custom agreement rule. Prefer one primary field per FormItem and separate independently validated values.

### Controlled ownership

Business emptiness differs from ownership. Adding -1 or removing undefined from emptyValues does not change existing controlled predicates. Do not replace every internal undefined check with isEmpty: ownership, failed parsing, invalid dates and business markers have distinct meanings.

## Relationship to Element Plus

The separation follows [Element Plus configuration](https://element-plus.org/en-US/component/config-provider.html#empty-values-configurations) and [useEmptyValues](https://github.com/element-plus/element-plus/blob/dev/packages/hooks/use-empty-values/index.ts). Our emptyValue serves the role of valueOnClear; no synonym is added.

We use Form/FormItem inheritance and action-time factories, preserving component defaults and collection rules. Array deep equality, clear-output warnings and ConfigProvider integration are not copied.
