# LLM documentation

Cedar Design Web provides plain text and Markdown documentation for large language models (LLMs), including guides, component APIs and Vue examples. Give an AI coding assistant the online URLs so it can consult the documentation before writing code.

## Online documentation

Assistants that can read web pages can access these URLs directly. **Start with the index and read the component pages relevant to your task.**

| Document | Online URL | When to use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Documentation index | [https://cedar.show/llms.txt](https://cedar.show/llms.txt) | Find guides and individual component Markdown pages; recommended starting point |
| Full documentation | [https://cedar.show/llms-full.txt](https://cedar.show/llms-full.txt) | Read all documentation and examples when the tool has enough context capacity |

Each component in the index has its own Markdown URL. Open it, give it to an assistant, or save it locally.

## Use with an AI assistant

### Provide the documentation URL

Copy this prompt and add your requirements at the end:

```text
Use Cedar Design Web and Vue 3 to implement my requirements.
Read the official documentation index first: https://cedar.show/llms.txt
Then read the quick start and relevant component pages. Check installation, imports and styles.
Use only the documented props, events, slots and examples.
If an API is not documented, say so instead of guessing.

My requirements:
```

### Add project reference material

If your coding assistant supports documentation sources, add the online index URL above. In your project instructions, ask it to consult the official documentation when using `@cedar-design/ui`.

If the tool cannot access the web, save the files you need as `.txt` or `.md` and attach them to your task. The full document may exceed tool reading limits; prefer the index and individual pages for focused tasks.

## Choose a language

| Language | Documentation index | Full documentation |

## Cedar × Maple. Two platforms, one architecture.

Cedar is the desktop counterpart to Maple. The two libraries align component APIs, interaction semantics and design tokens, so familiar patterns carry across platforms while each keeps the interactions its platform needs.

| | Cedar Design Web | Maple Design Mobile |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Platform | Desktop · mouse and keyboard | Mobile · touch |
| Components | Shared API and behavior conventions | Shared API and behavior conventions |
| Themes | Semantic tokens · brand themes · light and dark modes | Semantic tokens · brand themes · light and dark modes |
| Explore | You are here | [Visit Maple ↗](https://maple.show) |

## Start with Cedar

```shell
pnpm add @cedar-design/ui
```

See the [quick start guide](en/guide/quickstart) for setup, component imports and styles. For mobile applications, explore [Maple Design Mobile](https://maple.show).

# Loading and waiting

Explore an event registration workspace. Try each component, hold all loading states, or start a two-second local wait. Labels in the live scenario are currently in Chinese.

1. Fill in registration information or use the button on its card to start a two-second wait.
2. Enable “全部保持加载” to compare every visible indicator; “重置加载” restores the state without clearing input.
3. Toggle editing independently, then compare default indicators and bottom lines on decorated fields.
4. Open the confirmation dialog to observe before-close feedback, including a rejected close.

Example source: docs/showcase/demos/loading-lab.vue

```vue

{ id: 'split-button', component: markRaw(CSplitButton), title: '报名操作', description: '主按钮等待', props: {}, text: '保存报名', lockable: true },

{ id: 'tag', component: markRaw(CTag), title: '参与者身份', description: '标签状态更新', props: {}, text: '体验官', lockable: true }]

{ title: '02 · 提交与状态操作', cards: actionCards }]
const held = ref(false)
const lock = ref(false)
const line = ref(false)
const pending = reactive<Record<string, boolean>>({})
const completed = reactive<Record<string, boolean>>({})
const timers = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()
const ids = [...fieldCards, ...actionCards].map(card => card.id).concat(['table', 'list', 'skeleton', 'loading'])

const busyCount = computed(() => ids.filter(id => isLoading(id)).length)
const status = ref('点击卡片上的「体验等待」，对照加载与恢复。')
function isLoading(id: string) { return held.value || Boolean(pending[id]) }
function run(id: string) {
  if (held.value || pending[id]) return
  pending[id] = true
  completed[id] = false
  status.value = `${id} 正在等待；2 秒后恢复。`
  timers.set(id, setTimeout(() => {
    pending[id] = false
    completed[id] = true
    timers.delete(id)
    status.value = `${id} 已完成，输入内容保留。`
  }, 2000))
}
function runAll() { held.value = false; ids.forEach(run) }
function reset() {
  held.value = false
  timers.forEach(timer => clearTimeout(timer))
  timers.clear()
  ids.forEach(id => { pending[id] = false; completed[id] = false })
  status.value = '已恢复全部加载状态，填写内容保留。'
}
const open = ref(false)
const allowClose = ref(true)
const guardStatus = ref('打开报名确认，关闭时等待 2 秒。')
const guardWaits = new Map<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>, (allowed: boolean) => void>()
function beforeClose() {
  guardStatus.value = '正在检查报名状态…'
  return new Promise<boolean>(resolve => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      guardWaits.delete(timer)
      guardStatus.value = allowClose.value ? '检查通过，允许关闭。' : '本次未通过，弹层保留，可再次尝试。'
      resolve(allowClose.value)
    }, 2000)
    guardWaits.set(timer, resolve)
  })
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => { reset(); guardWaits.forEach((resolve, timer) => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(false) }); guardWaits.clear() })
const columns = [{ title: '参与人', dataIndex: 'name' }, { title: '活动', dataIndex: 'event' }]
const rows = [{ key: '1', name: '林小满', event: '设计工作坊' }, { key: '2', name: '周青', event: '开发者交流' }]
</script>
<template>

      <p>逐项填写报名信息，观察各组件如何表达等待；也可以保持全部加载，比较位置、尺寸与布局。</p>
      <CForm layout="vertical">
        <div class="loading-lab__controls">

          <CFormItem label="文本字段使用底线"><CSwitch v-model="line" aria-label="文本字段使用底线" /></CFormItem>
        </div>
      </CForm>
      <div class="loading-lab__buttons"><CButton @click="runAll">全部等待 2 秒</CButton><CButton variant="outline" @click="reset">重置加载</CButton><span>{{ busyCount }} / {{ ids.length }} 项正在等待</span></div>
      <p role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ status }}</p>
      <small>所有等待均在本地模拟。loading 与 disabled 分别控制；切换底线只影响支持 loading-mode 的字段。</small>
    </header>
    <section v-for="group in groups" :key="group.title" class="loading-lab__section">
      <h3>{{ group.title }}</h3>
      <div class="loading-lab__grid">
        <article v-for="card in group.cards" :key="card.id" class="loading-lab__card" :data-loading-card="card.id">
          <div class="loading-lab__heading"><strong>{{ card.title }}</strong><code>{{ card.id }}</code></div>
          <p>{{ card.description }}</p>
          <div class="loading-lab__preview">
            <component v-if="card.text" :is="card.component" v-bind="card.id === 'split-button' ? { ...card.props, buttonProps: { loading: isLoading(card.id), disabled: lock && isLoading(card.id) } } : card.props" :loading="isLoading(card.id)" :disabled="lock && isLoading(card.id)" @change="run(card.id)">{{ card.text }}</component>
            <component v-else :is="card.component" v-bind="card.id === 'split-button' ? { ...card.props, buttonProps: { loading: isLoading(card.id), disabled: lock && isLoading(card.id) } } : card.props" :loading="isLoading(card.id)" :loading-mode="line ? 'line' : 'default'" :disabled="lock && isLoading(card.id)" @change="run(card.id)" />
          </div>
          <div class="loading-lab__footer"><CButton size="sm" variant="text" :disabled="isLoading(card.id)" @click="run(card.id)">体验等待</CButton><span>{{ isLoading(card.id) ? '等待中…' : completed[card.id] ? '已完成' : '就绪' }}</span></div>
        </article>
```

This page focuses on input surfaces, data selection, actions and content loading. Ordinary events do not collect Promises. Upload keeps per-file progress and before-hook feedback; Scheduler persistence guards are documented on its own page.

## More before-hook scenarios

### Drawer

Example source: src/drawer/__demos__/guard-protocol.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { DrawerBeforeClose } from "@cedar-design/ui";
const open = ref(false);
const mode = ref("promise");
const allowed = ref(true);
const status = ref("");
const check: DrawerBeforeClose = (payload, done, { signal }) => {
  status.value = `等待： ${payload.action}`;
  if (mode.value === "done") {
    setTimeout(() => {
      status.value = allowed.value ? "允许" : "阻止";
      done(!signal.aborted && allowed.value);
    }, 500);
    return;
  }
  return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) =>
    setTimeout(() => {
      status.value = allowed.value ? "允许" : "阻止";
      resolve(!signal.aborted && allowed.value);
    }, 500),
  );
};
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch">
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" label="允许关闭"><c-switch v-model="allowed" aria-label="允许关闭" /></c-form-item>
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="mode">
      <c-radio-group
        aria-label="mode"
        v-model="mode"
        :options="[
          { value: 'promise', label: 'Promise' },
          { value: 'done', label: 'done 回调' },
        ]"
        variant="button"
        size="sm"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-button @click="open = true">打开</c-button>
    <c-drawer
      v-model:open="open"
      :before-close="check"
      @guard-error="status = 'Error'"
    >
      <p>关闭前等待片刻。可以关闭开关体验一次拦截，再在抽屉内重新允许关闭并重试。</p>
      <c-form-item layout="vertical" label="允许关闭"><c-switch v-model="allowed" aria-label="抽屉内允许关闭" /></c-form-item>
      <c-button @click="allowed = true; open = false">允许并关闭</c-button>
      <p role="status">{{ status }}</p>
    </c-drawer>
    <p role="status">{{ status }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

### Popconfirm

Example source: src/popconfirm/__demos__/guard-protocol.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { PopconfirmBeforeConfirm } from "@cedar-design/ui";
const open = ref(false);
const mode = ref("promise");
const allowed = ref(false);
const status = ref("");
const check: PopconfirmBeforeConfirm = (payload, done, { signal }) => {
  status.value = `等待： ${payload.action}`;
  if (mode.value === "done") {
    setTimeout(() => {
      status.value = allowed.value ? "允许" : "阻止";
      done(!signal.aborted && allowed.value);
    }, 500);
    return;
  }
  return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) =>
    setTimeout(() => {
      status.value = allowed.value ? "允许" : "阻止";
      resolve(!signal.aborted && allowed.value);
    }, 500),
  );
};
</script>
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" align="stretch">
    <c-switch v-model="allowed" />
    <c-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="mode">
      <c-radio-group
        aria-label="mode"
        v-model="mode"
        :options="[
          { value: 'promise', label: 'Promise' },
          { value: 'done', label: 'done 回调' },
        ]"
        variant="button"
        size="sm"
      />
    </c-form-item>
    <c-button @click="open = true">打开</c-button>
    <c-popconfirm
      v-model:open="open"
      :before-confirm="check"
      @guard-error="status = 'Error'"
    >
      <template #default
        ><c-button v-if="true" @click="open = true">Confirm action</c-button
        ><span v-else>通过 beforeClose 关闭</span></template
      >
    </c-popconfirm>
    <p role="status">{{ status }}</p>
  </c-space>
</template>
```

# Themes

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### Toggle

Example source: src/themes/__demos__/toggle.vue

```vue
<template>
  <c-space direction="column" fill>
    <c-space wrap>
      <c-button status="primary" @click="apply(Themes.default.light)">默认亮色</c-button>
      <c-button status="primary" @click="apply(Themes.default.dark)">默认暗色</c-button>
      <c-button status="primary" @click="apply(Themes.maple.light)">枫叶亮色</c-button>
      <c-button status="primary" @click="apply(Themes.maple.dark)">枫叶暗色</c-button>
    </c-space>

    <div class="preview c-rounded-md c-p-16">
      <div class="c-text-1 c-mb-8">主题预览</div>
      <div class="c-text-3 c-mb-16">主色按钮与语义文字会随 StyleProvider / cedar-theme 变化。</div>
      <c-space>
        <c-button status="primary">Primary</c-button>
        <c-button>Default</c-button>
        <span class="semantic-primary">primary</span>
        <span class="semantic-success">success</span>
        <span class="semantic-warning">warning</span>
      </c-space>
    </div>
  </c-space>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { StyleProvider, Themes, type StyleVars } from '@cedar-design/ui'

  StyleProvider.setStyleVars(theme)
}
</script>
```
